--- Support 배틀액션
--- 전설의 용사 에리나(legendary_hero) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('LegendaryHeroSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')
	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)

	self:apply_myth_option(params)
end

function local_class:apply_myth_option(param)
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(param, self.owner)
	if not has_myth_option then return end

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'TotalDpsMult')

	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, myth_param)
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec, self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.shoot_helper = nil
		self.proj_spec = nil

		self.cs_shooter = nil

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- instantiate cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, _)
	if self.target then
		battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.target,
			direction_util.to_4way_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.1) then
		--- 대상 방향
		local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target)

		--- instantiate slash effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'slash', self.owner.Position, direction)
	end

	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do repeat
		--- 판정 시점
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			--- 발사 사운드 재생
			projectile_spec_util.play_shoot_sfx(self.proj_spec[1])

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target)

			--- 라벨에 명시적으로 id를 넣어줘서 nil(0)이 쓰여 잘못된 대상에게 상태이상을 부여하는 것을 막음
			local label = index == #self.hit_timing and
				character_util.get_entity_id(self.target) or
				character_util.get_entity_id(self.owner)

			--- 투사체 발사
			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
				self.shoot_helper[1], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.5 * direction, direction, label
			)

			--- 카메라 연출
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.1)
		end

	until true end
end


function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		--- 대상에게 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage(hit_info.target, label)
	end

	return false
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, label)
	--- 데미지 계수 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
		self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier, #self.hit_timing
	)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	if character_util.get_entity_id(t) == label then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 해지
	self.target = nil
	self.trigger = false
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Support 배틀액션
--- 기록실 서기 란 (librarian) 2차 전용 무기 연계기
local local_class = newclass('Librarian2SupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 판정 데미지 계수
	self.hit_dps_multipliers = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitDpsMultipliers')

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- 판정 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 높이 = 시전자의 키
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 판정 정보, 판정의 시작은 지면부터.
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 최대 타수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--- 타겟 할당 해제
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil
	self.calculator = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = true

	--- 시전자 위치
	self.trigger_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner))
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target))
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 캐릭터가 대상 방향을 처다보도록 세팅한다
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.normalized(self.target_pos - self.trigger_pos))
	--- 시전 애니메이션 출력
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 방향 잠긴 부분 제거
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 삭제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)

	--- 시전 이펙트 타이밍 (땅 짚으며 먹물 튀는것..)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.28) then
		--- 손위치 얻기 - 바라보는 방향에 0.2정도 곱한 거리
		--- lock_dir가 걸려있어서 해당 내용 반영한걸로 방향을 얻는다.
		local dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
		local offset = dir_vector * 0.2
		--- 시전 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', self.trigger_pos + offset)
		--- 시전 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	end

	--- 데미지 타이밍 마다 체크 해준다.
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		--- 데미지 타이밍을 지나쳤는지 여부 검사
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			local is_first_hit = idx == 1
			local is_last_hit = idx == self.max_hit

			if is_first_hit then
				--- 장판 이펙트 생성
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
				--- 장판 사운드 출력
				battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')
			end

			if is_last_hit then
				--- 카메라 흔들기
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.23, 0.2)
			else
				--- 카메라 흔들기
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.12)
			end

			--- 각 판정별 데미지 계수 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.hit_dps_multipliers[idx])

			--- 생성 지점을 기준으로 연출
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- 피격 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, is_last_hit)
			end

			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_ailment)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 상태 이상 적용 + 연계기 대상에게만 적용
	if apply_ailment and lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.target) then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Support 배틀액션
--- 기록실 서기 란 (librarian) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('LibrarianSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')

	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'ShootTiming')

	self.heal_ratio = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HealRatio')

	self.single_modifier = self.damage_multiplier / #self.shoot_timing

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 현재 타격 횟수
	self.current_hit_count = 0

	self.allys = {}
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec, self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.shoot_helper = nil
		self.proj_spec = nil

		self.cs_shooter = nil

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true

	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 타격 횟수 초기화
	self.current_hit_count = 0

	for each_ally in pairs(self.allys) do
		self.allys[each_ally] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 대상 해지
	self.target = nil
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, _)
	for index = 1, #self.shoot_timing do repeat
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[index]) == false then
			break
		end

		--- 마지막 발사 시점
		local last_shoot = index == #self.shoot_timing

		--- 대상 방향
		local dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target)

		--- 인덱스에 따른 다른 연출을 위한 방향 계산
		if (index - 1) % 3 == 1 then
			dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -self:get_avail_angle(self.target.Position, 1), 0) * -dir
		elseif (index - 1) % 3 == 2 then
			dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self:get_avail_angle(self.target.Position, 1), 0) * -dir
		end

		--- 벡터 노말라이즈
		dir = vector_util.normalized(dir)

		--- shoot proj
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
			self.shoot_helper[1], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), dir,
			character_util.get_entity_id(self.target), nil, self.target
		)

		--- get party
		local party = party_manager:GetPartyFor(self.owner)

		--- check party
		if party == nil then break end

		-- stage 내의 멤버들을 얻어온다.
		local members = party:GetStageMembers()

		local loop = last_shoot and members.Count - index + 1 or 1

		--- 필요한 횟수 만큼 루프
		for _ = 1, loop do
			--- 최대 거리
			local max_dist = -1
			--- 대상 아군
			local target_ally

			--- 파티 순회
			for _, member in pairs(members) do repeat
				--- 힐 가능 여부 체크
				if battle_util.can_apply_heal(self.owner, member, false) == false then
					break
				end

				--- 대상과의 거리
				local dist = battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, member)

				--- 거리 및 중복 체크
				if max_dist >= dist or self.allys[member] then
					break
				end

				--- 정보 갱신
				max_dist = dist
				target_ally = member
			until true end

			--- 대상 아군이 없을 경우
			if target_ally == nil then
				break
			end

			--- 플래그 체크
			self.allys[target_ally] = true

			--- 대상이 본인이 아니라면
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(target_ally, self.owner) == false then
				--- 대상에게 힐탄을 발사
				self:shoot_heal_proj(target_ally)
			else
				--- 힐 적용
				self:apply_heal(target_ally)
			end

			--- 소환수를 가져옴
			local summoned = summonable_util.get_summmoned(target_ally)

			--- 소환수 루프
			for summon_index = 1, #summoned do
				self:shoot_heal_proj(summoned[summon_index])
			end
		end

		members:Dispose()
	until true end
end

function local_class:shoot_heal_proj(fo)
	--- 대상 방향
	local dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, fo)

	dir = vector_util.normalized(unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self:get_avail_angle(fo.Position, 2), 0) * dir)

	--- shoot proj
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper[2], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), dir, character_util.get_entity_id(fo), nil, fo
	)
end

function local_class:get_avail_angle(target_pos, label)
	--- 최대 발사 각
	local spin = 90

	local spec = self.proj_spec[label]

	--- 발사 각도를 꺾더라도 homing 에 의해 대상에게 명중할 수 있어야 하므로 최대 꺾을 수 있는 각도를 계산
	local dist = vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos), vector_util.get_x0z(self.owner.Position))

	local speed = battle_util.get_number(spec.Speed)

	--- 정면으로 날아간다 가정할 때 걸리는 시간 계산
	local est_time = math.min(dist / speed, battle_util.get_number(spec.Lifetime))

	--- 해당 시간 동안 꺾을 수 있는 각도 / 2
	local avail_angle = est_time * battle_util.get_number(spec.HomingAngularSpeed) / 2

	--- 최대각도와 가능각도 중 작은것으로 발사
	return math.min(avail_angle, spin)
end


function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 대상 엔티티
	local target_entity = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetCharacterByEntityId(label)

	if hit_info.target == nil then return true end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(target_entity, hit_info.target) then return false end

	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target_entity) then
		--- 타격 횟수 증가
		self.current_hit_count = self.current_hit_count + 1
		--- 대상에게 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage(target_entity, hit_info.position, hit_info.direction, self.current_hit_count == #self.shoot_timing)
	else
		self:apply_heal(target_entity)
	end

	return true
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, hit_pos, hit_dir, is_last_hit)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.single_modifier)
	damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolHitEffect.Create(
		self.proj_spec[1].HitPreset, hit_pos, hit_dir, false
	)

	if is_last_hit then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.3)
end


function local_class:apply_heal(t)
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = t
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(t) * self.heal_ratio)
	heal_info.healEffect = CS.Oak.BasicHealEffect.Instance

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	self.proj = {
		--- 이펙트
		fx = nil,
		--- 지나간 시간
		time_passed = 0,
		--- 라이프 타임
		life_time = 0,
		--- 발사 위치
		start_pos = nil,
		--- 종료 위치

		--- 투사체 방향

	}
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()

end

function local_class:update_always(dt)
	if self.proj.fx then
		self.proj.time_passed = self.proj.time_passed + dt

		local progress = self.proj.time_passed / self.proj.life_time

		local current_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.proj.start_pos, self.proj.target_pos, progress)

		--- update proj fx
		effect_util.update_object(self.proj.fx, current_pos, self.proj.direction)

		--- on expired
		if progress >= 1 then
			--- explosion
			self:on_explosion(self.proj.target_pos)

			--- clear projectile
			self:clear_proj()
		end
	end
end


function local_class:on_force_cancel()
	if self.proj.fx then
		--- instantiate hit effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', self.proj.fx.transform.localPosition)

		--- play hit sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

		--- clear projectile
		self:clear_proj()
	end
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true

	--- 대상 캐싱
	self.target = info.target
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = info.target.Position
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.owner.Position))
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- set anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- instantiate cast effect
	self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.5 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector
	)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

	battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Special1)

	--- 캐릭터 흔들기
	character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.1, self.shoot_timing)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	if self.trigger == false then return end
	--- dispose cast fx
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx, true)
	self.cast_fx = nil

	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 해지
	self.target = nil
	--- 대상 위치 해지
	self.target_pos = nil
	--- 대상 방향 해지
	self.dir_vector = nil

	--- 트리거 여부 초기화
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, _)
	--- 발사 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- dispose cast fx
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx, true)
		self.cast_fx = nil

		--- instantiate cast effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'fire', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.5 * self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector
		)

		--- play hit sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'fire')

		--- 카메라 연출
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.3)

		local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner).y)

		--- shoot projectile
		self:shoot_proj(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + 0.5 * self.dir_vector, target_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_proj(center_pos, target_pos)
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - center_pos)
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	local distance = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

	--- shoot pos
	local shoot_pos = center_pos + 1.3 * direction

	--- 바로 터지는 시점
	if distance < 1 then
		--- on explosion
		self:on_explosion(target_pos)
		--- 투사체 발사
	else
		self.proj.fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'proj', shoot_pos, direction)
		self.proj.time_passed = 0
		self.proj.life_time = distance / self.speed
		self.proj.start_pos = shoot_pos
		self.proj.target_pos = target_pos
		self.proj.direction = direction
	end
end

function local_class:clear_proj()
	--- dispose fx
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj.fx)

	self.proj.fx = nil
	self.proj.time_passed = nil
	self.proj.life_time = nil
	self.proj.start_pos = nil
	self.proj.target_pos = nil
	self.proj.direction = nil
end

function local_class:on_explosion(position)
	--- instantiate explosion effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', battle_util.get_ground_pos(position))

	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self, self.owner, 'screen')

	--- atk modifier
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(position, self.radius)

	for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.32, 0.65)
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- fill ailment
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(t, self.target) then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('MaamSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 타격 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')
	--- 최대 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing
	--- 대미지 계수
	self.hit_dps_multipier = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "HitDpsMultipliers")

	--- 판정 반지름
	radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 시전 위치
	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)

	--- 방향
	self.dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target)

	local distance = 3

	local ground_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos)
	local center = ground_pos + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * vector_util.up
	local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner) * 1.5)

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, distance * -self.dir_vector
	)

	--- 가까운 대상이 존재할때
	if closest_object then
		--- 충돌 최소 거리
		local ray_dist = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(
			bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), -self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 실제 이동가능한 거리 갱신
		distance = math.min(distance, ray_dist)
	end

	--- 첫 목표 위치
	local diff = self.target_pos - self.trigger_pos
	self.need_adjust = vector_util.magnitude(diff) < 3
	self.first_pos = self.need_adjust and self.target_pos - distance * self.dir_vector or self.trigger_pos

	--- 도달 목표 위치
	self.dest_pos = self.target_pos - math.min(distance, 0.5) * self.dir_vector

	--- 돌진시 존 이탈 방지
	local zone = battle_util.get_event_zone(self.owner, self.target)
	local zone_bound = nil
	if zone then
		zone_bound = zone.Bounds
	end
	--- 돌진시 뚫고 나갈 경우 위치를 보정해준다.
	if zone_bound then
		self.first_pos = bounds_util.convert_position_to_inside(
			zone_bound, self.owner, self.first_pos,
			self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner).extents.x
		)

		self.dest_pos = bounds_util.convert_position_to_inside(
			zone_bound, self.owner, self.dest_pos,
			self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner).extents.x
		)
	end
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 충돌 무시 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
	support_action_util.change_to_ethereal_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 애니 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- 캐스트 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self,
		'cast',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	--- 카메라 쉐이킹
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.15)

	--- 충돌체 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

	--- 스페셜 대사 재생
	battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Special1)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.2) then
		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	end

	--- 0.3 ~ 0.35초 적 앞으로 이동
	if self.need_adjust and battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.3, 0.35) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - 0.3) / 0.05, 1)
		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.trigger_pos, self.first_pos, progress)
		--- 새로운 위치까지의 diff
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff)
		end
	end

	--- 0.35 돌진 이펙트 추력
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.35) then
		--- 애니 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'dash')
		--- 대시 이펙트
		self.dash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self,
			'dash',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			self.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)
		--- 카메라 쉐이킹
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.2)
	end

	--- 0.45 ~ 0.55초 적 앞으로 이동
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.45, 0.55) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - 0.45) / 0.1, 1)
		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.first_pos, self.dest_pos, progress)
		--- 새로운 위치까지의 diff
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff)
		end
	end

	--- 0.9 대시 이펙트 잔상 남지 않도록 정리
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.9) then
		--- 애니 제거
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		--- 이펙트 제거
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.dash_fx)
		self.dash_fx = nil
	end

	--- 0.9 ~ 1초 원위치
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.9, 1) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - 0.9) / 0.1, 1)
		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.dest_pos, self.trigger_pos, progress)
		--- 새로운 위치까지의 diff
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
				self.owner, vector_util.normalized(diff), dist, CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreCrash | CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope
			)
		end
	end

	--- 0.6, 0.72초 히트 타이밍
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			local first_hit = idx == 1
			local last_hit = idx == self.max_hit

			--- 첫 히트는 폭발 연출
			if first_hit then
				local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5
				local preset_key = self.dir_vector.x > 0 and 'attackrev' or 'attack'

				--- 충격파 이펙트
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self,
					preset_key,
					self.target_pos + height * vector_util.up,
					self.dir_vector
				)
				--- 효과음 출력
				battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'attack')
				--- 카메라 쉐이킹
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.5, 0.5)
			end

			--- 판정 처리
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.hit_dps_multipier[idx])
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
			for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, last_hit and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target))
			end
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거가 안된 경우는 생략함
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 시전 위치로 돌아감
	support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.trigger_pos)
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 해제
	support_action_util.change_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, nil)

	--- 이펙트 제거
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.dash_fx)
	self.dash_fx = nil

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 대상 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	self.target = nil
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_ailment)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 기본 사운드 mute
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	if apply_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('MechaAndroidSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true

	local diff = self.target.Position - self.owner.Position
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(diff))

	--- 고정할 방향
	self.be_locked = diff.x > 0 and
		CS.Oak.Direction.Right or
		(diff.x < 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Left or direction_util.to_side_dir(vector_util.to_direction(diff)))

	if vector_util.magnitude(self.dir_vector) == 0 then
		self.dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.be_locked)
	end

	--- 시작 위치
	self.trigger_pos = self.owner.Position

	--- 첫번째 도달 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = self.target.Position

	local distance = 4

	local ground_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target.Position)
	local center = ground_pos + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up
	local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner) * 1.5)

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, 4 * -self.dir_vector
	)

	if closest_object then
		--- 충돌 최소 거리
		local ray_dist = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(
			bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), -self.dir_vector, false, false
		)

		distance = math.min(distance, ray_dist)
	end

	--- 대시 시작할 위치
	self.start_pos = self.target_pos + distance * -self.dir_vector

	--- 두번째 도달 목표 위치
	self.jump_dest_pos = self.target_pos + 2 * self.dir_vector

	--- 돌진시 존 이탈 방지
	local zone = battle_util.get_event_zone(self.owner, self.target)
	local zone_bound = nil
	if zone then zone_bound = zone.Bounds end
	--- 돌진시 뚫고 나갈 경우 위치를 보정해준다.
	if zone_bound then
		self.start_pos = bounds_util.convert_position_to_inside(
			zone_bound, self.owner, self.start_pos,
			self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner).extents.x
		)
		self.jump_dest_pos = bounds_util.convert_position_to_inside(
			zone_bound, self.owner, self.jump_dest_pos,
			-self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner).extents.x
		)
	end
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 충돌 무시 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
	support_action_util.change_to_ethereal_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action)
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.be_locked)

	--- 적절한 애니메이션 재생
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 이펙트를 위한 본 캐싱
	local weapon_slot = '[base]elbowL'
	self.weapon_bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.owner, weapon_slot).Bone

	--- 이펙트 생성 위치, 방향 계산
	local bone_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -self.weapon_bone.WorldRotationX, 0) * unity_class.vector3.right
	local init_pos = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(self.weapon_bone, self.owner)

	--- 이펙트 생성 오프셋
	local offset = -0.25

	self.sword_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'sword', init_pos - offset * bone_rot, bone_rot)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'sword')

	--- 스페셜 대사 재생
	battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Special1)

	self.need_hide = true
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	if old_time_passed > 0 and self.need_hide then
		self.is_hide = false
		character_util.hide_weapon(self.owner, true, 'support')
	end

	--- 0 ~ 0.2초 첫 자리 잡아줌
	if 0 <= time_passed and old_time_passed < 0.2 then
		local progress = math.min(time_passed / 0.2, 1)

		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.trigger_pos, self.start_pos, progress)
		local diff = new_pos - self.owner.Position

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) == false then
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff)
		end
	end

	--- 0.2초 대시 시작할 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.2) then
		--- 이펙트 생성
		self.dash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'dash',
			self.owner.Position, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- 이펙트 방향 세팅
		local setter = self.dash_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.EffectDirectionSetter))
		setter:SetActiveByDirection(self.be_locked)
	end

	--- 0.2 ~ 0.35초 적 위치까지 돌진하는 연출
	if 0.2 <= time_passed and old_time_passed < 0.35 then
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - 0.2) / 0.15, 1)
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.start_pos, self.target_pos, progress)

		local diff = new_pos - self.owner.Position

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) == false then
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff)
		end
	end

	--- 0.3초 적 히트 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.3) then
		--- 적당히 카메라 흔들어줌
		stage_camera:Shake(0.08, 0.3)

		--- 베기 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'slash',
			self.target_pos + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up, self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 베기 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'slash')

		--- 타격 이펙트 생성
		local hit = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'hit',
			self.target_pos + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up, self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 이펙트 방향 세팅
		local setter = hit:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.EffectDirectionSetter))
		setter:SetActiveByDirection(self.be_locked)

		--- 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage()

		--- 벽은 관통 못하는 충돌 무시 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
		support_action_util.change_to_pass_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 0.35 ~ 0.4초 적 뒤로 돌진하는 연출
	if 0.35 <= time_passed and old_time_passed < 0.4 then
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - 0.35) / 0.05, 1)
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.target_pos, self.jump_dest_pos, progress)

		local diff = new_pos - self.owner.Position

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) == false then
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff)
		end
	end

	--- 0.4초 돌진 완료
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.4) then
		--- 벽에 부딪혀 더 못갔을 경우를 대비해 갱신
		self.jump_dest_pos = self.owner.Position

		--- dispose dash fx
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.dash_fx)
		self.dash_fx = nil
	end

	--- 0.6초 원래 위치로 돌아가기 위한 연출
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.6) then
		character_util.hide_weapon(self.owner, false, 'support')

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.sword_fx)
		self.sword_fx = nil

		self.owner:Jump(0.7, 0.3, false)

		--- 충돌 무시 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
		support_action_util.change_to_ethereal_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 0.6 ~ 0.8초 점프하여 제자리로 되돌아옴
	if 0.6 <= time_passed and old_time_passed < 0.8 then
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - 0.6) / 0.2, 1)
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.jump_dest_pos, self.trigger_pos, progress)

		local diff = new_pos - self.owner.Position
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) == false then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
				self.owner, vector_util.normalized(diff), dist, CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreCrash | CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope
			)
		end
	end

	--- 이펙트 위치 갱신
	if self.sword_fx then
		--- 이펙트 생성 위치, 방향 계산
		local bone_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -self.weapon_bone.WorldRotationX, 0) * unity_class.vector3.right
		local init_pos = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(self.weapon_bone, self.owner)

		local offset = -0.25

		effect_util.update_object(self.sword_fx, init_pos - offset * bone_rot, bone_rot)
	end
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 시전 중이 아니라면 생략함
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 시전 위치로 돌아감
	support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.trigger_pos)
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 해제
	support_action_util.change_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, nil)

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.sword_fx)
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.dash_fx)

	self.dash_fx = nil
	self.sword_fx = nil
	self.weapon_bone = nil

	character_util.hide_weapon(self.owner, false, 'support')
	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	self.target = nil
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage()
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = self.target
	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
	damage_info.force_ailment = true

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- 모디파이어 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)
		--- 피해 부여
		self:apply_damage(self.target, modifier)
		--- 대상에게 피격 이펙트 부여
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(self.target))
		--- play sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'heal')
		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.3)

		--- 힐 이펙트 연출 처리
		local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)

		--- 파티원 순회
		for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
			--- 생존 체크
			if character_util.is_dead(member) then break end

			--- 힐 이펙트 생성
			--- [부쉬] 이펙트 오너쉽 부여
			battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(
				self,
				'heal',
				member,
				character_util.get_position(member),
				nil,
				character_util.get_transform(member),
				parent_follow_flag.position
			)

			--- 소환된 소환수 순회
			for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
				--- 힐 이펙트 생성
				--- [부쉬] 이펙트 오너쉽 부여
				battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(
					self,
					'heal',
					summonable,
					character_util.get_position(summonable),
					nil,
					character_util.get_transform(summonable),
					parent_follow_flag.position
				)
			end

		until true end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.buff_timing) then
		local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)

		--- 파티원 순회
		for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
			--- 생존 체크
			if character_util.is_dead(member) then break end

			--- 버프 부여
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, member, self.buff_info)

			--- 소환된 소환수 순회
			for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
				--- 버프 부여
				buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, summonable, self.buff_info)
			end

		until true end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- 상태 이상 적용
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
	damage_info.force_ailment = true

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	)

	--- 타격 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- max hit
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	--- damage scale
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MainDamageScale')

	--- sub damage scale
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (self.max_hit - 1)

	--- radius
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')
	--- 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
		radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true
	)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- ground timing
	self.ground_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'GroundTiming')

	--- explosion timing
	self.explosion_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ExplosionTiming')

	--- 연계기 버프 정보
	self.support_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params, 'Buff')
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--- 타겟 할당 해제
	self.target = nil

	--- 이펙트 해제
	if self.fx_ground then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_ground)
		self.fx_ground = nil
	end

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = true

	--- 시작 위치
	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.trigger_pos))

	--- cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 캐릭터가 대상 방향을 처다보도록 세팅한다
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 판정 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

	--- 마법진 이펙트
	self.fx_ground = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'ground', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos))

	--- 버프 부여
	buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.support_buff_info, true)

	--- cast sound
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

	--- cast sound
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

	--- 커스텀 darken
	support_action_util.set_darken_on_declare(self.owner, self, nil, 0.4)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 암전 해제
	support_action_util.unset_darken(self)

	--- 이펙트 해제
	if self.fx_ground then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_ground)
		self.fx_ground = nil
	end

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false
	--- 방향 잠긴 부분 제거
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 삭제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)

	--- 암전 해제 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.4) then
		support_action_util.unset_darken(self, 1)
	end

	--- 폭발 이펙트
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.explosion_timing) then

		--- 마법진 이펙트 해제
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_ground)
		self.fx_ground = nil

		--- 폭발 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos))
	end

	--- 3회 히트
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

		--- 피격 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 막타 여부
		local is_last_hit = idx == self.max_hit

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.15)

		--- 액션 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)

		--- 데미지 부여
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, is_last_hit)
		end

	until true end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, m, is_last_hit)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m * (is_last_hit and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale)

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	--- 상태 이상 적용은 막타에만
	if is_last_hit and lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, t) then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 대상 순회
		for _, t in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
			--- 상태 이상 연계 여부
			local apply_ailment = lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, t)
			--- 데미지 적용
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier, apply_ailment)
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기 판정 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, modifier, apply_ailment)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 상태이상을 적용해야 할 경우
	if apply_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 배틀볼 소녀의 연계기
local local_class = newclass('NecromancerSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params = params
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- 소환수가 주는 데미지의 타입
	self.summoned_damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'SummonedDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
			cs_action, params)

	-- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 내 캐릭터의 dps 배율
	self.character_dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CharacterDpsMultiplier')

	--- 소환된 추종자들의 dps
	self.summoned_dps_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SummonedDpsMultiplier')

	--- 히트할 시간
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- 옵션이 적용 되었는 지 여부
	self.activate_option = false

	--- 전용 무기 옵션 체크
	self:apply_option(self.cs_action, params)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_start(info)
	self.target = info.target

	--- 표정 및 연출 실행
	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, "cast")
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

	local vfx_cast_key = 'cast'

	--- 소환수 있으면 다른 이펙트
	if #summonable_util.get_summmoned(self.character) ~= 0 then
		vfx_cast_key = vfx_cast_key .. '_enhanced'
	end

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, vfx_cast_key, bounds_util.get_center(self.target), nil)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- 히트할 시간이 되면
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		local vfx_explosion_key = 'explosion'

		--- 소환수 있으면 다른 이펙트
		if #summonable_util.get_summmoned(self.character) ~= 0 then
			vfx_explosion_key = vfx_explosion_key .. '_enhanced'
		end

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, vfx_explosion_key, bounds_util.get_center(self.target))
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, self.target) then
			--- 캐릭터 DPS 기반으로 피해를 입힘
			local character_dps = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
					self.cs_action, self.character_dps_multiplier)
			self:apply_damage(self.damage_type, self.target, character_dps, false, true)

			--- 소환수 DPS 기반으로 피해를 입힘.
			local summoned_table = summonable_util.get_summmoned(self.character)

			--- 소환수 있을 때만 발동
			if #summoned_table ~= 0 then
				local summoned_dps = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
						self.cs_action, self.summoned_dps_multiplier)

				self:apply_damage(self.summoned_damage_type, self.target, summoned_dps,
						self.activate_option, false)
			end

		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	self.target = nil

	self.animation_info = nil
	self.emotion_info = nil
	self.preset_info = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

--- 옵션 적용
function local_class:apply_option(cs_action, params)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.character)

	if activate_option then
		self.activate_option = true

		--- 옵션 적용할 데미지 계수
		self.option_heal_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'HealModifier')
	end
end

-- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(damage_type, target, modifier, is_option, apply_force_ailment)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	if apply_force_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	local result_info = command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	if is_option then
		--- 힐관련 계수가 존재 한다면
		if self.option_heal_multiplier and self.option_heal_multiplier > 0 then
			--- DamageCommand일 경우에만 적용
			--- 크레이그의 '전우 보호'가 발동할 경우 힐하지 않음 (DamageReplaceCommand)
			if result_info then
				self:apply_heal(self.character, result_info:GetTotalDamage() * self.option_heal_multiplier)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 흡혈 적용
--- @param damage number 가한 데미지
function local_class:apply_heal(target, amount)
	if amount > 0 then
		local summoned_table = summonable_util.get_summonables(self.character)

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.type = heal_type.drain
		heal_info.sender = summoned_table[1]
		heal_info.target = target
		heal_info.heal = math.floor(amount)

		command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
