--- Support 배틀액션
--- 백사장 용기사 샤피라 (summer_shapira) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('SummerShapiraSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')
	--- 삽에서 빔이 발사되는 시점
	self.cast_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CastTiming')
	--- 삽에서 빔이 발사되는 시점
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackTiming')
	--- 판정 시점
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')
	--- 빛이 반사될 위치
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Offset')
	--- 판정 최대 횟수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	self.beam_duration = 0.05
	self.beam_timing = self.hit_timing[1] - self.beam_duration

	--- 버프 정보 파싱
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params)    --- 트리거 여부
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--- 타겟 할당 해제
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = true

	--- 시작 위치
	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.target)
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 케스트 애니메이션 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 휘황찬란한 태양의 힘을 느낄 수 있는 스크린 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self, self.owner)
	--- 캐스트 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 애니메이션 할당 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- 삽이 번쩍 거리는 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.cast_timing) then
		--- 캐스트 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	end
	--- 삽이 번쩍 거리는 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		local fire_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + vector_util.up * self.offset
		self.target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.target)
		local diff = self.target_pos - fire_pos
		local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(diff)
		local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

		--- 번쩍 들은 삽에서 빛이 나면서 빔을 쏜다
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'fire', fire_pos, dir_vector)
		--- 벡터값으로 instantiate 하면 y축 성분을 제거한다. (pooledunityobject 확장함수에서 제거해버림.)
		local beam_quaternion = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(vector_util.left, dir_vector)
		local laser_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'laser', fire_pos, beam_quaternion)
		--- 폭발 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'laser')
		--- 레이저 이펙트 스케일 조정
		laser_fx.transform.localScale = vector(magnitude / 10, 1, 1)

		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.15)
	end

	--- 판정 타이밍 순회
	for index = 1, self.max_hit do
		repeat
			--- 타이밍 안지났으면 스킵
			if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then break end

			--- 첫번째 판정
			local first_hit = index == 1
			--- 마지막 판정
			local last_hit = index == self.max_hit

			if first_hit then
				local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(self.target_pos - self.trigger_pos)
				--- 삽에 반사된 태양이 상대에게 히트하는 연출. 상대한테 붙여져 있어야한다.
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(self.target), dir_vector
				)
			end

			--- 카메라 흔들기
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.12)

			--- 마지막 판정일 경우
			if last_hit then
				--- CC와 데미지 적용
				self:apply_damage(self.target, true)
				--- 아군들에게 버프 적용
				self:apply_ally_buff()
			else
				--- 처음 다단 히트에선 미적용
				self:apply_damage(self.target, false)
			end
		until true
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, apply_ailment)
	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
		self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier, self.max_hit
	)

	--- 상태 이상 적용
	if apply_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function local_class:apply_ally_buff()
	--- 스테이지 멤버
	local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)

	--- 파티원 순회
	for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do
		repeat
			--- 생존 체크
			if character_util.is_dead(member) then break end
			--- 파티원에게 버프 적용
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, member, self.buff_info, false)

			for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
				--- 소환수에게 버프 적용
				buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, summonable, self.buff_info, false)
			end
		until true
	end

end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Support 배틀액션
--- 신입 선녀 다빈(sunyeo) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('SunyeoSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, param, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, param
	)
	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	self.fire_fx_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FireFx')
	self.shoot_anim_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootAnim')
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--region damage field
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	local height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Height')
	local duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Duration')

	--- 판정 크기
	local size = vector(length, height, width)
	---밸런스로 1회만 히트
	local max_hit = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxHit')

	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, duration, nil, true)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, true, 0, max_hit)
	--endregion

	--region damage info
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TotalDpsMult')
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--endregion

	self.offset_table = {}
	self.offset_table[direction_util.left] = { shoot_offset = vector(0, 0, 0.6), fire_offset = vector(0, 0, 0.3) }
	self.offset_table[direction_util.right] = { shoot_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.6), fire_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.3) }
	self.offset_table[direction_util.up] = { shoot_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.7), fire_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.4) }
	self.offset_table[direction_util.down] = { shoot_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.2), fire_offset = vector(0, 0, -0.2) }

	self:apply_myth_option(param)
end

function local_class:apply_myth_option(param)
	--전무 개화 분기
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(param, self.owner)
	if not has_myth_option then return end

	self.damage_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'TotalDpsMult')
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--- 타겟 할당 해제
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = true

	--- 시작 위치
	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)

	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.trigger_pos))

	support_action_util.set_darken_on_declare(self.owner, self)
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))

	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 시전자 위치에서의 시전 fx 생성
	self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self,
		'fire',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		self.dir_vector
	)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, 0.1)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	self.fire_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then return end

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
	self.cast_fx = nil

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false

	support_action_util.unset_darken(self, 0.5)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- 발사각 상시 제어
	self.fire_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	--- 대상 추적
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
		local dir_type = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
		local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(vector_util.right, self.dir_vector)
		local fire_offset = vector_util.normalized(self.dir_vector + rot * self.offset_table[dir_type].fire_offset)
		spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, self.fire_pos + fire_offset, self.fire_pos)
	else
		self.fire_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, self.fire_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end

	-- 발사 반동 애니
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_anim_timing) then
		--- 발사 애니메이션
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'shoot')
	end

	--- 발사 연출 및 판정 시작
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.trigger_pos)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.4, 0.2)
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.4)
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.5)

		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
		--- 시전자 위치에서의 시전 fx 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self,
			'laser',
			battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner)),
			self.dir_vector
		)

		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'shoot')

		support_action_util.unset_darken(self, 0.5)

		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, nil, -self.dir_vector, 0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, false, 0, true
		)

		local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
		if look_dir == direction_util.left or look_dir == direction_util.right then
			character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.4, 0.3, 0.4, 0)
		elseif look_dir == direction_util.up then
			character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.2, 0.0, 0.4, -30)
		else
			character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.2, 0.0, 0.4, 20)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.6) then
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'knockback2')
	end

	--- 판정 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_modifier)

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 데미지 적용
		for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
			local apply_ailment = lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.target)

			self:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_ailment)

			--- 시전자 위치에서의 시전 fx 생성
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self,
				'hit',
				bounds_util.get_center(target)
			)
		end
	end

	--- 0.6
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_ailment)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	--- 연계기 주 대상에게만 적용
	if apply_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Support 배틀액션
--- 해변의 과학자 소히(surfer_sohee) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('SurferSoheeSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')

	self.speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Speed')

	self.hit_heal_ratio = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'EachTargetHealRatio')

	self.max_heal_ratio= cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MaxHealRatio')

	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Length')
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Width')

	self.life_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'LifeTime')

	local size = vector(self.length, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, width)

	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, self.life_time)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, info)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target
	--- 타겟 위치
	self.target_pos = self.target.Position
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(self.target_pos - self.owner.Position)
	--- 시작 위치
	self.start_pos = self.target_pos - (self.speed * self.life_time * 0.5) * self.dir_vector

	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true

	--- 현재 힐을 한 횟수
	self.count = 0
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- set action anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 시전 sfx 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'action')

	--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 세팅
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.start_pos)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- instantiate wave fx
	self.wave_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'wave', self.start_pos, self.dir_vector)
	--- 해일 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'wave')

	--- instantiate cast fx
	local cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	--- 캐스트 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

	--- 이펙트 오프셋
	local offset = 1.7

	--- 방향에 맞는 연출
	if character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner) == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		cast_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
		cast_fx.transform.localPosition = cast_fx.transform.localPosition + offset * unity_class.vector3.right

		--- 360도 회전
		spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(360, 0.4)
	else
		cast_fx.transform.localScale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
		cast_fx.transform.localPosition = cast_fx.transform.localPosition + offset * unity_class.vector3.left

		--- 360도 회전
		spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(-360, 0.4)
	end

	--- 점프
	character_util.jump(self.owner, 1, 0.4, 0, true)

	if battle_util.is_local_fo(self.owner) then
		stage_camera:Shake(0.075, self.life_time)
	end

	--- 스킬 2 보이스 재생
	battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Skill2)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, _, dt)
	--- 충돌 판정 활성화
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator)
		and not area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
		--- 현재 위치
		local current_pos = self.start_pos + math.min(time_passed, self.life_time) * self.speed * self.dir_vector

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, current_pos)

		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
			self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier, area_collision_util.get_max_hit(self.calculator)
		)

		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, target) then
					self:apply_damage(target, modifier, true)
				else
					--- 연계기 대상이 아니면 그냥 데미지만 입히자
					self:apply_damage(target, modifier, false)
				end
			end
		end

		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(0, 0)

	self.wave_fx = nil

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	self.trigger = false

	self.target = nil
	self.target_pos = nil
	self.start_pos = nil
	self.dir_vector = nil
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	self.calculator = nil

	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

	self.animation_info = nil
	self.emotion_info = nil
	self.preset_info = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, modifier, apply_ailment)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	if apply_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	if self.count * self.hit_heal_ratio < self.max_heal_ratio then
		self.count = self.count + 1

		self:apply_heal_party()
	end
end

function local_class:apply_heal_party()
	local party = party_manager:GetPartyFor(self.owner)

	--- 파티가 존재할때만
	if party == nil then return end

	local members = party:GetStageMembers()

	for _, member in pairs(members) do
		if character_util.is_dead(member) == false then
			--- apply heal
			self:apply_heal(member)

			--- 소환수 힐 적용
			local summonables = summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)

			for index = 1, #summonables do
				self:apply_heal(summonables[index])
			end
		end
	end

	members:Dispose()
end

--- 실제 힐 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_heal(target)
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(target) * self.hit_heal_ratio)

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	self:apply_ascent_option(params)

function local_class:apply_ascent_option(param)

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 승급 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_ascent_option = true

		--- parsing each info
		battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self, self.cs_action, option_param)

		--- 버프 정보 갱신
		self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param)
	end

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil

end

function local_class:on_declare(info)

	self.target = info.target
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 애니메이션 재생
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- 캐스트 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', character_util.get_position(self.owner))
	--- 캐스트 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

	--- 스테이지 멤버
	local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)

	--- 파티원 순회
	for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
		--- 생존 체크
		if character_util.is_dead(member) then break end

		--- 버프 이펙트 생성
		--- [부쉬] 이펙트 오너쉽 부여
		battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(
			self, 'buff', member, character_util.get_position(member), nil, character_util.get_transform(member)
		)

		--- 소환된 소환수 순회
		for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
			--- 버프 이펙트 생성
			--- [부쉬] 이펙트 오너쉽 부여
			battle_util.instantiate_ownership_effect(
				self, 'buff', summonable,
				character_util.get_position(summonable), nil, character_util.get_transform(summonable)
			)

		end
	until true end
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 애니메이션 할당 해제
	battle_util.set_anim(self.cs_action)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, _)
	--- 도발할 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.taunt_timing) then
		--- 현재 진행중인 전투
		local battle = battle_manager_util.get_battle_for(self.owner)

		--- 전투가 존재할 경우
		if battle then
			--- 도발 양
			local aggro_amount = character_util.get_dps(self.owner) * self.aggro_multiplier

			--- 전투의 타겟들
			local targets = battle_manager_util.get_targets(self.owner)

			--- 비교용 ActiveState 캐시
			local active_in_field = CS.Oak.ActiveState.InField
			local active_disabled = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

			--- 타겟 순회
			for _, target in pairs(targets) do
				--- 대상이 유효한 경우
				--- 전투에는 참여했으나 실제론 동작하지 않는 경우가 있어 ActiveState 체크를 추가함
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) and target.ActiveState & active_in_field ~= active_disabled then
					--- 도발 커맨드 발행
					command_util.publish_aggro_add(self.owner, target, aggro_amount)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	--- 판정 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- 아군 버프 적용
		self:apply_ally_buff()

		--- 데미지 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 대상 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage(self.target, modifier)
	end
end

function local_class:apply_ally_buff()
	--- 스테이지 멤버
	local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)

	--- 파티원 순회
	for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
		--- 생존 체크
		if character_util.is_dead(member) then break end

		--- 파티원에게 버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, member, self.buff_info, true)

		--- 소환된 소환수 순회
		for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
			--- 소환수에게 버프 적용
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, summonable, self.buff_info, true)

		end
	until true end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect.Create(bounds_util.get_center(t))
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
	damage_info.force_ailment = true

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Support 배틀액션
--- 쌍둥이 안드로이드 니프티 (twins_android) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('TwinsAndroidSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(cs_action, params)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')
	--- 타격 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	--- 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')

	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
		radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true
	)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	self:apply_option(params)
	self:apply_myth_option(params)

	--- 데미지 균등 분배
	self.damage_multiplier = self.damage_multiplier / self.max_hit
end

function local_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do
		repeat
			--- 옵션 유효성 확인
			local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

			--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
			if activate_option == false then
				break
			end

			--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
			local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

			if is_special then
			else
				self.activate_cwp_option = true
				self.cwp_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'Debuff')
				-- 개화 버프 가져오기용 파싱
				local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(option_param, self.owner)
				self.activate_cwp_option = myth_activate_option
				if myth_activate_option then
					self.cwp_debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(myth_option_param, 'Debuff')
				end
			end

		until true
	end
end

function local_class:apply_myth_option(param)

	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(param, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'TotalDpsMult')
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--- 타겟 할당 해제
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = true

	--- 시작 위치
	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.trigger_pos))
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 캐릭터가 대상 방향을 처다보도록 세팅한다
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	--- 애니 재생
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- 캐스트 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', battle_util.get_ground_pos(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)))
	--- 커스텀 darken
	support_action_util.set_darken_on_declare(self.owner, self)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then return end

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false
	--- 방향 잠긴 부분 제거
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 삭제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 암전 해제
	support_action_util.unset_darken(self, 0.7)

	--- 캐시 이펙트 dispose
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.laser_fx)
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.ground_fx)

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 전환
	self.trigger = false

	self.dir_vector = nil
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- 대상 지면에서 레이져 위성 타격
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.3) then
		--- 충돌체 세팅
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
		self.laser_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'laser', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos))
		self.ground_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'ground', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos))
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')
	end

	--- 다단히트
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			local is_last_hit = idx == self.max_hit

			if is_last_hit then
				--- 암전 해제
				support_action_util.unset_darken(self, 0.7)
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.2)
			else
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.12)
			end

			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
			local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

			--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 반환함
			if #hit_targets == 0 then break end

			--- 각각 적중한 대상들에게 피해 적용
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				--막타의 주 대상만 cc 판정
				local is_apply_ailment = lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.target) and is_last_hit
				self:apply_damage(target, battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier), is_apply_ailment)
			end


		 end
	until true end


	--- 다단히트
	--for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
	--	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx] + 0.05) then
	--		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.18)
	--	end
	--until true end

end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_ailment)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	--- 상태 이상 적용
	if apply_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 전무 옵션 발동
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, target, self.cwp_debuff_info)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, _)

		--- 케스트 애니메이션 설정
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

		--- 캐스트 이펙트 생성

		--- 캐스트 사운드 재생

		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.3)
	end

	--- 판정 타이밍 순회
	for index = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍 체크
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			break
		end

		--- 첫번째 판정
		if index == 1 then
			--- 폭발 애니메이션 설정
			battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'explosion')

			--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
			--- 폭발 사운드 재생
			battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

			--- 카메라 흔들기
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.23, 0.9)
		end

		--- 데미지 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
			self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier, self.max_hit
		)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 지정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 마지막 판정
		local last_hit = index == self.max_hit

		--- 충돌체 계산기 대상 순회
		for _, t in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
			--- 상태 이상 연계 여부
			local apply_ailment = lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, t) and last_hit
			--- 데미지 적용
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier, apply_ailment)

			--- 마지막 판정일 경우
			if last_hit then
				--- 디버프 적용
				buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, t, self.debuff_info)
			end
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기 판정 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	until true end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, modifier, apply_ailment)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 상태이상을 적용해야 할 경우
	if apply_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,

local local_class = newclass('UptownLancerGirlSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	local cast_sfx_info = self.sfx_info['cast']

	--- 파라미터를 읽지 못해서 직접 넣어줌
	cast_sfx_info.pitch = 1.6
	cast_sfx_info.startClipTime = 1.5

	self.sfx_info['cast'] = cast_sfx_info

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	self.trigger_distance = 3

	self.rect_length = 10
	self.rect_breadth = 2
	self.rect_height = 2
	self.rect_offset = -1.5
	self.rect_hit_timing = 0.6
	self.rect_dps_mult = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'rectDpsMult')

	--- 전용 무기 옵션이 발동된 상태인가
	self.activate_cwp_option = self:apply_option(self.cs_action, params)
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--- 전용 무기 옵션이 발동된 상태였을때
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		--- 버프 정보 해지
		self.buff_info = nil
	end

	if self.umbrella_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.umbrella_fx)
		self.umbrella_fx = nil
	end

	if self.calculator then
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		self.calculator = nil
	end

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	self.target = info.target

	--- 고정할 방향
	local dir_toward = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target)

	--- 고정할 방향
	local be_locked = dir_toward.x > 0 and
		CS.Oak.Direction.Right or
		(dir_toward.x < 0 and
			CS.Oak.Direction.Left or
			direction_util.to_side_dir(vector_util.to_direction(dir_toward)))

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, be_locked)

	self.shoot_direction = be_locked
	self.portal_position = self.target.Position - direction_util.to_vector3(be_locked) * self.trigger_distance
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 포탈 sfx 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'cast', self.portal_position)

	--- start 시점에 이펙트 재생
	self.umbrella_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', self.portal_position)

	--- 오른쪽으로 발사한다면 flip해야 한다.
	self.umbrella_fx.transform.localScale = self.shoot_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right and
		vector(-1, 1, 1) or
		unity_class.vector3.one

	local collision_info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	collision_info.Center = self.portal_position + direction_util.to_vector3(self.shoot_direction) * (self.rect_length / 2 + self.rect_offset) + unity_class.vector3.up * (self.rect_height / 2)
	collision_info.Extents = vector(self.rect_length / 2, self.rect_height / 2, self.rect_breadth / 2)
	collision_info.DamageTerm = -1
	collision_info.Duration = 0.5

	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, _, dt)
	--- 계산기가 존재하는가?
	if self.calculator ~= nil then
		if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) == false and time_passed >= self.rect_hit_timing then
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'impact', self.portal_position)
		end

		if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) and area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) == false then
			--- 범위 내의 ifo
			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

			--- ifo 루프
			for _, each_target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
				--- 대상이 공격 불가능
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, each_target) == false then
					break
				end

				--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
				self:apply_damage(each_target, lua_helper.reference_equals(each_target, self.target) and self.calculator:IsLastHit(each_target))
			until true end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()
		end
	end

end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 방향 고정 해지
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	if self.umbrella_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.umbrella_fx)
		self.umbrella_fx = nil
	end

	if self.calculator then
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		self.calculator = nil
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, apply_force_ailment)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.rect_dps_mult)
	damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect.Create(bounds_util.get_center(t))

	if apply_force_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 전용 무기 옵션이 발동된 상태
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		--- 자신에게 버프를 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info)
	end
end


--region option routine

function local_class:apply_option(_, params)
	--- 전용 무기 옵션 아이디
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	--- 옵션 활성화 여부
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 되었을때
	if activate_option then
		--- 특수 능력 옵션 아이디
		local special_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(option_param, 'SpecialOptionId')

		local option_data = game_data_service.GetData('OptionData')
		local special_option_param = option_data:GetSpec(special_option_id).Data

		self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(special_option_param)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	self.fire_fx = nil
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, _)
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		--- 판정 타이밍 체크
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			local is_first_hit = idx == 1
			local is_last_hit = idx == self.max_hit

			if is_first_hit then
				--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
				local effect_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos, self.target_pos.y + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5)
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', effect_pos)
				--- 폭발 사운드 재생
				battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')
			end

			if is_last_hit then
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.4)
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.7)
			else
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.17)
			end

			--- 판정 처리
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			local hit_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

			if #hit_targets > 0 then
				local scale = is_last_hit and self.main_scale or self.sub_scale
				local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier) * scale

				for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
					self:apply_damage(target, modifier, is_last_hit)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_ailment)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 상태 이상 적용
	if apply_ailment and lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.target) then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('VampireCaptainSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 타격 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')
	--- 대미지 계수
	self.hit_dps_multipier = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "HitDpsMultipliers")

	--- 판정 반지름
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')

	--- 충돌체 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.radius)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)
	--- 최대 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 시전 위치
	self.trigger_pos = self.owner.Position
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = self.target.Position

	--- 대상 바운드 위치
	self.target_bound_center = bounds_util.get_center(self.target)

	local diff = self.target_pos - self.trigger_pos
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(diff)

	--- 고정 방향
	self.be_locked = diff.x > 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or (diff.x < 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Left or direction_util.to_side_dir(vector_util.to_direction(diff)))
	--- 고정 방향을 백터로 변환
	self.dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.be_locked)

	--- 대상 위치의 바닥 위치
	local ground_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos)
	--- 대상 위치에서 높이를 맞춘 위치
	local center = ground_pos + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up
	--- 충돌 체크를 위한 바운드 생성
	local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner) * 0.1)

	local first_dist = 3
	local second_dist = 1

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, first_dist * -self.dir_vector
	)

	--- 가까운 대상이 존재할때
	if closest_object then
		--- 충돌 최소 거리
		local ray_dist = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(
			bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), -self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 실제 이동가능한 거리 갱신
		first_dist = math.min(first_dist, ray_dist)
	end

	--- 첫번째 도달 목표 위치
	local dist_vector = first_dist * -self.dir_vector
	self.first_pos = self.target_pos + dist_vector

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, second_dist * self.dir_vector
	)

	--- 가까운 대상이 존재할때
	if closest_object then
		--- 충돌 최소 거리
		local ray_dist = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(
			bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 실제 이동가능한 거리 갱신x
		second_dist = math.min(second_dist, ray_dist)
	end

	--- 두번째 도달 목표 위치
	dist_vector = second_dist * self.dir_vector
	self.second_pos = self.target_pos + dist_vector

	--- 실제 전투 이벤트 존만 찾아서
	local zone = battle_util.get_event_zone(self.owner, self.target)
	local zone_bound = nil
	if zone then zone_bound = zone.Bounds end

	--- 벽으로 인해 위치가 존 밖으로 나가는 부분을 보정
	if zone_bound then
		self.first_pos = bounds_util.convert_position_to_inside(
			zone_bound, self.owner, self.first_pos,
			self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner).extents.x
		)
		self.second_pos = bounds_util.convert_position_to_inside(
			zone_bound, self.owner, self.second_pos,
			-self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner).extents.x
		)
	end
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 충돌 무시 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
	support_action_util.change_to_ethereal_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.be_locked)

	--- 캐스트 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	--- 캐스팅 사운드
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	--- owner fade
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 0, 0.03)

	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'start')

	--- 충돌체 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- 0 ~ 0.1초 첫번째 자리로 이동
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, 0.1) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min(time_passed / 0.1, 1)
		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.trigger_pos, self.first_pos, progress)
		--- 새로운 위치까지의 diff
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.1) then
		--- owner fade
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0.03)
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'charge')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.23) then
		--- 돌진 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'charge', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector
		)
	end

	--- 0.2 ~ 0.27 동안 돌진
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.2, 0.27) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuint(time_passed - 0.2, 0, 1, 0.07)

		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos =  vector_util.lerp(self.first_pos, self.second_pos, progress)
		--- 새로운 위치까지의 diff
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff)
		end
	end

	--- 0.5 뛰어서 원래 자리로
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.5) then
		--- 간단한 점프
		character_util.jump(self.owner, 0.3, 0.2, 0, true)
		--- 애니 해제
		battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.2)
	end

	--- 0.5 ~ 0.7 시전한 위치로 복귀
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.5, 0.7) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - 0.5) / 0.2, 1)
		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.second_pos, self.trigger_pos, progress)
		--- 새로운 위치까지의 diff
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
				self.owner, vector_util.normalized(diff), dist, CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreCrash | CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope
			)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.7) then
		--- 마지막 모션
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'finale')
		--- 마지막 이모트
		battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'finale')

		--- 방향고정
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'land')
	end

	for index = 1, self.max_hit do
		--- 판정 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			--- 첫 판정인가?
			local first_hit = index == 1
			--- 마지막 판정인가?
			local last_hit = index == self.max_hit

			--- 칼날이 난무하는 이펙트 생성
			if first_hit then
				--- shake camera
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, self.hit_timing[self.max_hit] - self.hit_timing[1])

				self.slash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self, 'slash', self.target_pos
				)
				--- 참격 사운드
				battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'slash', self.target_pos)
			--- 마지막에는 칼날 이펙트를 끄고 폭발하는 이펙트 생성
			elseif last_hit then
				--- shake camera
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.4, 0.4)

				--- 난무 이펙트 제거
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.slash_fx)
				self.slash_fx = nil

				battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self, 'explosion', self.target_pos
				)
				--- 폭발 사운드
				battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
			end

			--- 데미지 계수 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.hit_dps_multipier[index])

			--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- 충돌체 계산기 갱신
			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator)

			--- 타겟 리스트 순회
			for _, each_target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				--- 상태이상을 적용해야 하는가?
				local apply_ailment = last_hit and lua_helper.reference_equals(each_target, self.target)

				--- 데미지 적용
				self:apply_damage(each_target, modifier, apply_ailment)
			end

			--- PooledList 해지
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 시전한 상태가 아니라면 생략함
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 시전한 위치로 돌아감
	support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.trigger_pos)
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 해제
	support_action_util.change_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, nil)

	--- owner fade
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0)

	--- 난무 이펙트 제거
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.slash_fx)
	self.slash_fx = nil

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 이모트 해제
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	self.target = nil
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_ailment)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	if apply_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 데몬샤이어 백작 클로드(vampire_lord) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('VampireLordSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 판정 시점
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')

	--- 최소 반지름
	self.min_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MinRadius')
	--- 최대 반지름
	self.max_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MaxRadius')

	--- 원본 캐릭터의 스파인 스킨 이름
	self.origin_skin_name = nil
	--- 변신시 사용할 스파인 스킨 이름
	self.skin_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(params, 'MetamorphSkinName')

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 여부
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target
	--- 타겟 위치
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 원본 캐릭터의 스파인 스킨 이름이 할당되지 않았을때
	if self.origin_skin_name == nil then
		--- 스킨 이름 캐싱
		self.origin_skin_name = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner).SkinName
	end

	--- 오너 스파인 캐릭터의 스킨을 변신 스킨으로 교체
	spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner).SkinName = self.skin_name

	--- 캐스트 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 준비 이펙트 생성
	self.ready_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'ready', self.target_pos)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.17, 0.1)

	--- shake character
	character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.3)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, _)
	--- 애니메이션 재생 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[1] - 0.2) then
		--- 적절한 애니메이션 재생
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

		--- 바라보는 방향
		local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
		--- 캐릭터 반동
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, direction_util.to_vector3(look_dir), 0.2, 0.1, 0.2, 15)
	end

	--- 판정 타이밍 순회
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		--- 판정 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			--- 첫 판정 시점
			if index == 1 then
				--- 준비 이펙트 해지
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.ready_fx)
				--- 준비 이펙트 비워줌
				self.ready_fx = nil

				--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', self.target_pos)

				--- 폭발 사운드 재생
				battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

				--- shake camera
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.20, 0.6)
			end

			--- modifier 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
				self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier, #self.hit_timing
			)

			--- 현재 진행도
			local progress = (index - 1) / (#self.hit_timing - 1)
			--- 진행도에 따른 범위
			local radius = self.min_radius + (self.max_radius - self.min_radius) * progress

			--- 범위 내의 ifo
			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(self.target_pos, radius)

			--- ifo 순회
			for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do
				--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) then
					--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
					self:apply_damage(t, modifier, index == 3)
				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 준비 이펙트 해지
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.ready_fx)
	--- 준비 이펙트 비워줌
	self.ready_fx = nil

	--- 반동 연출 취소
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	--- 이모션 해지
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 해지
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	if self.origin_skin_name then
		--- 오너 스파인 캐릭터의 스킨을 원본 스킨으로 되돌려줌
		spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner).SkinName = self.origin_skin_name
	end

	--- 타겟 위치 비워줌
	self.target_pos = nil
	--- 타겟 비워줌
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 전환
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	self.pass_crash_behaviour = nil
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, m, is_last)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- 연계기의 대상이고 마지막 공격일 경우
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(t, self.target) and is_last then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 뱀파이어 소녀 카리나 (vamipire_noble) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('VampireNobleSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')

	--- 판정 시간
	local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AttackDuration')
	--- 판정 간격
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageTerm')
	--- 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 높이 (고정값 CS 컨버트)
	local height = 4

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, attack_duration, damage_term, nil, true)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = area_collision_util.get_max_hit(self.calculator)

	--- 트리거 플래그
	self.trigger = false
	--- 연걔기 대상
	self.target = nil
	--- 타겟 위치
	self.target_pos = nil

	--- 승급 옵션 적용
	self:apply_ascent_option(params)
end

---- parsing option data
function local_class:apply_ascent_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'AscentOptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 승급 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_ascent_option = true

		--- parsing each info
		battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self, self.cs_action, option_param)

		--- 데미지 계수
		self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'TotalDpsMult')

		--- 생성된 히트 이펙트
		self.hit_fx = {}

		--- 트리거 조정
		self.trigger_ailment = cs_util.get_ailment_from_dictionary(option_param, 'Trigger')
	end
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--- 타겟 할당 해제
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 체크
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:get_trigger_ailment()
	return self.trigger_ailment
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = true
	--- 대상 할당
	self.target = info.target
	--- 대상 위치 할당
	self.target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target))
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- darken 강도 낮춰서 적용
	field:Darken('support_skill_declare', 0.3, 0.15 * 0.3)

	--- 캐스트 애니메이션 요청
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- 승급 옵션이 활성화되었을때
	if self.activate_ascent_option then
		--- 방향 고정 요청
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		--- 캐스트 이모션 요청
		battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

		--- 캐스트 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- 캐스트 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

		--- 점프 요청
		character_util.jump(self.owner, 1.5, 0.9, 0.5)
	end
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then return end

	--- 승급 옵션이 활성화되었을때
	if self.activate_ascent_option then
		--- 생성된 이펙트 리스트 순
		for k in pairs(self.hit_fx) do
			--- 히트 이펙트 해지
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.hit_fx[k])
			--- 히트 이펙트 할당 해제
			self.hit_fx[k] = nil
		end

		--- 점프 캔슬
		character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)

		--- 요청한 이모션 설정 해제
		battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

		--- 방향 고정 해제
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 요청한 애니메이션 설정 해제
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 위치 할당 해제
	self.target_pos = nil
	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- 승급 옵션이 활성화되었을때
	if self.activate_ascent_option then
		--- 최고 점에 올라간 시점
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.1) then
			--- 준비 이펙트 생성
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'ready', self.target_pos)

			--- 카메라 흔들기
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.3)
		end

		--- 폭발 시점
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.8) then
			--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', self.target_pos)

			--- 폭발 사운드 재생
			battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

			--- 카메라 흔들기
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.37, 0.3)
		end

	--- 기본 연계기 연출
	else
		--- 이펙트 생성 타이밍 루프
		for index = 0, 2 do
			--- 이펙트 생성 타이밍
			local timing = index * 0.4

			--- 이펙트 생성 타이밍인 경우
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, timing) then
				--- 장판 이펙트 생성
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'range', character_util.get_position(self.target))

				--- 첫 판정인 경우
				if index == 0 then
					--- 장판 사운드 재생
					battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'range')
				end
			end
		end
	end

	--- 판정을 해야하는 상황
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 데미지 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
			self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier, self.max_hit
		)

		--- 타겟 루프
		for _, t in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)) do
			--- 상태 이상 연계 여부
			local apply_ailment = lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, t) and self.calculator:IsLastHit(t)
			--- 데미지 적용
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier, apply_ailment)

			--- 승급 옵션이 활성화되었을때
			if self.activate_ascent_option and self.hit_fx[t] == nil then
				--- 히트 이펙트 생성
				self.hit_fx[t] = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(t), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(t)
				)

				--- 히트 이펙트 사이즈 조정
				self.hit_fx[t].transform.localScale = vector_util.one * 0.7
			end
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기가 종료된 시점
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, modifier, apply_ailment)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 상태이상을 적용해야 할 경우
	if apply_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Support 배틀액션
--- 자율 행동 안드로이드 Mk.2(villain_android) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('VillainAndroidSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')
	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 투사체 속도
	self.speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Speed')
	--- 투사체 수명
	self.life_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'LifeTime')
	--- 판정 반경
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')

	--- 디버프 정보 파싱
	self.debuff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params, 'Debuff')

	--- 바운스 오프셋
	self.bounds_offset = 0.4 * vector_util.up

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil
	--- 타겟 위치
	self.target_pos = nil

	--- 생성된 투사체
	self.proj = {
		--- 이펙트
		fx = nil,
		--- 발사 위치
		start_pos = nil,
		--- 종료 위치
		target_pos = nil,
		--- 투사체 방향
		direction = nil,
		--- 지나간 시간
		time_passed = 0,
		--- 라이프 타임
		life_time = 0
	}
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.buff_info, self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.buff_info = nil

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:update_always(dt)
	if self.proj.fx then
		self.proj.time_passed = self.proj.time_passed + dt

		local progress = self.proj.time_passed / self.proj.life_time

		local current_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.proj.start_pos, self.proj.target_pos, progress)

		--- update proj fx
		effect_util.update_object(self.proj.fx, current_pos, self.proj.direction)
		effect_util.update_object(self.proj.trail, current_pos, self.proj.direction)

		--- update shadow setter
		local shadow_setter = self.proj.fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageShadowSetter))
		shadow_setter.Position = current_pos

		--- on expired
		if progress >= 1 then
			--- explosion
			self:on_explosion(self.proj.target_pos)

			--- clear projectile
			self:clear_proj()
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_force_cancel()
	if self.proj.fx then
		--- instantiate hit effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'hit', self.proj.fx.transform.localPosition)

		--- play hit sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'hit')

		--- clear projectile
		self:clear_proj()
	end
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true

	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 타겟 위치
	self.target_pos = info.target.Position
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')
	--- set action emotion
	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	local direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)))
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.bounds_offset

	--- set ik
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + direction, center)

	--- instantiate cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'cast',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner), parent_follow_flag.position
	)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	if self.trigger == false then return end

	--- remove emotion
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 해지
	self.target = nil
	--- 타겟 위치 해지
	self.target_pos = nil

	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, _)
	--- 발사 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- play hit sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'shoot')

		--- 카메라 연출
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.3)

		local target_pos = self.target_pos + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * vector_util.up

		--- shoot projectile
		self:shoot_proj(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), target_pos)
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_proj(center_pos, target_pos)
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - center_pos)
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	local distance = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

	--- shoot pos
	local shoot_pos = center_pos + direction

	--- instantiate fire effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'fire', center_pos + 0.5 * direction, direction)

	--- 바로 터지는 시점
	if distance < 1 then
		--- on explosion
		self:on_explosion(target_pos)
	--- 투사체 발사
	else
		self.proj.fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'proj', shoot_pos, direction)
		self.proj.trail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'trail', shoot_pos, direction)
		self.proj.time_passed = 0
		self.proj.life_time = distance / self.speed
		self.proj.start_pos = shoot_pos
		self.proj.target_pos = target_pos
		self.proj.direction = direction
	end
end

function local_class:clear_proj()
	--- dispose fx
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj.fx)
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj.trail)

	self.proj.fx = nil
	self.proj.trail = nil
	self.proj.time_passed = nil
	self.proj.life_time = nil
	self.proj.start_pos = nil
	self.proj.target_pos = nil
	self.proj.direction = nil
end

function local_class:on_explosion(position)
	--- instantiate hit effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'hit', battle_util.get_ground_pos(position))

	--- play hit sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'hit')

	--- atk modifier
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(position, self.radius)

	for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier)

			--- apply debuff
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, t, self.debuff_info)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.22, 0.25)
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 기본 사운드 mute
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	--- fill ailment
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(t, self.target) then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
