--- Support 배틀액션
--- 간부 빨간 모자 아라벨 (villain_redhood) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('VillainRedhoodSupportBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	obj:change(state)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region projectile state

local projectile_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 데미지 유형
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 데미지 계수
	damage_multiplier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,

	--- 투사체 프리셋
	proj_preset = nil,
	--- 트레일 프리셋
	trail_preset = nil,

	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- 최대 각도
	spin = 90,
	--- 투사체 방향 관련 데이터
	dir_factor_table = {
		1,
		-1
	},
	--- 투사체 프리셋 테이블
	fx_table = {},
	--- 트레일 프리셋 테이블
	trail_table = {},
	--- 위치 정보 테이블
	pos_table = {},
	--- 방향 정보 테이블
	dir_table = {},

	--- 목표 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 목표 위치
	target_pos = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
projectile_state_class.mt = { __index = projectile_state_class }

--- create state
function projectile_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function projectile_state_class:init(param)

	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TotalDpsMult')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- C# 슈터 생성
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)

	--- 투사체 데이터 파싱 및 생성
	--- 실제로 projectile을 사용하진 않으나, 관련 연출을 하는데 사용되기 때문에 투사체로써 로드한다.
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	if activate_option then
		self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'TotalDpsMult')
		self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, option_param)
	end

	--- 투사체 옵젝풀
	self.proj_preset = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.proj_spec[1].PresetName)
	--- 트레일 옵젝풀
	--- 일단 없을리가 없으니 별도 체크는 하지 않는다.
	local _, trail_key = self.proj_spec[1].ExtraObjectPoolInfo:TryGetValue('trail')
	self.trail_preset = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(trail_key)

	--- 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(self.proj_spec[1]))
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function projectile_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

function projectile_state_class:set_target(target, target_pos)
	self.target = target
	self.target_pos = target_pos
end

function projectile_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 시전자의 중심
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	--- 목표 방향
	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(self.target_pos - bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	--- 유효 각도
	local avail_angle = self:get_avail_angle()

	for _, factor in pairs(self.dir_factor_table) do
		--- 이펙트 생성
		local proj_fx = effect_util.instantiate_effect(self.proj_preset, center)
		table.insert(self.fx_table, proj_fx)
		--- 트레일 생성
		local trail_fx = effect_util.instantiate_effect(self.trail_preset, center)
		table.insert(self.trail_table, trail_fx)
		--- 이동 위치 지정
		table.insert(self.pos_table, center)
		--- 이동 방향 지정
		local target_quaternion = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, avail_angle * factor, 0)
		table.insert(self.dir_table, target_quaternion * dir_vector)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.proj_spec[1].ShootSfxName)
end

function projectile_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 지울 것이라 역순으로 순회한다.
	for _ = #self.fx_table, 1, -1 do
		--- 이펙트 해제
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(table.remove(self.fx_table))
		--- 트레일 해제
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(table.remove(self.trail_table))
		--- 위치 해제
		table.remove(self.pos_table)
		--- 방향 해제
		table.remove(self.dir_table)
	end
end

function projectile_state_class:get_avail_angle()
	--- 발사 각도를 꺾더라도 homing 에 의해 대상에게 명중할 수 있어야 하므로 최대 꺾을 수 있는 각도를 계산
	local dist = vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos), vector_util.get_x0z(character_util.get_position(self.owner)))

	--- 투사체 속도
	local speed = projectile_spec_util.get_speed(self.proj_spec[1])

	--- 정면으로 날아간다 가정할 때 걸리는 시간 계산
	local est_time = math.min(dist / speed, projectile_spec_util.get_life_time(self.proj_spec[1]))

	--- 해당 시간 동안 꺾을 수 있는 각도 / 2
	local avail_angle = est_time * projectile_spec_util.get_homing_angular_speed(self.proj_spec[1]) * 0.5

	--- 최대각도와 가능각도 중 작은것으로 발사
	return math.min(avail_angle, self.spin)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function projectile_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	local is_expired = false

	for idx, _ in pairs(self.fx_table) do
		is_expired = self:update_proj(idx, dt)

		--- 만료되었다면 루프 이탈
		if is_expired then
			break
		end
	end

	--- 만료된 경우
	if is_expired then
		--- 폭발 처리
		self:on_explosion()
		--- 상태 이탈
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function projectile_state_class:update_proj(idx, dt)
	--- 투사체 이펙트
	local proj_fx = self.fx_table[idx]
	--- 트레일 이펙트
	local trail_fx = self.trail_table[idx]
	--- 현재 위치
	local current_pos = self.pos_table[idx]
	--- 현재 방향
	local dir_vector = self.dir_table[idx]

	local dir_vector_xz = vector_util.get_x0z(dir_vector)
	local xz_magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector_xz)
	local y_magnitude = dir_vector.y
	dir_vector_xz = vector_util.normalized(dir_vector_xz)

	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - current_pos)
	local diff_to_target = vector_util.normalized(diff)

	local angle_max_diff = projectile_spec_util.get_homing_angular_speed(self.proj_spec[1]) * dt

	local new_dir = unity_class.vector3.RotateTowards(dir_vector_xz, diff_to_target, math.rad(angle_max_diff), 0)

	dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(new_dir) * xz_magnitude + vector_util.up * y_magnitude

	local proj_speed = projectile_spec_util.get_speed(self.proj_spec[1])
	local move_vector = dir_vector * proj_speed * dt
	local new_pos = current_pos + move_vector

	effect_util.update_object(proj_fx, new_pos, dir_vector)
	effect_util.update_object(trail_fx, new_pos, dir_vector)
	self.dir_table[idx] = dir_vector
	self.pos_table[idx] = new_pos

	return vector_util.magnitude(diff) <= proj_speed * dt
end

function projectile_state_class:on_explosion()
	--- 폭발 연출
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec[1], self.target_pos)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.proj_spec[1].HitSfxName)

	--- 판정 처리
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
	--- 대상이 없으면 생략
	if #fo_list == 0 then
		return
	end

	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)

	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		self:apply_damage(fo, modifier)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function projectile_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- FIXME : 원본부터 이런데... 어째서 대상 위치에서...?!
	damage_info.hit_effect = CS.Oak.BasicHitEffect.Create(self.target_pos)

	--- 상태 이상 적용
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(t, self.target) then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 투사체 스테이트
	self.proj_state = projectile_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- 투사체 스테이트를 위한 스테이트 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.proj_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--- 타겟 할당 해제
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		--- 스테이트 머신 정지
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		--- 스테이트 머신 할당 해제
		self.state_machine = nil

		--- 투사체 스테이트 파라미터 할당 해제
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.proj_state)

		--- 투사체 스테이트 할당 해제
		self.proj_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.proj_state:is_loaded()
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = true

	--- 시작 위치
	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target) + vector_util.up * bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- set anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

	--- 투사체 상태 시작
	self.proj_state:set_target(self.target, self.target_pos)
	self.state_machine:change(self.proj_state)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
end

function local_class:update_always(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	--- 캐스팅 이펙트

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- [OnHit] 주먹이 지면을 강타하는 시점에 데미지, 및 사운드 처리
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.fx_explosion_timing) then
		--- 폭발 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
	end

	--- [OnHit] 주먹이 지면을 강타하는 시점에 데미지, 및 사운드 처리
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.37, 0.4)
		--- 데미지 계산 처리
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.total_dps_multiplier)
		--- 피격 판정 범위 대상위치로 이동
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)
		--- 피격 대상 순회
		for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
			local apply_ailment = lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.target)
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_ailment)
		end

		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end
end

--- 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, apply_ailment)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target

	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	--- 상태 이상 적용
	if apply_ailment then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

		damage_info.force_ailment = true

	--- 표정 바꿔줘야 하는 대상 영웅들
	self.origin_id_table = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(params, 'TargetOriginId')

	--- 판정 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 스택 체크용 버프 정보
	self.stack_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params, 'StackBuff')

	--- 아레나 분기처리용 플래그
	self.is_arena = stage_mode_util.is_arena()

	self:apply_option(params)
end

function local_class:apply_option(params)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do
		repeat
			--- 옵션 유효성 확인
			local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

			--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
			if activate_option == false then
				break
			end

			--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
			local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

			if is_special then
				--- 특수옵션 적용 시
				self.activate_special_option = true

				--- 사탕 스택 소모 버프
				self.special_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'AttackBuff')

			end
		until true
	end
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	--- 타겟 할당 해제
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = true

	--- 시작 위치
	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	--- 대상 위치
	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)

	--- 말 생성 오프셋
	self.horse_init_offset = vector(0, 0.03, -0.3)

	--- 대상 바운드 위치
	self.target_bound_center = bounds_util.get_center(self.target)

	local diff = self.target_pos - self.trigger_pos
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(diff)

	--- 고정 방향
	self.be_locked = diff.x > 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or (diff.x < 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Left or direction_util.to_side_dir(vector_util.to_direction(diff)))
	--- 고정 방향을 백터로 변환
	self.dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.be_locked)

	--- 대쉬 이펙트 오프셋
	self.dash_offset = vector(0, 0.75, 0)

	--- 대상 위치의 바닥 위치
	local ground_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos)
	--- 대상 위치에서 높이를 맞춘 위치
	local center = ground_pos + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up
	--- 충돌 체크를 위한 바운드 생성
	local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner) * 0.1)

	local first_dist = 5

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, first_dist * -self.dir_vector
	)

	--- 가까운 대상이 존재할때
	if closest_object then
		--- 충돌 최소 거리
		local ray_dist = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(
			bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), -self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 실제 이동가능한 거리 갱신
		first_dist = math.min(first_dist, ray_dist)
	end

	--- 첫번째 도달 목표 위치
	local dist_vector = first_dist * -self.dir_vector
	self.first_pos = self.target_pos + dist_vector

	--- 실제 전투 이벤트 존만 찾아서
	local zone = battle_util.get_event_zone(self.owner, self.target)
	local zone_bound = nil
	if zone then zone_bound = zone.Bounds end

	--- 벽으로 인해 위치가 존 밖으로 나가는 부분을 보정
	if zone_bound then
		self.first_pos = bounds_util.convert_position_to_inside(
			zone_bound, self.owner, self.first_pos,
			self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner).extents.x
		)
	end
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 충돌 무시 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
	support_action_util.change_to_ethereal_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.be_locked)

	--- 충돌체 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 시전한 위치로 돌아감
	support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.trigger_pos)
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 해제
	support_action_util.change_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, nil)

	--- 말 이펙트 해제
	if self.fx_horse then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_horse)
		self.fx_horse = nil
	end

	--- 대시 이펙트 해제
	if self.fx_dash then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_dash)
		self.fx_dash = nil
	end

	--- contrail 이펙트 해제
	if self.fx_contrail then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_contrail)
		self.fx_contrail = nil
	end

	--- 대상 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 삭제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 이모션 삭제
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- 0 ~ 0.15초 연계기 위치로 이동
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, 0.15) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min(time_passed / 0.1, 1)
		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.trigger_pos, self.first_pos, progress)
		--- 새로운 위치까지의 diff
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.15) then
		--- set animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'throw')
	end

	--- 0.35 초에 cast 모션
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.35) then
		--- set animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

		--- horse effect 미리 생성
		self.fx_horse = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'pinata', character_util.get_position(self.owner) + (self.dir_vector * 0.8) + self.horse_init_offset)

		local horse_spine = self.fx_horse:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

		--- 스파인 세팅
		horse_spine.Direction = self.be_locked
		horse_spine:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
		horse_spine:SetAlphaFade(1, 0.15)
		spine_util.set_track_animation(horse_spine, spine_animation_track.base, 'run', true)
	end

	--- 0.5 초에 브레스
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.5) then

		local is_reaction = false

		--- 상황에 맞게 emotion 출력. 아레나가 아닐 때만 출력
		if not self.is_arena then
			for idx = 1, #self.origin_id_table do repeat
				local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)

				--- 파티원 순회
				for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
					--- 생존 체크
					if character_util.is_dead(member) then
						break
					end

					if member.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.OriginId ~= self.origin_id_table[idx] then
						break
					end

					is_reaction = true

				until true end
			until true end
		end

		--- emotion
		battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, is_reaction and 'cast_reaction' or 'cast')

		--- hit effect 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * 0.5, self.dir_vector)

		--- play attack sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	end

	--- 0.65초에 마차 출발
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.65) then
		--- dash effect 캐싱
		self.fx_dash = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'dash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector)

		--- contrail effect 캐싱
		self.fx_contrail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'contrail', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	end

	--- 말 위치 갱신
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.65, 1.05) then
		--- 현재 fx 위치
		local fx_pos = self.fx_horse.transform.position

		--- 남은 시간 체크
		local remain_time = math.max(1.05 - time_passed, 0)

		--- 다음 lerp 도달점
		local next_lerp = 0

		if remain_time <= 0 then
			next_lerp = 1
		else
			next_lerp = math.min(dt / remain_time, 1)
		end

		--- 현재 위치
		local next_pos = vector_util.lerp(fx_pos, self.target_pos + self.horse_init_offset, next_lerp)

		--- 이펙트 포지션 업데이트
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_horse, next_pos)
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_dash, next_pos + self.dash_offset + self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector)
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_contrail, next_pos + self.dash_offset)
	end

	--- 0.85 ~ 1.05 시전 위치로 복귀
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.95, 1.15) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - 0.5) / 0.2, 1)
		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.first_pos, self.trigger_pos, progress)
		--- 새로운 위치까지의 diff
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
				self.owner, vector_util.normalized(diff), dist, CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreCrash | CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope
			)
		end
	end

	--- 히트 타이밍 1.05초
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- 폭발 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, self.dir_vector.x > 0 and 'explosion' or 'explosion_rev', character_util.get_position(self.target))

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.35, 0.4)

		--- play sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

		--- 사탕 버프 스택용
		local candy_stack = 0

		--- 현재 활성화된 버프를 가져옴
		local active_buffs = character_util.get_buffs(self.owner, self.stack_buff_info.name)

		--- 버프 리스트 순회
		for _, buff in pairs(active_buffs) do
			--- 버프 sender 체크
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(buff.Sender, self.owner) then
				candy_stack = buff_util.get_buff_stack(buff)
			end
		end

		if 0 < #fo_list then
			--- 액션 계수 계산. 사탕 스택 당 추가 계수 또한 같이 계산해준다.
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
				self.cs_action,
				self.damage_multiplier + self.damage_mult_per_stack * candy_stack
			)

			--- 데미지 부여
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(fo, modifier)
			end
		end

		--- 특능 적용시 사탕 개수에 비례한 버프 적용. 사탕이 최소 1개는 되어야 한다
		if self.activate_special_option and 0 < candy_stack then
			self.special_buff_info.level = math.min(candy_stack, 2)

			--- 버프 적용
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.special_buff_info)
		end

		--- 스택 체킹 버프 해제
		buff_util.remove_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.stack_buff_info.name)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- 데미지 대상과 연계기 타겟이 같은 경우에만 상태이상 적용
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(t, self.target) then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- 드루이드 칸나(white_druid) 연계기
local local_class = newclass('WhiteDruidSupportBattleAction')

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level
	self.cs_action = cs_action

	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- create ailment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이
	self.action_duration = self.cs_action.Duration

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 판정 시점
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HitTiming')

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'TotalDpsMult')
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

function local_class:on_declare(info)
	--- 타겟 캐싱
	self.target = info.target

	--- 트리거 했는지 여부
	self.trigger = true

	local diff = self.target.Position - self.owner.Position
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(diff))

	--- 고정할 방향
	self.be_locked = diff.x > 0 and
		CS.Oak.Direction.Right or
		(diff.x < 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Left or direction_util.to_side_dir(vector_util.to_direction(diff)))

	if vector_util.magnitude(self.dir_vector) == 0 then
		self.dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.be_locked)
	end

	--- 시작 위치
	self.trigger_pos = self.owner.Position

	--- 첫번째 도달 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = self.target.Position

	local distance = 4

	local ground_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target.Position)
	local center = ground_pos + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up
	local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner) * 1.5)

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, 4 * -self.dir_vector
	)

	if closest_object then
		--- 충돌 최소 거리
		local ray_dist = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(
			bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), -self.dir_vector
		)

		distance = math.min(distance, ray_dist)
	end

	--- 대시 시작할 위치
	self.start_pos = self.target_pos + distance * -self.dir_vector

	self.target_pos = self.target_pos + math.min(distance, 1) * -self.dir_vector

	--- 돌진시 존 이탈 방지
	local zone = battle_util.get_event_zone(self.owner, self.target)
	local zone_bound = nil
	if zone then
		zone_bound = zone.Bounds
	end
	--- 돌진시 뚫고 나갈 경우 위치를 보정해준다.
	if zone_bound then
		self.start_pos = bounds_util.convert_position_to_inside(
			zone_bound, self.owner, self.start_pos,
			self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner).extents.x
		)

		self.target_pos = bounds_util.convert_position_to_inside(
			zone_bound, self.owner, self.target_pos,
			self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner).extents.x
		)
	end

	character_util.jump(self.owner, 1, 0.3)
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 충돌 무시 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
	support_action_util.change_to_ethereal_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action)

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.be_locked)

	--- 적절한 애니메이션 재생
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- 0 ~ 0.3초 첫 자리 잡아줌
	if 0 <= time_passed and old_time_passed < 0.3 then
		local progress = math.min(time_passed / 0.3, 1)

		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.trigger_pos, self.start_pos, progress)
		local diff = new_pos - self.owner.Position

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) == false then
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff)
		end
	end

	--- 0.3초 대시 시작할 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.3) then
		--- 대시 애니메이션 재생
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'dash')

		--- 이펙트 생성
		self.dash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'dash', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- play cast sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	end

	--- 0.45 ~ 0.45초 적 위치까지 돌진하는 연출
	if 0.3 <= time_passed and old_time_passed < 0.45 then
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - 0.3) / 0.15, 1)
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.start_pos, self.target_pos, progress)

		local diff = new_pos - self.owner.Position

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) == false then
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff)
		end
	end

	--- 0.45초 적 히트 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.3)

		--- 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage()

		--- 히트 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, self.dir_vector.x < 0 and 'hit' or 'rev', bounds_util.get_center(self.target), self.dir_vector
		)

		--- play hit sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'hit')

		--- 벽에 부딪혀 더 못갔을 경우를 대비해 갱신
		self.target_pos = self.owner.Position
	end

	--- 0.6초 원래 위치로 돌아가기 위한 연출
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.6) then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

		self.owner:Jump(0.7, 0.3, false)
	end

	--- 0.6 ~ 0.8초 점프하여 제자리로 되돌아옴
	if 0.6 <= time_passed and old_time_passed < 0.8 then
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - 0.6) / 0.2, 1)
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.target_pos, self.trigger_pos, progress)

		local diff = new_pos - self.owner.Position
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) == false then
			--- 이동 요청
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
				self.owner, vector_util.normalized(diff), dist, CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreCrash | CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope
			)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 시전한 상태가 아니라면 생략함
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 시전한 위치로 돌아감
	support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.trigger_pos)
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 해제
	support_action_util.change_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, nil)

	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	self.target = nil
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	self.pass_crash_behaviour = nil
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage()
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = self.target
	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
	damage_info.force_ailment = true

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, param, nil,nil,nil,nil, myth_util.get_prefix_key(param, self.owner)
	)

	--- 배틀액션 길이

	--- 스킬 시전할 대상
	self.target = nil

	--- 타격 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')

	--- 판정 범위
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	self:apply_myth_option(param)

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.radius, height, self.attack_duration)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, 0, 1)

	--- 점프 연출 높이
	self.jump_height = 6

	self.ring_height = 1.6

	--- 링 연출 시작 타이밍
	self.ring_start_timing = 0
	--- 링 도착 완료 타이밍
	self.ring_end_timing = 0.3

	--- 점프 시작 타이밍
	self.jump_start_timing = 0.6
	--- 점프 도착 타이밍
	self.jump_end_timing = 0.75

	--- 돌진 시작 타이밍
	self.strike_start_timing = self.attack_timing - 0.1
	--- 돌진 완료 타이밍
	self.strike_end_timing =  self.attack_timing
	--- 복귀 타이밍
	self.return_start_timing =  self.attack_timing + 0.3
	--- 복귀 완료 타이밍
	self.return_end_timing = self.action_duration

	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')

	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	--- 데미지 계수
	self.damage_multiplier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'TotalDpsMult')
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'Radius')

	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)

	self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)

	local dist_to_ring = 3

	local dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target))
	--- 방향
	self.dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(dir)

	--- 처음 도달할 위치
	self.ring_pos = support_action_util.calculate_move_position(self.owner, self.target, -self.dir_vector, dist_to_ring)

	--- 최종 목표 위치
	self.dest_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos)

	self.ring_pos = self.ring_pos + (self.ring_pos - self.dest_pos).normalized * 1.5


	-- 시전 이펙트 출력
	self.ring_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'ring', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.ring_pos), self.dir_vector)


	self.dest_jump_pos = self.dest_pos + vector_util.up * self.jump_height
end


function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 충돌 무기 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
	support_action_util.change_to_ethereal_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action)

	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)


	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 트리거 되지 않았다면
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 원래 있던 위치로 복귀함
	support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.trigger_pos)
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 할당 해제
	support_action_util.change_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, nil)

	--- 스파인 오프셋 초기화
	spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.zero)
	--- 점프 연출 캔슬
	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)

	--- 이펙트 해제
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
	self.trail_fx = nil

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.ring_fx)
	self.ring_fx = nil

	--- 고정 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상 할당 해제
	self.target = nil
	--- 트리거 플래그 교체
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, dt)
	--- 점프 시점 출력
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.ring_start_timing) then
		--- 점프 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'jump', self.trigger_pos)
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'backtumbling')
	end

	--- 링 위로 올라감.
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.ring_start_timing, self.ring_end_timing) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - self.ring_start_timing) / (self.ring_end_timing - self.ring_start_timing), 1)
		--- 위치 이동
		support_action_util.execute_lerp_move(self.owner, self.trigger_pos, self.ring_pos, progress)
		--- 점프 연출
		spine_util.set_spine_offset(
			spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.up * self.ring_height * CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCirc(progress, 0, 1, 1)
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed,time_passed, self.ring_end_timing) then
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'victory')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed,time_passed, self.jump_start_timing- 0.1) then
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed,time_passed, self.jump_start_timing) then
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'jump')
	end



	--- 링에서 목표 대상 위로 점프
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_start_timing, self.jump_end_timing) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - self.jump_start_timing) / (self.jump_end_timing - self.jump_start_timing), 1)

		--local jump_pos = self:parabola_lerp(self.ring_pos, self.dest_jump_pos, self.jump_height, math.min(progress, 1))

		--- 위치 이동
		--support_action_util.execute_lerp_move(self.owner, self.ring_pos, self.dest_jump_pos, progress)

		--- 점프 연출
		--spine_util.set_spine_offset(
		--	spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.up * (self.ring_height + self.jump_height * CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCirc(progress, 0, 1, 1) )
		--)

		spine_util.set_spine_offset(
			spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.up * (self.ring_height + self.jump_height * math.min(progress,1) )
		)
	end

	--- 링에서 목표 대상 위로 점프
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_end_timing, self.strike_start_timing) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - self.jump_end_timing) / (self.strike_start_timing - self.jump_end_timing), 1)

		--- 위치 이동
		support_action_util.execute_lerp_move(self.owner, self.ring_pos, self.dest_jump_pos, progress)

	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed,time_passed, self.jump_end_timing) then
		self.owner.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed,time_passed, self.strike_start_timing - 0.005) then
		self.owner.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed,time_passed, self.strike_start_timing) then

		--- 트레일 이펙트 출력
		self.trail_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self,
			'trail',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner),
			nil,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- set animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.strike_start_timing, self.strike_end_timing) then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - self.strike_start_timing) / (self.strike_end_timing - self.strike_start_timing), 1)
		--- 위치 이동

		support_action_util.execute_lerp_move(self.owner, self.dest_jump_pos, self.dest_pos, progress)

		--- 점프 연출
		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.up * (self.jump_height + self.ring_height) * CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCirc(1- progress, 0,1, 1)  )
	end

	--- 이펙트 존재 시 위치 갱신
	--if self.trail_fx then
	--	--- 트레일 위치 갱신
	--	effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, battle_util.get_ground_pos(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner))
	--end

	--- 돌아오면서 낮은 점프
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.return_start_timing) then
		character_util.jump(self.owner, 0.2, self.return_end_timing - self.return_start_timing)
	end

	--- 원래 위치로 복귀
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.return_start_timing, self.return_end_timing) then
		support_action_util.execute_move_between_time(self.owner, self.dest_pos, self.trigger_pos, self.return_start_timing, self.return_end_timing, time_passed)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing + 0.05) then
		local ground_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos)

		--- 폭발 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'stomp', ground_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--- 폭발 사운드 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'explosion', ground_pos)
		--- 카메라 쉐이킹
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.4)

	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing + 0.1) then
		--- 트레일 해제
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx, true)
		self.trail_fx = nil
	end

	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 판정 체크
		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 액션 계수 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)

			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end

			--- camera shake
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.2)
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기가 종료된 시점
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.target) then
		--- 상태 이상 적용
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, param, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, param, cs_action)
	end
}

	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(diff))

	--- 고정할 방향
	self.be_locked = diff.x > 0 and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	if vector_util.magnitude(self.dir_vector) == 0 then
		self.dir_vector = direction_util.to_4way_vector3(self.be_locked)
	end

	local distance = 1.5

	local ground_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target.Position)
	local center = ground_pos + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up
	local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner) * 1.5)

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds, CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle, distance * -self.dir_vector
	)

	if closest_object then
		--- 충돌 최소 거리
		local ray_dist = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(
			bounds, bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_object), -self.dir_vector
		)

		distance = math.min(distance, ray_dist)
	end

	self.target_pos = ground_pos - distance * self.dir_vector

	--- 돌진시 존 이탈 방지
	local zone = battle_util.get_event_zone(self.owner, self.target)
	local zone_bound = nil
	if zone then
		zone_bound = zone.Bounds
	end
	--- 돌진시 뚫고 나갈 경우 위치를 보정해준다.
	if zone_bound then
		self.target_pos = bounds_util.convert_position_to_inside(
			zone_bound, self.owner, self.target_pos,
			self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner).extents.x
		)
	end
end

function local_class:on_start(_)
	--- 충돌 무시 크래시 비헤비어로 변경
	support_action_util.change_to_ethereal_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action)
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.be_locked)

	--- 적절한 애니메이션 재생
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

	--- instantiate cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'blink', character_util.get_position(self.owner))

	--- set alpha fade
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 0, 0.01)
end

function local_class:update_movement(time_passed, old_time_passed, _)
	--- 0 ~ 0.1초 순간이동
	if 0 <= time_passed and old_time_passed < 0.05 then
		local progress = math.min(time_passed / 0.05, 1)

		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.trigger_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) == false then
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff.normalized, diff.magnitude, CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.05) then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0.03)

		--- set action animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'action')

		--- 캐릭터 흔들기
		character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.35)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.23) then
		--- instantiate cast effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', character_util.get_position(self.owner))

		--- play cast sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	end


	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.4) then
		--- set action animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'explosion')

		--- instantiate cast effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', character_util.get_position(self.owner))

		--- 카메라 연출
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.28, 0.5)
	end

	if 0.4 <= time_passed and old_time_passed < 0.9 then
		--- modifier 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_multiplier)

		local progress = math.min((time_passed - 0.4) / self.expand_duration, 1)

		local radius = (self.min_radius + self.max_radius) * progress

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(character_util.get_position(self.owner), radius)

		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) and self.hit_targets[target] == nil then
				--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)

				self.hit_targets[target] = true
			end
		end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.9) then
		--- set alpha fade
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 0, 0.03)
	end

	if 0.9 <= time_passed and old_time_passed < 1.0 then
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - 0.9) / 0.1, 1)

		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.target_pos, self.trigger_pos, progress)
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)

		--- 이동할 거리가 있을때
		if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(diff)) == false then
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, diff.normalized, diff.magnitude, CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 1) then
		--- instantiate blink effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self, 'blink', character_util.get_position(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0.03)
	end
end

function local_class:on_cancel()
	--- 시전한 상태가 아니라면 생략함
	if not self.trigger then
		return
	end

	--- 시전한 위치로 돌아감
	support_action_util.return_to_position(self.owner, self.trigger_pos)
	--- 크래시 비헤비어 해제
	support_action_util.change_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, nil)

	--- 영향을 준 타겟 리셋
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0.03)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	self.target = nil
	self.trigger = false
end

function local_class:on_dispose()
	self.target = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.cs_action = nil
end

--- 실제 데미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(t, self.target) then
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('FarmAquarium')

local fish = {}
fish.mt = { __index = fish }

function fish:new(uid, fx_object, spine, move_style, speed)
	local instance = {}
	setmetatable(instance, self.mt)

	instance.uid = uid
	instance.object = fx_object
	instance.transform = fx_object.transform
	instance.spine = spine
	instance.move_style = move_style
	instance.speed = speed

	instance.start_pos = nil
	instance.next_dest = nil
	instance.next_move_distance = nil
	instance.move_dist = 0
	instance.remain_stop_duration = 0
	instance.curernt_speed = 1
	instance.original_sorting_order = spine.SortingGroup.sortingOrder

	return instance
end

function fish:dispose()
	self.spine.SortingGroup.sortingOrder = self.original_sorting_order

	if self.object ~= nil then
		--self.object.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
		self.object:Dispose()
	end
	self.object = nil
	self. transform = nil
	self.spine = nil

	self.speed = nil
end

-- 생성자
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	self.cs_behaviour = cs_behaviour
	self.res_holder = nil
	self.farm_system = CS.Oak.Game:GetCurrentSubSystem()
	self.aquarium_manager = self.farm_system.AquariumManager

	-- 데이터 세팅
	data_key = lua_helper.get_or_default(data_key, 'default')
	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end
	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	self.is_in_aquarium = false

	self.origin_move_speed_mult = 0.15		-- 물고기 고유 속도 배율. 고유 속도값 추가되면 제거해도됨
	self.move_speed_random_mult = 0.5		-- 무작위 움직임의 오차값 +기준으로만

	--입장 위치 변수
	self.user_last_pos = nil

	self.enter_marker_name = 'aquarium_enter'
	self.elevator1_marker_name = 'elevator_1f'
	self.elevator2_marker_name = 'elevator_2f'
	self.tank1_camera_name='aquarium_camera_target_1f'
	self.tank2_camera_name='aquarium_camera_target_2f'

	self.floo1_fish_move_bound_name = 'fish1_move_area'
	self.floo2_fish_move_bound_name = 'fish2_move_area'

	self.theme1_marker_name = 'aquarium_theme1'
	self.theme2_marker_name = 'aquarium_theme2'

	self.default_theme_name = 'aquarium_theme_default'

	self.theme1_pos = nil
	self.theme2_pos = nil

	self.current_floor_theme_pos = nil

	self.fish_instances = {}

	--이거 벽으로 해도 되지 않나..? layer가 다른 벽.
	self.fish_tank1_interaction_pos = vector(2, 0, -48)
	self.fish_tank2_interaction_pos = vector(49, 0, -48)

	if farm_util.is_in_local_farm() then
		-- 내 농장이 아니라면 인터렉트가 켜질 필요가 없다.
		local go = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject()
		go.transform.parent = stage.StageTransform
		self.fish_tank_interaction_object = go:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject))
		self.fish_tank_interaction_object.Name = 'fish_tank_interaction'
		self.fish_tank_interaction_object.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(unity_class.vector3(10, 2, 0.75))
		self.fish_tank_interaction_object.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		self.fish_tank_interaction_object.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.fish_tank_interaction_object.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		self.fish_tank_interaction_object.Position = self.fish_tank1_interaction_pos
	else
		-- 책은 아쿠아리움 로드 시점에 인터렉트 할 수 없도록 막는다.
		local book_1_fo = get_field_object(self.data.book_handle_name1)
		book_1_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		local book_2_fo = get_field_object(self.data.book_handle_name2)
		book_2_fo.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	self.camera_suppress_move = false

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	--물고기 이동 관련
	self.aquarium1_min_x = 0
	self.aquarium1_max_x = 0

	self.aquarium2_min_x = 0
	self.aquarium2_max_x = 0

	self.aquarium_min_y = 0
	self.aquarium_min_y_1 = 1.8
	self.aquarium_min_y_2 = 2.5
	self.aquarium_max_y = 0

	self.current_aquarium_min_x = nil
	self.current_aquarium_max_x = nil

	self.fish_move_speed = 1
	self.fish_move_coroutine = nil

	self.crawler_y = 1
	self.current_floor = 0

	if self.user_fish_dict == nil then
		self.user_fish_dict = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.Int32, CS.Oak.FarmFishData)
	end

	self.sorting_order = {
		background = -1,
		normal = 0
	}

	--이차원 배열로 x,y 좌표를 가지고 겹치는게 있다면 다른데 배치하도록 한다.
	self.aquarium_grid = {}
	self.distance_between_fish = 0.3
	self.grid_size = 2
end

-- 수족관 입장
function local_class:start(res_holder)
	self.res_holder = res_holder
	self.is_in_aquarium = true
	self.user_last_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

	--입장 위치 마커들에 대한 세팅
	self.aquarium_enter_pos = field:GetMarker(self.enter_marker_name).position
	self.aquarium_1st_elevator_pos = field:GetMarker(self.elevator1_marker_name).position
	self.aquarium_2nd_elevator_pos = field:GetMarker(self.elevator2_marker_name).position

	self.tank1_camera_pos = field:GetMarker(self.tank1_camera_name).position
	self.tank2_camera_pos = field:GetMarker(self.tank2_camera_name).position

	local aquarium1_center_pos = field:GetMarker(self.floo1_fish_move_bound_name).position
	local aquarium2_center_pos = field:GetMarker(self.floo2_fish_move_bound_name).position

	--물고기 이동 가능 범위 설정
	self.aquarium1_min_x = aquarium1_center_pos.x - 6
	self.aquarium1_max_x = aquarium1_center_pos.x + 6

	self.aquarium2_min_x= aquarium2_center_pos.x - 6
	self.aquarium2_max_x = aquarium2_center_pos.x + 6

	self.aquarium_min_y = aquarium1_center_pos.y
	self.aquarium_max_y = aquarium1_center_pos.y + 7

	self.aquarium_z = aquarium1_center_pos.z

	-- 수족관 테마 배치 위치 세팅
	self.theme1_pos = field:GetMarker(self.theme1_marker_name).position
	self.theme2_pos = field:GetMarker(self.theme2_marker_name).position

	self.current_floor_theme_pos = self.theme1_pos

	-- 입장시 수족관 초기화
	self:set_floor(1)
	farm_util.play_screenplay(self.screen_anim_enter_aquarium, self)

	--도감에 느낌표 표시
	self.book1_field_obj = get_field_object(self.data.book_handle_name1)
	self.book2_field_obj = get_field_object(self.data.book_handle_name2)

	if farm_util.is_in_local_farm() and self:has_any_reward() then
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.book1_field_obj)
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(self.book2_field_obj)
	end
end

-- 수족관 퇴장
function local_class:stop()
	self.is_in_aquarium = false
	farm_util.play_screenplay(self.screen_anim_leave_aquarium, self)
end

-- 엘레베이터로 이동
-- 코루틴에서 불리는 것을 상정함
function local_class:move_floor(floor)
	self:set_floor(floor)
	self:screen_anim_move_elevator()
end

--region screen anim

-- 수족관 진입 연출
function local_class:screen_anim_enter_aquarium()
	--농장 배경음 종료
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	user_party.Leader.Position = self.aquarium_enter_pos
	user_party.Leader.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:Show(-1, false)
	self:set_aquarium_theme()
	self:create_aquarium_fishes()

	--수족관 환경음 시작
	self:aquarium_ambient_on()

	--수족관 BGM 시작
	local data = { name = 'ondemand/heavenhold_farm/audio:bgm_aquarium', state = 'event' }
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(data)

	coroutine.yield()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'aquarium_enter' }))
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')
end

-- 수족관 퇴장 연출
function local_class:screen_anim_leave_aquarium()
	--수족관 배경음 종료
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' , mix = 2})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	user_party.Leader.Position = self.user_last_pos
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:Show(-1, true)
	self:clear_fishes_in_aquarium()

	self:aquarium_ambient_off()
	self:clear_theme()

	local data = {
		state = 'field',
		mix = 0.5
	}
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(data)

	coroutine.yield()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'aquarium_leave' }))
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')
end

function local_class:aquarium_ambient_on()
	farm_util.play_ambient_sound('aqua_amient1', 'hhf_aquarium_ambient', self.fish_tank1_interaction_pos)
	farm_util.play_ambient_sound('aqua_amient2', 'hhf_aquarium_ambient', self.fish_tank2_interaction_pos)
end
function local_class:aquarium_ambient_off()
	farm_util.stop_ambient_sound('aqua_amient1')
	farm_util.stop_ambient_sound('aqua_amient2')
end

-- 층 이동 화면 연출
function local_class:screen_anim_move_elevator()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_elevator_02')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')

	--마커가 있다면 갱신한다.
	local elevator_marker = nil
	local pos = nil
	local direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	if self.current_floor == 1 then
		elevator_marker = field:GetMarker(self.elevator1_marker_name)
		pos = self.aquarium_1st_elevator_pos
	elseif self.current_floor > 1 then
		elevator_marker = field:GetMarker(self.elevator2_marker_name)
		pos = self.aquarium_2nd_elevator_pos
	end

	if elevator_marker ~= nil then
		pos = elevator_marker.position
		direction = elevator_marker.direction
	end

	user_party.Leader.Position = pos
	user_party.Leader.Direction = direction


	self:set_aquarium_theme()
	self:refresh_aquarium_move_floor()

	coroutine.yield()

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'linear')
end
--endregion

--region set theme
function local_class:clear_theme()
	if self.current_theme_obj ~= nil then
		self.current_theme_obj:Dispose()
		self.current_theme_obj = nil
	end
end
--endregion

--region Util
--층 값을 검증하고 세팅한다
function local_class:set_floor(floor)
	local aquarium_level = farm_util.get_current_user_data():GetFarmBuildingLevel(CS.Oak.FarmBuildingType.Aquarium)

	-- 아쿠아리움 레벨보다 높거나 같은 층이면 아무것도 세팅하지 않는다.
	if floor > aquarium_level or self.current_floor == floor then return end

	if floor > 1 then
		self.current_aquarium_min_x = self.aquarium2_min_x
		self.current_aquarium_max_x = self.aquarium2_max_x
		self.current_floor_theme_pos = self.theme2_pos

		if farm_util.is_in_local_farm() then
			self.fish_tank_interaction_object.Position = self.fish_tank2_interaction_pos
		end
	else
		self.current_aquarium_min_x = self.aquarium1_min_x
		self.current_aquarium_max_x = self.aquarium1_max_x
		self.current_floor_theme_pos = self.theme1_pos

		if farm_util.is_in_local_farm() then
			self.fish_tank_interaction_object.Position = self.fish_tank1_interaction_pos
		end
	end

	self.current_floor = floor
end

function local_class:create_aquarium_fishes()
	self.aquarium_manager:RefreshAquarium()
	self.user_fish_dict:Clear()

	local user_fish_list = farm_util.get_current_user_data().FishInventory
	for index = 0, user_fish_list.Count - 1 do
		if self.user_fish_dict:ContainsKey(user_fish_list[index].Id) == false then
			self.user_fish_dict:Add(user_fish_list[index].Id, user_fish_list[index])
		end
	end

	local current_floor_fish_list = self.aquarium_manager:GetFishList(self.current_floor)
	if current_floor_fish_list == nil or current_floor_fish_list.Count < 1 then
		return
	end

	--사전 캐시 작업..  UID - FarmFishData 로 매핑해준다. 나중에 정리가 필요하다

	for index = 0, current_floor_fish_list.Count - 1 do
		local user_fish_data = current_floor_fish_list[index]
		local uid = user_fish_data.Id
		if user_fish_data ~= nil then
			self:create_fish_instance(user_fish_data.Id, user_fish_data.SpecId, user_fish_data.Size)
		end
	end

	if self.fish_move_coroutine == nil then
		self.fish_move_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fish_move, self))
	end
end

function local_class:refresh_aquarium_fishes(moved_fish_dict)
	self.aquarium_manager:RefreshAquarium()	--현재 배치된 물고기 정보만 가져온다

	--[참고] self.fish_instances(old) fish_list(new) moved_fish_dict(changed)

	--삭제해야할 생선과, 추가해야할 생선목록을 구분한다
	local delete_list = {}
	local add_list = {}
	if moved_fish_dict ~= nil then
		for floor, changed_fishes in pairs(moved_fish_dict) do
			--현재 층이 아니면 삭제 대상
			if floor ~= self.current_floor then
				if changed_fishes ~= nil and changed_fishes.Count > 0 then
					for index = 0, changed_fishes.Count - 1 do
						table.insert(delete_list, changed_fishes[index])
					end
				end
			else
				--같은 층은 추가대상
				if changed_fishes ~= nil and changed_fishes.Count > 0 then
					for index = 0, changed_fishes.Count - 1 do
						table.insert(add_list, changed_fishes[index])
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 삭제 목록과 비교하며 삭제해준다
	for _, deleted_fish_uid in pairs(delete_list) do
		for k = #self.fish_instances, 1, -1 do
			if self.fish_instances[k].uid == deleted_fish_uid then
				local fish = self.fish_instances[k]
				if fish.move_style == CS.Oak.FishAction.FloorPlace or fish.move_style == CS.Oak.FishAction.RandomPlace then
					local grid_x = math.floor(fish.start_pos.x * self.grid_size)        --0.5단위로 확인
					local grid_y = math.floor(fish.start_pos.y * self.grid_size)

					if self.aquarium_grid[grid_x] == nil then
						self.aquarium_grid[grid_x] = {}
					end

					if self.aquarium_grid[grid_x][grid_y] == nil or self.aquarium_grid[grid_x][grid_y] == true then
						self.aquarium_grid[grid_x][grid_y] = false
					end
				end

				fish:dispose()
				table.remove(self.fish_instances, k)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 추가 목록은 생성해서 넣어준다.
	for _, added_fish_uid in pairs(add_list) do

		local uid = added_fish_uid
		local has_value, user_fish_data = self.user_fish_dict:TryGetValue(uid)
		if has_value == true then
			self:create_fish_instance(user_fish_data.Id, user_fish_data.SpecId, user_fish_data.Size)
		end
	end

	if self.fish_move_coroutine == nil then
		self.fish_move_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fish_move, self))
	end
end

function local_class:refresh_aquarium_move_floor()
	self.aquarium_manager:RefreshAquarium()
	self:clear_fishes_in_aquarium()

	local current_floor_fish_list = self.aquarium_manager:GetFishList(self.current_floor)
	if current_floor_fish_list == nil or current_floor_fish_list.Count < 1 then
		return
	end


	for index = 0, current_floor_fish_list.Count - 1 do
		local user_fish_data = current_floor_fish_list[index]
		local uid = user_fish_data.Id
		if user_fish_data ~= nil then
			self:create_fish_instance(user_fish_data.Id, user_fish_data.SpecId, user_fish_data.Size)
		end
	end

	if self.fish_move_coroutine == nil then
		self.fish_move_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fish_move, self))
	end
end

function local_class:create_fish_instance(uid, spec_id, size)
	local fish_spec = CS.Oak.FishExtensions.GetFishSpec(spec_id)
	-- 실제 오브젝트의 크기배율 0.8 / 1 / 1.2
	local sacle_multiplier = self:GetFishSizeMultiplier(size, fish_spec)
	-- 움직이는 스타일
	local move_style = fish_spec.Action
	local speed = fish_spec.Speed * self.origin_move_speed_mult

	local start_pos = self:get_random_deploy_pos(move_style)

	local fx_object = CS.Oak.FishExtensions.GetFishObject(fish_spec.AssetName, start_pos)
	local spine = fx_object.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
	fx_object.transform.localScale = fx_object.transform.localScale * sacle_multiplier
	spine.IsShadowActive = false
	spine:SetAnimation(1, 'idle', true)


	local fish_instance = fish:new(uid, fx_object, spine, move_style, speed)
	fish_instance.next_dest = self:get_random_destination(start_pos, move_style)    --목적지 설정
	fish_instance.next_dest_distance = vector_util.distance(start_pos, fish_instance.next_dest)
	fish_instance.start_pos = start_pos
	fish_instance.curernt_speed = speed

	if move_style == CS.Oak.FishAction.RandomPlace or move_style == CS.Oak.FishAction.FloorPlace then
		spine.SortingGroup.sortingOrder = math.floor(start_pos.y * -100)
	end


	-- 초기 방향 할당
	if start_pos.x >= fish_instance.next_dest.x then
		spine.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	else
		spine.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	end

	table.insert(self.fish_instances, fish_instance)
end

function local_class:clear_fishes_in_aquarium()
	--기존의 생선 spine fx들을 날린다.
	for index = #self.fish_instances, 1, -1 do
		if self.fish_instances[index] ~= nil then
			self.fish_instances[index]:dispose()
			self.fish_instances[index] = nil
			table.remove(self.fish_instances, index)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:fish_move()

	while self.is_in_aquarium == true do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		for _, fish in pairs(self.fish_instances) do
			--가만히 있어야 하는 친구들 아니면 움직이는 알고리즘 처리
			if fish.move_style ~= CS.Oak.FishAction.RandomPlace and fish.move_style ~= CS.Oak.FishAction.FloorPlace then
				local cur_pos = fish.transform.position
				local spine = fish.spine
				local speed = fish.curernt_speed

				local remain_distance = vector_util.distance(cur_pos, fish.next_dest)

				-- 추가 목적지 도착 이후 무작위 대기시간을 통해 연출을 더 부드럽게 하는 방법도 고민

				if remain_distance < 0.01 then
					--목적지 할당
					fish.start_pos = fish.next_dest
					fish.next_dest = self:get_random_destination(cur_pos, fish.move_style)
					fish.next_dest_distance = vector_util.distance(cur_pos, fish.next_dest)
					fish.move_dist = 0

					--fish.remain_stop_duration = unity_class.random.value
					fish.current_speed = fish.speed + unity_class.random.value * self.move_speed_random_mult

					--방향 할당
					if fish.start_pos.x >= fish.next_dest.x then
						spine.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
					else
						spine.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
					end
				else
					fish.move_dist = fish.move_dist + speed * dt
					local progress = fish.move_dist / fish.next_dest_distance
					fish.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(fish.start_pos, fish.next_dest, progress)
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
	-- 이방식은 좋지 못한 것 같다. dispose 시점이나 혹은 이탈 시점에 명시적으로 종료 시켜준다.
	-- 코루틴 스탑 시키는걸 써도 되는지 확인 필요.
	self.fish_move_coroutine = nil	--스스로 놔준다.
end


function local_class:get_random_destination(current_pos, move_style)
	if current_pos == nil then
		return self:get_random_deploy_pos(move_style)
	end

	local next_dest_x = nil
	local next_dest_y = nil

	if move_style == CS.Oak.FishAction.Walk then
		-- 바닥만 기어다니는 개체들 가재
		next_dest_x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.current_aquarium_min_x, self.current_aquarium_max_x)
		next_dest_y = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.aquarium_min_y_1, self.aquarium_min_y_2)

	elseif move_style == CS.Oak.FishAction.Vertical then
		--수직 움직임 해파리류
		local min_x = math.max(current_pos.x - 0.3, self.current_aquarium_min_x)
		local max_x = math.min(current_pos.x + 0.3, self.current_aquarium_max_x)

		next_dest_x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(min_x, max_x)

		--샘플로 이동 방향을 결정하고, 만약 해당 방향으로 이동 불가능하면 반대 방향으로 간다.
		local sample_y = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.aquarium_min_y_2, self.aquarium_max_y)

		if sample_y > current_pos.y then	--위쪽으로 이동 결정
			local can_move_up = current_pos.y + 1 <= self.aquarium_max_y
			if can_move_up == true then
				next_dest_y = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(current_pos.y + 1, self.aquarium_max_y)
			else
				next_dest_y = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.aquarium_min_y_2, current_pos.y - 1)
			end
		else
			local can_move_down = current_pos.y - 1 >= self.aquarium_min_y_2
			if can_move_down == true then
				next_dest_y = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.aquarium_min_y_2, current_pos.y - 1)
			else
				next_dest_y = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(current_pos.y + 1, self.aquarium_max_y)
			end
		end

	else
		--일반 물고기
		next_dest_x = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.current_aquarium_min_x, self.current_aquarium_max_x)
		next_dest_y = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(self.aquarium_min_y_2, self.aquarium_max_y)
	end

	return vector(next_dest_x, next_dest_y, self.aquarium_z)
end

function local_class:get_random_deploy_pos(move_style)
	local next_dest_x = nil
	local next_dest_y = nil

	local diff_x = self.current_aquarium_max_x - self.current_aquarium_min_x

	for idx = 1, 10 do
		local random_x = math.floor(unity_class.random.value * diff_x / self.distance_between_fish) * self.distance_between_fish
		next_dest_x = random_x + self.current_aquarium_min_x
		next_dest_y = self.aquarium_min_y_1

		local diff_y = nli
		if move_style == CS.Oak.FishAction.Walk or move_style == CS.Oak.FishAction.FloorPlace then
			local diff_y = self.aquarium_min_y_2 - self.aquarium_min_y_1
			local random_y = math.floor(unity_class.random.value * diff_y / self.distance_between_fish) * self.distance_between_fish
			next_dest_y = random_y + self.aquarium_min_y_1

		else
			local diff_y = self.aquarium_max_y - self.aquarium_min_y_2
			local random_y = math.floor(unity_class.random.value * diff_y / self.distance_between_fish) * self.distance_between_fish
			next_dest_y = random_y + self.aquarium_min_y_2
		end

		-- 정적 배치형 물고기면 그리드 내에 유사 개체가 있는지 확인한다.
		if move_style == CS.Oak.FishAction.FloorPlace or move_style == CS.Oak.FishAction.RandomPlace then
			local grid_x = math.floor(next_dest_x * self.grid_size)        --0.5단위로 확인
			local grid_y = math.floor(next_dest_y * self.grid_size)

			if self.aquarium_grid[grid_x] == nil then
				self.aquarium_grid[grid_x] = {}
			end

			if self.aquarium_grid[grid_x][grid_y] == nil or self.aquarium_grid[grid_x][grid_y] == false then
				self.aquarium_grid[grid_x][grid_y] = true
				break
			end
		else
			break
		end
	end

	return vector(next_dest_x, next_dest_y, self.aquarium_z)
end

	CS.Oak.UI.HeavenHoldFarmWaterTankPopup.Instance:OnCancelClick()

end


--알아서 현재 층의 정보를 찾아서 테마를 세팅한다.
function local_class:set_aquarium_theme()
	local aquarium_list = farm_util.get_current_user_data().Aquariums
	--아쿠아리움 정보가 없다면 기본으로 세팅한다.
	if aquarium_list == nil or aquarium_list.Count < 1 then
		self:set_theme_obj(self.default_theme_name)
		return
	end

	--현재층을 기반으로 테마 정보를 찾는다.
	local theme_id = nil
	for index = 0, aquarium_list.Count - 1 do
		if aquarium_list[index] ~= nil and aquarium_list[index].Id == self.current_floor then
			theme_id = aquarium_list[index].ThemeSpecId
		end
	end

	--스펙 정보를 찾지 못했거나 0이라면 기본으로 세팅해준다.
	if theme_id == nil or theme_id < 1 then
		self:set_theme_obj(self.default_theme_name)
		return
	end

	local theme_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(theme_id)
	if theme_spec == nil then
		self:set_theme_obj(self.default_theme_name)
		return
	end

	self:set_theme_obj(theme_spec.Name)
end

function local_class:set_theme_obj(name)
	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('hhf_'..name)
	if pool == nil then return end

	if self.current_theme_obj ~= nil then
		self.current_theme_obj:Dispose()
		self.current_theme_obj = nil
	end

	coroutine.yield(unity_object_pool.WaitUntilLoaded(pool))

	self.current_theme_obj = pool:Instantiate(self.current_floor_theme_pos)
end

--region Event
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance.CurrentOverlay ~= nil then
		return
	end

	local target_name = e.Target.Name

	-- 출구
	if target_name == self.data.exit_handle_name then
		self.aquarium_manager:AquariumOut()
		return true
	--1층에서 상호작용
	elseif target_name == self.data.aquarium_elevator1_handle_name then
		farm_util.play_screenplay(self.show_elevator_talk_branch, self)
		return true
	--N번째 층에서 상호작용
	elseif target_name == self.data.aquarium_elevator2_handle_name then
		character_util.reset_action_state(user_party.Leader)
		farm_util.play_screenplay(self.show_elevator_talk_branch, self)
		return true
	-- 남의 농장이라면 처리되면 안되는 인터렉트들
	elseif farm_util.is_in_local_farm() then
		-- 도감
		if target_name == self.data.book_handle_name1 or target_name == self.data.book_handle_name2 then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ui_transition_02',0.5)
			self:open_fish_book()
			return true
		-- 수족관
		-- 남의 농장이면 해당 인스턴스가 없지만, 애초에 이 부분에 오지 못할테니 세부적인 체크는 생략한다.
		elseif target_name == self.fish_tank_interaction_object.Name then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_01', 0.5)
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_fish_tank, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

		end

		camera_util.move(nil, 1, { target = user_party, end_target = user_party })

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.data.aquarium_elevator1_area_name) then
		if self.camera_suppress_move == false then
			camera_util.move(nil, 1, { target = user_party, end_target = user_party })
		end

		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.data.aquarium_elevator2_area_name) then
		if self.camera_suppress_move == false then
			camera_util.move(nil, 1, { target = user_party, end_target = user_party })
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:GetSpec(spec_id)
	local spec = CS.Oak.FishExtensions.GetFishSpec(spec_id)
	if spec == nil then
		return 1
	end
end

function local_class:GetFishSizeMultiplier(size, spec)
	local min = spec.MinLength
	local max = spec.MaxLength

	local diff = max - min

	local small = diff * 0.475 + min
	local medium = diff * 0.95 + min

	if size <= small then
		return 0.9
	elseif size <= medium then
		return 1.0
	else
		return 1.1
	end
end

function local_class:show_elevator_talk_branch()
	local aquarium_level = farm_util.get_current_user_data():GetFarmBuildingLevel(CS.Oak.FarmBuildingType.Aquarium)
	if aquarium_level <= 1 then
		self:narration_elevator_disabled()
		return
	end


	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local wait = true
	local select = 0


	for index = 1, aquarium_level do
		if self.current_floor ~= index then
			branches:Add({
				Text = game_string:GetString('farm_aquarium_elevator'..tostring(index)),
				Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
				Callback = function()
					wait = false
					select = index
				end })
		end
	end

	-- 돌아간다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('farm_aquarium_elevator_return'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			select = 0
			wait = false
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if select ~= 0 then
		self:move_floor(select)
	end
end

-- 증설 필요 나레이션
function local_class:narration_elevator_disabled()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'heavenhold_farm_elevator_disabled' })
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	CS.Oak.UI.HeavenHoldFarmResourceInfoUI.Instance:Hide()
end

function local_class:dispose()

	self.cs_behaviour = nil
	self.res_holder = nil
	self.farm_system = nil
	self.aquarium_manager = nil
	self.is_in_aquarium = false


	if self.fish_instances ~= nil and #self.fish_instances > 0 then

		self:clear_fishes_in_aquarium()
		self.fish_instances = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	self.aquarium_1st_elevator_pos = nil
	self.aquarium_2nd_elevator_pos = nil
	self.aquarium_enter_pos = nil

	self.book1_field_obj = nil
	self.book2_field_obj = nil

	self.data = nil
	self.fish_move_coroutine = nil

	self.fish_tank1_interaction_pos = nil
	self.fish_tank2_interaction_pos = nil
	self.fish_tank_interaction_object = nil

	self.tank1_camera_pos = nil
	self.tank2_camera_pos = nil

	if self.user_fish_dict ~= nil then
		self.user_fish_dict:Clear()
		self.user_fish_dict = nil
	end

	self.user_last_pos = nil
end

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('FarmFishing')

--region Base Function
function local_class:init(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)

	self.res_holder = nil

	-- 데이터 세팅

	if data_key == '' then
		data_key = 'default'
	end
	self.data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(data_path, data_key)

	-- 낚시 진행 상황
	self.fish_progress = self.data.fish_progress.none

	self.is_loaded_fishing_resource = false	-- 처음 시작시에 낚시 관련 리소스 로드 여부 확인
	self.fishing_wait_coroutine = nil	-- 물고기 기다리기 코루틴
	self.push_attack = false	-- 낚시 버튼을 눌렀나 여부
	self.current_fish_data = nil	-- 현재 물고기 FarmFishData
	self.current_fish_spec = nil	-- 현재 물고기 Spec
	self.current_fish_obj = nil		-- 현재 물고기 오브젝트(Asset 또는 item)
	self.current_fish_type = self.data.fish_obj_type.none	-- 현재 물고기 오브젝트 타입
	self.fish_fight_end = false	-- 힘겨루기 종료 여부

	-- 위치 정보

	self.water_center_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)	-- 물고기가 튀어오른 물 중앙 위치
	self.trash_throw_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)	-- 쓰레기 버리는 위치

	-- NPC
	self.npc_cat = nil
	self.npc_cat_base_pos = vector(17, 0, -10)

	-- FX
	self.fx_water_in_pool = nil
	self.fx_water_out_pool = nil
	self.fx_sweat_pool = nil
	self.fx_minigame_great = nil
	self.fx_minigame_good = nil
	self.fx_fish_water_splash2_loop_pool = nil
	self.fx_fish_water_wave_pool = nil

	self.cheat_rod_hp = 0	-- 0 초과 값을 넣으면 낚싯대 체력이 해당 값으로 변함

-- TODO: dispose 시점에 나중에 미해제된 내용 찾아서 릴리즈 처리 필요
function local_class:dispose()

	self.res_holder = nil
	self.farm_system = nil
	self.fishing_manager = nil

			self.current_fish_obj:Dispose()

	self.fx_minigame_great = nil
