--endregion

--region Fishing Function
-- 낚시 시작
function local_class:start(res_holder)
	self.res_holder = res_holder
	self.fishing_spot_pos = self.fishing_manager.FishingPosition - vector(1, 0, 0)
	self.cat_stand_pos = self.fishing_spot_pos - vector(2, 0, 0)
	self.water_center_pos = self.fishing_spot_pos + vector(3, 0, 0)
	self.trash_throw_pos = vector(self.fishing_spot_pos.x - 3, 0.5, -11.5)	-- TODO : 현재 고정인데, 낚시터가 확장되면 다른 위치가 되어야 함

	-- 액션 스테이트 리셋
	character_util.reset_action_state(user_party.Leader)

	start_coroutine(self.start_fishing, self)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
end

function local_class:start_fishing()
	self.fish_progress = self.data.fish_progress.start

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.6)

	-- 대표 캐릭터 선택 막음
	self.farm_system.CharacterManager:DisableCharacterSelector(self.cs_behaviour)

	--리더가 잡히지 않는다면 문제가 있다. 낚시를 못하게 처리해버린다.
	if user_party.Leader == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 캐릭터 형에 따른 낚시질 애니메이션 변경
	self.throw_anim_name = 'throw'
	local spec =  CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCharacterSpec(user_party.Leader)
	if spec ~= nil then
		-- 캉, 하얀야수
		if spec.OriginId == 13 or spec.OriginId == 244 then
			self.player_type = self.data.player_type.pet
			self.throw_anim_name = 'release'
		-- 유진, Mk.2
		elseif spec.OriginId == 338 or spec.OriginId == 428 then
			self.player_type = self.data.player_type.rider
		else
			self.player_type = self.data.player_type.normal
		end
	end

	-- 첫 낚시 때만 초기화(yield가 있기 때문에 init에서 하면 안 됨)
	if self.is_loaded_fishing_resource == false then
		self:load_fishing_resource()
		self.is_loaded_fishing_resource = true
	end

	-- PS-10640 발동중인 배틀액션들 강제종료 (칸나 변신 이슈 빙지)
	user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

	-- UI 숨기기
	self:game_ui_show()
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 농장 재료 숨기기
	CS.Oak.UI.HeavenHoldFarmResourceInfoUI.Instance:Hide()

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_to_fishing_spot, self))

	-- 튜토리얼 낚시
	if self.fishing_manager.fishingType == CS.Oak.HeavenHoldFarmFishingManager.FishingType.Tutorial then
		-- 낚시 스폿까지 거리가 있어서 조금 더 대기
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ChangeActionButton)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 이벤트용 물고기 데이터 생성
		self.current_fish_data = self.fishing_manager:CreateEventFishData(self.data.cat_npc_id, self.data.cat_length)
		self.current_fish_spec = self.fishing_manager:GetFishSpec(self.current_fish_data.SpecId)
		self:throw_rod_animation()
		wait_for_sec(2)
		field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
		character_util.spine_rotate(self.npc_cat, 30, 0.3)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fishing_fight, self))
	-- 일반낚시
	else
		-- 고양이가 주인공 뒤로 이동
		start_coroutine(function()
			if self.npc_cat.Position == self.cat_stand_pos then
				wait_for_sec(1)
			else
				character_util.set_anim(self.npc_cat, { name = 'walk' })
				character_util.move_to_async(self.npc_cat, self.cat_stand_pos, 1, nil, true)
			end
			character_util.set_direction(self.npc_cat, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(self.npc_cat, { name = 'idle' })
		end, self)
	end
end

-- 플레이어가 낚시 스폿으로 이동
function local_class:move_to_fishing_spot()
	-- 무기 숨기기
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(true)

	-- 낚싯 스폿 중앙으로 이동
	camera_util.move(self.water_center_pos, 0.5)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'walk' })
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, self.fishing_spot_pos, nil, 2, true)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	if self.fishing_manager.fishingType == CS.Oak.HeavenHoldFarmFishingManager.FishingType.Normal then
		-- 아이스박스 꺼내기
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack', count = 1, end_call_func = function()
			character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'idle' })
		end })
		wait_for_sec(0.1)

		-- 아이스박스 배치
		local icebox_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
		self.icebox_obj = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = user_party.Leader.Position, target = icebox_pos,
													   itemid = self.data.bucket_item_id, notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.7,
													   lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true,
													   bounce_callback = function()
														   music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_boat_01')
													   end })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')

		-- 아이스박스 NPC. Consume하기 위해서 존재. disabled 상태로 놔둔다.
		self.npc_box.Position = icebox_pos
		self.npc_box.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 낚시대 꺼내기
		self:EquipRod()
		self:select_bait()
	else
		-- 튜토리얼 진행 중에는 강제로 나무 낙싯대로 변환
		local rod_sprite_name = 'farm_fishing_rod_1'
		user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', rod_sprite_name)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'fishing/fishing_idle' })
end

-- 낚시 종료
function local_class:stop()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	start_coroutine(self.stop_fishing, self)
end

function local_class:stop_fishing()
	-- BGM 볼륨 돌리기
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 1)

	--낚시 UI 숨기기
	self.fishing_tool_ui:Hide()

	if self.fishing_manager.fishingType == CS.Oak.HeavenHoldFarmFishingManager.FishingType.Normal then
		-- 고양이가 원래 위치로
		start_coroutine(function()
			if self.npc_cat.Position == self.npc_cat_base_pos then
				wait_for_sec(1)
			else
				character_util.set_anim(self.npc_cat, { name = 'walk' })
				character_util.move_to_async(self.npc_cat, self.npc_cat_base_pos, 1, nil, true)
			end
			character_util.set_direction(self.npc_cat, 'down')
			character_util.set_anim(self.npc_cat, { name = 'idle' })
		end, self)

		-- 아이스박스 챙기기
		user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')    -- 낚싯대 숨기기
		user_party.Leader.SpineController.TimeScale = 1
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'walk' })
		character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), nil, 1)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })
		self.equpping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true})
		self.icebox_obj.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		self.equpping_sfx:Stop()
	end
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'idle' })

	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Position, 1, { end_target = user_party })

	-- 리더 초기화
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	farm_util.end_screenplay()

	-- UI 초기화
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction = nil
	local fish_list_button = field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ChangeActionButton)
	fish_list_button:SetIcon(CS.Oak.ChangeActionType.HoldBuilding)
	fish_list_button:SetReddot(false)

	-- 대표 캐릭터 선택 가능
	self.farm_system.CharacterManager:EnableCharacterSelector(self.cs_behaviour)

	-- 내비바 버튼들 활성화
	-- 낚시 종료 연출이 끝났으므로 다시 채팅 버튼을 누를수 있게한다.
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseChatButton = true
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseOptionButton = true
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:SetMiniChatInteraction(true)
end

--TODO: UI 관련 이벤트를 코드쪽에서 제어하도록 변경
-- 미끼 선택
function local_class:select_bait()
	self.fish_progress = self.data.fish_progress.select_bait
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	--낚싯대 정보 보여주기
	self.fishing_tool_ui:Show()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:UpdateUserAccountBuffsUI()

	-- 미끼 선택 창 보이기
	self.fishing_manager:OpenBaitList()
	-- TODO: UI 갱신 이벤트. 수정 필요
	self:refresh_fishing_action_button()
end

function local_class:throw_rod_animation()
	self.fish_progress = self.data.fish_progress.throw_rod

	-- 낚싯대 던지고 0.35초 뒤에 사운드 재생
	start_coroutine(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.35)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fish_start_01')
	end, self)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'fishing/fishing_throw', count = 1, end_call_func = function()
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'fishing/fishing_idle' })
		self.fx_fish_water_wave_pool:Instantiate(self.water_center_pos)
		if self.fishing_manager.fishingType == CS.Oak.HeavenHoldFarmFishingManager.FishingType.Normal then
			-- 낚시찌 생성
			self.fishing_float_speed = 1
			self.fishing_float_offset_y = 0
			self.fishing_float = self.fishing_float_pool:Instantiate(self.water_center_pos - vector(0, 0.25, 0))
			self.fishing_float_coroutine = start_coroutine(self.fishing_float_animation, self, self.fishing_float)
		end
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fish_start_02')
	end })
end

-- 둥실 둥실 애니메이션
function local_class:fishing_float_animation(fishing_float)
	local origin_pos = fishing_float.transform.localPosition
	while true do
		local time_passed = 0
		local height = 0.15
		local duration = 2
		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
			fishing_float.transform.localPosition = origin_pos + vector(0, y + self.fishing_float_offset_y, 0)
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.fishing_float_speed
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 물고기 기다리기
function local_class:fishing_wait()
	self.fish_progress = self.data.fish_progress.wait
	self.current_fish_data = nil
	local try_count = 1
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 액션 버튼 보이기
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	local loop_end = false
	while loop_end == false do
		local wait_time = random_util.get_random_int(10, 30)
		wait_time = wait_time / 10
		wait_for_sec(wait_time)

		-- 물고기 등장
		self.current_fish_data = nil
		if self.cheat_fish_id > 0 then	-- 치트 모드로 원하는 물고기 얻기
			self.current_fish_spec = self.fishing_manager:GetFishSpec(self.cheat_fish_id)
			self.current_fish_data = self.fishing_manager:CreateEventFishData(self.cheat_fish_id, self.current_fish_spec.MaxLength)
		elseif try_count <= self.fishing_manager.CatchableFishList.Count then
			self.current_fish_data = self.fishing_manager.CatchableFishList[try_count - 1]
			self.current_fish_spec = self.fishing_manager:GetFishSpec(self.current_fish_data.SpecId)
		end

		-- 물고기 실루엣 띄우기
		if self.current_fish_data ~= nil and self.current_fish_spec ~= nil then
			-- 당겨지는 애니메이션
			self.fishing_float_offset_y = -0.15
			self.fishing_float_speed = 10

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_pop_01')
			self.bubble_ui:SetUI(self.current_fish_spec.Rarity, vector(0.5, 2.5, 0))
			self.bubble_ui:ScaleAnimation(0.1, 0.01, 1)

			-- 물고기 도망
			local disapear_delay = 0.1
			wait_for_sec(0.65)
			self.bubble_ui:ScaleAnimation(disapear_delay, 1, 0.01)
			wait_for_sec(disapear_delay)
			self.bubble_ui:HideUI()
			self.current_fish_data = nil

			-- 다시 원래대로
			self.fishing_float_offset_y = 0
			self.fishing_float_speed = 1
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 확률에 따라서 미끼가 사라짐
		local rand_num = random_util.get_random_int(0, 9)
		if try_count == 1 then	-- 첫 시도는 미끼를 잃지 않음
			try_count = try_count + 1
		elseif try_count >= self.fishing_manager.CatchableFishList.Count or rand_num < try_count then
			loop_end = true
		else
			try_count = try_count + 1
		end
	end

	self:lost_bait()
end

-- 낚시 성공 [CatchFish]
function local_class:fishing_success()
	-- 최고 길이 잡았는지 체크
	local max_collected = false
	local collection_data = CS.Oak.FishCollectionData.Instance;
	if collection_data:IsMaxCollected(self.current_fish_spec.Id) then
		max_collected = true
	end

	-- 물고기콜렉션데이터의 IsCollected 체크 하고 그거 잠시 보관하자. 이후 OpenFishInfo할때 New보여줘야하는지 처리
	local isNew = not collection_data:IsCollected(self.current_fish_spec.Id)

	-- 서버에 물고기 잡은 사실 전달
	-- -1은 치트 또는 이벤트 데이터
	local catch_request
	if self.current_fish_data.Id >= 0 then
		catch_request = self.fishing_manager:CatchFish(self.current_fish_data)

		-- 요청을 했는대 NetworkRequest가 없다면 무언가 잘못된 것
		-- TODO : 분기 시 블로킹 되는 중... 요청 실패 관련 처리 추가?
		if catch_request == nil then
			return
		end
	end

	local size_multiplier = self:GetFishSizeMultiplier(self.current_fish_data.Size, self.current_fish_spec)
	-- 물고기 생성
	local fish = CS.Oak.FishExtensions.GetFishObject(self.current_fish_spec.AssetName, vector(999, 0, 999))
	local spine = fish.transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

	fish.transform.localScale = fish.transform.localScale * size_multiplier

	spine.IsShadowActive = false
	spine:SetAnimation(1, 'catch', true)

	-- 낚아 올리는 애니메이션
	self:fish_get_scene(fish, vector(0, 0, 0), 'smile', true, self.data.fish_obj_type.spine)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 요청을 한 상태면 이후 결과 보여주기 전까지 요청을 대기한다.
	if catch_request then
		while not catch_request.IsCompleted do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- 요청이 Ok하지 않다면 무언가 잘못 된 것
		-- TODO : 분기 시 블로킹 되는 중... 요청 실패 관련 처리 추가?
		if not catch_request.Ok then
			return
		end
	end

	-- 물고기 정보 보여주기
	local stamp = false
	if self.is_big_fish and max_collected == false then
		stamp = true
	end

	-- 물고기 정보 보여주기
	self.fishing_manager:OpenFishInfo(self.current_fish_data, stamp, isNew)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ui_transition_01')
end

-- 물고기 튀어 오르고 받는 연출 (공용연출)
function local_class:fish_get_scene(fish, offset_pos, get_emotion, is_success, object_type, tutorial_option)
	tutorial_option = lua_helper.get_or_default(tutorial_option, false)

	if is_success == true then
		self.fish_progress = self.data.fish_progress.success
	else
		self.fish_progress = self.data.fish_progress.fail
	end

	-- UI 숨기기
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ChangeActionButton)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	if self.is_big_fish then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', volume = 0.6 })
	end

	if self.current_fish_spec.Id == self.data.shark_marina_id then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
	end

	-- 튀어오르는 물고기 받기
	camera_util.move(user_party.Position, 0.5, { end_target = user_party })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.5)
	user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')    -- 낚싯대 숨기기

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.fish_capture_sfx)
	self.fx_splash_loop:Dispose()
	self.fx_water_out_pool:Instantiate(self.water_center_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fish_catch_01')

	-- 물고기 위치 세팅
	if object_type == self.data.fish_obj_type.spine
		or object_type == self.data.fish_obj_type.prefab then
		fish.transform.localPosition = self.water_center_pos
	else
		fish.Position = self.water_center_pos
	end

	if tutorial_option then
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_cat, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'water_splash_end' }))
	end

	-- 물고기가 튀어오르는 연출
	self.current_fish_obj = fish
	self.current_fish_type = object_type
	if self.player_type == self.data.player_type.rider then	-- 탈것 탄 영웅들은 y를 조금 올림
		offset_pos = offset_pos + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	end
	local target_pos = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 1, 0) + offset_pos
	start_coroutine(self.fish_jump, self, fish, target_pos, self.data.fish_jump_duration, object_type, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	-- 튀어오르는 물고기를 받는 기사와 고양이 연출
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'get' }, { name = get_emotion })
	if is_success == true then
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_cat, { name = 'clap' }, { name = get_emotion })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_01')
	elseif not tutorial_option then
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_cat, { name = 'idle' }, { name = get_emotion })
		if get_emotion == 'tired' then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		elseif get_emotion == 'cry' then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
		end
	end
	user_party.Leader.SpineController.TimeScale = 1
end

-- 물고기 튀어 오르기
function local_class:fish_jump(fish, end_position, duration, object_type, is_get)
	-- 시작 위치 얻기
	local start_position = vector(0, 0, 0)
	if object_type == self.data.fish_obj_type.spine
		or object_type == self.data.fish_obj_type.prefab then
		start_position = fish.transform.localPosition
	else
		start_position = fish.Position
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	local height = 4

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

		if object_type == self.data.fish_obj_type.spine
			or object_type == self.data.fish_obj_type.prefab then
			fish.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)
		else
			fish.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	-- 최종 포지션으로 이동(프레임 스킵이 일어난 경우 마지막 좌표 안 오는 경우가 발생)
	if object_type == self.data.fish_obj_type.spine
		or object_type == self.data.fish_obj_type.prefab then
		fish.transform.localPosition = end_position
	else
		fish.Position = end_position
	end

	-- 효과음 처리
	if is_get == true then
		if self.current_fish_spec.FishType == CS.Oak.FarmFishType.Fish then
			if self.is_big_fish then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_quest_complete_a_01')
			else
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_new_quest_accept_01')
			end
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_get_head_01')
		else
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_get_head_01')
		end

		if self.fishing_manager.fishingType == CS.Oak.HeavenHoldFarmFishingManager.FishingType.Tutorial then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_quest_complete_a_01')
		end
	end
end

-- 쥐폭탄 낚는 연출
function local_class:fishing_fail_mouse_bomb()
	-- 쥐폭탄 세팅
	local fish = self.mouse_bomb_pool:Instantiate(self.water_center_pos - vector(0, 0.25, 0))
	fish.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
	fish.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 90, 0))
	fish.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.75

	local tankTransform = fish.transform:Find('tank');
	local animator = tankTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Play('mouse_bomb_move');
	local meshRenderer = tankTransform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))
	local is_explode = false
	local time_passed = 0

	local color_change = function()
		while is_explode == false or time_passed < 3.0 do	--3초는 지나면 무조건 루틴을 종료한다.
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local x = time_passed * 4 * (1 + time_passed)
			x = math.abs(math.sin(x));
			meshRenderer.material.color = unity_color({ 1, x, x, 1 })
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
	start_coroutine(color_change)

	-- 건지고 놀람
	self:fish_get_scene(fish, vector(0, 0.1, 0), 'blood', false, self.data.fish_obj_type.prefab)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bomb_count_fast_01')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 폭발
	local fx_bomb = self.fx_bomb_pool:Instantiate(fish.transform.localPosition)
	fish:Dispose()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	is_explode = true

	-- 쓰러짐
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'confused' })
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_cat, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'confused' })
	wait_for_sec(self.data.fail_scene_duration)

	-- 다시 일어남
	fx_bomb:Dispose()
	scene_util.shake_and_wakeup(self.npc_cat, 'right', 2, nil, true)
	scene_util.shake_and_wakeup(user_party.Leader, 'right', 2, nil, true)

	-- 캐릭터 상태 초기화
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.npc_cat)
	self:EquipRod()
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'fishing/fishing_idle' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.npc_cat, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(self.water_center_pos, 0.5)
	self:select_bait()
end

-- 힘 겨루기 (미니게임 메인 로직)
function local_class:fishing_fight()
	self.fish_progress = self.data.fish_progress.fight
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	-- 말풍선 숨기기
	self.bubble_ui:HideUI()

	-- 낚싯대 파워와 물고기 파워 가져오기
	local rod_power = self.fishing_manager:GetCurrentRodPower()
	-- 튜토리얼 중일 때
	if self.fishing_manager.fishingType == CS.Oak.HeavenHoldFarmFishingManager.FishingType.Tutorial then
		rod_power = 1
	end

	-- 당기는 액션
	user_party.Leader.SpineController.TimeScale = 2
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'staff_cast'})

	-- 좌표 초기화
	local ui_center = 0
	local start_position = vector(ui_center - self.data.minigame_shot_width, 0, 0)
	local end_position = vector(ui_center + self.data.minigame_shot_width, 0, 0)

	-- 낚싯대, 물고기 체력 초기화
	local rod_hp = self.fishing_manager:GetCurrentRodStamina()
	if self.cheat_rod_hp > 0 then
		rod_hp = self.cheat_rod_hp
	end

	-- 튜토리얼 중일 때
	if self.fishing_manager.fishingType == CS.Oak.HeavenHoldFarmFishingManager.FishingType.Tutorial then
		rod_hp = 3
	end

	-- 첨벙거리는 fx
	self:dispose_fishing_float()
	self.fx_splash_loop = self.fx_fish_water_splash2_loop_pool:Instantiate(self.water_center_pos - vector(0, 0.4, 0))

	local fish_hp = self.current_fish_spec.Stamina
	self.is_big_fish = false
	-- 큰 물고기
	if self.current_fish_data.Size == self.current_fish_spec.MaxLength then
		self:show_emoticon(CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Notice)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted'})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')	-- 낚싯대 당기는 소리
		wait_for_sec(0.1)	-- 동시에 재생하면 낚싯대 소리가 묻히므로 텀을 줌
		self.fish_capture_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_fish_capture_02', loop = true})	-- 물소리 재생 시작
		wait_for_sec(2.4)

		-- 땀 표현
		local sweat_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
		if self.player_type == self.data.player_type.rider then
			sweat_pos = sweat_pos + vector(0, 0.5, 0)	-- 라이더 경우 땀 위치 조정
		end
		self.fx_sweat_obj = self.fx_sweat_pool:Instantiate(sweat_pos)
		self.is_big_fish = true

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_shaolin_figo', state = 'event', volume = 0.6, mix = 0 })
	-- 일반 물고기
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')	-- 낚싯대 당기는 소리
		wait_for_sec(0.1)	-- 동시에 재생하면 낚싯대 소리가 묻히므로 텀을 줌
		self.fish_capture_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_fish_capture_01', loop = true})	-- 물소리 재생 시작
		wait_for_sec(0.4)
	end

	-- 낚시 UI 초기화
	self.minigame_ui:InitUI(start_position, rod_hp, fish_hp, rod_hp, fish_hp)
	self.minigame_ui:ShowUI()
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	-- 힘겨루기 루프
	local game_end = false
	print('#3#[Fishing] fishId = ' .. self.current_fish_spec.Id)
	while game_end == false do
		-- 초기화
		self.push_attack = false
		local speed = self.current_fish_spec.Speed
		self.fish_fight_end = false
		self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = start_position

		-- 움직임 나누기
		local shot_move_coroutine = nil
		local fish_fight_type = self.current_fish_spec.FightType
		if fish_fight_type == CS.Oak.FishFightType.Wave then
			shot_move_coroutine = start_coroutine(self.shot_move_wave, self, start_position, end_position, speed)
		elseif fish_fight_type == CS.Oak.FishFightType.StopAndGo then
			shot_move_coroutine = start_coroutine(self.shot_move_and_stop, self, start_position, end_position, speed)
		elseif fish_fight_type == CS.Oak.FishFightType.Jump then
			shot_move_coroutine = start_coroutine(self.shot_move_jump, self, start_position, end_position, speed)
		elseif fish_fight_type == CS.Oak.FishFightType.S_Move then
			shot_move_coroutine = start_coroutine(self.shot_move_wave2, self, start_position, end_position, speed)
		elseif fish_fight_type == CS.Oak.FishFightType.Zigzag then
			shot_move_coroutine = start_coroutine(self.shot_move_zigzag, self, start_position, end_position, speed)
		elseif fish_fight_type == CS.Oak.FishFightType.Inverse then
			shot_move_coroutine = start_coroutine(self.shot_move_inverse, self, start_position, end_position, speed)
		elseif fish_fight_type == CS.Oak.FishFightType.Stealth then
			shot_move_coroutine = start_coroutine(self.shot_move_stealth, self, start_position, end_position, speed)
		else
			shot_move_coroutine = start_coroutine(self.shot_move_direct, self, start_position, end_position, speed)
		end

		-- 한판의 힘겨루기가 끝날 때까지 루프
		while self.fish_fight_end == false do
			if self.push_attack == true then
				stop_coroutine(shot_move_coroutine)
				self.fish_fight_end = true
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 노트 애니메이션
		self.minigame_ui:ShowNoteAnimation()

		-- 판정
		if self.cheat_rod_power > 0 then
			rod_power = self.cheat_rod_power
		end
		local fish_power = self.current_fish_spec.Power
		local pos = self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition
		local wPos = self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.position

		-- Great
		if pos.x >= ui_center - 3 and pos.x <= ui_center + 3 then
			local great_fx = self.fx_minigame_great:Instantiate(wPos)
			great_fx.transform.localScale = self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.lossyScale;
			self.minigame_ui:SetResultSprite(CS.Oak.UI.FishingMiniGameUI.FishingResult.Great)
			rod_hp = rod_hp - fish_power
			fish_hp = fish_hp - (rod_power * 2)

			self:show_emoticon(CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Heart)
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_cat, { name = 'smile' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_get_heart_02')
		-- Good
		elseif pos.x >= ui_center - 24 and pos.x <= ui_center + 24 then
			local good_fx = self.fx_minigame_good:Instantiate(wPos)
			good_fx.transform.localScale = self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.lossyScale;
			self.minigame_ui:SetResultSprite(CS.Oak.UI.FishingMiniGameUI.FishingResult.Good)
			rod_hp = rod_hp - fish_power
			fish_hp = fish_hp - rod_power

			self:show_emoticon(CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Happy)
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_cat, { name = 'smile' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_get_heart_01')
		-- Miss
		else
			self.minigame_ui:SetResultSprite(CS.Oak.UI.FishingMiniGameUI.FishingResult.Miss)
			rod_hp = rod_hp - fish_power

			self:show_emoticon(CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Sweat)
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_cat, { name = 'tired' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
		end

		-- 체력 갱신
		self.minigame_ui:RefreshHp(rod_hp, fish_hp)

		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.npc_cat)

		-- 판정 텍스트 숨기기
		self.minigame_ui:SetResultSprite(CS.Oak.UI.FishingMiniGameUI.FishingResult.None)

		-- 낚시 성공
		if fish_hp <= 0 then
			self:fishing_fight_end()

			-- 기사의 투구
			if self.current_fish_spec.Id == self.data.guardian_helmet_id then
				self:fishing_fail_helmet()
			-- 물수세미
			elseif self.current_fish_spec.Id == self.data.watermilfoil_id then
				self:fishing_fail_watermilfoil()
			-- 깡통
			elseif self.current_fish_spec.Id == self.data.can_id then
				self:fishing_fail_can()
			-- 상어 마리나
			elseif self.current_fish_spec.Id == self.data.shark_marina_id then
				self:fishing_fail_shark()
			-- 고양이 NPC
			elseif self.current_fish_spec.Id == self.data.cat_npc_id then
				self:fishing_get_cat_npc()
			-- 타이어
			elseif self.current_fish_spec.Id == self.data.tire_id then
				self:fishing_fail_tire()
			-- 구식 TV
			elseif self.current_fish_spec.Id == self.data.crt_id then
				self:fishing_fail_crt()
			-- 쥐폭탄
			elseif self.current_fish_spec.Id == self.data.mouse_bomb_id then
				self:fishing_fail_mouse_bomb()
			-- 일반 물고기
			else
				self:fishing_success()
			end
			game_end = true
		-- 낚시 실패
		elseif rod_hp <= 0 then
			music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.fish_capture_sfx)
			self.fx_splash_loop:Dispose()

			self:fishing_fight_end()
			self:narration_fish_run()
			self:fishing_fail()
			game_end = true
		end
	end
end

	self.minigame_ui:HideUI()

--region Mini Game Move Logic
-- 직선으로 이동하는 샷
function local_class:shot_move_direct(start_position, end_position, speed)
	self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = start_position
	while self.fish_fight_end == false do
		local pos = self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition
		local diff =  (self.data.minigame_shot_move_min_speed + (speed - 1) * self.data.minigame_shot_move_speed) * unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = vector(pos.x + diff, pos.y, pos.z)
		if pos.x + diff > end_position.x then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.fish_fight_end = true
end

-- 넘실대는 샷
function local_class:shot_move_wave(start_position, end_position, speed)
	local time_passed = 0
	local height = self.data.minigame_shot_height
	local duration = 2.5
	local center_position = vector(start_position.x + ((end_position.x - start_position.x) / 2), 0 , start_position.z)
	while time_passed < duration and self.fish_fight_end == false do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

		self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, center_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + (unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed)
	end

	time_passed = 0
	height = self.data.minigame_shot_height * -1
	while time_passed < duration and self.fish_fight_end == false do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

		self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(center_position, end_position, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + (unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed)
	end

	self.fish_fight_end = true
end

-- 이동하다 멈추는 샷
function local_class:shot_move_and_stop(start_position, end_position, speed)
	local stop_x1 = start_position.x + ((end_position.x - start_position.x) / 4)
	local stop_x2 = start_position.x + ((end_position.x - start_position.x) / 4 * 3)
	self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = start_position
	while self.fish_fight_end == false do
		local pos = self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition
		local diff =  (self.data.minigame_shot_move_min_speed + (speed - 1) * self.data.minigame_shot_move_speed) * unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = vector(pos.x + diff, pos.y, pos.z)

		-- 잠시 멈추기
		if pos.x >= stop_x1 then
			stop_x1 = 999
			wait_for_sec(0.4 / speed)
		elseif pos.x >= stop_x2 then
			stop_x2 = 999
			wait_for_sec(0.4 / speed)
		elseif pos.x + diff > end_position.x then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.fish_fight_end = true
end

-- 점프하는 샷
function local_class:shot_move_jump(start_position, end_position, speed)
	local height = self.data.minigame_shot_height
	local duration = 1.25
	local quarter = ((end_position.x - start_position.x) / 4)
	-- 4번 점프
	for i = 0, 3 do
		local point1_x = start_position.x + (quarter * i)
		local point2_x = point1_x + quarter
		local point1 = vector(point1_x, start_position.y, start_position.z)
		local point2 = vector(point2_x, start_position.y, start_position.z)
		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration and self.fish_fight_end == false do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
			self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(point1, point2, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			time_passed = time_passed + (unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed)
		end
	end

	self.fish_fight_end = true
end

-- 역방향 샷
function local_class:shot_move_inverse(start_position, end_position, speed)
	self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = end_position
	while self.fish_fight_end == false do
		local pos = self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition
		local diff =  (self.data.minigame_shot_move_min_speed + (speed - 1) * self.data.minigame_shot_move_speed) * unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = vector(pos.x - diff, pos.y, pos.z)
		if pos.x + diff < start_position.x then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.fish_fight_end = true
end

-- S자 넘실대는 샷
function local_class:shot_move_wave2(start_position, end_position, speed)
	local height = self.data.minigame_shot_height
	local duration = 1.5
	local quarter = ((end_position.x - start_position.x) / 4)

	-- 4번 꺾기
	for i = 0, 3 do
		local point1_x = start_position.x + (quarter * i)
		local point2_x = point1_x + quarter
		local point1 = vector(point1_x, start_position.y, start_position.z)
		local point2 = vector(point2_x, start_position.y, start_position.z)
		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration and self.fish_fight_end == false do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
			if i == 1 or i == 3 then
				y = y * -1
			end
			self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(point1, point2, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			time_passed = time_passed + (unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed)
		end
	end

	self.fish_fight_end = true
end

-- 지그재그 샷
function local_class:shot_move_zigzag(start_position, end_position, speed)
	local height = self.data.minigame_shot_height
	local turn_count = 8	-- 4의 배수로
	local duration = 6 / turn_count
	local part_dis = ((end_position.x - start_position.x) / turn_count)

	-- n번 꺾기
	for i = 0, turn_count - 1 do
		local point1_x = start_position.x + (part_dis * i)
		local point2_x = point1_x + part_dis
		local point1 = vector(point1_x, start_position.y, start_position.z)
		local point2 = vector(point2_x, start_position.y, start_position.z)
		local time_passed = 0
		while time_passed < duration and self.fish_fight_end == false do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local y = progress * height
			local p = i % 4
			if p == 1 or p == 2 then
				y = y * -1
			end
			if p == 1 then
				y = y + height
			elseif p == 3 then
				y = y - height
			end
			self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(point1, point2, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

			coroutine.yield(nil)

			time_passed = time_passed + (unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed)
		end
	end

	self.fish_fight_end = true
end

-- 스텔스 샷
function local_class:shot_move_stealth(start_position, end_position, speed)
	self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = start_position
	local center_pos_x = (end_position.x + start_position.x) / 2
	local half_distance = (end_position.x - start_position.x) / 2
	while self.fish_fight_end == false do
		local pos = self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition
		local diff =  (self.data.minigame_shot_move_min_speed + (speed - 1) * self.data.minigame_shot_move_speed) * unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.minigame_ui.ShotTransform.localPosition = vector(pos.x + diff, pos.y, pos.z)
		local alpha_progress = math.abs(center_pos_x - pos.x) / half_distance
		self.minigame_ui:SetIconAlpha(alpha_progress);
		if pos.x + diff > end_position.x then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.fish_fight_end = true
end

-- 물고기 놔주는 연출
function local_class:release_fish_core()
	local fish_list = self.fishing_manager.ProcessFishList

	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.npc_cat, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.npc_cat, { name = 'hurt' })

	-- 물고기 풀어주는 연출
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'eat' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	self.fish_throw_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_04', loop = true })
	for i = 0, fish_list.Count - 1 do
		local fish_data = fish_list[i]
		start_coroutine(self.throw_fish_to_water, self, fish_data)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.fish_throw_sfx)

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.npc_cat)
	character_util.set_anim(self.npc_cat, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'fishing/fishing_idle' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 리워드 알림
	if self.fishing_manager.ReleaseRewardList.Count > 0 then
		-- 방생 보상 메시지
		self:narration_release_reward()

		-- 보상 리워드 창
		local state = CS.Oak.RewardNoticeDefaultState()
		state.Title = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('popup_default_title')
		state.Notice = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('farm_fishing_get_release_reward')
		state.ItemList = self.fishing_manager.ReleaseRewardList
		state.OnConfirmButtonClicked = function()
			start_coroutine(self.close_reward_notice, self)
		end

		CS.Oak.RewardNoticeUtil.ShowRewardNotice(CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance, state)
	else
		self.fishing_manager:OpenIceBox()
	end
end

-- 물고기 한 마리를 물에 던지는 연출
function local_class:throw_fish_to_water(fish_data)
	local fish_spec = self.fishing_manager:GetFishSpec(fish_data.SpecId)
	local fish = self:get_fish_object(fish_spec)
	local target_pos = self.water_center_pos
	local fish_drop_end = false
	local item = drop_item_util.create_custom_item({ pos = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0), target = target_pos,
											 game_object = fish.gameObject, itemid = self.data.fishing_coin_item_id,	--아이템 ID가 무조건 필요해서 아무거나 넣음
											 notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true, show_shadow = false,
											 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true, auto_consume = true,
											 bounce_callback = function()
													fish_drop_end = true
												end })

	-- 물에 빠질 때까지 기다림
	while fish_drop_end == false do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self.fx_water_in_pool:Instantiate(target_pos)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_water_splash_01')
	item.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)	-- Dispose되는 타이밍이 약간 느려서 일단 치움
end

function local_class:GetFishSizeMultiplier(size, spec)
	local min = spec.MinLength
	local max = spec.MaxLength

	local diff = max - min

	local small = diff * 0.475 + min
	local medium = diff * 0.95 + min

	if size <= small then
		return 0.9
	elseif size <= medium then
		return 1.0
	else
		return 1.1
	end
end

-- 미끼 투척
function local_class:throw_rod()
	self.fish_progress = self.data.fish_progress.throw_rod

	-- 미끼가 없으면 경고 메시지
	local bait_count = 0
	local selected_bait = self.fishing_manager:GetSelectedBait()
	local item = CS.Oak.User.Me:GetItem(selected_bait);
	if item ~= nil then
		bait_count = item.Amount
	end

	if bait_count <= 0 then
		self.fish_progress = self.data.fish_progress.select_bait_fail
		start_coroutine(self.narration_no_bait, self)
		return
	end

	local is_valid_bait = self.fishing_manager:IsValidBaitRarity(selected_bait)
	if not is_valid_bait then
		self.fish_progress = self.data.fish_progress.select_bait_fail
		start_coroutine(self.narration_rarity_not_valid,self)
		return
	end

	-- 아이스 박스 한계
	local maxCount = self.fishing_manager:GetIceboxInventoryMax();
	-- 아이스박스 안의 물고기 수
	local fishCount = 0
	local inventory = farm_util.get_local_user_data().FishInventory
	if inventory ~= nil then
		for i = 0, inventory.Count - 1 do
			local fish = inventory[i]
			if fish.Floor == 0 then
				fishCount = fishCount + 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- 인벤토리 가득참
	if fishCount >= maxCount then
		self.fish_progress = self.data.fish_progress.select_bait_fail
		start_coroutine(self.narration_inventory_full,self)
		return
	end

	-- UI 숨김
	self.fishing_manager:HideBaitList()
	self.fishing_tool_ui:Hide()
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ChangeActionButton)

	-- 낚싯대 던지고 기다리는 애니메이션
	self:throw_rod_animation()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.use_bait, self))
end

-- 미끼 사용 후 네트워크 응답 기다림 [UseBait]
function local_class:use_bait()
	-- 서버에 요청 보내기
	local fishing_request = self.fishing_manager:UseBait()

	-- 요청을 했는대 NetworkRequest가 없다면 무언가 잘못된 것
	if fishing_request == nil then
		self:lost_bait_by_no_respond()
		return
	end

	-- 서버 응답 기다리기
	while not fishing_request.IsCompleted do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 요청이 Ok하지 않다면 무언가 잘못 된 것
	if not fishing_request.Ok then
		self:lost_bait_by_no_respond()
		return
	end

	-- 물고기 기다리기 시작
	self.fishing_wait_coroutine = coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fishing_wait, self))
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		-- 물고기 기다리는 중 낚시 버튼 터치
		if self.fish_progress == self.data.fish_progress.wait then
			--물고기 기다리는 코루틴을 중단시킴
			stop_coroutine(self.fishing_wait_coroutine)
			self.fishing_wait_coroutine = nil

			if self.current_fish_data ~= nil then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fishing_fight, self))
			elseif CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.GetInt("fishing_miss_check") == 0 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.action_button_warning_event, self))
				CS.UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs.SetInt("fishing_miss_check", 1)
			else
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lost_bait, self))
			end
		-- 미끼 선택
		elseif self.fish_progress == self.data.fish_progress.select_bait then
			self:throw_rod()
		-- 그 외 낚시 버튼 터치시
		else
			self.push_attack = true
		end
	-- 낚시 버튼 손 떼기
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchUp then
		self.push_attack = false
	-- 아이스박스 버튼 터치
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.ChangeStateTouchDown then
		self:open_icebox()
	end

	return false
end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	self.fish_throw_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_04', loop = true })

	-- 물고기 아이스박스에서 나오는 연출
	local eat_sfx
	local total_coin = 0
	for i = 0, fish_list.Count - 1 do
		local fish_data = fish_list[i]
		local fish_spec = self.fishing_manager:GetFishSpec(fish_data.SpecId)
		local fish = self:get_fish_object(fish_spec)
		local target_pos = self.npc_cat.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
		local item = drop_item_util.create_custom_item({ pos = self.npc_box.Position, target = target_pos,
											game_object = fish.gameObject, itemid = self.data.fishing_coin_item_id,	--아이템 ID가 무조건 필요해서 아무거나 넣음
											notforinven = true, showoncharacter = true, show_shadow = false,
											lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true,
										 	bounce_callback = function()
												fish_drop_end = true
											end })

		if i == 0 then
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'smile' })
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		if i == 0 then
			eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.npc_cat, { name = 'eat' }, { name = 'greed' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
		end
		start_coroutine(self.eat_fish, self, item, fish, 1.3)

		total_coin = total_coin + fish_spec.Price
	end

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.fish_throw_sfx)
	wait_for_sec(2.3)
	eat_sfx:Stop()

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.npc_cat)
	character_util.set_anim(self.npc_cat, { name = 'idle' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.npc_cat, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 낚시 코인 연출
	local coin = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = self.npc_cat.Position, target = user_party.Leader.Position,
											  itemid = self.data.fishing_coin_item_id, notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.5,
											  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true, skip_text = true })
	coin.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	wait_for_sec(2)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'fishing/fishing_idle' })

	-- 리워드 알림
	local reward = CS.Oak.Item.Create(CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(self.data.fishing_coin_item_id), nil, nil, nil,
			total_coin)
	local str = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('farm_fishing_get_fishing_coin')
	local list = CS.System.Collections.Generic.List(CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder)
	local items = list()
	items:Add(CS.Oak.IItemExtension.ToItemPlaceholder(reward))

	local state = CS.Oak.RewardNoticeDefaultState()
	state.Title = CS.GameStrings.Instance:GetString('popup_default_title')
	state.Notice = str
	state.ItemList = items
	state.OnConfirmButtonClicked = function()
		start_coroutine(self.close_reward_notice, self)
	end

	CS.Oak.RewardNoticeUtil.ShowRewardNotice(CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance, state)
end

-- 리워드 창 바로 닫고 아이스박스 열면 에러라서 이런 식으로 처리
function local_class:close_reward_notice()
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'fishing/fishing_idle', mix_duration = 0.2 })
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	self.fishing_manager:OpenIceBox()
end

-- 물고기 흔들리면서 줄어들고 사라지는 연출
function local_class:eat_fish(item, fish, duration)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local shake_duration = duration

	local shake_range = 0.05

	local shrink_start = duration - 1
	local start_scale = 1
	local end_scale = 0.3

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local item_pos = item.Position
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < shake_duration do
		local cur_shake_x = unity_class.random.Range(-shake_range, shake_range)
		local cur_shake_z = unity_class.random.Range(-shake_range, shake_range)

		item.Position = item_pos + vector(cur_shake_x, 0, cur_shake_z)

		if unity_class.time.time - cur_time >= shrink_start then
			local cur_scale = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear((unity_class.time.time - cur_time) - shrink_start,
					start_scale, end_scale - start_scale, shake_duration - shrink_start)

			fish.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * cur_scale
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item.ConsumeTarget = self.npc_cat
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
		return local_class(data_path, data_key, cs_behaviour)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('AfterWorldConveyorBeltMiniGame')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'AfterWorldConveyorBeltMiniGame'

	-- 게임의 데이터 키
	self.constants_data_key = ''
	self.data = nil

	-- 게임이 진행중인지
	self.game_loop = false

	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 게임 패드 버튼이 눌렸는지
	self.gamepad_button_pressed = false

	-- ox 카운트
	self.ox_count = 0

	-- 컨베이어 벨트의 마커 노드
	self.node = {}

	-- 피자 테이블
	self.pizza_table = {}

	-- 파인애플
	self.pineapple = {}

	-- 죄수 npc들
	self.prisoner_npc = {}

	-- 간수 npc들
	self.reaper_npc = {}

	-- 콤보 카운트
	self.combo_count = 0

	-- 성공한 피자 수
	self.success_pizza_count = 0

	-- 성공 + 실패 피자 수
	self.all_pizza_count = 0

	-- 마지막 피자 인덱스
	self.max_pizza_index = 0

	-- 리듬 게임 버튼
	self.button = nil

	-- 피자 카운터 ui
	self.ui_num_counter_object = nil
	self.ui_num_counter = nil

	-- ox 결과창 ui
	self.ox_object = nil
	self.ox = nil

	-- 콤보 텍스트 ui
	self.combo_text_object = nil
	self.combo_text = nil

	self.fail_count = 0
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require(
			'minigame/AfterWorldConveyorBeltMiniGame/AfterWorldConveyorBeltMiniGameConstants')
	self.data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	-- 오브젝트 풀 로드
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_button')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUINumCounter')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reward')

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

--region Event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.GamepadEvent) then
		if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown then
			self.gamepad_button_pressed = true
		end
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

--region Game Logic
function local_class:game_start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start_routine, self))
end

-- 게임 시작
function local_class:game_start_routine()
	self.game_loop = true

	-- 사전 세팅
	self:pre_setting()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	-- 경기 시작 카운트
	for i = 3, 1, -1 do
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_whistle_01')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(tostring(i), 2.1)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- 필요한 ui 로드
	self:load_UI()

	-- 필요한 구독 추가
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_event')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.conveyor_routine, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.touch_routine, self))

	wait_for_sec(0.417 / 2)

	-- BGM 재생
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ state = 'event', name = 'ondemand/afterworld/audio:bgm_afterworld_pizza' })
end

-- 실패 후 게임 재시작
function local_class:game_retry_routine()
	self.game_loop = true

	-- 사전 세팅
	self:pre_setting()

	-- 경기 시작 카운트
	for i = 3, 1, -1 do
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_whistle_01')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(tostring(i), 2.1)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.button.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.conveyor_routine, self))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.touch_routine, self))

	-- BGM 다시재생
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ state = 'event', name = 'ondemand/afterworld/audio:bgm_afterworld_pizza' })
end

-- 사전 세팅
function local_class:pre_setting()
	self.pizza_table = {}
	-- 피자 종류별로 노드 +1만큼 생성
	for i = 1, #self.data.pizza_table do
		local pizza = {}
		local sprite = self.data.pizza_table[i].sprite_id
		local scale = self.data.pizza_table[i].sprite_scale
		for j = 1, #self.data.conveyor_node + 1 do
			table.insert(pizza, { item = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ itemid = sprite, pos = vector(999, 0, 999),
					  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = scale }), use = false, index = i })
		end
		table.insert(self.pizza_table, pizza)
	end

	self.pineapple = {}
	-- 파인애플 추가
	for i = 1, #self.data.conveyor_node do
		table.insert(self.pineapple, { item = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ itemid = self.data.throw_sprite_id, pos = vector(999, 0, 999),
				  lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true, sprscale = self.data.throw_sprite_scale }), use = false })
	end

	self.node = {}
	-- 노드들 미리 추가 해놓음
	for i = 1, #self.data.conveyor_node do
		table.insert(self.node, { pos = field:GetMarker(self.data.conveyor_node[i]).position, pizza = nil })
	end

	self.prisoner_npc = {}
	-- npc 정보 추가
	for i = 1, #self.data.prisoner_npc_data do
		table.insert(self.prisoner_npc, { character = get_character(self.data.prisoner_npc_data[i].name),
		                                  index = self.data.prisoner_npc_data[i].node_index,
		                                  dir = self.data.prisoner_npc_data[i].direction })
	end

	self.reaper_npc = {}
	for i = 1, #self.data.reaper_npc_data do
		table.insert(self.reaper_npc, { character = get_character(self.data.reaper_npc_data[i].name) })
	end

	self.anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(user_party.Leader, self.data.action_anim) / self.data.action_anim_scale
end

-- UI 로드
function local_class:load_UI()
	-- UI 버튼
	local aspect = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.safeArea.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height;
	local target_size = vector(CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight * aspect, CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight);
	local button_pos = vector(0, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 140, 0)
	local start_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

	self.button = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('steampunk_rhythm_minigame_button'):Instantiate(start_pos)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.button.transform, 'FieldUI')
	self.button.transform.localPosition = button_pos
	self.button.transform.localScale = vector(60, 60, 60)
	self.button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, 'red_idle', true)

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local widget_offset = 0.2
	-- 콤보 텍스트
	if self.combo_text_object == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, res_holder,
				'theatres/steampunk_rhythm_minigame', 'rhythm_combo', function (prefab)
					local go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
					local t = go.transform
					t.localPosition = vector(0, target_size.y * widget_offset, 0)
					local n_text = t:Find('number'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel))
					self.combo_text_object = go
					self.combo_text = n_text
					go:SetActive(false)
				end	)
	end

	-- 카운트 ui
	self.ui_num_counter_object = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUINumCounter'):Instantiate(vector(0, 0, 1))
	self.ui_num_counter = self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUINumCounter))
	self.ui_num_counter:Reposition()
	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(self.success_pizza_count)
	self.ui_num_counter:SetMaxCount(#self.data.pizza_cycle)

	res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	-- ox ui
	if self.ox_object == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				res_holder, 'ondemand/afterworld/ui', 'minigame_ox', function(prefab)
					self.ox_object = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				end)
	end
	self.ox = self.ox_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation))
	self.ox_object.transform.localScale = vector(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.ox_object.transform, 'UI')
	self.ox_object.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

-- 터치 관리하는 루틴
function local_class:touch_routine()
	local button_pos = self.button.transform.localPosition
	local button_state = self.button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state
	local button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
	button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = self.button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
	button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)
	local pressed = button_touch_handler.Pressed
	local button_cooltime = self.data.button_cooltime

	while self.game_loop do
		local down = false
		local up = false
		button_cooltime = button_cooltime + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local current_pressed = button_touch_handler.Pressed or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A)
				or self.gamepad_button_pressed == true

		self.gamepad_button_pressed = false

		button_touch_handler:Update()

		if current_pressed ~= pressed then
			if current_pressed then
				down = true
			else
				up = true
			end
			pressed = current_pressed
		end

		-- 버튼 down + 버튼 쿨타임이 지났으면 호출
		if down then
			self.button.transform.localPosition = button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)
			music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_rhythm_o_01', fade_in_time = 0, type_priority = 'event'})
			button_state:SetAnimation(0, 'red_touch_on', false)

			if button_cooltime > self.data.button_cooltime then
				button_cooltime = 0
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.button_clicked, self))
			end
		elseif up then
			self.button.transform.localPosition = button_pos
			button_state:SetAnimation(0, 'red_idle', true)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 컨베이어 벨트 루틴
function local_class:conveyor_routine()
	local pizza_count = 0
	local time_passed = 0
	local cycle = 0
	local duration = self.data.move_duration
	local stay_time = self.data.stay_time
	local cycle_count = 1

	self.max_pizza_index = #self.data.pizza_table

	-- 한번 while 돌면 컨베이어 한칸 이동
	while self.game_loop do
		-- 아직 피자를 다 만들지 않았고 이번에 생성 타이밍이면 생성
		if pizza_count < #self.data.pizza_cycle then
			if cycle == self.data.pizza_cycle[cycle_count] then
				self.node[1].pizza = self:get_pizza(self.node[1].pos, 1)
				pizza_count = pizza_count + 1
				cycle_count = cycle_count + 1
				cycle = 0
			else
				cycle = cycle + 1
			end
		end

		time_passed = 0
		-- 반칸 이동하기
		while time_passed <= duration/2 do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			for i = 1, #self.node - 1 do
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(
						CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))

				if self.node[i].pizza ~= nil then
					self.node[i].pizza.item:SetPosition(
							unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.node[i].pos, self.node[i+1].pos, progress))
				end
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		local player_pizza = self.node[self.data.player_node].pizza
		-- 플레이어의 피자가 여전히 완성되지 않은 상태라면 실패 처리
		if player_pizza ~= nil and player_pizza.index < self.max_pizza_index then
			self.combo_count = 0
			self.combo_text_object:SetActive(false)
			self.all_pizza_count = self.all_pizza_count + 1
			self:combo_reaction()
			self:clear_check()

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_result_ui, self, false))
		end

		-- 절반정도 이동했으므로 피자의 노드를 한칸씩 이동시켜준다.
		for i = #self.node, 2, -1 do
			if self.node[i-1].pizza ~= nil then
				self.node[i].pizza = self.node[i-1].pizza
				self.node[i-1].pizza = nil
			end
		end

		-- 남은 절반 이동하기
		while time_passed <= duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			for i = 2, #self.node do
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(
						CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
				if self.node[i].pizza ~= nil then
					self.node[i].pizza.item:SetPosition(
							unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.node[i-1].pos, self.node[i].pos, progress))
				end
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not self.game_loop then return end

		-- 마지막 노드에 도착한 피자 제거
		if self.node[#self.node].pizza ~= nil then
			self:remove_item(self.node[#self.node].pizza)
			self.node[#self.node].pizza = nil
		end

		-- 자신의 노드에 피자가 있는 npc는 체크 후 파인애플을 올린다.
		for i = 1, #self.prisoner_npc do
			if self.node[self.prisoner_npc[i].index].pizza ~= nil then
				character_util.set_anim(self.prisoner_npc[i].character,
						{name = self.data.action_anim, scale = self.action_anim_scale,
						 loop = false, remove_after = self.anim_duration})

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_pineapple, self,
					self.node[self.prisoner_npc[i].index], self.prisoner_npc[i].character))
			end
		end

		if not self.game_loop then return end

		-- stay_time만큼 쉬기
		wait_for_sec(stay_time)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 버튼 클릭했을 때
function local_class:button_clicked()
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = self.data.action_emotion })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader,
			{name = self.data.action_anim, scale = self.action_anim_scale,
			 loop = false, remove_after = self.anim_duration})

	-- SFX 재생
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_food_02')

	-- 파인애플 던지기
	local result = self:throw_pineapple(self.node[self.data.player_node], user_party.Leader)

	-- 성공했다면
	if result then
		-- 콤보 증가
		self.combo_count = self.combo_count + 1
		self.combo_text_object:SetActive(true)
		self.combo_text.text = string.format("%d", self.combo_count)

		-- 동그라미 ui 표시
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_result_ui, self, true))

		-- 피자 점프
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pizza_jump, self))

		-- 카운트 증가
		self.all_pizza_count = self.all_pizza_count + 1
		self.success_pizza_count = self.success_pizza_count + 1
		self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(self.success_pizza_count)

		-- npc 콤보 리액션
		self:combo_reaction()

		-- 클리어 체크
		self:clear_check()
	end

	-- 콤보에 따른 플레이어 모션 변화
	self:set_leader_emotion()
end

-- 피자 점프
function local_class:pizza_jump()
	local time_passed = 0
	local pizza_jump_duration = 0.3

	-- 위 아래로 리듬 타는 피자
	while time_passed <= pizza_jump_duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if time_passed < pizza_jump_duration / 2 then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(
					CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(time_passed, 0, 1, pizza_jump_duration / 2))
			local cur_y = 0.7 +
					unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, self.data.pizza_jump_height, progress)

			for i = 2, #self.node - 1 do
				if self.node[i].pizza ~= nil then
					self.node[i].pizza.item:SetPosition(
							vector(self.node[i].pizza.item.Position.x, cur_y, self.node[i].pizza.item.Position.z))
				end
			end
		else
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(
					CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(time_passed, 0, 1, pizza_jump_duration))
			local cur_y = 0.7 +
					unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.data.pizza_jump_height, 0, progress)

			for i = 2, #self.node - 1 do

				if self.node[i].pizza ~= nil then
					self.node[i].pizza.item:SetPosition(
							vector(self.node[i].pizza.item.Position.x, cur_y, self.node[i].pizza.item.Position.z))
				end
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 성공 여부 ui 띄우기
function local_class:show_result_ui(success)
	self.ox_object.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.ox_count = self.ox_count + 1
	local count = self.ox_count
	if success then
		self.ox_result = true
		self.ox.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, 'good', false)
	else
		self.ox_result = false
		self.ox.AnimationState:SetAnimation(0, 'bad', false)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.433)

	-- 자기가 마지막 ox 코루틴이면 ui를 꺼준다
	if count == self.ox_count then
		self.ox_object.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end
end

-- 컨테이너에 돌아가고 있지 않은 피자를 가져온다. 노드보다 피자가 많기 때문에 정상적인 상황이라면 nil이 리턴되지 않음
function local_class:get_pizza(pos, index)
	for i = 1, #self.pizza_table[index] do
		if self.pizza_table[index][i].use == false then
			self.pizza_table[index][i].use = true
			self.pizza_table[index][i].item:SetPosition(pos)
			return self.pizza_table[index][i]
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- 컨테이너에 돌아가고 있지 않은 파인애플을 가져온다.
function local_class:get_pineapple(pos)
	for i = 1, #self.pineapple do
		if self.pineapple[i].use == false then
			self.pineapple[i].use = true
			self.pineapple[i].item:SetPosition(pos)
			return self.pineapple[i]
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- 노드의 피자를 다음 단계로 바꾼다
function local_class:change_next_pizza(node)
	local cur_pizza = node.pizza
	node.pizza = self:get_pizza(node.pos, node.pizza.index+1)
	self:remove_item(cur_pizza)
	return nil
end

-- 노드의 피자를 마지막 단계로 바로 완성 시킨다.
function local_class:complete_pizza(node)
	local cur_pizza = node.pizza
	node.pizza = self:get_pizza(node.pos, self.max_pizza_index)
	self:remove_item(cur_pizza)
	return nil
end

-- 피자에 파인애플을 더하는 루틴 / 올리는데 성공하면 true 아니면 false를 반환
function local_class:throw_pineapple(node, character)
	local duration = self.data.pineapple_duration
	local leader = lua_helper.reference_equals(character, user_party.Leader)

	-- 판정시간 - 날아가는 시간만큼 쉬기
	wait_for_sec(self.data.success_check_delay - duration)

	local pineapple = self:get_pineapple(character.Position + (direction_util.to_vector3(character.Direction)/5) +
			vector(0, node.pos.y + self.data.pineapple_pos.y, 0))
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = pineapple.item.Position
	local end_pos = node.pos + vector(self.data.pineapple_pos.x, self.data.pineapple_pos.y, self.data.pineapple_pos.z)
	-- 피자로 이동하기
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = time_passed / duration
		if progress > 1 then
			progress = 1
		end

		pineapple.item:SetPosition(unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress))
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 완성된 피자가 아니라면 파인애플 추가
	if node.pizza ~= nil and node.pizza.index < self.max_pizza_index then
		-- 파인애플을 던진게 리더라면 성공 체크
 		if leader then
		    if (node.pizza.item.Position - node.pos).magnitude <= self.data.success_distance then
			    self:remove_item(pineapple)
			    self:complete_pizza(node)
			    return true
		    else
			    self:remove_item(pineapple)
			    return false
		    end
		else
			-- npc라면 그냥 성공 처리
		    self:remove_item(pineapple)
		    self:change_next_pizza(node)
			return true
		end
	else
		self:remove_item(pineapple)
		return false
	end
end

-- 아이템 없애기
function local_class:remove_item(item)
	item.use = false
	item.item:SetPosition(vector(999, 0, 999))
	return nil
end

-- 콤보에 따른 npc들 상태 변경
function local_class:combo_reaction()
	if self.combo_count == 0 then
		for i = 1, #self.reaper_npc do
			character_util.set_direction(self.reaper_npc[i].character, 'right')
			character_util.normal_jump(self.reaper_npc[i].character)
			character_util.set_emotion(self.reaper_npc[i].character, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_anim(self.reaper_npc[i].character, {name = 'release', remove_after = 0.92})
		end
		for i = 1, #self.prisoner_npc do
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.prisoner_npc[i].character)
		end
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	elseif self.combo_count == 2 then
		for i = 1, #self.reaper_npc do
			character_util.remove_emotion(self.reaper_npc[i].character)
			character_util.set_direction(self.reaper_npc[i].character, 'up')
		end
	elseif self.combo_count == 5 then
		for i = 1, #self.reaper_npc do
			character_util.set_direction(self.reaper_npc[i].character, 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(self.reaper_npc[i].character, { name = 'smile' })
			character_util.set_anim(self.reaper_npc[i].character, { name = 'sing' })
		end
		for i = 1, #self.prisoner_npc do
			character_util.set_emotion(self.prisoner_npc[i].character, { name = 'smile' })
		end
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
	elseif self.combo_count == 10 then
		for i = 1, #self.reaper_npc do
			character_util.set_emotion(self.reaper_npc[i].character, { name = 'awesome' })
			character_util.set_anim(self.reaper_npc[i].character, { name = 'clap' })
		end
		for i = 1, #self.prisoner_npc do
			character_util.set_emotion(self.prisoner_npc[i].character, { name = 'awesome' })
		end
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'awesome' })
	end
end

-- 콤보에 따른 리더 emotion 변경
function local_class:set_leader_emotion()
	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(user_party.Leader, self.data.action_anim) / self.data.action_anim_scale
	wait_for_sec(anim_duration - self.data.success_check_delay)

	if not self.game_loop then return end

	if self.combo_count < 5 then
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	elseif self.combo_count < 10 then
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'smile' })
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'awesome' })
	end
end

-- 클리어 체크
function local_class:clear_check()
	if self.all_pizza_count >= #self.data.pizza_cycle then
		local clear_count = self.fail_count >= self.data.change_ease_count
				and self.data.change_ease_count or self.data.clear_count
		if self.success_pizza_count >= clear_count then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.minigame_clear, self))
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.minigame_fail, self))
		end
	end
end

-- 게임 클리어

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	self.combo_text_object:SetActive(false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = "01_firework_01" })

	local fanfare = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_reward'):Instantiate(vector(0,0,0))
	fanfare.transform.localScale = vector(0.00278,0.00278,0.00278)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('aw_conveyor_mini_game_clear'), 2.1)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'success' }, { name = 'smile'})
	for i = 1, #self.prisoner_npc do
		character_util.look_at(self.prisoner_npc[i].character, user_party.Leader)
		character_util.remove_anim(self.prisoner_npc[i].character)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.prisoner_npc[i].character, { name = 'clap' }, { name = 'smile'})
	end

	for i = 1, #self.reaper_npc do
		character_util.look_at(self.reaper_npc[i].character, user_party.Leader)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.reaper_npc[i].character, { name = 'clap' }, { name = 'smile'})
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)

	local afterworld_main_quest_id = 60049
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(afterworld_main_quest_id)

	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.InnerProgress == 6 then
		-- 테이블 제거
		self:clear_table()

		-- ui 제거
		self:clear_ui()
	else
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		for i = 1, #self.prisoner_npc do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.prisoner_npc[i].character)
			character_util.set_direction(self.prisoner_npc[i].character, self.prisoner_npc[i].dir)
		end

		for i = 1, #self.reaper_npc do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.reaper_npc[i].character)
		end
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

		-- 테이블 제거
		self:clear_table()

		-- ui 제거
		self:clear_ui()

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
end

-- 게임 실패
function local_class:minigame_fail()
	self.game_loop = false

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('aw_conveyor_mini_game_fail'))

	self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.button.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.combo_text_object:SetActive(false)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'dead3', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged'})
	for i = 1, #self.prisoner_npc do
		local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.prisoner_npc[i].character.Position - user_party.Leader.Position)
		self.prisoner_npc[i].character.Direction = look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None and self.prisoner_npc[i].character.Direction or look_dir
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.prisoner_npc[i].character, { name = 'dead1', loop = false }, { name = 'tired'})
	end

	for i = 1, #self.reaper_npc do
		character_util.look_at(self.reaper_npc[i].character, user_party.Leader)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.reaper_npc[i].character, { name = 'cast2' }, { name = 'mad'})
		character_util.show_emoticon(self.reaper_npc[i].character, nil, 'angry')
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)
	self.fail_count = self.fail_count + 1
	if self.fail_count >= self.data.pass_fail_count then
		if #self.reaper_npc > 0 then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.reaper_npc[1].character, { key = 'aw_conveyor_mini_game_fail_1', skip = true })
		end
		local afterworld_main_quest_id = 60049
		local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(afterworld_main_quest_id)

		if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.InnerProgress == 6 then
			-- 테이블 제거
			self:clear_table()

			-- ui 제거
			self:clear_ui()
		else
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			for i = 1, #self.prisoner_npc do
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.prisoner_npc[i].character)
				character_util.set_direction(self.prisoner_npc[i].character, self.prisoner_npc[i].dir)
			end

			for i = 1, #self.reaper_npc do
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.reaper_npc[i].character)
			end
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

			-- 테이블 제거
			self:clear_table()

			-- ui 제거
			self:clear_ui()

			message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))

			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		end
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
		return
	end

	-- 재도전 여부 체크
	local wait = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local retry = true

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('aw_conveyor_mini_game_fail_retry'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })

	--branches:Add({
	--	Text = game_string:GetString('aw_conveyor_mini_game_fail_stop'),
	--	Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
	--	Callback = function()
	--		wait = false
	--		retry = false
	--	end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for i = 1, #self.prisoner_npc do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.prisoner_npc[i].character)
		character_util.set_direction(self.prisoner_npc[i].character, self.prisoner_npc[i].dir)
	end

	for i = 1, #self.reaper_npc do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.reaper_npc[i].character)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	-- 테이블 제거
	self:clear_table()

	-- 재도전
	if retry then
		self.gamepad_button_pressed = false
		self:reset_count()
		self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(0)
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_retry_routine, self))
	else
		-- ui 제거
		self:clear_ui()

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, false))
	end
end

-- 테이블 삭제
function local_class:clear_table()
	for i = 1, #self.node do
		self.node[i].pizza = nil
	end
	self.node = nil

	for i = 1, #self.pizza_table do
		for j = 1, #self.pizza_table[i] do
			self.pizza_table[i][j].item:ConsumeComplete()
		end
		self.pizza_table[i] = nil
	end
	self.pizza_table = nil

	for i = 1, #self.pineapple do
		self.pineapple[i].item:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	self.prisoner_npc = nil

	self.reaper_npc = nil
end

-- ui 삭제
function local_class:clear_ui()
	-- 버튼 제거
	if self.button ~= nil then
		self.button:Dispose()
		self.button = nil
	end

	-- ox 제거
	self.ox = nil
	if self.ox_object ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.ox_object)
		self.ox_object = nil
	end

	-- 카운터 ui 제거
	self.ui_num_counter = nil
	if self.ui_num_counter_object ~= nil then
		self.ui_num_counter_object:Dispose()
		self.ui_num_counter_object = nil
	end

	-- 콤보 텍스트 ui
	self.combo_text = nil
	if self.combo_text_object ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.combo_text_object)
		self.combo_text_object = nil
	end
end

-- count들 초기화
function local_class:reset_count()
	self.combo_count = 0
	self.success_pizza_count = 0
	self.all_pizza_count = 0
	self.ox_count = 0
end
--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))

	if self.button ~= nil then
		self.button:Dispose()
		self.button = nil
	end

	self.ox = nil
	if self.ox_object ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.ox_object)
		self.ox_object = nil
	end

	self.ui_num_counter = nil

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

function local_class:game_start()

	start_coroutine(self.game_start_routine, self)
end

function local_class:game_start_routine()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self.game_failed = false
	self.playing_game_clear_routine = false

	self:execute_manager_func('start_routine')
	camera_util.resize_to(self.default_cam_size, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(self.game_center, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	start_coroutine(self.update_routine, self)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_dendrobium', state = 'event' })
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

	--TODO: UI를 오프닝 연출에 보일지 말지 정해서 할 수 있도록 수정
	self.ui_manager:show_minigame_field_ui()

	if self.cur_opening_scene_state == self.opening_scene_state.none then
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
		self.update_time = true
	end
end

function local_class:game_restart_routine()
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.starting
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.update_time = false

	if self.repeat_opening_scene then
		self.cur_opening_scene_state = self.opening_scene_state.should_play
	end

	self:game_start_routine()
end

function local_class:update_routine()
	if self.cur_opening_scene_state == self.opening_scene_state.should_play then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'play_desert_bull_worm_opening_scene' }))

		while self.cur_opening_scene_state == self.opening_scene_state.should_play do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

			--TODO: 다른 오픈닝 연출에 사용 가능하도록 옵션에 따라 메니져를 골라서 update_routine 하도록 수정
			self:execute_manager_func('update_routine', dt)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.ui_manager:show_minigame_field_ui()
		self.update_time = true
	end

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.playing

	while self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.playing do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.update_time then
			self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
		end

		self:execute_manager_func('update_routine', dt)

		if self.enemy_manager.all_pattern_cleared and
				not self.playing_game_clear_routine then
			self.playing_game_clear_routine = true
			start_coroutine(self.game_clear, self)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:execute_manager_func(function_name, param1)
	for i = 1, #self.managers do
		local manager = self.managers[i]

		if manager ~= nil then
			local init_func = manager[function_name]

			if init_func ~= nil then
				init_func(manager, param1)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == 'AvoidDesertBullWorm' and not e.success and not self.game_failed then
		start_coroutine(self.game_over_event, self)
	end
end

-- 플레이어와 적의 공통 연출은 여기서 진행하도록 하겠음.
