function local_class:game_over_event()
	self.ui_manager:hide_minigame_field_ui()
	self.game_failed = true

	local player = self.player_manager.player
	local enemies = {}
	local enemies_data = self.enemy_manager.enemies_data
	for i = 1, 3 do
		table.insert(enemies, enemies_data[i].enemy)
	end

	-- 이동 관련 변수 (공용)
	local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
	local end_center_pos = vector(self.game_center.x, 0, player.Position.z)
	local enemy_move_back = false

	-- 적 중 하나라도 위치가 앞으로 나와 있는 경우
	for i = 1, 3 do
		if enemies[i].Position.x >= end_center_pos.x - 0.5 then
			enemy_move_back = true
			break
		end
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.5)

	local player_and_bg_move_routine = util.cs_generator(function()
		self.player_manager:wait_state()

		local dur = 2
		local time_passed = 0
		local player_start_pos = player.Position
		local player_end_pos = end_center_pos

		-- 플레이어와 같은 ease_out_quad로 배경 이동 할 거라 일반 배경 스크롤링 중단
		self.bg_manager.cur_speed = 0

		while self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.playing do
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			time_passed = time_passed + dt

			if time_passed > dur then
				break
			end

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(interpolations_constants.ease_out_quad(time_passed, 0, 1, dur))

			-- 플레이어 위치 이동
			local player_new_pos = player_start_pos * (1 - progress) + player_end_pos * progress
			local moving_vector = player_new_pos - player.Position

			if enemy_move_back then
				local player_moving_dis = player_new_pos - player.Position
				for i = 1, 3 do
					enemies[i].Position = enemies[i].Position + player_moving_dis
				end
			end

			player.Position = player_new_pos

			-- 배경 속도 줄이기
			self.bg_manager:move_bg_manually(moving_vector)
		end
	end)

	-- 사막 황소벌레 위치 이동은 다른 코루틴에서 처리한다.
	-- 이유: 플레이어는 쓰러진 후 바로 맵 중앙으로 이동하고, 황소벌레는 패턴 끝내고, 바닥에 들어간 후 이동해야 자연스러운 연출이 나옴
	local enemy_move_routine = util.cs_generator(function()
		self.enemy_manager:stop_and_wait()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_16')

		for i = 1, 3 do
			local enemy = enemies[i]
			character_util.set_anim(enemy, { name = 'in', loop = false })
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.783)

		for i = 1, 3 do
			if self.enemy_manager.sand_run_fxs[i] ~= nil then
				self.enemy_manager.sand_run_fxs[i]:Dispose()
			end

			self.enemy_manager.get_sand_run_end_fx():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(enemies[i].Bounds.center))
		end

		self.enemy_manager.sand_run_fxs = nil

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sink_sand_02')

		for i = 1, 3 do
			local enemy = enemies[i]
			character_util.set_active_shadow(enemy, false)
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.45)

		enemy_move_back = false

		local enemy_move_dur = 1
		local enemy_time_passed = 0

		-- 사막황소벌레 이동 관련
		local enemy_star_pos = {
			enemies[1].Position,
			enemies[2].Position,
			enemies[3].Position
		}
		local enemy_z_diff = end_center_pos.z > self.game_center.z and -0.7 or 0.7
		local is_enemy_one_right = enemies[1].Position.x > enemies[3].Position.x
		local enemy_end_pos = {
			end_center_pos + vector(is_enemy_one_right and 2 or -2, 0, enemy_z_diff),
			end_center_pos,
			end_center_pos + vector(is_enemy_one_right and -2 or 2, 0, enemy_z_diff)
		}

		while self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.playing do
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			enemy_time_passed = enemy_time_passed + dt

			if enemy_time_passed > enemy_move_dur then
				break
			end

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(interpolations_constants.ease_out_quad(enemy_time_passed, 0, 1, enemy_move_dur))

			-- 사막 황소벌레 위치 이동
			for i = 1, 3 do
				enemies[i].Position = enemy_star_pos[i] * (1 - progress) + enemy_end_pos[i] * progress
			end
		end
	end)

	wait_all({
		player_and_bg_move_routine,
		enemy_move_routine
	})

	local dur = 1.5

	--FIXME: 아래처럼 작업하면 필요한 쓰레드가 생기니까 화면으로 날아가는 연출 scene_util에 최적화 된 버전으로 하나 만들어서 사용하면 좋을듯
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(player, 'Default', 10)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(player, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(player)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(player)
	character_util.spine_rotate(player, -45, dur)
	character_util.jump(player, 1.5, dur)
	character_util.spine_scale(player, unity_class.vector3.one * 10, dur)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	local fly_target_pos = self.game_center + vector(0, 1, -7)

	character_util.move_to(player, fly_target_pos, dur)

	wait_for_sec(0.03)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sink_sand_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_01')

	self.enemy_manager:make_sand_out_fx()

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local enemy = enemies[i]
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(enemy, { name = 'out' })
		character_util.set_active_shadow(enemy, true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.47)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	character_util.spine_rotate(player, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_scale(player, unity_class.vector3.one)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(player, true)
	character_util.set_sorting_layer(player, 'Default', 0)

	self:game_restart_routine()
end

function local_class:game_clear()
	-- 한 프레임 기다리고, 게임 실패하지 않았다면 성공 연출 진행
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if self.game_failed then
		self.playing_game_clear_routine = false
		return
	end

	local enemies_data = self.enemy_manager.enemies_data
	local enemies = { enemies_data[1].enemy, enemies_data[2].enemy, enemies_data[3].enemy }
	local player = self.player_manager.player
	local screen_x = screen_util.get_world_screen_size().x
	local screen_x_extents = screen_x * 0.5

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_rise_01')

	--UI 제거 후 연출 시작 전 0.5초 대기
	self.ui_manager:hide_minigame_field_ui(true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--황소벌레들 공격 범위 표시 후 돌진 시작하도록
	local attack_ranges = {}

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local enemy = enemies[i]
		local x_size = player.Position.x - enemy.Position.x + 2
		local x_pos = enemy.Position.x + (x_size * 0.5) + 1
		local attack_range_pos = unity_class.vector3(x_pos, 0.03, enemy.Position.z)
		local attack_range_size = unity_class.vector2(x_size, 1.33)

		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(attack_range_pos, attack_range_size, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		attack_range:Show(1)

		table.insert(attack_ranges, attack_range)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_rush_01')

	local cam_dur = 0.5

	--따라오던 황소벌레들, 셋 동시에 정면으로 회전하며 1의 속도로 돌진
	local time_speed = 0.1
	local worm_speed = 2.5
	local worm_move_dur = 3

	-- 카메라 이동에 걸리는 시간도 더해준다
	local worm_move_dis = worm_speed * worm_move_dur * time_speed + cam_dur
	local worm_move_end_cnt = 0

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local enemy = enemies[i]
		character_util.set_anim(enemy, { name = 'spin' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(enemy, enemy.Position + vector(worm_move_dis, 0, 0),
				worm_speed, false, nil, nil, nil, false, nil, function()
					worm_move_end_cnt = worm_move_end_cnt + 1
				end)
	end

	-- 0.5초동안 서서히 황소벌레들 엘비라에 가까워지며 카메라 엘비라 2타일 왼쪽으로 포커스, 카메라 줌 4
	local cam_move_to = vector(player.Position.x - 2, 0, self.game_center.z)

	camera_util.resize_to(4, cam_dur)
	camera_util.move_async(cam_move_to, cam_dur, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	-- 카메라 줌 끝난 후, 엘비라 표정(damaged), 슬로우모션 0.1배속으로 연타 QTE 12회
	character_util.set_emotion(player, { name = 'damaged' })
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')

	time_util.mod('slow_motion', time_speed)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	start_coroutine(self.bg_manager.mult_bg_color, self.bg_manager, 0.5, 0.1 * time_speed)
	self:qte_tap_event(12)

	time_util.unmod('slow_motion')

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_cyclone_02', loop = false, fade_out_time = 0.5 })

	self.bg_manager:mult_bg_color(2, 0.1)

	while worm_move_end_cnt < #enemies do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local enemy = enemies[i]
		character_util.set_anim(enemy, { name = 'spin' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(enemy, enemy.Position + vector(screen_x, 0, 0), 2.5, false)
	end

	-- QTE 끝난 후 엘비라 run 애니메이션 1.5배속으로 재생하며 표정 attack (FIX)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(player, { name = 'run', scale = 1.5 }, { name = 'attack' })

	-- 이동 시작하고 2초동안 원래의 카메라 사이즈로 서서히 줌아웃
	camera_util.resize_to(self.default_cam_size, 2)
	camera_util.move(cam_move_to + vector(4, 0, 0), 2)

	-- 서서히 빨리 달리다가 최대 속도 도달하면 속도 유지하면서 오른쪽 화면 밖으로 달려나가는 연출
	local faded_out = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		local target_speed = 2
		local time_passed = 0
		local total_dur = 2.2
		local accel_dur = 1

		while self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.playing do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			time_passed = time_passed + dt

			local cur_speed = interpolations_constants.ease_in_quad(time_passed, 0, target_speed, accel_dur)

			if time_passed >= total_dur or faded_out then
				break
			end

			player.Position = player.Position + vector(cur_speed * dt, 0, 0)
		end
	end)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_01')

	self:play_loop_sfx('01_cyclone_02')
	self:play_loop_sfx('01_earthquake_03')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1.2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	--황소벌레 공격 범위 제거
	for i = 1, 3 do
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(attack_ranges[i].gameObject)
	end

	faded_out = true

	-- 앤딩 연출 배경으로 이동
	self.bg_manager:add_ending_bg()
	self.bg_manager:move_to_end_bg()
	self.bg_manager.cur_speed = 0

	-- 플레이어 세팅
	character_util.stop(player)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(player, 'none')
	character_util.set_direction(player, 'right')

	local player_x_offset = 2
	player.Position = self.game_center - vector(screen_x_extents + player_x_offset, 0, 0)

	-- 적 세팅
	local enemy_x_offset = 4 + self.enemy_manager.radius
	local enemy_pivot = player.Position - vector(enemy_x_offset, 0, 0)
	local angle = { 0, 90, 270 }

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local enemy = enemies[i]
		character_util.stop(enemy)
		enemy.Position = self.enemy_manager:get_position_by_angle(angle[i], enemy_pivot)
	end

	camera_util.move_async(self.game_center, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	wait_for_sec(1)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	local speed = 10

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local enemy = enemies[i]
		character_util.move_waypoint(enemy, enemy.Position + vector(100, 0, 0), speed)
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.05, 99999)

	local player_wp = {
		vector(self.game_center.x, 0, player.Position.z),
		vector(self.game_center.x, 0, self.game_center.z - 4)
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(player, player_wp, speed, true)
	character_util.set_direction(player, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(player, { name = 'frustration', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })

	local left_side_enemy = enemies[3]

	while screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(left_side_enemy.Position, { bonus_distance = 4 }) or
			self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		character_util.stop(enemies[i])
	end

	self:remove_all_loop_sfx(0.5)

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1.5)
	camera_util.move_async(player.Position, 1.5)

	character_util.set_direction(player, 'right')

	character_util.move_waypoint(player, player.Position + vector(0, 0, -8), 2, false)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	character_util.stop(player)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
	character_util.hide_weapon(player, false)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create('AvoidDesertBullWorm', true))
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.clear
	self:clean()
end

function local_class:qte_tap_event(target_tap_count)
	local tap_count = 0

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap
					or e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.DoubleTap then
				tap_count = tap_count + 1
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	-- 게임패드 사용중이면 이벤트 핸들러 세팅
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self.game_pad_handler = {
			callback = function(_, e)
				if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.XButtonDown or
						e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.YButtonDown then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchEvent.Create(CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap, unity_class.vector2.zero))
					return true
				end
				return false
			end
		}
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	-- 게임패드 핸들러가 세팅되있다면 게임패드 이벤트 구독
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Subscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'callback')
	end

	-- QTE 연타 출력
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1, false, true)

	while tap_count <= target_tap_count and not self.is_stage_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	-- 구독 해지
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.touch_handler = nil
	if self.game_pad_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.game_pad_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
		self.game_pad_handler = nil
	end
end

function local_class:play_loop_sfx(sfx_name)
	if self.sfx_loop == nil then
		self.sfx_loop = {}
	end

	self.sfx_loop[sfx_name] = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_name, loop = true })
end

function local_class:remove_loop_sfx(sfx_name, mix_time)
	if self.sfx_loop[sfx_name] ~= nil then
		if mix_time == nil then
			self.sfx_loop[sfx_name]:Stop()
		else
			self.sfx_loop[sfx_name]:FadeOut(mix_time)
		end

		self.sfx_loop[sfx_name] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:remove_all_loop_sfx(mix_time)
	if self.sfx_loop ~= nil then
		for sfx_name, _ in pairs(self.sfx_loop) do
			self:remove_loop_sfx(sfx_name, mix_time)
		end

		self.sfx_loop = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('AvoidDesertBullWormBg')

function local_class:init()
	-- 배경 프리팹 담음 테이블
	self.bg_pools = {}

	-- 배경 프리팹의 길이
	self.bg_pool_size = 0

	-- 배경 프리팹이 리셋되는 위치
	self.bg_reset_pos = nil

	-- 플레이어가 이동 못하도록 막는 벽들
	self.walls = nil

	-- 배경 중심 위치 관련
	self.bg_offset = vector(0, 0, -1)
	self.bg_center = nil

	-- 배경 이동 속도
	self.original_speed = 0
	self.cur_speed = 0

	-- 배경 이동 방향
	self.bg_scroll_dir = 'left'
	self.bg_scroll_dir_vec = vector(-1, 0, 0)

	-- 리셋할 때 더할 사이즈
	self.reset_adding_size = nil

	-- 앤딩 연출에 사용되는 배경 프리팹
	self.ending_bg_pool = nil
	self.cached_bg_pool = nil

	self.show_ending_bg = false
	self.mid_idx = 0
	self.ending_bg_idx = 0
	self.ending_bg_full_appear = false
	self.ending_prefab_offset = vector(0, 0, 0)
	self.half_screen_size = nil

	self.shared_materials = nil
end

function local_class:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	-- 데이터 초기화
	local bg_data = self.controller.constants_data['bg_data']
	local bg_offset = vector(0, 0, -1)
	self.bg_center = self.controller.game_center + bg_offset
	self.bg_pool_size = bg_data.prefab_size
	self.original_speed = bg_data.speed
	self.bg_reset_pos = self.controller.game_center.x + (self.bg_pool_size * -2)
	self.reset_adding_size = self.bg_scroll_dir_vec * self.bg_pool_size * -1

	local ending_prefab_offset = bg_data.ending_prefab_offset
	if ending_prefab_offset ~= nil then
		self.ending_prefab_offset = vector(ending_prefab_offset.x, ending_prefab_offset.y, ending_prefab_offset.z)
	end

	self.half_screen_size = screen_util.get_world_screen_size() * 0.5

	-- 배경 생성
	local gap = direction_util.to_vector3(self.bg_scroll_dir) * self.bg_pool_size
	local mid_idx = math.floor(bg_data.prefab_num * 0.5)
	self.mid_idx = bg_data.prefab_num % 2 ~= 0 and mid_idx + 1 or mid_idx

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	self.shared_materials = {}

	for i = 1, bg_data.prefab_num do
		local idx_from_mid = self.mid_idx - i
		local pos = self.bg_center + (gap * idx_from_mid)

		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.res_holder, bg_data.asset_bundle, bg_data.prefab_name, function(prefab)
					local bg_pool = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
					bg_pool.transform.localPosition = pos
					self:add_shared_materials(bg_pool)
					table.insert(self.bg_pools, bg_pool)
				end)
	end

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, bg_data.asset_bundle, bg_data.ending_prefab_name, function(prefab)
				self.ending_bg_pool = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
				self.ending_bg_pool.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
				self.ending_bg_pool:SetActive(false)
				self:add_shared_materials(self.ending_bg_pool)
			end)
end

function local_class:add_shared_materials(pool)
	for i = 0, pool.transform.childCount - 1 do
		local layer = pool.transform:GetChild(i)

		local renderers = layer:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))

		for j = 0, renderers.Length - 1 do
			local renderer = renderers[j]
			local shared_material = renderer.sharedMaterial
			local new_shared_material = CS.UnityEngine.Material(shared_material)

			renderer.sharedMaterial = new_shared_material

			table.insert(self.shared_materials, new_shared_material)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:mult_bg_color(color_mult, dur)
	local original_colors = {}

	for i = 1, #self.shared_materials do
		local original_color = self.shared_materials[i].color
		table.insert(original_colors, original_color)
	end

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < dur do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / dur)

		for i = 1, #self.shared_materials do
			local shared_material = self.shared_materials[i]
			local color = original_colors[i]
			local target_color = color * color_mult
			local cur_color = unity_class.color.Lerp(color, target_color, progress)

			if shared_material:HasProperty("_Color") then
				shared_material:SetColor("_Color", cur_color)
			elseif shared_material:HasProperty("_TintColor") then
				shared_material:SetColor("_TintColor", cur_color)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:clean()
	self:dispose()
	self:init()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.bg_pools ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.bg_pools do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.bg_pools[i])
		end
		self.bg_pools = nil
	end

	if self.ending_bg_pool ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.ending_bg_pool)
		self.ending_bg_pool = nil
	end

	self.shared_materials = nil
	self.res_holder = nil
	self.walls = nil
	self.walls_original_pos = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:start_routine()
	self.cur_speed = self.original_speed

	if self.walls == nil then
		self:create_boundary_walls()
	end
end

function local_class:update_routine(dt)
	self:scroll_bg(dt)
end

function local_class:add_ending_bg()
	self.show_ending_bg = true

	local half_bg_size = self.bg_pool_size * 0.5
	local pos_adding_size = self.reset_adding_size + self.ending_prefab_offset
	local pool_num = #self.bg_pools

	-- 화면에 보이지 않으면서 다음 순서로 화면에 보이는 배경의 idx를 찾아라
	for i = self.mid_idx, pool_num do
		local cur_bg_pos = self.bg_pools[i].transform.position
		local check_pos = cur_bg_pos + vector(half_bg_size, 0, 0)

		if check_pos.x >= self.bg_center.x  and not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(check_pos) then
			self.ending_bg_idx = i == pool_num and 1 or i + 1

			self.cached_bg_pool = self.bg_pools[self.ending_bg_idx]
			self.bg_pools[self.ending_bg_idx] = self.ending_bg_pool

			self.cached_bg_pool.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			self.cached_bg_pool:SetActive(false)

			self.ending_bg_pool:SetActive(true)
			self.ending_bg_pool.transform.position = self.bg_pools[i].transform.position + pos_adding_size
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:scroll_bg(dt)
	local velocity = self.bg_scroll_dir_vec * self.cur_speed * dt
	local num = #self.bg_pools

	-- 배경 위치 업데이트
	for i = 1, num do

	--

	--		end
	--

	--		reset_target.transform.position = dest_pos
	--	end
	--end

	-- 배경 재사용을 위한 위치 리셋
	local reset_target = self.bg_pools[1]
	local reset_target_pos = reset_target.transform.position

	if reset_target_pos.x < self.bg_reset_pos then
		local dest_pos = self.bg_pools[num].transform.position + self.reset_adding_size

		for i = 2, num do
			self.bg_pools[i - 1] = self.bg_pools[i]
		end

		self.bg_pools[num] = reset_target
		reset_target.transform.position = dest_pos
	end
end

function local_class:move_bg_manually(moving_vector)
	for i = 1, #self.bg_pools do
		local bg = self.bg_pools[i]
		bg.transform.position = bg.transform.position + moving_vector

function local_class:move_to_end_bg()
	local ending_pool_pos = self.bg_pools[self.ending_bg_idx].transform.position
	-- offset 만큼 x 이동 했을 때 T의 아랫 길이 화면 중앙에 오도록 한다.
	local x_offset = 122.5

	for i= 1, #self.bg_pools do

function local_class:create_boundary_walls()
	local player = self.controller.cached_player
	local player_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(player.Bounds.center, player.Position.y)

	local wall_data = {
		top_wall = {
			hitbox_size = vector(20, 1, 1),
			position = self.bg_center + vector(0, 0, 3.5)
		},
		bot_wall = {
			hitbox_size = vector(20, 1, 1),
			position = self.bg_center + vector(0, 0, -1.5)
		},
		left_wall = {
			hitbox_size = vector(1, 0.2, 10),
			position = player_pos - vector(0.5, 0, 0)
		},
		right_wall = {
			hitbox_size = vector(1, 0.2, 10),
			position = player_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
		}
	}

	self.walls = {}
	self.walls_original_pos = {}

	for wall_name, wall_info in pairs(wall_data) do
		local wall = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		wall.Name = wall_name
		wall.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(wall_info.hitbox_size)
		wall.Position = wall_info.position
		wall.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.DefaultCrashBehaviour.Instance
		wall.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
		wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

		self.walls[wall_name] = wall
		self.walls_original_pos[wall_name] = wall.Position

		message_system:Send(field, CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(wall))
	end
end

-- 플레이어의 z축 이동을 막는 함수
function local_class:block_vertical_movement(block_on)
	local player = self.controller.cached_player
	local top_wall = self.walls.top_wall
	local bot_wall = self.walls.bot_wall

	if block_on then
		local player_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(player.Bounds.center, player.Position.y)

		top_wall.Position = player_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
		bot_wall.Position = player_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	else
		top_wall.Position = self.walls_original_pos.top_wall
		bot_wall.Position = self.walls_original_pos.bot_wall
	end
end

-- 플레이어가 연출 등의 이유료 x축 이동하면 x축이동을 막는 벽도 위치 업데이트 필요
function local_class:update_horizontal_block_walls()
	local player = self.controller.cached_player
	local player_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(player.Bounds.center, player.Position.y)
	local right_wall = self.walls.right_wall
	local left_wall = self.walls.left_wall

	right_wall.Position = player_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	left_wall.Position = player_pos - vector(0.5, 0, 0)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('AvoidDesertBullWormEnemy')

local enemy_state_base = newclass('AvoidDesertBullWormEnemyState')
local enemy_normal_state = newclass('AvoidDesertBullWormEnemyNormalState', enemy_state_base)
local enemy_dash_state = newclass('AvoidDesertBullWormEnemyDashState', enemy_state_base)
local enemy_spit_state = newclass('AvoidDesertBullWormEnemySpitState', enemy_state_base)

-- 가로 화면 크기와 상관없이 플레이어와 간격은 같게 해야한다. (동일한 게임 난이도를 위해)

function local_class:init()
	self.controller = nil

	-- 몬스터들의 위치
	self.spawn_pivot_pos = nil
	self.radius = 1.5
	self.enemies_data = {
		{
			enemy = nil,
			state = nil,
		},
		{
			enemy = nil,
			state = nil,
		},
		{
			enemy = nil,
			state = nil,
		}
	}

	self.enemies_angle_data = nil

	-- 단체 행동 관련
	-- 회전 패턴 진행도
	self.rotate_state = {
		none = 0,
		starting = 1,
		rotating = 2,
		force_stop = 3
	}
	self.cur_rotate_state = self.rotate_state.none
	self.rotate_time_passed = 0
	self.rotate_speed = 0

	-- 벌레가 움직이지 않고, 배경만 움직일 때 사용할 이팩트
	self.sand_run_fxs = nil

	self.pattern_data = nil
	self.pattern_balance_data = nil

	-- 다음에 실행할 패턴 (nil이면 다음 패턴은 없는 것으로 간주)
	self.next_pattern = nil
	self.cur_pattern_idx = 1

	self.get_sand_out_fx = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_graboid_sand_out')
	end

	self.get_sand_run_fx = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_graboid_sand_hide_loop_run_rosetta')
	end

	self.get_sand_run_end_fx = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_graboid_sand_hide_loop_run_end_rosetta')
	end

	self.get_acid_proj = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_graboid_acid_saliva_proj')
	end

	self.get_acid_proj_fire = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_graboid_acid_saliva_proj_fire')
	end

	self.get_acid_proj_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_graboid_acid_saliva_proj_hit')
	end

	self.stop = false
	self.is_stopped = false

	self.all_pattern_cleared = false

	--region 투척형 패턴을 위한 프로젝타일 관련
	self.pooled_proj_data = {}
	self.pooled_proj_num = 18
	--endregion
end

function local_class:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.spawn_pivot_pos = self.controller.game_center + vector(-4.5, 0, 0)

	self.optimized_enemies = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		enemy_1 = 'shortstory_rt_boss_graboid',
		enemy_2 = 'shortstory_rt_boss_graboid',
		enemy_3 = 'shortstory_rt_boss_graboid',
	})

	local enemies_key = {
		'enemy_1', 'enemy_2', 'enemy_3'
	}

	self.get_sand_run_fx()
	self.get_sand_run_end_fx()
	self.get_sand_out_fx()

	local rosetta_global_data = get_or_create_global_variable('Quest/ShortStory/Rosetta/ConstantsData')
	local shadow_size = rosetta_global_data.desert_bull_worm_shadow_size

	for i = 1, #self.enemies_data do
		local enemy_data = self.enemies_data[i]
		enemy_data.enemy = self.optimized_enemies[enemies_key[i]]
		enemy_data.enemy.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2.75, 1, 1.1))
		enemy_data.enemy.SpineController.ShadowTransform.localScale = shadow_size
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(enemy_data.enemy, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	end

	self.pattern_data = self.controller.constants_data['pattern']
	self.pattern_balance_data = self.controller.constants_data['pattern_balance_data']
	self.rotate_speed = self.pattern_balance_data.rotate.speed

	--region 투척형 패턴을 위한 프로젝타일 관련 세팅
	self.get_acid_proj()
	self.get_acid_proj_fire()
	self.get_acid_proj_hit()

	local pooled_pos = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.spit_attack_radius = self.pattern_balance_data.spit.attack_radius

	for _ = 1, self.pooled_proj_num do
		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(pooled_pos, self.spit_attack_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		attack_range:Hide()

		table.insert(self.pooled_proj_data, {
			proj = nil,
			proj_fire = nil,
			proj_hit = nil,
			attack_range = attack_range,
			in_use = false,
			is_ready = false,
			is_hit = false,
			time_passed = 0,
			start_pos = nil,
			end_pos = nil,
			y_calculator = nil,
			damaged_applied = false
		})
	end
	--endregion
end

function local_class:clean()
	self:dispose()
	self:init()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_enemies)
	self.optimized_enemies = nil
	self.enemies_data = nil

	if self.pooled_proj_data ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.pooled_proj_data do
			local pooled_proj = self.pooled_proj_data[i]

			if pooled_proj.proj ~= nil then
				pooled_proj.proj:Dispose()
				pooled_proj.proj = nil
			end

			if pooled_proj.proj_fire ~= nil then
				pooled_proj.proj_fire:Dispose()
				pooled_proj.proj_fire = nil
			end

			if pooled_proj.proj_hit ~= nil then
				pooled_proj.proj_hit:Dispose()
				pooled_proj.proj_hit = nil
			end
		end
		self.pooled_proj_data = nil
	end

	if self.sand_run_fxs ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.sand_run_fxs do
			self.sand_run_fxs[i]:Dispose()
		end
		self.sand_run_fxs = nil
	end

	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:start_routine()
	self.enemies_angle_data = {
		{
			original_angle = 0,
			cur_angle = 0,
			angle_to_move = 0
		},
		{
			original_angle = 90,
			cur_angle = 90,
			angle_to_move = 0
		},
		{
			original_angle = 270,
			cur_angle = 270,
			angle_to_move = 0
		}
	}

	if self.sand_run_fxs == nil then
		self.sand_run_fxs = {}
	end

	local enemy_num = #self.enemies_data

	for i = 1, enemy_num do
		local enemy_data = self.enemies_data[i]
		local enemy = enemy_data.enemy

		-- 기본 트랜프폼 세팅
		character_util.set_active_state(enemy, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(enemy, 'right')

		enemy.Position = self:get_position_by_angle(self.enemies_angle_data[i].cur_angle)

		if #self.sand_run_fxs < enemy_num then
			local sand_run_fx = self.get_sand_run_fx():Instantiate(enemy.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, enemy_data.enemy.Transform)
			table.insert(self.sand_run_fxs, sand_run_fx)
		end
	end

	self.all_pattern_cleared = false
	self.stop = false
	self.is_stopped = false
	self.cur_pattern_idx = 1
	self.next_pattern = self.pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_idx]

	for i = 1, enemy_num do
		-- 시작 스테이트로 세팅
		self:change_state(i, enemy_normal_state(self, i))
	end
end

function local_class:update_routine(dt)
	self:update_rotate_pattern(dt)
	self:read_pattern_and_update_state(dt)
	self:update_projectiles(dt)
	self:check_pattern_clear()
end

-- 다음 패턴이 없고, 현재 진행중인 패턴이 끝났고, 모든 투사체 피했으면 패턴 클리어
function local_class:check_pattern_clear()
	if self.next_pattern == nil then
		local all_pattern_ended = true

		for i = 1, #self.enemies_data do
			if not self.enemies_data[i].state.pattern_finished then
				all_pattern_ended = false
				break
			end
		end

		if not all_pattern_ended then
			return
		end

		local all_proj_avoided = true

		for i = 1, #self.pooled_proj_data do
			if self.pooled_proj_data[i].in_use then
				all_proj_avoided = false
				break
			end
		end

		if all_proj_avoided then
			self.all_pattern_cleared = true
		end
	end
end

function local_class:read_pattern_and_update_state(dt)
	local pattern_changed = false
	local try_rotate_cnt = 0

	for i = 1, #self.enemies_data do
		local state = self.enemies_data[i].state

		if state ~= nil then
			state:update(dt)
		end

		if state.pattern_finished and state.type ~= 'enemy_normal_state' then
			-- 패턴 끝나면 기본 패턴으로 변경
			self:change_state(i, enemy_normal_state(self, i))
		end

		if not self.stop then
			local is_rotating = self.cur_rotate_state == self.rotate_state.rotating
			local is_not_in_rotate_pattern = self.cur_rotate_state == self.rotate_state.none

			if self.next_pattern ~= nil and (is_not_in_rotate_pattern or is_rotating) then
				if state.pattern_finished then
					-- 화면 fade_in 하는대 걸린 시간은 게임 시간에서 뺀다.
					local fade_in_time = 1

					if self.controller.time_passed > self.next_pattern.time + fade_in_time then
						if self.next_pattern.rotate == nil then
							for j = 1, #self.next_pattern.target do
								if i == self.next_pattern.target[j] then
									local type = self.next_pattern.type[j]
									local next_state = nil

									if type == 'dash' then
										next_state = enemy_dash_state(self, i)
									elseif type == 'spit' then
										next_state = enemy_spit_state(self, i)
									end

									self:change_state(i, next_state)
									pattern_changed = true
									break
								end
							end
						else
							-- 회전형 패턴 시도 준비
							try_rotate_cnt = try_rotate_cnt + 1
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.stop then
		return
	end

	-- 회전형 패턴 실행
	if try_rotate_cnt == #self.enemies_data then
		self:start_rotate_pattern()
		pattern_changed = true
	end

	if pattern_changed then
		self.cur_pattern_idx = self.cur_pattern_idx + 1
		self.next_pattern = self.pattern_data[self.cur_pattern_idx]
	end
end

-- 투척 중인 오브젝트 이동 처리
function local_class:update_projectiles(dt)
	local target = self.controller.cached_player

	for i = 1, #self.pooled_proj_data do
		local pooled_proj = self.pooled_proj_data[i]

		if pooled_proj.is_ready then
			pooled_proj.time_passed = pooled_proj.time_passed + dt

			local is_done = pooled_proj.y_calculator:IsDone()

			-- 투척 물체가 목적지에 도착하면
			if is_done and pooled_proj.proj_hit == nil then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_missile_02')

				pooled_proj.time_passed = 0

				pooled_proj.attack_range:Hide()

				pooled_proj.proj_hit = self.get_acid_proj_hit():Instantiate(pooled_proj.end_pos)
				pooled_proj.is_hit = true

				if pooled_proj.proj ~= nil then
					pooled_proj.proj:Dispose()
					pooled_proj.proj = nil
				end

				if pooled_proj.proj_fire ~= nil then
					pooled_proj.proj_fire:Dispose()
					pooled_proj.proj_fire = nil
				end

				-- 출동 판정 후 데미지 적용 진행
				if not pooled_proj.damaged_applied then
					local diff = pooled_proj.end_pos - target.Bounds:ClosestPoint(pooled_proj.end_pos)
					if diff.magnitude < self.spit_attack_radius then
						pooled_proj.damaged_applied = true
						message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(target, { self.controller.send_damage_event }))
					end
				end

			elseif not is_done and pooled_proj.proj ~= nil then
				-- 투척 물체 이동 중인 경우
				pooled_proj.y_calculator:Proceed(dt)

				local progress = pooled_proj.y_calculator:GetProgress()
				local pos = pooled_proj.start_pos * (1 - progress) + pooled_proj.end_pos * progress
				pos.y = pooled_proj.y_calculator:GetDistance()
				pooled_proj.proj.transform.position = pos
			end

			-- 투척 물체 hit 이팩트 끝난 후에 사용 중지
			if pooled_proj.is_hit then
				if pooled_proj.time_passed >= 1 then
					pooled_proj.is_hit = false
					pooled_proj.in_use = false
					pooled_proj.is_ready = false

					if pooled_proj.proj_hit ~= nil then
						pooled_proj.proj_hit:Dispose()
						pooled_proj.proj_hit = nil
					end

					pooled_proj.y_calculator = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_position_by_angle(angle, pivot_pos, radius)
	local pos = lua_helper.get_or_default(pivot_pos, self.spawn_pivot_pos)
	local rad = lua_helper.get_or_default(radius, self.radius)

	local radians = math.rad(angle)
	local x = math.cos(radians) * rad
	local z = math.sin(radians) * rad

	return pos + vector(x, 0, z)
end

function local_class:start_rotate_pattern()
	if self.cur_rotate_state == self.rotate_state.none then
		self.rotate_time_passed = 0
		self.cur_rotate_state = self.rotate_state.starting

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_15')

		for i = 1, #self.enemies_angle_data do
			local enemy_angle_data = self.enemies_angle_data[i]
			local rotate_num = self.next_pattern.rotate

			enemy_angle_data.angle_to_move = rotate_num * 360
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.enemies_data[i].enemy, { name = 'out' })
			camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.5)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_rotate_pattern(dt)
	if self.cur_rotate_state == self.rotate_state.starting then
		self.rotate_time_passed = self.rotate_time_passed + dt

		if self.rotate_time_passed > 1.17 then
			self.rotate_time_passed = 0
			self.cur_rotate_state = self.rotate_state.rotating
		end

	elseif self.cur_rotate_state == self.rotate_state.rotating then
		self.rotate_time_passed = self.rotate_time_passed + dt

		local adding_angle = self.rotate_speed * dt * 20

		for i = 1, #self.enemies_angle_data do
			local enemy_angle_data = self.enemies_angle_data[i]

			enemy_angle_data.angle_to_move = enemy_angle_data.angle_to_move - adding_angle

			if enemy_angle_data.angle_to_move <= 0 then
				enemy_angle_data.angle_to_move = 0
				enemy_angle_data.cur_angle = enemy_angle_data.original_angle

				self.cur_rotate_state = self.rotate_state.none
			else
				enemy_angle_data.cur_angle = enemy_angle_data.cur_angle + adding_angle

				if enemy_angle_data.cur_angle > 360 then
					enemy_angle_data.cur_angle = enemy_angle_data.cur_angle - 360
				end
			end

			local enemy_data = self.enemies_data[i]
			local is_dashing_state = enemy_data.state ~= nil and enemy_data.state.type == 'enemy_dash_state'

			if not is_dashing_state then
				enemy_data.enemy.Position = self:get_position_by_angle(enemy_angle_data.cur_angle)
			end
		end
	elseif self.cur_rotate_state == self.rotate_state.force_stop then
		for i = 1, #self.enemies_angle_data do
			self.enemies_angle_data[i].angle_to_move = 0
		end

		self.cur_rotate_state = self.rotate_state.none
	end
end

-- 외부에서 게임 오버와 같은 이유로 적의 행동을 하던 것 까지만 하고 멈추게 하는 코루틴 함수
function local_class:stop_and_wait()
	self.stop = true
	self.cur_rotate_state = self.rotate_state.force_stop

	while self.controller.cur_game_state == self.controller.game_state.playing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		local all_pattern_stopped = true

		for i = 1, #self.enemies_data do
			if self.enemies_data[i].state.type ~= 'enemy_normal_state' then
				all_pattern_stopped = false
				break
			end
		end

		local all_proj_not_in_use = true

		for i = 1, #self.pooled_proj_data do
			if self.pooled_proj_data[i].in_use then
				all_proj_not_in_use = false
				break
			end
		end

		if all_pattern_stopped and all_proj_not_in_use and
				self.cur_rotate_state == self.rotate_state.none then
			break
		end
	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.is_stopped = true
end

function local_class:make_sand_out_fx()
	for i = 1, #self.enemies_data do
		local enemy = self.enemies_data[i].enemy
		self.get_sand_out_fx():Instantiate(enemy.Position)
	end
end

--region state
function local_class:change_state(enemy_idx, next_state)
	local enemy_data = self.enemies_data[enemy_idx]

	if enemy_data.state then
		enemy_data.state:exit(next_state)
		enemy_data.state:dispose()
	end

	local prev_state = enemy_data.state
	enemy_data.state = next_state

	if next_state ~= nil then
		enemy_data.state:enter(prev_state)
	end
end

-- 외부에서 사용하면 편리한 함수
function local_class:change_state_manually(enemy_idx, type)
	if type == 'enemy_dash_state' then
		self:change_state(enemy_idx, enemy_dash_state(self, enemy_idx))
	elseif type == 'enemy_spit_state' then
		self:change_state(enemy_idx, enemy_spit_state(self, enemy_idx))
	end
end

-- 외부에서 사용하면 편리한 함수
function local_class:start_rotate_pattern_manually(rotate_num)
	local can_rotate = true

	for i = 1, 3 do
		if self.enemies_data[i].state.type ~= 'enemy_normal_state' then
			can_rotate = false
			break
		end
	end

	if can_rotate then
		self.rotate_time_passed = 0
		self.cur_rotate_state = self.rotate_state.starting

		for i = 1, #self.enemies_angle_data do
			local enemy_angle_data = self.enemies_angle_data[i]

			enemy_angle_data.angle_to_move = rotate_num * 360
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.enemies_data[i].enemy, { name = 'out' })
			camera_util.shake(0.15, 0.5)
		end
	end
end

--region enemy_state_base
function enemy_state_base:init(controller, enemy_idx)
	self.type = 'enemy_state_base'
	self.controller = controller
	self.enemy_idx = enemy_idx
	self.enemy_data = self.controller.enemies_data[enemy_idx]
	self.enemy = self.enemy_data.enemy
	self.target = self.controller.controller.cached_player
	self.pattern_finished = false
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function enemy_state_base:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.enemy = nil
end
--endregion

--region enemy_normal_state
function enemy_normal_state:init(controller, enemy_idx)
	self.super:init(controller, enemy_idx)
	self.type = 'enemy_normal_state'

	self.pattern_finished = true

	self.rotate_idle = false
end

function enemy_normal_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function enemy_normal_state:enter(prev_state)
end

function enemy_normal_state:exit(next_state)
	if self.rotate_idle then
		self.rotate_idle = false
		character_util.remove_anim(self.enemy)
	end
end

function enemy_normal_state:update(dt)
	local cur_rotate_state = self.controller.cur_rotate_state

	if self.rotate_idle then
		if cur_rotate_state == self.controller.rotate_state.none then
			self.rotate_idle = false
			character_util.remove_anim(self.enemy)
		end
	else
		if cur_rotate_state == self.controller.rotate_state.rotating then
			self.rotate_idle = true
			character_util.set_anim(self.enemy, { name = 'idle', scale = 1.5 })
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--region enemy_dash_state
function enemy_dash_state:init(controller, enemy_idx)
	self.super:init(controller, enemy_idx)
	self.type = 'enemy_dash_state'

	self.enemy_angle_data = self.controller.enemies_angle_data[enemy_idx]

	self.attack_range = nil

	-- 패턴의 진행도
	self.progress = {
		ready = 1,
		dashing = 2,
		returning = 3,
		finish = 4
	}
	-- 패턴의 현재 진행도
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.ready
	-- 원래 위치
	self.original_pos = nil
	-- 돌진 목표 이동 위치
	self.dest_pos = nil

	self.hide_attack_range = false

	self.ready_time = self.controller.pattern_balance_data.dash.ready_time
	self.dash_time = self.controller.pattern_balance_data.dash.dash_time
	self.return_time = self.controller.pattern_balance_data.dash.return_time
	self.return_speed = 0

	self.dash_reach_time = self.ready_time + self.dash_time

	self.sfx = nil
end

function enemy_dash_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function enemy_dash_state:enter(prev_state)
	self.sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_cyclone_02', loop = true})
	character_util.set_anim(self.enemy, { name = 'spin' })

	-- 데쉬 어텍레인지 생성
	local x_offset = 1
	local x_size = self.target.Position.x - self.enemy.Position.x - x_offset
	local x_pos = self.enemy.Position.x + (x_size * 0.5) + x_offset
	local attack_range_pos = unity_class.vector3(x_pos, 0.03, self.enemy.Position.z)
	local attack_range_size = unity_class.vector2(x_size, 1.33)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(attack_range_pos, attack_range_size, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Show(self.ready_time)

	self.damaged_applied = false
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.cur_progress = self.progress.ready
	self.original_pos = self.enemy.Position
	self.dest_pos = vector(self.target.Position.x - 1, 0, self.enemy.Position.z)
end

function enemy_dash_state:exit(next_state)
	self.sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_anim(self.enemy)

	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.attack_range.gameObject)
end

function enemy_dash_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.controller.stop then
		self.cur_progress = self.progress.finish
		self.pattern_finished = true
		return
	end

	-- 해당 스테이트 진입 후 스테이트 나가기 전까지 한 번의 데미지만 가하도록 한다.
	if not self.damaged_applied and self.enemy.Bounds:Intersects(self.target.Bounds) then
		self.damaged_applied = true
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.target,
				{ self.controller.controller.send_damage_event }))
	end

	-- 회전 시작 후 n초 뒤 돌진 시작.
	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.ready then
		if self.time_passed >= self.ready_time then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_rush_01')

			self.time_passed = 0
			self.cur_progress = self.progress.dashing
		end
	-- n초 동안 플레이어가 있는 선까지 이동 (직사각형 범위를 벗어나지 않음)
	elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.dashing then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.dash_time)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.original_pos, self.dest_pos, progress)

		self.enemy.Position = cur_pos

		if progress >= 1 then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.cur_progress = self.progress.returning
			self.return_speed = (self.original_pos - self.dest_pos).magnitude / self.return_time
		end
	-- n초 동안 다시 제자리로 돌아옴
	elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.returning then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / self.return_time)
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.dest_pos, self.original_pos, progress)

		self.enemy.Position = cur_pos

		if not self.hide_attack_range then
			self.hide_attack_range = true
			self.attack_range:Hide()
		end

		local target_progress = 1

		-- 만약 초기 위치가 달라졌으면 n% 돌아갔을 때 변한 위치로 이동
		local return_pos = self.controller:get_position_by_angle(self.enemy_angle_data.cur_angle)
		if return_pos ~= self.original_pos then
			target_progress = 0.4
		end

		if progress >= target_progress then
			self.cur_progress = self.progress.finish
		end
	elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.finish then
		-- 만약 회전 중이라 원래 위치가 바뀐 경우, 현재 돌아가야하는 위치로 돌아가고 state를 나간다.
		local return_pos = self.controller:get_position_by_angle(self.enemy_angle_data.cur_angle)
		local pos = self.enemy.Position
		local diff = (return_pos - pos)

		if return_pos ~= pos then
			self.enemy.Position = self.enemy.Position + (diff.normalized * self.return_speed * dt)

			if diff.sqrMagnitude < 0.03 then
				self.enemy.Position = return_pos
				self.pattern_finished = true
			end
		else
			self.pattern_finished = true
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--region enemy_spit_state
-- 총알을 발사한 후에는 스테이트를 나가도 총알이 남아 있어야한다.
-- 따라서 발사된 총알 관리는 외부 업데이트에서 관리
function enemy_spit_state:init(controller, enemy_idx)
	self.super:init(controller, enemy_idx)
	self.type = 'enemy_spit_state'
	self.in_use_idx = -1

	self.attack_delay = self.controller.pattern_balance_data.spit.attack_delay
	self.projectile_speed = self.controller.pattern_balance_data.spit.projectile_speed

	self.attack_ready_time = 0.4125
end

function enemy_spit_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function enemy_spit_state:enter(prev_state)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.enemy, { name = 'attack', scale = 1.5 })
	self.time_passed = 0

	for i = 1, #self.controller.pooled_proj_data do
		self.in_use_idx = i
		local pooled_proj = self.controller.pooled_proj_data[i]

		if not pooled_proj.in_use then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_light_05')

			pooled_proj.in_use = true
			pooled_proj.start_pos = self.enemy.Position + vector(0, 3.15, 0)
			pooled_proj.end_pos = self.target.Position
			pooled_proj.time_passed = 0
			pooled_proj.attack_range.transform.position = pooled_proj.end_pos + vector(0, 0.03, 0)
			pooled_proj.attack_range:Show(99999)
			pooled_proj.damaged_applied = false
			break
		end
	end
end

function enemy_spit_state:exit(next_state)

end

function enemy_spit_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.attack_ready_time then
		local pooled_proj = self.controller.pooled_proj_data[self.in_use_idx]

		if not pooled_proj.is_ready then
			pooled_proj.start_pos = self.enemy.Position + vector(0, 3.15, 0)

			local vertical_speed = 7.5
			local gravity = 5.5
			pooled_proj.y_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(vertical_speed, gravity, pooled_proj.start_pos.y, 0)
			pooled_proj.y_calculator:ScaleTime(self.projectile_speed)

			local total_time = pooled_proj.y_calculator:GetTotalTime() * 0.25
			pooled_proj.attack_range:Show(total_time)

			local fire_offset = vector(0, -2.25, 0)
			pooled_proj.proj_fire = self.controller.get_acid_proj_fire():Instantiate(pooled_proj.start_pos + fire_offset)
			pooled_proj.proj = self.controller.get_acid_proj():Instantiate(pooled_proj.start_pos)
			pooled_proj.is_ready = true
		end
	end

	if self.time_passed >= self.attack_delay and not self.pattern_finished then
		self.pattern_finished = true
	end
end
--endregion
--endregion

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('AvoidDesertBullWormPlayer')

local player_state_base = newclass('AvoidDesertBullWormPlayerState')
local player_normal_state = newclass('AvoidDesertBullWormPlayerNormalState', player_state_base)
local player_damaged_state = newclass('AvoidDesertBullWormPlayerDamagedState', player_state_base)
local player_dead_state = newclass('AvoidDesertBullWormPlayerDeadState', player_state_base)

function local_class:init()
	self.controller = nil

	self.life = 3
	self.hit_count = 0

	self.player = nil
	self.player_spawn_pos = nil

	self.state = nil

	self.original_hitbox_size = nil
	self.hitbox_size = vector(0.5, 0.75, 0.3)
end

function local_class:clean()
	if self.original_hitbox_size ~= nil then
		self.player.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(self.original_hitbox_size)
		self.original_hitbox_size = nil
	end

	self:dispose()
	self:init()
end

function local_class:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.life = self.controller.constants_data.life == nil and 3 or self.controller.constants_data.life

	self.player = user_party.Leader
	self.player_spawn_pos = self.controller.game_center + vector(4, 0, 0)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:start_routine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	-- 플레이어 라이프 초기화
	self.hit_count = 0

	-- 플레이어 기본 세팅
	self.player.Position = self.player_spawn_pos
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.player, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, { name = 'run' }, { name = 'scared' })

	self.original_hitbox_size = self.player.Hitbox.size
	self.player.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(self.hitbox_size)

	self:change_state(player_normal_state(self))
end

function local_class:update_routine(dt)
	if self.state ~= nil then
		self.state:update(dt)

		if self.state.state_finished then
			if self.state.type == 'player_damaged_state' then
				self:change_state(player_normal_state(self))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params[0] == self.controller.send_damage_event then
		return self:get_damage()
	end
end

function local_class:get_damage()
	if self.state.type == 'player_normal_state' and
			not self.controller.playing_game_clear_routine then
		self:change_state(player_damaged_state(self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:wait_state()
	while not self.state.state_finished do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.state then
		self.state:exit(next_state)
		self.state:dispose()
	end

	local prev_state = self.state
	self.state = next_state

	if next_state ~= nil then
		self.state:enter(prev_state)
	end
end

--region player_state_base
function player_state_base:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.player = self.controller.player
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.state_finished = false
	self.type = 'player_state_base'
end

function player_state_base:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
end
--endregion

--region player_normal_state
function player_normal_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
	self.type = 'player_normal_state'
end

function player_normal_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function player_normal_state:enter(prev_state)
	self.state_finished = true
end

function player_normal_state:exit(next_state)
end

function player_normal_state:update(dt)
end
--endregion

--region player_damaged_state
--Redpulse, Squish 기본값 적용
--엘비라 surprisesurprise, cliff 자세로 0.5초간 오른쪽 0.5타일 앞으로 높이 0.3 점프
--바닥에 닿는 순간부터 다시 scared, run으로 달리기
--이후 1.5초간 엘비라 불투명도 0.7로 적용, 지속되는동안 피격X.
--달리기 시작한 후 1초동안 천천히 원래 있던 위치로 복귀
--종합: 피격 순간부터 총 2초간 무적시간을 가짐.
function player_damaged_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
	self.type = 'player_damaged_state'

	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		jump_end = 1,
		finish = 2
	}
	self.cur_progress = self.progress
	self.move_speed = 0

	self.cached_bg_manager = self.controller.controller.bg_manager
end

function player_damaged_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function player_damaged_state:enter(prev_state)
	self.controller.hit_count = self.controller.hit_count + 1

	-- 의존성 생기니까 이벤트로 소통할지 고려해봐야겠음
	self.controller.controller.ui_manager:update_life_ui(self.controller.hit_count)

	if self.controller.life - self.controller.hit_count <= 0 then
		self.controller:change_state(player_dead_state(self.controller))
		return
	end

	if prev_state.type == 'player_normal_state' then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.cur_progress = self.progress.none
		self.cached_bg_manager:block_vertical_movement(true)

		local move_dis = 1
		local move_dur = 0.5
		self.move_speed = move_dis / move_dur

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, { name = 'cliff' }, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.jump(self.player, 0.3, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.player)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.player, 0.7, 1.3, 1, 0.5)
	end
end

function player_damaged_state:exit(next_state)

end

function player_damaged_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.cur_progress == self.progress.none then
		self.player.Position = self.player.Position + vector(self.move_speed * dt, 0, 0)

		if self.time_passed >= 0.5 then
			self.cur_progress = self.progress.jump_end
			self.cached_bg_manager:block_vertical_movement(false)

			local move_dis = -1
			local move_dur = 1.5
			self.move_speed = move_dis / move_dur

			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, { name = 'run' }, { name = 'scared' })
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.player, 0.5, 0)
		end
	elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.jump_end then
		if self.player.Position.x > self.controller.player_spawn_pos.x then
			self.player.Position = self.player.Position + vector(self.move_speed * dt, 0, 0)
		else
			self.player.Position = vector_util.get_0yz(self.player.Position, self.controller.player_spawn_pos.x)
		end

		if self.time_passed > 2 then
			self.cur_progress = self.progress.finish

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.player, 1, 0)
		end
	elseif self.cur_progress == self.progress.finish then
		self.player.Position = vector_util.get_0yz(self.player.Position, self.controller.player_spawn_pos.x)
		self.state_finished = true
	end

	self.cached_bg_manager:update_horizontal_block_walls()
end
--endregion

--region player_dead_state
function player_dead_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
	self.type = 'player_dead_state'
	self.dur = 0.5
	self.height = 0.5
end

function player_dead_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function player_dead_state:enter(prev_state)
	self.state_finished = false
	self.is_done = false
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.start_pos = self.player.Position
	self.end_pos = self.player.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
	self.prostrate_played = false

	-- 3회 피격 당한 순간 엘비라 surprise, cliff로 0.5초, 높이 0.3 포물선 그리며 튕겨짐
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.player)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.player, 0.7, 1.3, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.player, { name = 'surprise' })
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create('AvoidDesertBullWorm', false))
end

function player_dead_state:exit(next_state)
end

function player_dead_state:update(dt)
	if not self.is_done then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.dur)
		local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * self.height
		self.player.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.start_pos, self.end_pos, progress) + vector(0, y, 0)

		if progress > 0.5 then
			if not self.prostrate_played then
				self.prostrate_played = true
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.player, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })
			end

			if progress >= 1 then
				self.is_done = true
			end
		end
	else
		self.state_finished = true
	end
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:init()
	self.controller = nil

	-- 실패 카운트 UI
	self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	self.get_fail_counter_ui = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIFailCounter')
	end

	self.is_pause = false
end

function local_class:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.get_fail_counter_ui()
end

function local_class:clean()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseOptionButton = true

	self:all_unsubscribe()
	self:remove_ui_fail_counter()
end

function local_class:all_unsubscribe()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:all_unsubscribe()
	self:remove_ui_fail_counter()
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:start_routine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_pause_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')

	-- 실패 카운트 UI 생성 및 초기화
	if self.ui_fail_counter == nil then
		local life = self.controller.constants_data.life == nil and 3 or self.controller.constants_data.life
		local ui_fail_counter_obj = self.get_fail_counter_ui():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
		local counter_num = ui_fail_counter_obj.transform.childCount

		self.ui_fail_counter = ui_fail_counter_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIFailCounter))

		if life > counter_num then
			self.ui_fail_counter:IncreaseMaxCountByNum(life - counter_num)
		end

		-- insrease 된 후의 childCount만큰 순회
		for i = 0, ui_fail_counter_obj.transform.childCount - 1 do
			local child_obj = ui_fail_counter_obj.transform:GetChild(i).gameObject
			if i < life then
				child_obj:SetActive(true)
			else
				child_obj:SetActive(false)
			end
		end

		self.ui_fail_counter:SetCenterPosOfActiveCount(vector(15, 275))
	end

	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(0)
end

function local_class:on_pause_start_event(e)
	if not self.is_pause then
		self.is_pause = true
	end
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(e)
	if self.is_pause then
		start_coroutine(self.show_minigame_field_ui, self)
	end
end

function local_class:update_life_ui(hit_count)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(hit_count)
end

function local_class:hide_minigame_field_ui(hide_fail_counter)
	if hide_fail_counter then
		self.ui_fail_counter.transform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
end

function local_class:show_minigame_field_ui()
	self.ui_fail_counter.transform.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseOptionButton = false
end

function local_class:remove_ui_fail_counter()
	if self.ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
		self.ui_fail_counter:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end

local local_class = newclass('AvoidShootingGame')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'AvoidShootingGame'

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	self.game_state = {
		none = 1,
		loaded = 2,
		playing = 3,
		paused = 4,
		game_end = 5,
	}

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none

	-- 플레이어 관련
	self.player = nil
	self.player_radius = 0
	self.player_lt_pos = nil
	self.player_rb_pos = nil
	self.center_pos = nil
	self.cashed_leader = nil

	-- 게임 진행 시간
	self.game_play_time = 40
	self.current_play_time = 0

	-- 웨이브 정보
	self.wave_index = 1

	-- 패턴 정보
	self.pattern_info = nil

	-- 공격 관련
	self.attack_range_width = nil
	self.bullet_marker_pre_fix = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.bullets = nil
	self.bullet_pool_count = 4

	-- fx
	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		custom_sprite = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
		end,
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		shot_trail = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_noel_bullet_shot_contrail')
		end
	})

	-- background
	self.background = {
		pooled = {},
		count = 2,
		bg_size = nil
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource(key)
	self.constants_data = require('minigame/AvoidShootingGame/AvoidShootingGameConstants')[key]

	-- constants 정보 세팅
	self.game_play_time = self.constants_data['game_play_time']
	self.pattern_info = self.constants_data['pattern_info']
	self.bullet_marker_pre_fix = self.constants_data['bullet_marker_pre_fix']
	self.attack_range_width = self.constants_data['attack_range_width']
	self.player = get_character(self.constants_data['player_name'])
	self.player_radius = self.constants_data['player_radius']
	self.bullet_pool_count = self.constants_data['pool_count']
	self.center_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.constants_data['game_marker'])

	-- 고정 초기화 세팅
	self.current_play_time = 0
	self.wave_index = 1

	self.fx:load_async()

	-- Attack Range 세팅
	self:set_attack_range()

	-- 총알 세팅
	self:load_bullet()

	-- 배경 세팅
	self:load_background()

	-- 플레이어 세팅
	self.cashed_leader = get_party_leader()

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.player, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(self.player, param)
	camera_util.move_async(self.center_pos, 0)

	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.player, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(self.player, screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', self.center_pos, -1))

	scene_util.set_anim(self.player, self, 'fly')
	stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(self.player)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.player, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	self.player.CustomRunSfxName = '01_nothing_01'

	self.player_lt_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', self.center_pos, 1)
	self.player_lt_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up', self.player_lt_pos, -1)

	self.player_rb_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', self.center_pos, -1)
	self.player_rb_pos = screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', self.player_rb_pos, 0.5)

	self.camera_dist = self.constants_data['camera_dist']

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.loaded
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))

	self:hide_game_ui()

	self:dispose_background()

	if self.attack_range_list then
		for i, info in ipairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			attack_range_util.destroy(info.attack_range)
		end

		self.attack_range_list = nil
	end

	if self.cashed_leader then
		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()

		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.cashed_leader, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(self.cashed_leader, param)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.player, active_state_type.enabled)

		self.cashed_leader = nil
	end

	if self.bullets then
		for i, info in ipairs(self.bullets) do
			info.bullet:Dispose()
		end

		self.bullets = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:use_update_frame()
	return true
end

function local_class:use_late_update_frame()
	return false
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)

end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_pause_start_event(e)
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.paused
	self:hide_game_ui()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(e)
	self:show_game_ui()
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.playing

	return false
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	if self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		if e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			character_util.set_locked_dir(self.player, 'right')
		elseif e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			character_util.set_locked_dir(self.player, 'left')
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion event

function local_class:update_frame_priority()
	return CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
		return
	end

	self.current_play_time = self.current_play_time + dt

	if self.current_play_time >= self.game_play_time then
		self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.game_end
		mini_game_util.game_end(self.game_name, true)
		return
	end

	self:background_scroller_routine(dt)
	self:player_update()
	self:camera_update()
	self:pattern_update()
	self:attack_range_update(dt)
	self:bullet_update(dt)
	self:check_collision()
end

function local_class:player_update()
	if self.player.Position.x < self.player_lt_pos.x then
		self.player.Position = vector(self.player_lt_pos.x, 0, self.player.Position.z)
	end

	if self.player.Position.z > self.player_lt_pos.z then
		self.player.Position = vector(self.player.Position.x, 0, self.player_lt_pos.z)
	end

	if self.player.Position.x > self.player_rb_pos.x then
		self.player.Position = vector(self.player_rb_pos.x, 0, self.player.Position.z)
	end

	if self.player.Position.z < self.player_rb_pos.z then
		self.player.Position = vector(self.player.Position.x, 0, self.player_rb_pos.z)
	end
end

function local_class:camera_update()
	local row_dist = self.player_rb_pos.x - self.player_lt_pos.x
	local col_dist = self.player_lt_pos.z - self.player_rb_pos.z
	local player_x = self.player.Position.x - self.player_lt_pos.x
	local player_z = self.player.Position.z - self.player_rb_pos.z

	local ratio_x = (player_x / row_dist) - 0.5
	local ratio_z = (player_z / col_dist) - 0.5

	camera_util.set_position(self.center_pos + vector(ratio_x * self.camera_dist, 0, ratio_z * self.camera_dist))
end

function local_class:pattern_update()
	if self.wave_index > #self.pattern_info then
		return
	end

	if self.pattern_info[self.wave_index].game_time <= self.current_play_time then
		self:show_attack_range(self.wave_index)
		self.wave_index = self.wave_index + 1
	end
end

function local_class:set_attack_range()
	self.attack_range_list = {}

	for i = 1, self.bullet_pool_count do
		local attack_range = attack_range_util.create_rect(vector(999, 0, 999),
				vector(self.attack_range_width, 60))

		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, {
			attack_range = attack_range,
			life_time = 0,
			index = 1,
			is_use = false
		})
	end
end

function local_class:show_attack_range(index)
	for i, info in ipairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		if not info.is_use then
			info.is_use = true
			info.index = index
			info.life_time = self.pattern_info[index].attack_range_lifetime

			local start_pos = self:get_marker_pos(self.pattern_info[index].start_index)
			local target_pos = self:get_marker_pos(self.pattern_info[index].target_index)
			local dir = (target_pos - start_pos).normalized
			local quaternion = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(-90, unity_class.vector3.up)
			local rotate_vector = quaternion * dir

			attack_range_util.setup_by_position(info.attack_range, start_pos)
			attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(info.attack_range, start_pos, rotate_vector)
			attack_range_util.show(info.attack_range)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_01')
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:attack_range_update(dt)
	for i, info in ipairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		if info.is_use then
			info.life_time = info.life_time - dt

			if info.life_time <= 0 then
				info.is_use = false
				attack_range_util.hide(info.attack_range)
				self:shot_bullet(info.index)
			end

			if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.game_end then
				info.is_use = false
				attack_range_util.hide(info.attack_range)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:load_bullet()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	local prefab = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
			'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom')

	local custom_atlas
	custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
	custom_atlas:Initialize()

	self.bullets = {}

	for i = 1, self.bullet_pool_count do
		local bullet = self.fx.custom_sprite():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one)
		local bullet_sprite = bullet.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		bullet_sprite.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
		bullet_sprite.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		bullet_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
		bullet_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
		bullet_sprite.SpriteName = 'small_shot_normal.png'
		bullet_sprite:Rebuild()

		table.insert(self.bullets, {
			bullet = bullet,
			is_use = false,
			start_pos = nil,
			target_pos = nil,
			shot_fx = nil,
			duration = 0,
			cur_duration = 0,
		})
	end
end

function local_class:shot_bullet(index)
	for i, info in ipairs(self.bullets) do
		if not info.is_use then
			info.is_use = true
			info.start_pos = self:get_marker_pos(self.pattern_info[index].start_index)
			info.target_pos = self:get_marker_pos(self.pattern_info[index].target_index)
			info.duration = self.pattern_info[index].bullet_duration
			info.cur_duration = 0
			info.cur_pos = info.start_pos
			info.shot_fx = self.fx.shot_trail():Instantiate(info.start_pos)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bullet_whoosh_01')
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:bullet_update(dt)
	for i, info in ipairs(self.bullets) do
		if info.is_use then
			info.cur_duration = info.cur_duration + dt
			info.cur_pos = info.bullet.transform.position

			local shoot_dir = (info.target_pos - info.start_pos).normalized
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(info.start_pos, info.target_pos,
					unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(info.cur_duration / info.duration))
			info.bullet.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(shoot_dir)
					* unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
			info.bullet.transform.position = cur_pos
			info.shot_fx.transform.localPosition = cur_pos

			if info.cur_duration > info.duration then
				info.is_use = false
				info.shot_fx = nil
				info.bullet.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_collision()
	for i, info in ipairs(self.bullets) do
		if info.is_use then
			-- 999 위치에 있는 프레임은 체크하지 않음
			local check_dist = vector_util.magnitude(info.cur_pos - vector(999, 0, 999))

			if not float_util.is_almost_zero(check_dist) and
					self:is_segment_circle_colliding(info.cur_pos.x, info.cur_pos.z,
					info.bullet.transform.position.x, info.bullet.transform.position.z,
					self.player.Position.x, self.player.Position.z + 0.5, self.player_radius) then
				self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.game_end
				mini_game_util.game_end(self.game_name, false)
				break
			end
		end
	end

	-- 게임 종료되면 바로 총알 리셋
	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state.game_end then
		for i, info in ipairs(self.bullets) do
			info.is_use = false
			info.bullet.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_segment_circle_colliding(x1, y1, x2, y2, cx, cy, radius)
	-- 선분 벡터
	local dx = x2 - x1
	local dy = y2 - y1

	-- 선분 시작점에서 원 중심까지의 벡터
	local fx = x1 - cx
	local fy = y1 - cy

	local a = dx * dx + dy * dy
	local b = 2 * (fx * dx + fy * dy)
	local c = fx * fx + fy * fy - radius * radius

	local discriminant = b * b - 4 * a * c

	if discriminant < 0 then
		-- 교차 없음
		return false
	else
		-- 교차점 확인
		discriminant = math.sqrt(discriminant)

		local t1 = (-b - discriminant) / (2 * a)
		local t2 = (-b + discriminant) / (2 * a)

		if (t1 >= 0 and t1 <= 1) or (t2 >= 0 and t2 <= 1) then
			-- 선분 범위 내에 교차점이 있음
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:load_background()
	local start_offset = vector(0, 0, 0)
	local bg_pos = self.center_pos + start_offset

	for i = 1, self.background.count do
		local bg_prefab = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
				'ondemand/short_story_noel/theatres/noel_minigame', 'noel_minigame')

		bg_prefab.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, 0, 0))
		bg_prefab.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2

		local bg_sprite = bg_prefab.transform:Find('noel_minigame_bg')
		local sprite_renderer = bg_sprite:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))
		--TODO Attack Range 보다 아래에 출력하게 함
		sprite_renderer.sortingLayerName = 'Attack Range'
		sprite_renderer.sortingOrder = -100

		self.background.pooled[i] = {
			prefab = bg_prefab,
			down = bg_prefab.transform:Find('down_pivot').transform,
			up = bg_prefab.transform:Find('up_pivot').transform,
			center = bg_prefab.transform:Find('center_pivot').transform,
			pos = bg_pos
		}

		self.background.pooled[i].prefab.transform.position = bg_pos
		self.background.bg_size = self.background.pooled[i].up.position - self.background.pooled[i].down.position
		bg_pos = bg_pos + self.background.bg_size * i
	end
end

function local_class:background_scroller_routine(dt)
	local bg_size_z = self.background.bg_size.z
	local dir_vector = -1

	local scrolling_routine = function(info, speed)
		local fo = info.prefab
		local boundary_pos_z = info.pos.z - bg_size_z
		local cur_x = fo.transform.position.x
		local cur_z = fo.transform.position.z + dir_vector * speed * dt

		if cur_z < boundary_pos_z then
			cur_z = cur_z + bg_size_z
		end

		local cur_pos = vector(cur_x, 0, cur_z)
		fo.transform.position = cur_pos
	end

	for i = 1, self.background.count do
		scrolling_routine(self.background.pooled[i], 1)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_background()
	for i = 1, self.background.count do
		if self.background.pooled[i] ~= nil then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.background.pooled[i].prefab)
		end
		self.background.pooled[i] = nil
	end

	self.background = nil
end

function local_class:get_marker_pos(index)
	return field_util.get_marker_pos(self.bullet_marker_pre_fix .. index)
end

function local_class:start()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_pause_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')

	start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	self:show_game_ui()

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.playing

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)
end

function local_class:game_end(is_success, data)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.6)

	start_coroutine(function()
		self:hide_game_ui()

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))

		character_util.reset_locked_dir(self.player)

		if is_success then
			camera_util.move(self.center_pos, 1)

			--1초동안 노엘 캐릭터 up 방향으로 화면 중앙으로 이동.
			character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'up')
			character_util.move_to_async(self.player, self.center_pos, 1)

			--노엘 (up, idle, fly) : 거, 거의 다 올라온 것 같아…!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.player, 'ss_noel_main_s10_1')

			--노엘 (up, idle, fly) : 조금만 더 힘내 줘, 이브!
			scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(self.player, 'ss_noel_main_s10_2')

			--노엘+폭탄벌레 캐릭터 1.3초 동안 화면 위쪽 바깥으로 나가며 사라짐.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fly_loop_01')
			character_util.move_to_async(self.player,
					screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('up', self.player.Position, 1), 1.3)

			--0.5초 대기
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			--1.5초 동안 화면 일반 페이드 아웃.
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1.5, unity_class.color.black)

			--1.5초 대기
			wait_for_sec(1.5)
		else
			--배경 일러스트 루프 중지.
			--동시 실행
			camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
			-- 노엘 캐릭터 위치에 FX_hit 와 FX_lasthit 이펙트, Damage Squish, Red pulse 출력됨.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_huntress_hit_01')
			self.fx.hit():Instantiate(self.player.Position)
			self.fx.last_hit():Instantiate(self.player.Position)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.player)
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.player)
			--노엘 캐릭터 damaged 표정으로 전환.
			character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'down')
			scene_util.set_emotion(self.player, self, 'damaged')
			--노엘 캐릭터 1.5초동안 회전 3바퀴.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
			character_util.spine_rotate(self.player, 1080, 1.5)
			--노엘 캐릭터 1.5초동안 아래쪽 화면 바깥으로 이동
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
			character_util.move_to_async(self.player,
					screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', self.player.Position, -2), 1.5)

			--게임오버 서큘러 페이드 아웃.
			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1)

			--서큘러 페이드 인 이후 미니게임 시작 연출부터 재시작.
		end

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success))
	end)
end

function local_class:show_game_ui()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	end

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton,
			user_party.Leader)
end

function local_class:timer_finished()
	mini_game_util.game_end(self.game_name, false)
end

function local_class:hide_game_ui()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
end

function local_class:reset()
	self.current_play_time = 0
	self.wave_index = 1

	self:attack_range_update(0)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.player, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(self.player, screen_util.get_up_down_outside_pos('down', self.center_pos, -1))
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.player)
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.player, 0, 0)
	camera_util.move(self.center_pos, 0)
end
