local local_class = newclass('BarPartTimeJobGame')

-- 바 서빙 아르바이트 미니게임의 스크립트
function local_class:init()
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'BarPartTimeJobGame'

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	-- 추후 다른 입장 케이스가 필요한 경우 처리용
	self.constants_data_key = ''

	self.is_playing_game = false
	self.player_serving_food_type = nil
	self.player_serving_food_item = nil
	self.game_time = 0
	self.scene_play_infos = { }
	self.game_result = 0
	self.game_result_type = { none = 0, success = 1, failed = 2 }
	self.guest_state = { created = 0, waiting = 1, completed = 2, failed = 3 }
	self.enemy_state = { created = 0, running = 1, completed = 2 }
	self.current_failed_count = 0
	self.active_enemy_list = { }
	self.food_table_item_list = { }
	self.food_sprite_names = { }
	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_fail_counter_ui = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIFailCounter') end
	self.ui_fail_counter_obj = nil
	self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	self.waiting_guests = nil

	self.item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ItemData")
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ItemData")
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require('minigame/BarPartTimeJobGame/BarPartTimeJobConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	self.game_failed_count = self.constants_data.system_data.game_failed_count
	self.max_guest_count = table_util.get_size(self.constants_data.guest_data)
	self.max_enemy_count = table_util.get_size(self.constants_data.enemy_data)
	self.guest_duration = self.constants_data.system_data.guest_duration
	self.game_duration = self.constants_data.system_data.game_duration
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fail_counter_ui()

	load_util.emoticon_items_custom_shear_atlas()

	self.food_sprite_names = { }
	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.food_type_data do
		local food_item_id = self.constants_data.food_type_data[i].item_id
		self.food_sprite_names[i] = self.item_data:GetSpec(food_item_id).SpriteName
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	coroutine.yield(unity_object_pool.WaitAll())

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:emoticon_list_dispose()
	if self.guest_emoticon_list == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.guest_emoticon_list do
		if self.guest_emoticon_list[i] ~= nil then
			self.guest_emoticon_list[i]:Dispose()
		end
	end

	self.guest_emoticon_list = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.timer_is_alive then
		timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
		self.timer_is_alive = false
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent))

	self.food_sprite_names = nil
	self.item_data = nil
	if self.player_serving_food_item ~= nil then
		self.player_serving_food_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.player_serving_food_item = nil
	end

	if self.food_table_item_list ~= nil then

	end

	self:emoticon_list_dispose()

	self.active_enemy_list = nil
	self.scene_play_infos = nil
	self.player_serving_food_type = nil
	self.guest_food_table = nil
	self.food_table_item_list = nil
	self.waiting_guests = nil
	self.mini_game_cs = nil
end

function local_class:reset_game_state()
	if self.guest_emoticon_list == nil then
		self.guest_emoticon_list = { }
	end

	self:reset_failed_count()
	self.game_time = 0
	self.is_playing_game = true
	self.game_result = self.game_result_type.none
	self.active_enemy_list = { }
	self.guest_food_table = { }
	self.player_serving_food_type = nil
	self.waiting_guests = { }
	self.scene_play_infos = { }
	self.game_result = 0
	self.current_failed_count = 0
	self.active_enemy_list = { }
	self.food_table_item_list = { }

	local food_type_data = self.constants_data.food_type_data
	for i = 1, #food_type_data do
		local food_type_info = food_type_data[i]
		local table = get_field_object(food_type_info.table_name)

		if table ~= nil then
			table.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		end
	end
end

-- 여기서 연출이 아닌 해제 코드만 넣어야한다.
-- shutdown_scene을 분리할것.
function local_class:game_end()
	self.is_playing_game = false
	self.game_time = 0
	self.waiting_guests = nil
	self.mini_game_cs = nil

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent))

	self.active_enemy_list = { }

	local guest_data = self.constants_data.guest_data
	local mini_game_cs = mini_game_manager:GetMiniGameLuaScript(self.game_name)

	for i = 1, #guest_data do
		local guest = get_character(guest_data[i].name)
		if guest ~= nil then
			character_util.remove_relate_event(guest, mini_game_cs)
		end
	end

	table_util.for_each(self.guest_food_table, function(key, value)
		if value ~= nil and value[2] ~= nil then
			value[2]:ConsumeComplete()
		end
	end)


	self.game_result = self.game_result_type.none
	self.player_serving_food_type = nil
	self:reset_failed_count()

	self.guest_food_table = nil
end

function local_class:game_start()
	self:reset_game_state()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_field_object_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent), 'on_got_crashed_event')

	self.mini_game_cs = mini_game_manager:GetMiniGameLuaScript(self.game_name)

	--for i = 1, #guest_data do
	--	local guest = get_character(guest_data[i].name)
	--	character_util.add_listener(guest, mini_game_cs)
	--end

	start_coroutine(self.game_start_scene, self)
end

function local_class:game_update()
	self.timer_is_alive = true
	local food_type_data = self.constants_data.food_type_data
	for i = 1, #food_type_data do
		local food_type_info = food_type_data[i]
		local table = get_field_object(food_type_info.table_name)

		--if table ~= nil then
			-- hitbox temp code
			table.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7))
		--end
	end

	-- start_timer 사용 할 것
	timer_util.start_timer(
			{ duration = self.game_duration,
			  handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })

	local timer_sfx = nil
	timer_util.set_position_based_on_anchor(vector(0, -100))

	while self.is_playing_game do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self:guest_update(dt)
		self:enemy_update(dt)
		self:food_update(dt)
		self.game_time = self.game_time + dt

		if self.game_time > self.game_duration or self.game_result ~= self.game_result_type.none then
			if self.game_result == self.game_result_type.none then
				self.game_result = self.game_result_type.success
			end

			-- 게임 종료 처리
			self.is_playing_game = false
			break
		end

		local left_time = self.game_duration - self.game_time

		-- 시간 10초 남았을 때부터 루프 재생
		if timer_sfx == nil and left_time <= 10 then
			timer_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({
				sfx_name = '02_gimmick_ticking_01', loop = true, parent = get_party_leader(),
				type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
			})
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if timer_sfx ~= nil then
		timer_sfx:FadeOut(0)
		timer_sfx = nil
	end

	if self.timer_is_alive then
		timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
		self.timer_is_alive = false
	end

	yield_return_func(self.game_shutdown_scene, self, self.game_result)
end

-- 제한 시간 다 되서 실패하는 연출
function local_class:timer_finished()
	self.is_playing_game = false
	self.timer_is_alive = false
	self.game_result = self.game_result_type.failed

	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
end
--endregion

-- 취객에 관련된 업데이트 함수
function local_class:enemy_update(dt)
	local current_time = self.game_time
	local next_time = self.game_time + dt
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local lost_food_key = 'lost_food'

	table_util.for_each(self.constants_data.enemy_data,
			function (index, enemy_info)
				-- 스폰이 가능한 시간이면 캐릭터를 스폰
				if current_time <= enemy_info.spawn_time and next_time > enemy_info.spawn_time then
					start_coroutine(self.start_enemy_action, self, index)
				end
			end)

	if self.active_enemy_list ~= nil and self.scene_play_infos[lost_food_key] == nil then
		for i = 1, #self.active_enemy_list do
			local enemy_index = self.active_enemy_list[i]
			local enemy_info = self:get_enemy_info(enemy_index)
			local enemy = get_character(enemy_info.name)

			-- aabb 충돌을 이용하여 플레이어와 적의 충돌을 확인
			if self:aabb(leader.Bounds, enemy.Bounds) then
				start_coroutine(self.lost_serving_food_scene, self, leader.Position, enemy_index)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_got_crashed_event(e)
	if self.is_playing_game and self.active_enemy_list ~= nil and self.scene_play_infos[lost_food_key] == nil then
		for i = 1, #self.active_enemy_list do
			local leader = get_party_leader()
			local enemy_index = self.active_enemy_list[i]
			local enemy_info = self:get_enemy_info(enemy_index)
			local enemy = get_character(enemy_info.name)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Crash.other, leader) and
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Crash.self, enemy) then
				start_coroutine(self.lost_serving_food_scene, self, leader.Position, enemy_index)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 손님과 연관된 모든 업데이트 작업 함수
function local_class:guest_update(dt)
	local current_time = self.game_time
	local next_time = self.game_time + dt

	table_util.for_each(self.constants_data.guest_data,
			function (index, guest_info)
				-- 스폰이 가능한 시간이면 캐릭터를 스폰
				if current_time <= guest_info.spawn_time and next_time > guest_info.spawn_time then
					start_coroutine(self.start_guest_action, self, index)
				end
			end)
end

-- 음식을 스폰하거나 집는 등등에 관련된 업데이트 함수
function local_class:food_update(dt)
	local food_type_data = self.constants_data.food_type_data
	local player_food_type = self.player_serving_food_type

	-- 플레이어가 서빙중이 아니면 테이블에 음식이 비어있다면 스폰 시켜준다.
	if self.food_table_item_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #food_type_data do
			local food_type_info = food_type_data[i]
			local food_table = get_field_object(food_type_info.table_name)
			local spawn_pos = field:GetMarker(food_type_info.spawn_marker_name).position

			if self.food_table_item_list[i] == nil and food_table ~= nil and i ~= player_food_type then
				start_coroutine(self.food_spawn, self, food_table, food_type_info.item_id, i, spawn_pos)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:food_spawn(food_table, item_id, food_type, spawn_pos)
	local food_key = 'food_' .. food_type

	-- 연출에 대한 정보 등록
	self.scene_play_infos[food_key] = true

	-- 0.3 초 동안 음식 생기는 연출 동작
	local food_spawn_duration = 0.3
	local next_time = self.game_time + food_spawn_duration

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_pop_01')

	-- 여기서 이미 drop_item으로 food를 생성해야함
	local food_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = item_id,
		notforinven = true,
		pos = spawn_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.1),
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		showoncharacter = true,
		skip_text = true
	})

	self.food_table_item_list[food_type] = food_item

	food_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(0, 0, 0)
	food_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(0, 0, 0)

	food_table.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	while next_time > self.game_time and self.is_playing_game do
		local percent = (food_spawn_duration - (next_time - self.game_time)) / food_spawn_duration
		local target_scale = vector(1, 1, 1) * percent

		food_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = target_scale
		food_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = target_scale

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	food_item.SpriteTransform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
	food_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)

	if self.is_playing_game then
		food_table.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	self.scene_play_infos[food_key] = nil
end

function local_class:start_guest_action(guest_index)
	local start_time = self.game_time
	local guest_info = self:get_guest_info(guest_index)
	local guest_name = guest_info.name
	local guest_unique_name = 'g_' .. guest_index
	local guest = get_character(guest_name)
	local guest_spawn_pos = self:get_guest_spawn_pos(guest_index)
	local guest_state = self.guest_state.created
	local guest_duration = self.guest_duration

	if guest_info.duration ~= nil then
		guest_duration = guest_info.duration
	end

	guest.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullCrashBehaviour.Instance
	guest.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	guest.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 1, 0.5))

	character_util.set_active_state(guest, 'disabled')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guest, 0, 0)
	guest.Position = guest_spawn_pos

	-- 씬 재생 정보에 게스트의 정보를 넣어 준다.
	self.scene_play_infos[guest_unique_name] = true

	while self.is_playing_game and guest_state < self.guest_state.completed do
		-- 손님의 스테이트에 따라 로직들이 다르게 작용
		if guest_state == self.guest_state.created then
			-- 게스트의 생성을 위해서 테이블에 스폰 시키고 알파 페이드
			-- 아직은 테이블 위치 셋팅을 안했음
			self.waiting_guests[guest_index] = guest
			guest_state = self.guest_state.waiting
			character_util.set_direction(guest, self:get_guest_direction(guest_index))
			character_util.set_active_state(guest, 'visible')
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guest)
			character_util.set_anim(guest,  { name = 'seat', loop = true } )
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guest, 1, 1)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_door_push_01')
			wait_for_sec(1)
			guest.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
			character_util.add_listener(guest, self.mini_game_cs)
			character_util.set_active_state(guest, 'enabled')
			self:show_emoticon(guest_index)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(guest, guest_duration))
			start_time = self.game_time
		elseif guest_state == self.guest_state.waiting then
			-- 게스트가 지속 시간을 초과하면 실패 처리
			if start_time + guest_duration < self.game_time then
				guest_state = self.guest_state.failed
				break
			else
				-- 여기서는 게스트 앞에 음식이 있는지 체크
				-- 잘못된 음식이면 실패 처리해야한다.
				local guest_food_info = self.guest_food_table[guest_index]
				if guest_food_info ~= nil then
					local food_type = guest_food_info[1]
					if food_type ~= nil then
						-- 음식이 도착해야하는 연출 때문에 잠시 대기
						--wait_for_sec(0.5)
						if food_type == guest_info.food_type then
							guest_state = self.guest_state.completed
						else
							guest_state = self.guest_state.failed
						end
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_relate_event(guest, self.mini_game_cs)
	guest.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	self.waiting_guests[guest_index] = nil
	self:hide_emoticon(guest_index)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(guest))

	-- loop를 빠져나왔지만 게임이 계속 실행중이면 그에 따른 연출을 재생해준다.
	-- 또한 여기로 넘어온 순간에는 상호작용이 불가능하게 해야한다.
	character_util.set_active_state(guest, 'visible')
	if self.is_playing_game then
		if guest_state == self.guest_state.completed then
			local guest_food_info = self.guest_food_table[guest_index]
			local guest_food_item = guest_food_info[2]

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
			-- 만족시킴
			-- 정해진 시간 이내에 정확히 음식을 서빙함
			-- 손님 앞에 음식이 놓이고 박수 0.5초
			character_util.set_anim(guest, { name = 'clap', upper = true, loop = true})
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guest, true)
			-- eat 모션으로 음식 먹기 1초
			character_util.set_anim(guest, { name = 'eat', upper = true, loop = true})
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guest, 0, 1)
			drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(guest_food_item, 0, 1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guest, true)
			guest_food_item:ConsumeComplete()

			self.guest_food_table[guest_index] = nil

			-- 이후 음식과 손님 둘 다 페이드아웃 1초 (아직은 음식 처리 안했음)
			-- 완전히 사라진 후에 해당 자리는 빈 것으로 처리
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guest, true)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guest)
			wait_for_sec(1)
		elseif guest_state == self.guest_state.failed then
			-- 불만족함
			-- 시간이 초과되거나 다른 음식이 서빙된 경우
			-- 손님 앞에 음식은 생성되지 않고 즉시 실패 횟수 1회 추가
			-- mad, jingak으로 1초간 화냄
			self:increase_failed_count()
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guest)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(guest, {name = 'jingak'}, {name = 'mad'})
			wait_for_sec(1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guest)
			-- 이후 손님 페이드아웃 1초

			-- 완전히 사라진 후에 해당 자리는 빈 것으로 처리
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guest)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guest, 0, 1)

			local guest_food_info = self.guest_food_table[guest_index]

			if guest_food_info ~= nil then
				local guest_food_item = guest_food_info[2]
				self.guest_food_table[guest_index] = nil
				start_coroutine(function()
					drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(guest_food_item, 0, 1)
					guest_food_item:ConsumeComplete()
				end, self)
			end

			wait_for_sec(1)
		end
	end

	if not self.is_playing_game and guest ~= nil then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(guest, 0, 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guest, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(guest)
	character_util.remove_anim(guest)
	character_util.set_active_state(guest, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_position(guest, vector(999, 0, 999))
	-- 모든 연출이 끝났으니 재생 정보를 삭제
	self.scene_play_infos[guest_unique_name] = nil
end

function local_class:start_enemy_action(enemy_index)
	local index = enemy_index
	local enemy_info = self:get_enemy_info(index)
	local enemy_spawn_pos = self:get_enemy_spawn_pos(index)
	local enemy_state = self.enemy_state.created
	local enemy_name = enemy_info.name
	local enemy_spawn_dir = enemy_info.spawn_direction
	local enemy = get_character(enemy_name)

	-- path table data = pair (type, value)
	local enemy_pattern = enemy_info.pattern_data
	local enemy_pattern_type = self.constants_data.system_data.enemy_pattern_type
	local pattern_count = table_util.get_size(enemy_pattern)
	local current_pattern = 1

	local scene_key = 'enemy_scene_' .. enemy_index

	character_util.set_active_state(enemy, 'disabled')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(enemy, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(enemy, enemy_spawn_dir)
	character_util.set_position(enemy, enemy_spawn_pos)

	while self.is_playing_game and enemy_state < self.enemy_state.completed do
		if enemy_state == self.enemy_state.created then
			character_util.set_emotion(enemy, { name = 'blush' })
			character_util.set_active_state(enemy, 'enabled')

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(enemy, 1, 0.5)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			table.insert(self.active_enemy_list, index)
			enemy_state = self.enemy_state.running
		elseif enemy_state == self.enemy_state.running then
			-- 여기서 자신의 path 데이터를 가져와서 행동 시작
			local current_pattern_data = enemy_pattern[current_pattern]
			local current_pattern_type = current_pattern_data[1]

			-- type이 0이면 move, 1이면 delay
			if current_pattern_type == enemy_pattern_type.move_by_speed
					or current_pattern_type == enemy_pattern_type.move_by_duration then

				-- 여기는 연출 등록을 해주어야 함.
				self.scene_play_infos[scene_key] = true
				local target_marker_index = current_pattern_data[2]
				local target_pos = self:get_enemy_move_pos(target_marker_index)

				if current_pattern_type == enemy_pattern_type.move_by_speed then
					local move_speed = current_pattern_data[3]
					character_util.move_to_async(enemy, target_pos, nil, move_speed, true, true)
				elseif current_pattern_type == enemy_pattern_type.move_by_duration then
					local move_duration = current_pattern_data[3]
					character_util.move_to_async(enemy, target_pos, move_duration, nil, true, true)
				end
				self.scene_play_infos[scene_key] = nil
			elseif current_pattern_type == enemy_pattern_type.wait_for_sec then
				local delay_sec = current_pattern_data[2]
				wait_for_sec(delay_sec)
			end

			current_pattern = current_pattern + 1
			if current_pattern > pattern_count then
				enemy_state = self.enemy_state.completed
				break
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 모든 행동을 했으니 페이드로 사라지게
	if self.is_playing_game and enemy_state == self.enemy_state.completed then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(enemy, 0, 0.5)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	character_util.set_position(enemy, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_active_state(enemy, 'disabled')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade_v2(enemy, 0, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(enemy)

	-- active enemy list에서 해당 enemy를 제거해주기
	if self.is_playing_game and self.active_enemy_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.active_enemy_list do
			if self.active_enemy_list[i] == index then
				table.remove(self.active_enemy_list, i)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 서빙중인 음식을 떨어트릴 때
-- 충돌시 0.5초간 경직, 당황하며 엘비라가 들고있던 음식을 떨어뜨림.
function local_class:lost_serving_food_scene(ground_pos, enemy_index)
	local scene_key = 'lost_food'

	if self.scene_play_infos[scene_key] ~= nil then
		return
	end

	local enemy_info = self:get_enemy_info(enemy_index)
	local enemy = get_character(enemy_info.name)

	if self.is_playing_game then
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	end

	local wakeup_dir = 'right'
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local leader_to_enemy_dir = (enemy.Position - leader.Position).normalized

	if enemy.Position.x > leader.Position.x then
		wakeup_dir = 'left'
	end

	self.scene_play_infos[scene_key] = true

	-- 음식이 땅에 떨어지는것은 코루틴으로 병렬적으로 연출
	if self:is_serving() then
		local item_drop_pos = leader.Position - (leader_to_enemy_dir * 1.7)
		start_coroutine(self.food_to_ground, self, item_drop_pos)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

	local goal_pos = leader.Position - (leader_to_enemy_dir * 0.7)

	local fx_hit_inst = self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position + (leader_to_enemy_dir * 0.1))
	fx_hit_inst.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1) * 0.8
	camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.3)

	character_util.set_direction(leader, wakeup_dir)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.jump(leader, 0.5, 0.3)

	-- 게임 내부 바운드가 있으면 처리
	if self.game_bound ~= nil then
		local result_data = self:aabb_by_line(self.game_bound, leader.Position, goal_pos)

		if result_data.result then
			character_util.move_to_async(leader, goal_pos, nil, 6, false, false, false)
		else
			character_util.move_to_async(leader, result_data.result_points[1], nil, 6, false, false, false)

			if wakeup_dir == 'left' then
				character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
			else
				character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_knockback_wall_01')
			local fx_hit_inst_by_wall = self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position)
			fx_hit_inst_by_wall.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1) * 0.8

			character_util.spine_pulse_color(leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

			character_util.move_to_async(leader, result_data.result_points[2], nil, 6, false, false, false)
		end
	else
		character_util.move_to_async(leader, goal_pos, nil, 6, false, false, false)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'confused' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.shake_and_wakeup(leader, wakeup_dir, 0, nil, true)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	if self.is_playing_game then
		party_util.reset_controllers()

		local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(get_party_leader(), false)
		manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

		local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
		message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
				| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
				| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

		self:hide_top_ui()
	end

	self.scene_play_infos[scene_key] = nil
end

function local_class:load_fail_counter()
	local life = self.game_failed_count
	local ui_fail_counter_obj = self.get_fail_counter_ui():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.ui_fail_counter = ui_fail_counter_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIFailCounter))

	for i = 0, ui_fail_counter_obj.transform.childCount - 1 do
		local child_obj = ui_fail_counter_obj.transform:GetChild(i).gameObject
		if i < life then
			child_obj:SetActive(true)
		else
			child_obj:SetActive(false)
		end
	end

	local layout_positioner = ui_fail_counter_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenLayoutPositioner))
	layout_positioner.AnchorPosition = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	layout_positioner.Position = vector(0, 220)

	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(0)
	self.ui_fail_counter:Reposition()
end

function local_class:unload_fail_counter()
	if self.ui_fail_counter then
		self.ui_fail_counter:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	end
end

function local_class:show_emoticon(guest_index)
	if self.guest_emoticon_list == nil then
		return
	end

	local guest_data = self.constants_data.guest_data
	local guest_info = guest_data[guest_index]
	local food_type = guest_info.food_type
	local food_data = self.constants_data.food_type_data
	local food_item_sprite_size = food_data[food_type].sprite_size
	local guest = get_character(guest_info.name)

	self.guest_emoticon_list[guest_index] = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(
			guest, nil, 'item', self.food_sprite_names[food_type],
			{ emoticon_time = { 0.15, 1, 0 }, no_time_limit = true, attach_to_fo = true, item_sprite_p2w = food_item_sprite_size })

end

function local_class:hide_emoticon(guest_index)
	if self.guest_emoticon_list == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.guest_emoticon_list[guest_index] ~= nil then
		self.guest_emoticon_list[guest_index]:Dispose()
		self.guest_emoticon_list[guest_index] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:game_start_scene()
	-- UI에 대해 설정이 필요하기 때문에 play_normal_screenplay_hide_weapon 코드를 가져와서 사용
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 의자들을 감춰준다.
	local hide_field_object_names = self.constants_data.system_data.hide_field_object_names
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local start_marker = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.player_data.start_marker_name)

	leader.Position = start_marker.position

	-- 카메라 사이즈 변경 및 카메라 고정
	camera_util.move_async(start_marker.position + vector(0, 0, -1), 0)
	camera_util.resize_to(6, 0)

	table_util.for_each(hide_field_object_names, function(_, fo_name)
		local fo = get_field_object(fo_name)

		if fo ~= nil then
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end)

	self.food_table_item_list = { }

	local food_type_data = self.constants_data.food_type_data
	for i = 1, #food_type_data do
		table.insert(self.food_table_item_list, nil)
	end

	-- 리더 무적 해제
	if leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
		leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
	end

	self:hide_top_ui()
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	if self.pre_play_scene ~= nil then
		yield_return_func(self.pre_play_scene, self)
	end

	self.pre_play_scene = nil

	-- 영업개시
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bell_02')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString("short_story_rt_bar_part_time_job_1"))
	wait_for_sec(2)
	self:load_fail_counter()

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseOptionButton = false
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(get_party_leader(), false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.is_playing_game = true
	start_coroutine(self.game_update, self)
end

function local_class:game_shutdown_scene(game_result)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	self:unload_fail_counter()
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance.CanUseOptionButton = true

	-- 무기 숨김
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], true)
	end

	-- 리더가 HoldUpState일 경우 들고 있는 오브젝트 내려 놓도록
	local current_state = leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
	if lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		local hold_target = current_state.HoldTarget
		--TODO: HoldTarget이 nil일 때는 버그 일텐데 굳이 체크하는게 맞을지...?
		if hold_target ~= nil then
			command_util.execute_throw(leader, hold_target, direction_util.to_vector3(leader.Direction)
			, leader.Position, 4, false)
		end
	end

	-- 게임 결과에 따른 연출 시작 (game_result)
	-- 연출 페이드하면서 캐릭터 위치들이나 상태를 전부 리셋해줘야함.
	if game_result == self.game_result_type.success then
		-- 성공 연출
		character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false})
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	elseif game_result == self.game_result_type.failed and self.failed_scene ~= nil then
		-- 실패 연출. 실패 연출 내부에서 페이드를 알아서 처리해야함.
		local failed_scene = self.failed_scene
		self.failed_scene = nil
		yield_return_func(failed_scene, self)
	end

	self:game_end()
	local guest_data = self.constants_data.guest_data

	for i = 1, #guest_data do
		self:hide_emoticon(i)
	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	-- 현재 연출중인 장면들을 모두 기달려주기
	for key, value in pairs(self.scene_play_infos) do
		while self.scene_play_infos[key] do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self:emoticon_list_dispose()

	-- 무기 다시 보이게
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.hide_weapon(user_party[i], false)
	end

	-- 서빙중인 아이템 삭제
	if self.player_serving_food_item ~= nil then
		self.player_serving_food_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.player_serving_food_item = nil
	end

	-- 아이템들 모두 삭제
	if self.food_table_item_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.food_table_item_list do
			if self.food_table_item_list[i] ~= nil then
				self.food_table_item_list[i]:ConsumeComplete()
				self.food_table_item_list[i] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	self.food_table_item_list = { }

	character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	-- 의자들을 보여준다.
	local hide_field_object_names = self.constants_data.system_data.hide_field_object_names

	table_util.for_each(hide_field_object_names, function(_, fo_name)
		local fo = get_field_object(fo_name)

		if fo ~= nil then
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		end
	end)

	local end_event_value = false

	if game_result == self.game_result_type.success then
		end_event_value = true
	end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, end_event_value))
end

function local_class:hide_top_ui()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(e)
	if self.is_playing_game then
		self:hide_top_ui()
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 서빙중인 상태에서 손님과 인터렉트 했는지 체크
	if self:is_serving() then
		local interacted_guest_index = nil
		table_util.for_each(self.waiting_guests, function(guest_index, guest)
			if interacted_guest_index == nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(guest, e.Target) then
				-- 서빙 이벤트 발생
				interacted_guest_index = guest_index
			end
		end)

		if interacted_guest_index ~= nil then
			start_coroutine(self.serving_food_to_guest, self, interacted_guest_index)
		else
			local food_type_data = self.constants_data.food_type_data
			for i = 1, #food_type_data do
				local food_type_info = food_type_data[i]
				local food_table = get_field_object(food_type_info.table_name)

				if lua_helper.reference_equals(food_table, e.Target) and food_table.Interactable ~= CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance then
					start_coroutine(self.food_swap, self, i)
					break
				end
			end
		end
	else
		local food_type_data = self.constants_data.food_type_data
		for i = 1, #food_type_data do
			local food_type_info = food_type_data[i]
			local food_table = get_field_object(food_type_info.table_name)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(food_table, e.Target) and food_table.Interactable ~= CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance then
				-- 음식 얻는 이벤트 발생

				start_coroutine(self.get_serving_food_scene, self, i)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	if self.is_playing_game and self:is_serving() and self.player_serving_food_item ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, leader) then
		self.player_serving_food_item.Position = leader.Position + vector(0, 1.25, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:reset_failed_count()
	self.current_failed_count = 0
end

function local_class:increase_failed_count()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
	self.current_failed_count = self.current_failed_count + 1

	local ui_fail_counter = self.ui_fail_counter

	if ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
		ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(self.current_failed_count)
		ui_fail_counter:Reposition()
	end

	if self.current_failed_count >= self.game_failed_count then
		self.game_result = self.game_result_type.failed
	end
end

-- aabb 함수
function local_class:aabb(a, b)
	return a.min.x <= b.max.x and a.max.x >= b.min.x
			and a.min.z <= b.max.z and a.max.z >= b.min.z
end

-- 올바른 연산을 위해서는 b가 항상 끝점이 되어야 함 (end point)
function local_class:aabb_by_line(bound, a, b)
	local result = bound.min.x <= b.x and bound.max.x >= b.x and bound.min.z <= b.z and bound.max.z >= b.z
	local result_points = { }

	if result == false then
		-- 충돌 지점 구하는 공식
		local start_point = vector_util.get_x0z(a)
		local end_point = vector_util.get_x0z(b)
		local hit_point = vector(0, 0, 0)
		local magnitude = vector_util.magnitude(start_point - end_point)

		if end_point.x <= bound.min.x then
			hit_point.x = bound.min.x
		elseif end_point.x >= bound.max.x then
			hit_point.x = bound.max.x
		else
			hit_point.x = end_point.x
		end

		if end_point.z <= bound.min.z then
			hit_point.z = bound.min.z
		elseif end_point.z >= bound.max.z then
			hit_point.z = bound.max.z
		else
			hit_point.z = end_point.z
		end

		result_points[1] = hit_point

		local dir = (hit_point - start_point).normalized

		local end_magnitude = magnitude - (vector_util.magnitude(start_point - hit_point))

		result_points[2] = hit_point - (dir * end_magnitude)
	end

	return { result = result, result_points = result_points }
end

function local_class:get_guest_spawn_pos(guest_index)
	local guest_info = self:get_guest_info(guest_index)
	local chair_index = guest_info.spawn_chair_index
	local chair = get_field_object(self.constants_data.guest_chair_data[chair_index].name)

	return chair.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
end

function local_class:get_guest_direction(guest_index)
	local guest_info = self:get_guest_info(guest_index)
	local chair_index = guest_info.spawn_chair_index
	local chair_info = self.constants_data.guest_chair_data[chair_index]
	return chair_info.dir
end

function local_class:get_guest_food_pos(guest_index)

	local guest_info = self:get_guest_info(guest_index)
	local chair_index = guest_info.spawn_chair_index
	local chair_info = self.constants_data.guest_chair_data[chair_index]
	local chair = get_field_object(chair_info.name)
	local chair_dir = chair_info.dir
	local chair_pos = chair.Position

	if chair_dir == 'up' then
		return chair_pos + vector(0, 1, 1)
	elseif chair_dir == 'down' then
		return chair_pos + vector(0, 1, -1)
	elseif chair_dir == 'left' then
		return chair_pos + vector(-1, 1, 0)
	elseif chair_dir == 'right' then
		return chair_pos + vector(1, 1, 0)
	end

	-- error
	logger_util.error('get_guest_food_pos failed!')
	return vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:get_enemy_move_pos(marker_index)
	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.enemy_spawn_marker_data[marker_index])

	return marker.position
end

function local_class:get_enemy_spawn_pos(enemy_index)
	local enemy_info = self:get_enemy_info(enemy_index)
	local enemy_spawn_marker_index = enemy_info.spawn_marker_index
	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.enemy_spawn_marker_data[enemy_spawn_marker_index])

	return marker.position
end

function local_class:get_food_spawn_pos(food_type)
	local food_info = self:get_food_info(food_type)
	local marker = field:GetMarker(food_info.spawn_marker_name)

	return marker.position + vector(0, 1, 0)
end

function local_class:is_serving()
	return self.player_serving_food_type ~= nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class();
	end
}

-- 바구니 캐치 게임
-- 공용으로 만들기엔 해당 퀘스트에만 쓰이는 부분들이 너무 많이 들어감
local local_class = newclass('BasketCatchGame')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'BasketCatchGame'

	-- 게임의 데이터 키
	self.constants_data_key = ''
	self.constants_data = nil

	-- 게임이 진행중인지
	self.game_loop = false

	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 파티 백업용
	self.cached_party = nil

	-- 캐릭터 list
	self.character_list = nil

	-- 바구니 list
	self.basket_list = nil

	-- 실패 카운트
	self.fail_count = 0

	-- 실패 ui
	self.fail_count_ui = nil

	-- 던지는 사람
	self.throwers = nil

	-- 던지는 주기
	self.throw_cycle = 0

	-- 받는 범위
	self.catch_dist = 1

	-- 던질 아이템 id
	self.throw_item_ids = nil

	self.rolling_number = 0

	-- 던진 횟수
	self.throw_count = 0

	-- 일시정지 후 스테이지 종료 시 호출한 섹션에서 ended를 true로 바꿔줌
	self.is_stage_ended = false
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key
	local constants_data = require('minigame/BasketCatchGame/BasketCatchGameConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadStageTitle()

	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			'FX_get',
			'FieldUIFailCounter'
	)

	--Subscribe
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_fo_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	-- 기존 파티 백업 후 제외
	self.cached_party = {}
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		table.insert(self.cached_party, party_member)
		character_util.set_active_state(party_member, 'disabled')
		character_util.convert_to_npc(party_member)
	end

	-- 플레이 파티 세팅
	if self.constants_data_key == 'afterworld_basket' then
		self.rolling_number = 1000000
		if user_util.has_knight_male() then
			self.character_list = self.constants_data.play_character_name_male
		else
			self.character_list = self.constants_data.play_character_name_female
		end

		-- 파티 합류
		local npc = get_character(self.character_list[1])
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
		local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character(npc, param)
	end


	--게임 위치로 이동
	local game_start_pos = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.game_start_marker_name).position
	local game_start_dir = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.game_start_marker_name).direction
	for i = 1, #self.character_list do
		local party_member =  get_character(self.character_list[i])
		character_util.set_position(party_member, game_start_pos + vector(0.7 * (i - 1), 0, 0 ))
		character_util.set_direction(party_member, game_start_dir)
	end

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.constants_data.mini_game_camera_size, 0.01)

	-- 바구니 세팅
	self.basket_list = {}
	for i = 1, #self.character_list do
		local party_member = get_character(self.character_list[i])
		character_util.set_anim(party_member, { name = 'hold_loop', upper = true })

		-- 머리 위 오프셋
		local margin = 0.25
		local basket_offset = unity_class.vector3.up * (party_member.Hitbox.size.y + margin)

		local basket = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = party_member.Position + basket_offset, itemid = 20179, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })
		basket.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		table.insert(self.basket_list, { item_sprite = basket, offset = basket_offset })
	end

	-- 던지는 NPC 세팅
	self.throwers = {}
	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.throwers do
		local thrower = get_character(self.constants_data.throwers[i].thrower)
		character_util.set_active_state(thrower, 'enabled')
		table.insert(self.throwers, thrower)
	end

	-- 아이템 id 세팅
	self.throw_item_ids = {}
	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.item_id do
		table.insert(self.throw_item_ids, self.constants_data.item_id[i])
	end

	-- 던지는 주기
	self.throw_cycle = self.constants_data.throw_cycle

	self.caught_items = {}
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.1)
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

-- 게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_routine, self))
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	if self.character_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.character_list do
			if self.game_loop and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_character(self.character_list[i])) then
				-- 플레이어 바구니 위치 업데이트
				self.basket_list[i].item_sprite.Position = get_character(self.character_list[i]).Position + self.basket_list[i].offset
				self:items_on_basket_reposition(i)
				return true
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_timer_alarm_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent) and e.IsComplete then
		-- 시간이 지나면 게임 클리어
		self.game_loop = false
		self.game_clear = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.game_loop then
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local npc = get_character('trash_thrower_'..i)
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, npc, 'trash_thrower_out_1') or
					type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, npc, 'trash_thrower_out_1') then
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(npc, 0, 0.5)
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

-- 게임 진행 루틴
function local_class:game_routine()
	-- 경기 시작 카운트
	for i = 3, 1, -1 do
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_whistle_01')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('aw_basket_game_count_'..i), 2.1)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('aw_basket_game_start'), 2.1)

	self.game_loop = true
	self.game_clear = false
	-- 타이머 실행
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	timer_util.start_timer({ duration = self.constants_data.mini_game_time, handler = self, callback = 'on_timer_alarm_event' })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/afterworld/audio:bgm_afterworld_game', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

	-- 실패 UI 세팅
	self:attach_count_ui()
	self.fail_count = 0

	-- 달리기, 인터랙트, 공격, 들기, 스킬 전부 막아놓음
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact |
			CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold)

	local state_change_event = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(manual_touch_state)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, state_change_event)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)

	for i = 2, #self.character_list do
		local party_member = get_character(self.character_list[i])
		party_member.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(party_member, user_party, i - 2, 0, false)
		party_member.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		party_member:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	local cur_value = 0
	self.throw_count = 0

	while self.game_loop do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 물건을 던질 시간이 됐다면 던지게함.
		if time_passed >= self.throw_cycle then
			local index = cur_value % 4 + 1
			local thrower = self.throwers[cur_value % #self.throwers + 1]
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_something, self, thrower, index))

			cur_value = cur_value + 1
			time_passed = 0
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.is_stage_ended then
		return
	end

	if self.game_clear then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_activity_clear_01')

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	else
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		timer_util.end_timer(self)
		self:detach_count_ui()

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field' })
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('afterworld_judgement_minigame_fail'), 2.1)

		local leader = user_party.Leader
		character_util.set_side_direction(leader)
		character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'damaged' })

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			local time = 0
			local start_pos = self.basket_list[1].item_sprite.Position
			local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.basket_list[1].item_sprite.Position)
			local duration = 0.3
			while time < duration do
				local progress = time / duration
				self.basket_list[1].item_sprite.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
				self:items_on_basket_reposition(1)
				time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end
		end))

		wait_for_sec(3)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			local time = 0
			local start_pos = self.basket_list[3].item_sprite.Position
			local target_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.basket_list[3].item_sprite.Position)
			local duration = 0.3

			while time < duration do
				local progress = time / duration
				self.basket_list[3].item_sprite.Position = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
				self:items_on_basket_reposition(3)
				time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield()
			end

		end))

		local fairy_2 = get_character('fairy_2')
		character_util.remove_anim(fairy_2, true)
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(fairy_2, leader.Position + vector(1,0,0),
				2, false, nil, nil, 'left')

		--막내님! 좀더 힘내보죠!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		character_util.play_speech_action(fairy_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }
		, nil, 'aw_fox_fairy_23')

		character_util.remove_emotion(leader)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
		character_util.mario_jump_async(leader, 'right', 0.3, 0.5)
		character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.nod_twice(leader)
	end

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, self.game_clear))
end

--- 바구니 위의 물체들의 위치를 갱신해줌
function local_class:items_on_basket_reposition(index)
	local x_offsets = { -0.13, 0.03, 0.19 }
	local z_offsets = { 0.11, 0.12, 0.13 }
	local row_offset = 0.1
	local party_count = #self.basket_list

	for i, item in ipairs(self.caught_items) do
		if (i - 1) % party_count + 1 == index then
			local row = math.floor((i - 1) / 3) + 1
			local col = math.floor((i - 1) / 3 % 3) + 1

			item.Position = self.basket_list[index].item_sprite.Position +
					unity_class.vector3.right * x_offsets[col] +
					unity_class.vector3.forward * (row_offset * (row / party_count - 1) + z_offsets[col])
			item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite)):SetSortingOrder(row + 1)

			-- 반복문 추가로 도는 횟수 제거
			i = i + party_count - 1
		end
	end
end

--- NPC들이 물체를 던지는 루틴
function local_class:throw_something(thrower, index)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(thrower, 1, 0.5)
	if index % 2 == 1 then
		character_util.set_position(thrower, field:GetMarker('trash_thrower_init_1').position)
		character_util.set_direction(thrower, 'down')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(thrower, 'up')
		character_util.set_position(thrower, field:GetMarker('trash_thrower_init_2').position)
	end

	local wait_time = 3.5
	local time_passed = 0
	while self.game_loop and wait_time > time_passed do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if not self.game_loop then
		return
	end

	local target_pos
	if index % 2 == 1 then
		target_pos =  thrower.Position - vector(
				random_util.get_random_int(-1, 3), 0.63, random_util.get_random_int(2, 3))
	else
		target_pos =  thrower.Position + vector(
				random_util.get_random_int(-1, 3), -0.63, random_util.get_random_int(2, 3))
	end

	local gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultGravity
	local y_init = 12
	local start_pos = thrower.Position
	local y_calc = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(y_init, gravity, 0, 0)
	local speech_random = self.throw_count % 4 + 1
	local item_id = self.throw_item_ids[self.throw_count % #self.throw_item_ids + 1]
	self.throw_count = self.throw_count + 1

	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = start_pos, itemid = item_id,
											 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true})
	local caught = false

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })
	character_util.set_anim(thrower, {name = 'throw', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle'})

	if self.constants_data_key == 'afterworld_basket' and speech_random == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		if item_id == 20503 then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(thrower, { key = 'aw_fox_fairy_' .. random_util.get_random_int(24, 26) })
		elseif item_id == 20529 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(thrower, { key = 'aw_fox_fairy_27' })
				wait_for_sec(1)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(get_character('fairy_2'), { key = 'aw_fox_fairy_28' })
			end))
		end
	end

	-- 아이템 습득 범위를 보여준다.
	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(target_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.05, self.catch_dist)
	attack_range:Show()

	while not y_calc:IsDone() do
		-- 플레이어와의 충돌 판정
		local to_leader_dist = (user_party.Leader.Position - item.Position).magnitude
		if self.game_loop and to_leader_dist <= self.catch_dist then
			caught = true
			self:on_player_catch_something(item)
			break
		end

		-- 위치 업데이트
		y_calc:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local progress = y_calc:GetProgress()
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		cur_pos.y = target_pos.y + y_calc:GetDistance()
		item.Position = cur_pos

		-- 회전 갱신
		local cur_angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, -720, progress)
		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, cur_angle, 0)
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, cur_angle, 0)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(attack_range.gameObject)

	-- 물체를 못잡았을 경우에만 잡기 실패 연출을 실행
	if not caught then
		if self.game_loop then
			self:update_count_ui()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_hit_01')
		end

		item.Position = target_pos
		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(item, 0, 1)
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
	end
end

--- 플레이어가 물체를 잡는데 성공하면 불리는 콜백
function local_class:on_player_catch_something(item)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_get_soul_point_01' })

	-- 먹은 이펙트 디스플레이
	local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)
	effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2

	-- 잡은 아이템을 바구니 위로 올려줌.
	item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.6
	item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.6
	item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
	item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	item:SetSortingLayer(true)
	table.insert(self.caught_items, item)

	if self.constants_data_key == 'afterworld_basket' then
		local fairy_2 = get_character('fairy_2')

		self.rolling_number = self.rolling_number - 1
		character_util.set_rolling_number(
				fairy_2.Transform, self.rolling_number, nil, 0, unity_class.color.red)
	end

	-- 바구니 아이템들 위치 갱신
	for i = 1, #self.character_list do
		self:items_on_basket_reposition(i)
	end
end

--region 실패 카운트 UI 함수
-- ui 생성
function local_class:attach_count_ui()
	local ui = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIFailCounter'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.count_ui_object = ui;

	self.count_ui = ui.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIFailCounter))

	self.count_ui:SetFailCount(0)
	self.count_ui:Reposition()
end

-- ui 갱신
function local_class:update_count_ui()
	if self.count_ui == nil then
		return
	end
	-- 실패 카운트, ui 갱신
	self.fail_count = math.min(self.fail_count + 1, self.constants_data.life)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
	self.count_ui:SetFailCount(self.fail_count)

	-- 모든 목숨 소진 시 게임 종료
	if self.fail_count >= self.constants_data.life then
		self.game_loop = false
	end
end

-- ui 삭제
function local_class:detach_count_ui()
	if self.count_ui_object ~= nil then
		self.count_ui_object:Dispose()
	end
	self.count_ui_object = nil
	self.count_ui = nil
end
--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	--Unsubscribe
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	timer_util.end_timer(self)
	self:detach_count_ui()
	self.game_loop = false

	-- 바구니 제거
	if self.basket_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, #self.basket_list do
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.basket_list[i].item_sprite)
		end
		self.basket_list = nil
	end

	if self.caught_items ~= nil then
		-- 바구니 안의 쌓여진 아이템들 제거
		for _,item in ipairs(self.caught_items) do
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
		end
		self.caught_items = nil
	end

	-- 물건 던지는 NPC들 비활성화
	if self.throwers ~= nil then
		for _, thrower in ipairs(self.throwers) do
			thrower.Position = vector(999,0,999)
			thrower.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
		self.throwers = nil
	end

	if self.character_list ~= nil then
		for i = 2, #self.character_list do
			message_system:SendSync(get_character(self.character_list[i]).FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		end
		self.character_list = nil
	end

	if not self.is_stage_ended then
		-- 파티 표정, 애니메이션 클리어
		party_util.remove_emotion()
		party_util.remove_animation()

		-- 기존 파티 싸그리 비워줌.
		for i = user_party.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
			local member = user_party[i]
			character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
		end

		-- 원래 순서대로 파티 복구
		if self.cached_party ~= nil then
			for i = #self.cached_party, 1, -1 do
				local member = self.cached_party[i]
				character_util.set_active_state(member, 'enabled')
				if i == #self.cached_party then
					local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
					character_util.convert_to_manual_character(member, param)

					party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
				else
					character_util.convert_to_party_member(member, user_party)
				end
			end

			self.cached_party = nil
		end
	end

	self.throw_item_ids = nil
	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end
}

--- 바구니로 물체를 잡는 게임 컨트롤러
local local_class = newclass("BasketCatchGameController")

function local_class:init(_, _)
	self.game_name = 'basket_catch_game'

	self.game_progress = {
		none = 1,
		playing = 2,
		clear = 3,
		area_out_fail = 4,
		catch_fail = 5
	}
	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.none

	self.throw_points = {}
	self.throwers = {}

	self.throw_item_ids = {
		20086 -- 사탕 아이템
	}

	self.throw_cycles = {}

	self.game_durations = {}

	self.caught_items = {}

	self.catch_fail_count = 0

	self.fail_count_ui = nil

	self.player_basket = nil

	self.throw_cycle = 0
	self.default_throw_cycle = 2

	self.catch_dist = 1

	self.cached_party = {}

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_game_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_fo_event')
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIFailCounter')
	coroutine.yield(unity_object_pool.WaitAll())
end

function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		-- 플레이어 바구니 위치 업데이트
		if self.player_basket ~= nil then
			self.player_basket.Position = user_party.Leader.Position + self.basket_offset
		end

		self:items_on_basket_reposition()
	end
end

function local_class:on_game_start_event(e)
	if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.none and e:GetParamAt(0) == self.game_name then

		-- 이 게임을 플레이 할 캐릭터가 없으면 리턴
		self.play_character = get_character(e:GetParamAt(2))
		if is_unity_null(self.play_character) then return true end

		-- 머리 위 오프셋
		local margin = 0.15
		self.basket_offset = unity_class.vector3.up * (self.play_character.Hitbox.size.y + margin)

		-- 게임 클리어 카운트 세팅
		self.clear_count = e:GetParamAt(3) == nil and 7 or tonumber(e:GetParamAt(3))

		self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.playing
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, self.game_name .. '_moveable_area') then
		self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.area_out_fail
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:game_init()
	self.caught_items = {}
	self.catch_fail_count = 0

	-- 던질 위치를 미리 매핑
	self.throw_points = {}
	local radius = self.catch_dist
	local throw_area = field:GetZone(self.game_name .. '_throw_area').Bounds
	local area_width = math.floor(throw_area.size.x - radius)
	local area_height = math.floor(throw_area.size.z - radius)
	local area_lb = vector_util.get_x0z(throw_area.center) + unity_class.vector3.left * (area_width / 2) +
			unity_class.vector3.back * (area_height / 2)
	for y = 0, area_height do
		for x = 0, area_width do
			local x_offset = unity_class.vector3.right * (radius + x)
			local z_offset = unity_class.vector3.forward * (radius + y)
			local target_point = area_lb + x_offset + z_offset + vector(0, 0, 1)
			table.insert(self.throw_points, target_point)
		end
	end

	-- 원래 파티 캐싱
	self.cached_party = {}
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(self.cached_party, user_party[i])
	end

	-- 기존 파티 싸그리 비워줌.
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
		member.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	-- 플레이 캐릭터로 리더 변경
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.play_character, param)
	self.play_character.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')

	-- 매뉴얼 캐릭터로 바꿔준 직후에 못 움직이게함.
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 플레이어 위치 세팅
	local player_stand = field:GetMarker(self.game_name .. '_player_stand')
	user_party.Leader.Position = player_stand.position
	user_party.Leader.Direction = player_stand.direction

	-- 플레이어에게 바구니 들게해주기
	user_party.Leader:SetUpperAnimation('hold_loop', true)
	self.player_basket = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = user_party.Leader.Position + self.basket_offset, itemid = 20179, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = true })
	self.player_basket.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	-- 무언가를 던지는 NPC들 세팅
	self.throwers = {}
	for i = 1, math.huge do
		local thrower_name = self.game_name .. '_thrower_' .. i
		local thrower = get_character(thrower_name)
		if thrower == nil then break end

		local marker = field:GetMarker(self.game_name ..'_thrower_' .. i .. '_stand')
		thrower.Position = marker.position
		thrower.Direction = marker.direction
		thrower.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		table.insert(self.throwers, thrower)
	end

	camera_util.resize_to(4.5, 0)
	coroutine.yield()
end

function local_class:game_start()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	-- 게임 초기화
	self:game_init()

	-- 로드 완료 이벤트를 퍼블리시해줌.
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'basket_catch_game_loaded' }))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	-- 플레이어 뛸수만 있게 하고 게임 시작.
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	player_state:DisableControls(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All) ~
			(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Move) + CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash)))
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))

	-- 실패 횟수 UI 활성화
	local ui_obj = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIFailCounter'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.fail_count_ui = ui_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIFailCounter))
	self.fail_count_ui:SetFailCount(0)
	self.fail_count_ui:Reposition()

	self:game_loop()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 실패 횟수 UI 제거
	if not is_unity_null(self.fail_count_ui) then
		self.fail_count_ui:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.fail_count_ui = nil
	end

	-- 위치가 비뚤어져 보이지않게 바구니와 바구니 위 아이템들 위치 업데이트
	if self.player_basket ~= nil then
		self.player_basket.Position = user_party.Leader.Position + self.basket_offset
	end
	self:items_on_basket_reposition()

	if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.clear then
		self:clear_reaction()
	else
		self:fail_reaction()
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	user_party.Leader:RemoveUpperAnimation()

	party_util.switch_leader(get_character('knight_female'))

	-- 기존 파티 싸그리 비워줌.
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
		member.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	-- 원래 순서대로 파티 복구
	for i, member in ipairs(self.cached_party) do
		if i == 1 then
			local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
			character_util.convert_to_manual_character(member, param)

			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		else
			member.Position = user_party.Leader.Position + -direction_util.to_vector3(user_party.Leader.Direction) * (i - 1)
			character_util.convert_to_party_member(member, user_party)
		end

		member.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 플레이어 바구니 제거
	if self.player_basket ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.player_basket)
		self.player_basket = nil
	end

	-- 바구니 안의 쌓여진 아이템들 제거
	for _,item in ipairs(self.caught_items) do
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
	end

	-- 물건 던지는 NPC들 비활성화
	for _, thrower in ipairs(self.throwers) do
		thrower.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	-- 파티 표정, 애니메이션 클리어
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.05)

	-- 게임 메모리 해제 이벤트 브로드캐스트
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'basket_catch_dispose'}))

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)

	-- 랭크 세팅
	local rank = 'fail'
	if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.clear then
		if self.catch_fail_count == 0 then
			rank = 'perfect_clear'
		else
			rank = 'normal_clear'
		end
	end

	-- 게임 결과 이벤트 브로드캐스트
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(
			nil, { 'basket_catch_game', 'end', rank }))

	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.none
end

function local_class:set_throw_cycle(idx)
	if self.throw_cycles[stage.Name] then
		self.throw_cycle = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.throw_cycles[stage.Name][idx], self.default_throw_cycle)
	else
		self.throw_cycle = self.default_throw_cycle
	end
end

--- 바구니 위의 물체들의 위치를 갱신해줌
-- TODO: 담는 물체가 다양해지는것을 고려해 바구니 실제 사이즈 / 담는 물체 사이즈 계산해서 세팅해주는게 좋을듯함.
function local_class:items_on_basket_reposition()
	local x_offsets = { -0.16, 0.02, 0.19 }
	local z_offsets = { 0.04, 0.05, 0.09 }
	local row_offset = 0.1
	for i, item in ipairs(self.caught_items) do
		local row = math.floor((i - 1) / 3) + 1
		local col = math.floor((i - 1) % 3) + 1
		item.Position = self.player_basket.Position + unity_class.vector3.right * x_offsets[col] +
				unity_class.vector3.forward * (row_offset * (row - 1) + z_offsets[col] )
		item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite)):SetSortingOrder(row + 1)
	end
end

function local_class:game_loop()
	local cycle_idx = 1
	self:set_throw_cycle(cycle_idx)

	local time_passed = 0
	while self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 물건을 던질 시간이 됐다면 던지게함.
		if time_passed >= self.throw_cycle then
			local thrower = self.throwers[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.throwers)]
			local throw_point = self.throw_points[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.throw_points)]
			local item_id = self.throw_item_ids[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.throw_item_ids)]
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.throw_something, self, thrower, item_id, throw_point))

			time_passed = 0
			cycle_idx = cycle_idx + 1
			self:set_throw_cycle(cycle_idx)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:clear_reaction()
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_gimmick_jingle_01' })

	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('awesome', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:fail_reaction()
	user_party.Leader:SetEmotion('tired', true)
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

--- 플레이어가 물체를 잡는데 성공하면 불리는 콜백
function local_class:on_player_catch_something(item)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_get_soul_point_01' })

	-- 먹은 이펙트 디스플레이
	local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get'):Instantiate(user_party.Leader.Position)
	effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2

	-- 잡은 아이템을 바구니 위로 올려줌.
	item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.4
	item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.4
	item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
	item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	item:SetSortingLayer(true)
	table.insert(self.caught_items, item)

	-- 바구니 아이템들 위치 갱신
	self:items_on_basket_reposition()

	-- 클리어가능한 개수만큼 잡았다면 클리어 처리
	if #self.caught_items >= self.clear_count then
		self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.clear
	end
end

--- 플레이어가 물체를 잡는데 실패하면 불리는 콜백
function local_class:on_player_catch_fail()
	local max_fail_count = 4

	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_quiz_x_01', type_priority = 'event'})

	self.catch_fail_count = self.catch_fail_count + 1
	if self.catch_fail_count >= max_fail_count then
		self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.catch_fail
	end

	-- UI에 실패 횟수 갱신
	if self.fail_count_ui ~= nil then
		self.fail_count_ui:SetFailCount(self.catch_fail_count)
	end
end

--- NPC들이 물체를 던지는 루틴
function local_class:throw_something(thrower, item_id, target_pos)
	local gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultGravity
	local y_init = 10
	local start_pos = thrower.Position
	local y_calc = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(y_init, gravity, 0, 0)
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = start_pos, itemid = item_id,
											 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true})
	local caught = false

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01' })
	thrower:SetEmotion('smile', true)
	character_util.set_anim(thrower, {name = 'throw', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle'})

	-- 아이템 습득 범위를 보여준다.
	local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(target_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.05, self.catch_dist)
	attack_range:Show()

	while not y_calc:IsDone() do
		-- 플레이어와의 충돌 판정
		local to_leader_dist = (user_party.Leader.Position - item.Position).magnitude
		if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing and to_leader_dist <= self.catch_dist then
			caught = true
			self:on_player_catch_something(item)
			break
		end

		-- 위치 업데이트
		y_calc:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local progress = y_calc:GetProgress()
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)
		cur_pos.y = target_pos.y + y_calc:GetDistance()
		item.Position = cur_pos

		-- 회전 갱신
		local cur_angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, -720, progress)
		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, cur_angle, 0)
		item.ShadowTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, cur_angle, 0)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(attack_range.gameObject)

	-- 물체를 못잡았을 경우에만 잡기 실패 연출을 실행
	if not caught then
		self:on_player_catch_fail()

		item.Position = target_pos
		drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(item, 0, 1)
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))

	if not is_unity_null(self.fail_count_ui) then
		self.fail_count_ui:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.fail_count_ui = nil
	end
end


return {
	create = function(cs_controller, scene)
		return local_class(cs_controller, scene)
	end
}
