	self.get_num_counter_ui()
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fx_lasthit()
	self.get_fx_plitvice_buff_loop()
	self.get_fx_plitvice_buff_end()

	-- 콤보 텍스트 세팅
	self:load_combo_text()

	yield_return_func(unity_object_pool.WaitAll, unity_object_pool)

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end


--region Event
--  버튼
function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then
		return true
	end

	if self.current_input_state == self.input_state.valid and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		self.current_input_state = self.input_state.processed
		return true
	end

	if self.current_input_state == self.input_state.valid and
			CS.Oak.InputManager.IsPC and
			e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.current_input_state = self.input_state.processed
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion Event

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.current_game_progress = nil

	-- 비치볼 아이템 해제
	if self.beach_ball ~= nil then
		self.beach_ball:ConsumeComplete()
		self.beach_ball = nil
	end

	-- 콤보 텍스트
	self:unload_combo_text()

	-- 카운터 ui 제거
	self.ui_num_counter = nil

	if self.ui_num_counter_object ~= nil then
		self.ui_num_counter_object:Dispose()
		self.ui_num_counter_object = nil
	end

	--리소스 홀더 해제
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	--이펙트 제거
	if self.fx_plitvice_buff_loop ~= nil then
		self.fx_plitvice_buff_loop:Dispose()
		self.fx_plitvice_buff_loop = nil
	end

	self.beach_ball_shadow = nil
	self.beach_ball_sprite = nil

	-- 실패 UI
	self:unload_fail_counter()

	--shear값 원래대로
	self:activate_shear()

end

function local_class:game_start()
	start_coroutine(self.game_start_routine, self)
end

-- 페이드가 사용되어 환경이 백그라운드로 셋팅되는 씬이다.
-- 외부에서 페이드를 통해 진입해야 한다.
function local_class:game_start_routine()
	local constants_data = self.constants_data
	local player_data = constants_data.player_data
	local enemy_data = constants_data.enemy_data
	local crowd_data = constants_data.crowd_data
	local cam_data = constants_data.cam_data

	local player = get_character(player_data.character_name)
	local enemy = get_character(enemy_data.character_name)
	local crowd_npc_data_list = {}
	for i = 1, #crowd_data.npc_list do
		local npc_data = crowd_data.npc_list[i]
		table.insert(crowd_npc_data_list, npc_data)
	end

	local player_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(player_data.marker_name)
	local enemy_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(enemy_data.marker_name)
	local cam_ratio = cam_data.ratio
	local cam_pos_offset = to_vector3(cam_data.pos_offset)
	local cam_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(cam_data.marker_name) + cam_pos_offset

	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.wait

	--플레이어 배치
	self.player_pos_org = player.Position
	character_util.set_position(player, player_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(player, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)

	--적 배치
	self.enemy_pos_org = enemy.Position
	character_util.set_position(enemy, enemy_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(enemy, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(enemy)

	-- 구경꾼 배치
	local npc_default_action = crowd_data.default_action
	for i = 1, #crowd_npc_data_list do
		local npc = get_character(crowd_npc_data_list[i].character_name)
		local npc_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(crowd_npc_data_list[i].marker_name)
		table.insert(self.crowd_pos_org_table, npc.Position)
		table.insert(self.crowd_active_state_org_table, npc.ActiveState)

		character_util.set_position(npc, npc_pos)
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(npc, npc_default_action.direction)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, npc_default_action.emotion)
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, npc_default_action.animation)
	end

	--shear값 0으로
	self:deactivate_shear()

	--카메라 배치
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(cam_ratio, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, 0.1)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	--미니게임 시작 시 UI 숨기기
	self:hide_common_ui()

	--0.7초만에 서큘러 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.7, 'linear')

	-- 경기 시작 카운트
	local start_count = 3
	local start_count_string_key = 'short_story_mm_bbr_activity_count'
	local title_mod = 2.1
	for i = start_count, 1, -1 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:Format(start_count_string_key, i), title_mod)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'event',
		name = 'ondemand/short_story_mermaid/audio:bgm_mermaid_game',
	})

	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.playing

	start_coroutine(self.game_update, self)

end

function local_class:game_update()
	local constants_data = self.constants_data
	local attack_pattern_data = constants_data.attack_pattern_data
	local system_data = constants_data.system_data
	local player_data = constants_data.player_data
	local enemy_data = constants_data.enemy_data
	local crowd_data = constants_data.crowd_data
	local fever_data = constants_data.fever_data
	local attack_type = constants_data.attack_type

	local attack_miss_data = attack_type.miss
	local attack_clear_data = attack_type.clear

	local player = get_character(player_data.character_name)
	local enemy = get_character(enemy_data.character_name)

	local player_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(player_data.marker_name)
	local enemy_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(enemy_data.marker_name)

	local crowd_npc_data_list = {}
	for i = 1, #crowd_data.npc_list do
		local npc = crowd_data.npc_list[i]
		table.insert(crowd_npc_data_list, npc)
	end

	local current_fever_state = 'fever_none'

	local time_passed = 0
	local time_passed_in_this_state = 0

	if system_data.is_tutorial == false then
		self.is_tutorial = false
	end
	if system_data.is_tutorial == false then
		self.is_fever_tutorial = false
	end

	--게임 스테이트
	local rally_state = {
		none = 1,
		start = 2,
		start_toss_to_player = 3,
		start_wait_toss_anim_delay = 4,
		toss_to_player = 5,
		toss_to_enemy = 6,
		miss = 7,
		miss_ball_fade_out = 8,
		miss_ball_reload = 9,
		miss_enemy_move_back = 10,
		restart = 11,
		restart_toss_to_player = 12,
		restart_wait_toss_anim_delay = 13,
		pre_fail = 14,
		fail = 15,
		pre_clear = 16,
		clear = 17,
		ending = 18,
	}

	local current_rally_state = rally_state.start

	local current_attack_index = 1
	local total_attack_order_count = table_util.get_size(attack_pattern_data)

	local toss_success_count = 0
	local toss_miss_count = 0
	local combo_count = 0

	local input_started_time = 0

	local toss_cooldown = system_data.toss_cooldown
	local toss_duration = system_data.toss_duration

	local game_clear_count = system_data.game_clear_count
	local game_failed_count = system_data.game_failed_count

	local is_toss = false

	local rally_state_changed_time = 0
	local rally_state_changed_beach_ball_pos = nil

	--토스를 빨리 한 만큼 빨리 날라감
	local exceed_time = 0

	local is_progress_tutorial = false

	--위치 변경해야하지 않을까?
	local current_attack_name = attack_pattern_data[current_attack_index]
	local current_attack_data = attack_type[current_attack_name]

	-- 적이 전진이동을 했는지 안했는지 여부
	local is_already_enemy_moved_forward = false

	-- 적이 점프를 했는지 안했는지 여부.
	local is_already_enemy_jumped = false
	local is_already_enemy_attacked = false

	-- 플레이어가 점프를 했는지 안했는지 여부.
	local is_already_player_jumped = false

	local is_exist_quick_spike = system_data.is_exist_quick_spike
	local quick_spike_exceed_time = system_data.quick_spike_exceed_time

	local idle_emotion = 'idle'

	--피버 튜토리얼시 점프 관련 변수
	local is_tutorial_jump = false
	local player_tutorial_jump_start_time = 0
	local player_tutorial_jump_duration = 0
	local player_tutorial_jump_height = 2.8
	local player_tutorial_jump_start_pos = player.Position

	--end_pos_offset
	local end_pos_offsets = {
		attack_miss = to_vector3(attack_miss_data.end_pos_offset),
		toss_to_player = to_vector3(system_data.toss_to_player_end_pos_offset),
		attack_clear = to_vector3(attack_clear_data.end_pos_offset)
	}

	--sfx 관련
	--03_equipping_01
	local eat_sfx = nil

	while self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing do

		--튜토리얼 진행 중이라면 시간 진행이 멈춘다.
		if not is_progress_tutorial then
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		--region self.current_input_state
		if self.current_input_state == self.input_state.processed then
			self.current_input_state = self.input_state.cooldown

			local toss_anim = player_data.toss_anim
			local toss_emotion = player_data.toss_emotion
			local toss_sfx = player_data.toss_sfx

			input_started_time = time_passed

			is_toss = true

			-- 플레이어 공격 애니메이션 / 이모션
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(toss_sfx)
			scene_util.set_emotion(player, self, toss_emotion)
			scene_util.set_anim(player, self, { name = toss_anim, count = 1 })

		elseif self.current_input_state == self.input_state.cooldown then
			if time_passed - input_started_time > toss_cooldown then
				is_toss = false
				scene_util.set_emotion(player, self, idle_emotion)
				character_util.remove_anim(player)
				self.current_input_state = self.input_state.valid
			elseif time_passed - input_started_time > toss_duration then
				is_toss = false
			end
		else
			--바닥에 닿는 순간에 입력 동시에 했을 때 자동 토스 되는 문제 예외 처리
			is_toss = false
		end
		--endregion

		--region self.current_rally_state
		time_passed_in_this_state = time_passed - rally_state_changed_time

		if current_rally_state == rally_state.start then
			--실패 카운터 UI 세팅
			self:load_fail_counter()

			--성공 카운터 UI 세팅
			self:load_num_counter()

			--enemy 최초 idle 표정, cast 자세로 공을 쥐고 있는 상태.
			scene_util.set_anim(enemy, self, 'cast')

			--비치 볼 아이템 생성
			self:create_beach_ball_item()

			--튜토리얼이 필요하면 입력 못하도록

			self.current_input_state = self.input_state.valid

			rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
			current_rally_state = rally_state.start_toss_to_player

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.start_toss_to_player then
			local wait_time = 1.0

			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then
				local enemy_attack_animation = current_attack_data.enemy_attack_animation
				local enemy_attack_sfx = current_attack_data.enemy_attack_sfx

				if enemy_attack_sfx ~= nil then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(enemy_attack_sfx)
				end

				scene_util.set_anim(enemy, self, { name = enemy_attack_animation, count = 1, sfx_name = false })

				rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
				current_rally_state = rally_state.start_wait_toss_anim_delay
			end

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.start_wait_toss_anim_delay then
			local wait_time = current_attack_data.enemy_attack_delay

			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then
				rally_state_changed_beach_ball_pos = self.beach_ball.Position
				rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
				current_rally_state = rally_state.toss_to_player
			end

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.toss_to_player then
			local wait_time = current_attack_data.air_time_to_player
			local toss_success_time = current_attack_data.success_time_min

			local is_jump = current_attack_data.is_player_jump
			local jump_duration = current_attack_data.player_jump_duration
			local jump_height = current_attack_data.player_jump_height
			local jump_maximum_point = current_attack_data.success_time_min

			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then
				--목숨 1회 소진.
				toss_miss_count = toss_miss_count + 1
				self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(toss_miss_count)

				--공격 패턴 초기화.
				current_attack_index = 1
				current_attack_name = attack_pattern_data[current_attack_index]
				current_attack_data = attack_type[current_attack_name]

				--콤보 초기화
				combo_count = 0
				self.combo_text_object:SetActive(false)

				--콤보 초기화에 따라 구경꾼 표정/애니메이션 변경
				self:update_crowd(crowd_npc_data_list, 'fever_out')

				--점프 여부 초기화
				is_already_player_jumped = false

				--enemy는 tired 표정 전환.
				scene_util.set_emotion(enemy, self, 'tired')

				--beach_ball 아이템이 player한테 맞으며,  player damaged 표정으로 embarrassed 자세 1초 유지.
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
				scene_util.set_anim(player, self, 'embarrassed')
				scene_util.set_emotion(player, self, 'damaged')
				idle_emotion = 'idle'

				-- Damage red pulse, damage squish
				player.SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
				player.SpineController:DamageRedPulse()

				--공을 맞은 인어 캐릭터에 FX_hit 이펙트 출력.
				self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(self.beach_ball.Position)

				--피버 이펙트 해제
				self:activate_fever_effect(false)

				self.current_input_state = self.input_state.invalid

				rally_state_changed_beach_ball_pos = self.beach_ball.Position
				rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
				current_rally_state = rally_state.miss
			elseif time_passed_in_this_state > toss_success_time then
				if self.is_tutorial then

					self.is_tutorial = false
					is_progress_tutorial = true

					self.current_input_state = self.input_state.valid

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
					time_util.mod('qte', 0.1)
					CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActionTap(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton, 1 * 0.1)

					self.toss_button_touched = false

				elseif is_toss then

					if is_progress_tutorial then
						is_progress_tutorial = false
						CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
						ui_quest_marker:Show(false)
						CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
						time_util.unmod('qte')

						is_toss = false
					end

					--함수화 가능?
					toss_success_count = toss_success_count + 1
					self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(toss_success_count)

					combo_count = combo_count + 1
					self.combo_text_object:SetActive(true)
					self.combo_text.text = string.format("%d", combo_count)

					--콤보 횟수에 따라 피버 적용 (군중 emotion/animation 적용)
					for i = 1, #fever_data do
						local fever_count = fever_data[i].count
						if combo_count >= fever_count then
							self:update_crowd(crowd_npc_data_list, fever_data[i].name)
							break
						end
					end

					if is_jump then
						local player_spike_sfx = player_data.spike_sfx
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(player_spike_sfx)
					end

					current_attack_index = current_attack_index + 1
					if current_attack_index > total_attack_order_count then
						current_attack_index = 1
					end

					exceed_time = wait_time - time_passed_in_this_state

					--피버와 유저 행동에 따른 패턴 변경
					if combo_count % 5 == 4 then
						current_attack_name = 'fever'
						idle_emotion = 'burning'

						--피버 이펙트 ON
						self:activate_fever_effect(true)

						--피버 튜토리얼이 true라면 튜토리얼 다시 실행하도록
						if self.is_fever_tutorial then
							self.is_tutorial = true
						end

					elseif combo_count % 5 == 0
							and current_attack_name ~= 'quick_spike' then
						current_attack_name = 'normal_after_fever'
						scene_util.set_emotion(enemy, self, 'surprise')
						idle_emotion = 'idle'

						--피버 이펙트 OFF
						self:activate_fever_effect(false)

					elseif exceed_time >= quick_spike_exceed_time
							and current_attack_name == 'spike'
							and is_exist_quick_spike then
						-- 스파이크를 일찍쳤으면, 다음 패턴이 quick_spike로 변경
						current_attack_name = 'quick_spike'
						scene_util.set_emotion(player, self, 'damaged')
						idle_emotion = 'damaged'

					else
						current_attack_name = attack_pattern_data[current_attack_index]
						idle_emotion = 'idle'

					end
					current_attack_data = attack_type[current_attack_name]

					--character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(enemy)

					-- 앞으로 이미 움직였고, 이번 공격이 적이 앞으로 전진 해야하는 공격이 아니라면, 적은 뒤로 돌아감
					if is_already_enemy_moved_forward and
							not current_attack_data.is_enemy_move_forward then
						wp_util.move(enemy,
								enemy_pos,
								nil,
								current_attack_data.enemy_move_forward_duration,
								{ run = true, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right })
						is_already_enemy_moved_forward = false
					end

					-- 인어의 손에서 FX_lasthit
					self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(self.beach_ball.Position)

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_head_01')

					rally_state_changed_beach_ball_pos = self.beach_ball.Position
					rally_state_changed_time = time_passed

					--점프 여부 초기화
					is_already_player_jumped = false

					if toss_success_count >= game_clear_count then
						current_rally_state = rally_state.pre_clear
					else
						current_rally_state = rally_state.toss_to_enemy
					end

				end
			elseif is_jump and
					not is_already_player_jumped and
					time_passed_in_this_state + jump_duration / 2 >= jump_maximum_point then
				-- 플레이어가 점프해야 한다면,
				local enemy_jump_sfx = current_attack_data.enemy_jump_sfx

				if enemy_jump_sfx ~= nil then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(enemy_jump_sfx)
				end

				scene_util.set_anim(player, self, { name = 'get', one_shot_sfx = false })

				self.is_fever_tutorial = false
				is_tutorial_jump = true
				player_tutorial_jump_start_time = time_passed
				player_tutorial_jump_duration = current_attack_data.player_jump_duration
				player_tutorial_jump_height = jump_height
				player_tutorial_jump_start_pos = player.Position
				is_already_player_jumped = true
			end

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.toss_to_enemy then
			local wait_time = (current_attack_data.air_time_to_enemy - exceed_time) * 0.95

			local is_move_forward = current_attack_data.is_enemy_move_forward
			local move_forward_distance = current_attack_data.enemy_move_forward_distance
			local move_forward_duration = current_attack_data.enemy_move_forward_duration

			if time_passed_in_this_state <= wait_time then
				-- 전진
				if is_move_forward and
						not is_already_enemy_moved_forward then
					wp_util.move(enemy,
							enemy_pos + vector(move_forward_distance, 0, 0),
							nil,
							move_forward_duration,
							{ run = true, play_sfx = true })
					is_already_enemy_moved_forward = true
				end

				--점프
				local is_enemy_jump = current_attack_data.is_enemy_jump
				local jump_duration = current_attack_data.enemy_jump_duration
				local jump_height = current_attack_data.enemy_jump_height

				if is_enemy_jump and
						not is_already_enemy_jumped and
						time_passed_in_this_state + jump_duration / 2 >= wait_time then
					local enemy_jump_sfx = current_attack_data.enemy_jump_sfx

					if enemy_jump_sfx ~= nil then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(enemy_jump_sfx)
					end

					scene_util.set_anim(enemy, self, { name = 'get', one_shot_sfx = false })
					character_util.jump(enemy, jump_height, jump_duration)

					is_already_enemy_jumped = true
				end

				-- 공격
				local enemy_attack_delay = current_attack_data.enemy_attack_delay

				if not is_already_enemy_attacked and
						time_passed_in_this_state + enemy_attack_delay >= wait_time then

					local enemy_attack_emotion = current_attack_data.enemy_attack_emotion
					scene_util.set_emotion(enemy, self, enemy_attack_emotion)

					local enemy_attack_animation = current_attack_data.enemy_attack_animation

					scene_util.set_anim(enemy, self, { name = enemy_attack_animation, count = 1, sfx_name = false })

					is_already_enemy_attacked = true
				end

			else
				-- 공격 anim/emotion을 끝까지 안했다면, 하도록 처리
				if not is_already_enemy_attacked then
					local enemy_attack_emotion = current_attack_data.enemy_attack_emotion
					scene_util.set_emotion(enemy, self, enemy_attack_emotion)

					local enemy_attack_animation = current_attack_data.enemy_attack_animation

					scene_util.set_anim(enemy, self, { name = enemy_attack_animation, count = 1, sfx_name = false })

				end

				--위에 정의 안된 변수들 초기화 해줘야 할 듯
				is_already_enemy_jumped = false
				is_already_enemy_attacked = false

				--점프 여부에 따라 달라지는 공격 이펙트
				if current_attack_data.is_enemy_jump then
					self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(self.beach_ball.Position)
				else
					self.get_fx_lasthit():Instantiate(self.beach_ball.Position)
				end

				local enemy_attack_sfx = current_attack_data.enemy_attack_sfx

				if enemy_attack_sfx ~= nil then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(enemy_attack_sfx)
				end
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bounce_head_01')

				rally_state_changed_beach_ball_pos = self.beach_ball.Position
				rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
				current_rally_state = rally_state.toss_to_player
			end
		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.miss then
			local wait_time = attack_type.miss.air_time
			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then
				self.beach_ball.Position = player_pos + end_pos_offsets.attack_miss

				rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
				current_rally_state = rally_state.miss_ball_fade_out
			end
		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.miss_ball_fade_out then
			local wait_time = 1

			if time_passed_in_this_state < wait_time then
				self:update_item_fade(self.beach_ball,
						time_passed_in_this_state,
						self.beach_ball_item_color,
						self.beach_ball_shadow_color,
						0,
						wait_time)
			else
				self:item_fade_async(self.beach_ball, 0, 0)
				rally_state_changed_time = time_passed

				--만약 앞으로 적이 움직였다면, 원래 자리르 돌아오는 과정을 거침
				if is_already_enemy_moved_forward then
					current_rally_state = rally_state.miss_enemy_move_back
				else
					current_rally_state = rally_state.miss_ball_reload
				end
			end

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.miss_enemy_move_back then
			local wait_time = system_data.common_enemy_move_forward_duration
			local is_move = false
			if not is_move then
				-- 적이 원 위치로 돌아옴
				wp_util.move(enemy,
						enemy_pos,
						nil,
						system_data.common_enemy_move_forward_duration,
						{ run = true, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right })
				is_already_enemy_moved_forward = false
				is_move = true
			end
			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then
				current_rally_state = rally_state.miss_ball_reload
			end

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.miss_ball_reload then
			local wait_time = 0.5

			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then
				if toss_miss_count >= game_failed_count then
					rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
					current_rally_state = rally_state.pre_fail
				else
					-- 구경꾼 모두 idle 표정으로 전환.
					self:update_crowd(crowd_npc_data_list, current_fever_state)
					-- 적 right 방향 eat 자세 이후 신틸라의 손에 beach_ball 아이템이 새로 쥐어지고 액티비티 재개.
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(enemy)
					scene_util.set_anim(enemy, self, 'eat')
					eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })

					self.current_input_state = self.input_state.valid

					rally_state_changed_beach_ball_pos = self.beach_ball.Position
					rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
					current_rally_state = rally_state.restart
				end
			end

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.restart then
			local wait_time = 0.5

			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then
				local create_pos = self:get_beach_ball_create_pos()
				self.beach_ball.Position = create_pos
				self.beach_ball.ShadowTransform.position = vector(create_pos.x, 0, create_pos.z)

				music_player_util.stop_sfx(eat_sfx)

				drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async(self.beach_ball, 0)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_holdup_01')
				scene_util.set_anim(enemy, self, 'cast')
				rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
				current_rally_state = rally_state.restart_toss_to_player
			end
		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.restart_toss_to_player then
			local wait_time = 1.0

			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then
				local enemy_attack_animation = current_attack_data.enemy_attack_animation
				local enemy_attack_sfx = current_attack_data.enemy_attack_sfx

				if enemy_attack_sfx ~= nil then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(enemy_attack_sfx)
				end

				scene_util.set_anim(enemy, self, { name = enemy_attack_animation, count = 1, sfx_name = false })

				rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
				current_rally_state = rally_state.restart_wait_toss_anim_delay
			end

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.restart_wait_toss_anim_delay then
			local wait_time = current_attack_data.enemy_attack_delay

			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then

				rally_state_changed_beach_ball_pos = self.beach_ball.Position
				rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
				current_rally_state = rally_state.toss_to_player
			end

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.pre_clear then

			local wait_time = 0

			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then
				-- 콤보 텍스트 비활성화
				self.combo_text_object:SetActive(false)

				--액티비티 클리어 문구 표시.
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

				--신틸라 smile 표정으로 clap 자세 진행.
				scene_util.set_emotion(enemy, self, 'smile')
				scene_util.set_anim(enemy, self, 'clap')

				--입력 못하도록
				self.current_input_state = self.input_state.invalid

				--인어 캐릭터 left 방향 smile 표정으로 victory_get 자세 1회.
				scene_util.set_emotion(player, self, 'smile')
				scene_util.set_anim(player, self, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
				rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
				current_rally_state = rally_state.clear
			end

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.clear then
			local wait_time = attack_clear_data.air_time

			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then

				self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.clear
				start_coroutine(self.game_end, self)
				return
			end

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.pre_fail then
			local wait_time = 0

			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then
				-- 인어 캐릭터 left 방향 cry 표정으로 frustration 하며 액티비티 실패 문구 표시.
				scene_util.set_emotion(player, self, 'cry')
				scene_util.set_anim(player, self, 'frustration')

				-- 콤보 텍스트 비활성화
				self.combo_text_object:SetActive(false)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('short_story_mm_bbr_activity_failed'))
				rally_state_changed_time = time_passed
				current_rally_state = rally_state.fail
			end

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.fail then
			local wait_time = 2

			if time_passed_in_this_state >= wait_time then

				self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.fail
				start_coroutine(self.game_end, self)
				return
			end

		end
		--endregion

		--region beach_ball_update

		-- toss_to_player
		time_passed_in_this_state = time_passed - rally_state_changed_time

		if current_rally_state == rally_state.toss_to_player then
			self:beach_ball_update(self.beach_ball,
					time_passed_in_this_state,
					rally_state_changed_beach_ball_pos,
					player_pos
							+ end_pos_offsets.toss_to_player
							+ vector(0, current_attack_data.player_jump_height, 0),
					current_attack_data.rotation_angle * -1,
					current_attack_data.air_time_to_player,
					current_attack_data.throw_height,
					current_attack_data.is_enemy_attack_straight)

			-- toss_to_enemy
		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.toss_to_enemy then
			self:beach_ball_update(self.beach_ball,
					time_passed_in_this_state,
					rally_state_changed_beach_ball_pos,
					enemy_pos + vector(current_attack_data.enemy_move_forward_distance,
							current_attack_data.enemy_jump_height,
							0),
					current_attack_data.rotation_angle,
					(current_attack_data.air_time_to_enemy - exceed_time) * 1,
					current_attack_data.throw_height,
					current_attack_data.is_player_attack_straight)

			-- miss
		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.miss then
			self:beach_ball_update(self.beach_ball,
					time_passed_in_this_state,
					rally_state_changed_beach_ball_pos,
					player_pos + end_pos_offsets.attack_miss,
					attack_miss_data.rotation_angle,
					attack_miss_data.air_time,
					attack_miss_data.throw_height,
					false)

		elseif current_rally_state == rally_state.clear then
			self:beach_ball_update(self.beach_ball,
					time_passed_in_this_state,
					rally_state_changed_beach_ball_pos,
					enemy_pos + end_pos_offsets.attack_clear,
					attack_clear_data.rotation_angle,
					attack_clear_data.air_time,
					attack_clear_data.throw_height,
					false)
		end

		--endregion

		--튜토리얼때문에 공중에 떠있다면, update를 통해 바닥으로 내려준다.
		if is_tutorial_jump then
			if time_passed - player_tutorial_jump_start_time < player_tutorial_jump_duration then
				self:update_tutorial_jump(player,
						player_tutorial_jump_start_pos,
						player_tutorial_jump_height,
						time_passed - player_tutorial_jump_start_time,
						player_tutorial_jump_duration)
			else
				self.is_player_free_fall = false
				local end_pos = vector(player_tutorial_jump_start_pos.x, 0, player_tutorial_jump_start_pos.z)
				character_util.set_position(player, end_pos, true)
			end
			self:update_fail_counter_pos()
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

end

function local_class:game_end()
	local player_data = self.constants_data.player_data
	local enemy_data = self.constants_data.enemy_data
	local crowd_data = self.constants_data.crowd_data

	local player = get_character(player_data.character_name)
	local enemy = get_character(enemy_data.character_name)

	-- 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.7, 'linear')
	--0.2초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	--콤보 텍스트 세팅

	--실패 카운터 UI 세팅

	--목숨 카운터 UI 세팅

	-- 비치볼 아이템 해제
	if self.beach_ball ~= nil then
		self.beach_ball:ConsumeComplete()
		self.beach_ball = nil
	end

	--플레이어 배치
	character_util.set_position(player, self.player_pos_org)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(player)

	--적 배치
	character_util.set_position(enemy, self.enemy_pos_org)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(enemy)

	-- 구경꾼 리셋
	local crowd_npc_data_list = {}
	for i = 1, #crowd_data.npc_list do
		local npc_data = crowd_data.npc_list[i]
		table.insert(crowd_npc_data_list, npc_data)
	end
	self:reset_crowd(crowd_npc_data_list)

	--카메라 배치
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.1)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name,
			self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.clear))

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	--0.7초만에 서큘러 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.7, 'linear')

	--미니게임 시작 시 숨긴 UI 노출
	self:show_common_ui()
end

function local_class:load_combo_text()
	if self.combo_text_object == nil then
		local widget_offset = 0.2
		local aspect = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.safeArea.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height
		local target_size = vector(CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight * aspect, CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight)

		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, self.res_holder,
				'theatres/steampunk_rhythm_minigame', 'rhythm_combo', function(prefab)
					local go = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
					local transform = go.transform

					transform.localPosition = vector(0, target_size.y * widget_offset, 0)

					local number_text = transform:Find('number'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel))

					self.combo_text_object = go
					self.combo_text = number_text

					go:SetActive(false)
				end)
	end
end

function local_class:unload_combo_text()
	self.combo_text = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.combo_text_object) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.combo_text_object)
		self.combo_text_object = nil
	end

end

function local_class:item_fade_async(item, target_alpha, duration)
	local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local shadow_sprite = item.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local item_start_color = item_sprite.TintColor
	local shadow_start_color = shadow_sprite.TintColor
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		item_sprite.TintColor = item_start_color *
				unity_class.mathf.Lerp(item_start_color.a, target_alpha, progress)
		shadow_sprite.Alpha = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(shadow_start_color.a, target_alpha, progress)

		item_sprite:Rebuild()
		shadow_sprite:Rebuild()
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item_sprite.TintColor = item_start_color
	shadow_sprite.Alpha = shadow_start_color.a
end

function local_class:update_item_fade(item, time_passed, item_color, shadow_color, target_alpha, duration)
	local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local shadow_sprite = item.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))

	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

	item_sprite.TintColor = item_color *
			unity_class.mathf.Lerp(item_color.a, target_alpha, progress)
	shadow_sprite.Alpha = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(shadow_color.a, target_alpha, progress)

	item_sprite:Rebuild()
	shadow_sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:update_crowd(npc_data_list, fever_action_name)
	if self.current_fever_state == fever_action_name then
		return
	end

	self.current_fever_state = fever_action_name

	local npc_action_default = self.constants_data.crowd_data.default_action
	for i = 1, #npc_data_list do
		local npc_data = npc_data_list[i]

		local npc = get_character(npc_data.character_name)
		local npc_action = npc_action_default
		if npc_data.fever_action[fever_action_name] ~= nil then
			npc_action = npc_data.fever_action[fever_action_name]
		end
		character_util.set_direction(npc, npc_action.direction)
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, { name = npc_action.emotion, sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false })
		scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, { name = npc_action.animation, sfx_name = false, one_shot_sfx = false })

	end
end

function local_class:reset_crowd(npc_data_list)
	for i = 1, #npc_data_list do
		local npc_data = npc_data_list[i]
		local npc_name = npc_data.character_name
		local npc = get_character(npc_name)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_position(npc, self.crowd_pos_org_table[i])
		npc.ActiveState = self.crowd_active_state_org_table[i]
	end
end

function local_class:get_beach_ball_create_pos()
	local enemy = get_character(self.constants_data.enemy_data.character_name)
	local create_pos_offset = self.constants_data.beach_ball_data.create_pos_offset
	return vector_util.get_x0z(enemy.Bounds.center) + to_vector3(create_pos_offset)
end

function local_class:create_beach_ball_item()
	--비치 볼 아이템 배치
	local beach_ball_data = self.constants_data.beach_ball_data
	local beach_ball_id = beach_ball_data.id
	local beach_ball_spr_scale = beach_ball_data.spr_scale
	local create_pos = self:get_beach_ball_create_pos()
	local beach_ball_shadow_scale = to_vector3(beach_ball_data.shadow_scale)

	self.beach_ball = drop_item_util.create_item({
		pos = create_pos,
		itemid = beach_ball_id,
		notforinven = true,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		skip_text = true,
		showoncharacter = true,
		spr_scale = beach_ball_spr_scale,
	})

	--비치 볼 그림자 크기 조절
	self.beach_ball.ShadowTransform.localScale = beach_ball_shadow_scale
	self.beach_ball_item_color = self.beach_ball.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite)).TintColor
	self.beach_ball_shadow_color = self.beach_ball.ShadowTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite)).TintColor

	self.beach_ball_shadow = self.beach_ball.ShadowTransform
	self.beach_ball_sprite = self.beach_ball.SpriteTransform
end

--비치볼 아이템 위치 업데이트
function local_class:beach_ball_update(
		beach_ball, time_passed, start_pos, end_pos, rotation_angle, air_time, throw_height, is_move_straight)
	-- 공이 날아감
	local progress = time_passed / air_time
	local cur_horizontal_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + end_pos * progress
	local cur_y = 0

	if not is_move_straight then
		cur_y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * throw_height
	end
	local cur_pos = cur_horizontal_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0)

	beach_ball.Position = cur_pos

	--공 그림자 위치 조정
	local shadow_pos = vector(cur_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z)
	self.beach_ball_shadow.position = shadow_pos

	-- 공이 회전함
	local cur_rot_z = rotation_angle * progress
	self.beach_ball_sprite.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rot_z)
end

function local_class:activate_fever_effect(is_active)
	local player_data = self.constants_data.player_data
	local player = get_character(player_data.character_name)
	if is_active then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_dash_01')
		self.fx_plitvice_buff_loop = self.get_fx_plitvice_buff_loop():Instantiate(
				player.Position,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity,
				player.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
		self.fx_plitvice_buff_loop.transform.localScale = vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)

	elseif self.fx_plitvice_buff_loop ~= nil then
		self.fx_plitvice_buff_loop:Dispose()
		self.fx_plitvice_buff_loop = nil

		local fx_plitvice_buff_end = self.get_fx_plitvice_buff_end():Instantiate(player.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform.position,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, player.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
		fx_plitvice_buff_end.transform.localScale = vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
	end
end

function local_class:deactivate_shear()
	self.shear_field_obj = get_field_object('shear')

	if self.shear_field_obj ~= nil then
		self.previous_shear = self.shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear
		self.shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0
	end

end

function local_class:activate_shear()
	self.shear_field_obj = get_field_object('shear')

	if self.shear_field_obj ~= nil then
		self.shear_field_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = self.previous_shear
	end
end

function local_class:update_tutorial_jump(fo, start_pos, height, time_passed, duration)
	local progress = time_passed / duration

	local cur_y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height
	local cur_pos = vector(start_pos.x, cur_y, start_pos.z)

	character_util.set_position(fo, cur_pos, true)
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class();
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('BeachSurvivalController')

function local_class:init()
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'BeachSurvival'

	self.origin_pos = vector(48.5, 1, -16.0)
	self.center_pos = self.origin_pos + vector(4.5, 0, 4.5)

	self.cardinals = {
		up = 'north',
		down = 'south',
		left = 'west',
		right = 'east',
		north = 'up',
		south = 'down',
		west = 'left',
		east = 'right',
	}

	self.throwers = {
		up = {},
		down = {},
		left = {},
		right = {},
	}
	self.attack_ranges = {}

	self.get_water_ball_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_waterball_explosion') end
	self.get_water_splash_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_wateballoon_explosion') end
	self.get_water_explosion_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_waterbomb_explosion') end

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	-- 추후 다른 입장 케이스가 필요한 경우 처리용
	self.constants_data_key = 'default'

	self.constants_data = nil

	self.throw_speed = 7

	self.game_data = {}

	self.game_state = {
		none = 0,
		loading = 1,
		loaded = 2,
		starting = 3,
		prologue = 4,
		in_game = 5,
		epilogue = 6,
		in_success = 7,
		in_fail = 8,
		between_phase = 9,

		game_off = 99,
		disposed = 100,
	}
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.none

	self.pattern_type = {
		explode = 1,
		throw = 2,
	}

	self.pattern_state = {
		none = 1,
		pre = 2,
		on_going = 3,
		imminent = 4,
		done = 5
	}

	self.phase_pattern_data = {}
	self.running_pattern_data = {}

	self.vfo_pool = {}
	self.using_vfo = {}

	-- 미니게임이 진행중인지
	self.is_playing = false

	-- 페이즈에 할당 된 패턴이 진행중인지
	self.in_phase = false

	-- 로드된 현재 페이즈의 패턴 정보
	self.current_phase_data = {}

	-- 현재 진행중인 페이즈
	self.current_phase = 0

	-- 각 페이즈의 경과 시간
	self.elapsed_time = 0.0

	self.on_phase_cleared_callback = nil
	self.on_minigame_cleared_callback = nil
	self.on_minigame_failed_callback = nil

	self.bomb_generate_sfx = nil
	self.bomb_alert_sfx = nil
	self.bomb_explode_sfx = nil
	self.ball_throw_sfx = nil
	self.ball_explode_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.loading

	self.constants_data_key = key

	self.constants_data = require(
			'minigame/BeachSurvival/BeachSurvivalConstants')[self.constants_data_key]
	self.phase_count = #self.constants_data.phase_data
	self.throw_speed = self.constants_data.throw_speed

	self.origin_pos = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.origin_marker_name).position
	self.center_pos = self.origin_pos + vector(4.5, 0, 4.5)

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)

	for dir, t in pairs(self.throwers) do
		local face = direction_util.get_opposite(character_util.get_direction(dir))
		local side = self.cardinals[dir]

		for i = 1, 6 do
			local npc = get_character('beach_survival_' .. side .. '_' .. i)
			table.insert(self.throwers[dir], npc)
			character_util.set_direction(npc, face)

			local pos = self.center_pos
					+ direction_util.to_vector3(dir) * 5.5
					+ direction_util.to_vector3(self:direction_rotate_cw(dir)) * (i * 2 - 6.5)
			character_util.set_position(npc, pos)
		end
	end

	self.get_water_ball_effect()
	self.get_water_splash_effect()
	self.get_water_explosion_effect()

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.loaded

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:game_start()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent.Create(self.game_name))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_routine, self))
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	self:reset_player_state()

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_game

	self.is_playing = true
	self.in_phase = false
	self.current_phase = 0
	self.running_pattern_data = {}
	self.current_phase_data = {}

	while self.is_playing do
		-- 현재 패턴이 진행중인 경우
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.elapsed_time = self.elapsed_time + dt
		if self.in_phase then
			-- done 상태가 된 패턴 일괄 제거
			local is_dirty = true
			while is_dirty do
				is_dirty = false
				for i, data in ipairs(self.running_pattern_data) do
					-- state가 done인 패턴은 이미 dispose까지 끝난 상태여야 함.
					if data.state == self.pattern_state.done then
						table.remove(self.running_pattern_data, i)
						is_dirty = true
						break
					end
				end
			end

			-- 현재 진행중인 패턴 목록
			for i, data in ipairs(self.running_pattern_data) do
				data.progress = data.progress + dt
				if data.state < self.pattern_state.done then
					if data.type == self.pattern_type.throw then
						self:throw_pattern_execute(data)
					elseif data.type == self.pattern_type.explode then
						self:explode_pattern_execute(data)
					end
				end
			end

			self.bomb_generate_sfx = nil
			self.bomb_alert_sfx = nil
			self.bomb_explode_sfx = nil
			self.ball_throw_sfx = nil
			self.ball_explode_sfx = nil

			if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_fail then
				--실패시
				if #self.running_pattern_data == 0 and self.elapsed_time > 3 then
					self.is_playing = false
					self.in_phase = false

					--TODO: 실패 이후 장면이 들어가야 함.
					self:end_minigame(false)
				end

			elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_game then

				if #self.current_phase_data == 0 then
					if #self.running_pattern_data == 0 then
						self.current_game_state = self.game_state.between_phase

						self.in_phase = false
						wait_for_sec(0.3)
						self:on_phase_cleared(self.current_phase)
					end
				elseif self.current_phase_data[1].time_stamp < self.elapsed_time then
					local dataset = table.remove(self.current_phase_data, 1)
					--TODO: 루프 패턴을 정류해줘야 함.
					if dataset.loop ~= nil and dataset.loop then
						local time_token = dataset.interval
						while time_token <= dataset.duration do
							local gen_data = {
								time_stamp = dataset.time_stamp + time_token,
								data = {}
							}
							for _, pattern in ipairs(dataset.data) do
								table.insert(gen_data.data, pattern)
							end
							table.insert(self.current_phase_data, 1, gen_data)
							time_token = time_token + dataset.interval
						end
						self:sort_phase_pattern_data()
					end

					for _, pattern in ipairs(dataset.data) do
						self:pattern_initiate(pattern)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			-- TODO: 페이즈가 끝나고 넘어가는 중인 연출

			if #self.current_phase_data == 0 then
				self.current_phase = self.current_phase + 1

				if self.current_phase > self.phase_count then
					--TODO: 미니게임 올 클리어시 처리
					self.is_playing = false
					self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_success

					self:end_minigame(true)
				else
					-- 다음 페이즈 로드
					self.current_phase_data = self:load_phase_data(self.current_phase)
					self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_game

					self:resume_pattern()
				end
			end
			self.elapsed_time = 0

		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

end

function local_class:reset_player_state()
	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.align_party(self.center_pos + vector(-1.6, 0, 0), 'right', 0, 'linear')
	party_util.set_direction('up')
end

function local_class:end_minigame(is_cleared)
	if is_cleared then

		if self.on_minigame_cleared_callback ~= nil then
			self.on_minigame_cleared_callback()
		end

	else

		if self.on_minigame_failed_callback ~= nil then
			self.on_minigame_failed_callback()
		end

	end

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_cleared))
end

function local_class:on_phase_cleared(phase)
	if self.on_phase_cleared_callback ~= nil then
		self.on_phase_cleared_callback(phase)
	end
end

function local_class:resume_pattern()
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_game
	self.in_phase = true
end

function local_class:load_phase_data(idx)
	local phase_data = {}

	end
	print('phase ' .. idx .. ' loaded : ' .. #phase_data .. ' patterns' )
	return phase_data

function local_class:sort_phase_pattern_data()

end

function local_class:elastic_scale(progress)
	local v = math.sin(progress * math.pi * 2) * (1 - progress) * 0.12
	return vector(1 + v,1,1 - v * 0.7)
end

function local_class:explode_pattern_execute(data)
	if data.state == self.pattern_state.none then
		data.state = self.pattern_state.pre
		local balloon_id = 20708 + random_util.get_random_int(0, 1) * 2
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({itemid = balloon_id, pos = data.start_pos,
											notforinven = true, sprscale = 1,
											lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
		data.relate = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		drop_item_util.move_item(item, data.destination, {duration = 1, interpolation = interpolations_constants.ease_in_sine})
		data.item = item
		data.item.ShadowTransform.position = data.destination + vector(0, 0.03, 0)

		if self.bomb_generate_sfx == nil then
			self.bomb_generate_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_fat_gnome_03', loop = false})
		end
	elseif data.state == self.pattern_state.pre then
		if data.progress > 1 then
			data.progress = 0
			data.state = self.pattern_state.on_going
			--TODO: 착지시 작업

		end
	elseif data.state == self.pattern_state.on_going then
		data.state = self.pattern_state.imminent
		--TODO: 아이템 교체되어야 함.
		data.progress = 0

		if self.bomb_alert_sfx == nil then
			self.bomb_alert_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_bombard_range_01', loop = false})
		end
	elseif data.state == self.pattern_state.imminent then
		if data.progress < 1 then
			--TODO: 터지기 직전 연출
			local twopithird = math.pi * 2 / 3
			local shake = (data.progress%0.1 * 360) + twopithird + random_util.get_random_value() * twopithird
			while shake > 360 do
				shake = shake - 360
			end
			data.item.Position = data.destination + vector(math.cos(shake), 0, math.sin(shake))
					* ((data.progress < 0.5) and 0 or data.progress * 0.05)

			local tint = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.cos(6 * math.pi * (data.progress) * (data.progress + 1))

			local sprite = data.relate
			sprite.TintColor = unity_color({1, tint, tint, 1})
			sprite:Rebuild()
		else
			data.state = self.pattern_state.done
			--TODO: 물풍선 터지는 연출

			data.item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
			data.item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

			data.item:ConsumeComplete()
			--TODO: 해당 패턴 정보 Dispose 해줘야 함.
			local is_hit = false
			-- 가로방향 체크
			local h_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(data.destination, vector(5, 2, 0.6))
			local h_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(h_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

			for i = 0, h_list.Count - 1 do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(h_list[i], user_party.Leader) then
					is_hit = true
					break
				end
			end

			--세로방향 체크
			local v_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(data.destination, vector(0.6, 2, 5))
			local v_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(v_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

			for i = 0, v_list.Count - 1 do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(v_list[i], user_party.Leader) then
					is_hit = true
					break
				end
			end

			h_list:Dispose()
			v_list:Dispose()

			if is_hit then
				--TODO: 피격시 연출
				field_ui_manager:Hide()
				party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

				if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.in_fail then
					self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_fail

					for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
						local member = user_party[i]

						music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted'})
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_water_01')
						character_util.set_side_direction(member)
						character_util.set_emotion(member, {name = 'confused'})
						scene_util.set_dead_anim(member)
						character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(member)
						character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(member)
					end
					self.elapsed_time = 0
				end

			end

			self.get_water_explosion_effect():Instantiate(data.destination + vector(0, 0.03, 0))

			if self.bomb_explode_sfx == nil then
				self.bomb_explode_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '02_stomp_water_01', loop = false})
			end

		end
	end
end

function local_class:throw_pattern_execute(data)
	if data.state == self.pattern_state.none then
		data.state = self.pattern_state.pre
		local dir = direction_util.to_str(data.relate.Direction)
		local balloon_id = 20697 + random_util.get_random_int(0, 1)
		local item = drop_item_util.create_item({itemid = balloon_id, pos = data.start_pos + vector(0, 0.4, 0),
		                                         notforinven = true, sprscale = 0.1,
		                                         lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = (dir ~= 'up')})
		local thrower = data.relate
		character_util.set_anim(thrower, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
		data.item = item
		drop_item_util.move_item(item, data.start_pos + vector(0, 0.4, 0), {
			duration = 0.4, y_move = function(progress)
				data.item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				data.item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				if progress > 0.75 then
					item:Stop()
				end
				end,
			callback = function()
				character_util.set_anim(thrower, {name = 'get'})
				drop_item_util.move_item(item, data.start_pos + vector(0, 1, 0), {duration = 0.3})
			end
		})

		--TODO: 던지려 하는 연출
	elseif data.state == self.pattern_state.pre then
		if data.progress > 1 then
			data.state = self.pattern_state.on_going
			--TODO: 던지는 연출
			local thrower = data.relate
			character_util.remove_anim(thrower)
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(thrower, {name = 'bomb_attack', count = 1})

			data.relate = self:get_vfo()
			data.item.SpriteTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 1, -1)
			data.item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
			data.item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

			data.progress = 0.1

			if self.ball_throw_sfx == nil then
				self.ball_throw_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_snowball_throw_01', loop = false})
			end
		end

	elseif data.state == self.pattern_state.on_going then
		local vec = (data.destination - data.start_pos).normalized

		if (data.destination - data.relate.Position).magnitude < 0.6 then
			data.state = self.pattern_state.imminent
			--TODO: 목적지 도착시 연출
			self.get_water_splash_effect():Instantiate(data.relate.Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0))

			if self.ball_explode_sfx == nil then
				self.ball_explode_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_water_splash_02', loop = false})
			end

			data.progress = 0
			return
		end

		local is_hit = false
		local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(data.relate.Position, vector(0.6, 2, 0.6))
		local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		for i = 0, list.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(list[i], user_party.Leader) then
				data.state = self.pattern_state.imminent
				is_hit = true
				break
			end
		end

		list:Dispose()

		if is_hit then
			--TODO: 피격시 연출
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			self.get_water_splash_effect():Instantiate(data.relate.Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0))

			if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.in_fail then
				self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_fail
				for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
					local member = user_party[i]

					music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted'})
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_water_01')

					character_util.set_side_direction(member)
					character_util.set_emotion(member, {name = 'confused'})
					scene_util.set_dead_anim(member)
					character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(member)
					character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(member)
				end
				self.elapsed_time = 0
			end

			data.progress = 0
		else
			data.relate.Position = data.start_pos + vec * (data.progress * self.throw_speed)
			data.item.Position = data.relate.Position
			data.item.SpriteTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 1, -1)

			local angle = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, data.progress * 360, 0)
			data.item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = angle
		end
	elseif data.state == self.pattern_state.imminent then
		data.state = self.pattern_state.done


		--TODO: 해당 패턴 정보 Dispose 해줘야 함.
		self:return_vfo(data.relate)
		data.relate = nil

		data.item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		data.item:ConsumeComplete()
		data.item = nil
	end
end

--region pools
function local_class:get_vfo()
	local vfo
	if #self.vfo_pool > 0 then
		vfo = table.remove(self.vfo_pool)
	else
		vfo = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		vfo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		vfo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.6, 2, 0.6))
		vfo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.InField
		message_system:Send(vfo, CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(vfo))
	end

	table.insert(self.using_vfo, vfo)
	return vfo
end

function local_class:return_vfo(target)
	for i, v in ipairs(self.using_vfo) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v, target) then
			local vfo = table.remove(self.using_vfo, i)
			vfo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			table.insert(self.vfo_pool, vfo)
			break
		end
	end
end

-- 모든 vfo들이 사용중이지 않은 상태여야 한다.
function local_class:dispose_all_vfo()
	for i = 1, #self.using_vfo do
		local vfo = table.remove(self.using_vfo)
		vfo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		table.insert(self.vfo_pool, vfo)
	end
	self.using_vfo = {}

	for _, v in ipairs(self.vfo_pool) do
		v:Dispose()
	end
	self.vfo_pool = {}
end

function local_class:pattern_initiate(pattern_string)
	local ps = pattern_string
	local type = 0
	if type_util.is_string(ps) then
		--TODO: 패턴 파싱을 좀더 명시적으로?
		type = #ps - 1
	end
	--print(self.elapsed_time , '[pattern type] : ', type)
	--print(self.elapsed_time , '[pattern data] : ', ps)

	local data = {
		type = type,
		state = self.pattern_state.none,
		item = nil,
		start_pos = vector(0, 0, 0),
		destination = vector(0, 0, 0),
		progress = 0,
		relate = nil
	}

	-- 정상적으로 패턴 데이터가 분류되었을 때
	if type > 0 then
		if type == self.pattern_type.throw then
			-- 물투척 패턴
			local dir
			local idx
			local diag
			for x, y, z in string.gmatch(ps, '(%u+)(%d+)(%u+)') do
				dir = x
				idx = tonumber(y)
				diag = z
			end
			if dir == 'N' or dir == 'U' then
				dir = 'up'
			elseif dir == 'S' or dir == 'D' then
				dir = 'down'
				idx = 7 - idx
			elseif dir == 'W' or dir == 'L' then
				dir = 'left'
				idx = 7 - idx
			elseif dir == 'E' or dir == 'R' then
				dir = 'right'
			end

			local thrower = self.throwers[dir][idx]
			data.relate = thrower
			data.start_pos = thrower.Position

			local diff = data.start_pos - (self.origin_pos + vector(-2, 0, -2))
			local pos

			if diag == 'L' then
				pos = self:direction_diagonal({diff.x, diff.z}, dir, 1)
			elseif diag == 'R' then
				pos = self:direction_diagonal({diff.x, diff.z}, dir, -1)
			end
			data.destination = self.origin_pos + vector(pos[1] - 1, 0, pos[2] - 1)

			table.insert(self.running_pattern_data, data)
		elseif type == self.pattern_type.explode then
			-- 물폭탄 패턴
			for x, y in string.gmatch(ps, '(%d+)(%d+)') do
				x = tonumber(x)
				y = tonumber(y)
				data.destination = self.origin_pos + vector(x, 0, y)
			end
			data.start_pos = data.destination + vector(0, 6, 0)

			table.insert(self.running_pattern_data, data)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:direction_rotate_cw(dir, count)
	local end_dir = dir
	count = lua_helper.get_or_default(count, 1)

	while count < 0 do
		count = count + 4
	end

	for _ = 1, count do
		if end_dir == 'up' then
			end_dir = 'right'
		elseif end_dir == 'right' then
			end_dir = 'down'
		elseif end_dir == 'down' then
			end_dir = 'left'
		elseif end_dir == 'left' then
			end_dir = 'up'
		end
	end

	return end_dir
end

-- 중앙(0, 0) 기준으로 처리
function local_class:direction_diagonal(pos, face, count)
	local end_dir = self:direction_rotate_cw(face, count)
	local end_pos = self:rotate_pos(12, pos, count)
	if direction_util.is_side(character_util.get_direction(end_dir)) then
		return self:mirror_x_pos(12, end_pos)
	else
		return self:mirror_y_pos(12, end_pos)
	end
end

--region position_utils

--- 주어진 좌표를 시계방향으로 회전시킨다.
--- @param scale number 한 변의 길이(칸)
--- @param pos table 변환할 좌표 (x, y)
--- @param count number 시계 방향으로 회전 시킬 횟수
function local_class:rotate_pos(scale, pos, count)
	count = lua_helper.get_or_default(count, 1)
	while count < 0 do
		count = count + 4
	end
	local new_pos = pos
	for i = 1, count do
		new_pos = {scale + 1 - new_pos[2], new_pos[1]}
	end
	return new_pos
end

--- 주어진 좌표 집단을 시계방향으로 회전시킨다.
--- @param scale number 한 변의 길이(칸)
--- @param set table 변환할 패턴 테이블

	return new_set

function local_class:mirror_x_pos(x_scale, pos)

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	self.front_dir = self:convert_table_to_vector3(self.constants_data.game.front)

	--for i = 1, 3 do
	--	if self.front_dir[i] ~= 0 then
