	--		break
	--	end
	--end

	self.right_dir = self:convert_table_to_vector3(self.constants_data.game.right)
	self.game_center_pos = self:convert_table_to_vector3(self.constants_data.game.center_pos)

	self.purple_coin_name = self.constants_data.game.purple_coin_name
	self.star_piece_name = self.constants_data.game.star_piece_name

	self.lane_count = #self.constants_data.game.lane_horizontal_centers

	self.max_vision_range = self.constants_data.game.max_vision_range
	self.gimmick_approach_gap = self.constants_data.game.gimmick_approach_gap
	self.default_speed = self.constants_data.game.default_speed
	self.game_animations = self.constants_data.game.animations
	self.max_hp = self.constants_data.game.max_hp
	self.need_prologue_checker = self[self.constants_data.game.need_prologue_checker]
	self.need_epilogue_checker = self[self.constants_data.game.need_epilogue_checker]

	--region UI

	local ui_path = self.constants_data.asset.ui

	-- 화살표 UI 로드
	self.right_arrow_button = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.resholder,
			ui_path.right_arrow.path, ui_path.right_arrow.name)
	self.right_arrow_button:SetActive(false)

	self.left_arrow_button = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.resholder,
			ui_path.left_arrow.path, ui_path.left_arrow.name)
	self.left_arrow_button:SetActive(false)

	self.right_arrow_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
	self.right_arrow_handler.buttonCollider = self.right_arrow_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))

	self.left_arrow_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
	self.left_arrow_handler.buttonCollider = self.left_arrow_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))

	local right_arrow_tf = self:get_transform(self.right_arrow_button)
	local left_arrow_tf = self:get_transform(self.left_arrow_button)

	local aspect = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.safeArea.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height
	local target_size = vector(CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight * aspect, CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight)
	local half_size = target_size / 2.0
	local center_offset = vector(300, 114)

	local left_button_pos = vector(-half_size.x + center_offset.x, -half_size.y + center_offset.y, 0)
	local right_button_pos = vector(half_size.x - center_offset.x, -half_size.y + center_offset.y, 0)

	if game_string.IsRTL then
		-- 위치 스왑
		local temp = left_button_pos
		left_button_pos = right_button_pos
		right_button_pos = temp

		local temp_rot = left_arrow_tf.localRotation
		left_arrow_tf.localRotation = right_arrow_tf.localRotation
		right_arrow_tf.localRotation = temp_rot
	end

	right_arrow_tf.localPosition = right_button_pos
	left_arrow_tf.localPosition = left_button_pos

	self.right_arrow_handler.OnButtonDown = function()
		if self:is_control_disabled() then
			return
		end

		self.current_input_state = self.input_state.move_right

		self.is_debug_input = false
	end

	self.left_arrow_handler.OnButtonDown = function()
		if self:is_control_disabled() then
			return
		end

		self.current_input_state = self.input_state.move_left

		self.is_debug_input = false
	end

	self.right_arrow_handler.OnButtonUp = function()
		if self:is_control_disabled() then
			return
		end

		self.current_input_state = self.input_state.none

		self.is_debug_input = true
	end

	self.left_arrow_handler.OnButtonUp = function()
		if self:is_control_disabled() then
			return
		end

		self.current_input_state = self.input_state.none

		self.is_debug_input = true
	end

	-- 체력 UI 로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.resholder, ui_path.hp.path, ui_path.hp.name, function(prefab)
				self.hp_ui_object = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.hp_ui_object:SetActive(false)
			end)

	local icon_parent = self:get_transform(self.hp_ui_object):Find('Content/sprites')

	for i = 1, icon_parent.childCount do
		local icon_go = icon_parent:Find('icon_' .. i).gameObject

		if i > self.max_hp then
			icon_go:SetActive(false)
		else
			icon_go:SetActive(true)
			table.insert(self.hp_ui_icons, icon_go)
		end
	end

	--endregion

	--region 카메라
	local cam_path = self.constants_data.asset.camera
	self.camera_holder = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.resholder, cam_path.path, cam_path.name)
	local cam_holder_tf = self:get_transform(self.camera_holder)
	cam_holder_tf.position = self.game_center_pos
	self.main_camera_transform = cam_holder_tf:Find('Camera Pivot/Camera')
	self.main_camera = self.main_camera_transform.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))

	local corner_cam_tf = cam_holder_tf:Find('Camera_corner')
	self.corner_camera_object = corner_cam_tf.gameObject

	--endregion

	--region 바이크

	local bike_path = self.constants_data.asset.bike
	self.bike_object = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.resholder, bike_path.path, bike_path.name)
	-- Transform들을 하나의 딕셔너리에 캐싱해두더라도 얘는 자주 쓸 것 같아서 따로 추가
	self.bike_transform = self:get_transform(self.bike_object)
	self.bike_mesh_transform = self.bike_transform:Find('mesh')

	local optimize_target_npcs = {}
	for npc_name, spec_name in pairs(self.constants_data.asset.occupant) do
		if type_util.is_table(spec_name) then
			if user_util.has_knight_male() then
				optimize_target_npcs[npc_name] = spec_name.male
			else
				optimize_target_npcs[npc_name] = spec_name.female
			end
		else
			optimize_target_npcs[npc_name] = spec_name
		end
	end

	self.optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(optimize_target_npcs)

	for npc_name, tabled_local_pos in pairs(self.constants_data.bike.occupants_local_pos) do
		local npc = self.optimized_npcs[npc_name]
		npc.Transform:SetParent(self.bike_mesh_transform)
		npc.Transform.localPosition = self:convert_table_to_vector3(tabled_local_pos)
		npc.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'idle' })
		character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, nil, self.constants_data.bike.occupant_scale)
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		character_util.hide_weapon(npc, true)
	end

	--endregion

	--region 도로
	local road_asset = self.constants_data.asset.road

	self.road_pool_object = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.resholder, road_asset.path, road_asset.name)
	local road_pool_tf = self:get_transform(self.road_pool_object)
	-- 풀링된 도로들의 부모 오브젝트 위치를 맞춰줘야 도로 애니메이션이 정상동작함
	road_pool_tf.position = self.game_center_pos

	-- 일단 모든 오브젝트 꺼줌
	for i = 0, road_pool_tf.childCount - 1 do
		road_pool_tf:GetChild(i).gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	for road_type, info in pairs(self.constants_data.road.type) do
		local road_tf = road_pool_tf:Find(info.go_name)
		local road_object = road_tf.gameObject

		self.road_dict[road_type] = { road_object }

		-- 이미 한 개는 로드되어있고, 그걸 복사
		for load_count = 1, road_asset.pool_count - 1 do
			table.insert(self.road_dict[road_type], CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(road_object, road_pool_tf))
		end

		for i = 1, #self.road_dict[road_type] do
			local cur_road_object = self.road_dict[road_type][i]
			local road_animator = self:get_animator(cur_road_object)

			road_animator.enabled = false
			cur_road_object:SetActive(false)

			self:cache_origin_parent(self:get_transform(cur_road_object))
		end
	end

	--endregion

	--region 쉐이더 관련

	self.bike_renderer = self.bike_transform:Find('mesh').gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))

	get_field_object('stage_light_controller').ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	local shader_asset = self.constants_data.asset.shader
	self.shader_container = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.resholder, shader_asset.path, shader_asset.name)

	-- Spine이 카메라를 바라보고 있지 않는 현상 수정
	local no_bend_shader = self.shader_container:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShaderContainer)).ShaderList[0]

	for _, npc in pairs(self.optimized_npcs) do
		-- 어차피 게임 끝나면 파괴되므로 굳이 캐싱 안해도 될 듯
		npc.SpineController.CustomShader = no_bend_shader
	end

	--endregion

	self.qte_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/BikeTempleRun/BikeTempleRunQTEManager')
	self.qte_manager:init_manager(self)

	self.bike_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/BikeTempleRun/BikeTempleRunBikeManager')
	self.bike_manager:init_manager(self)

	self.road_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/BikeTempleRun/BikeTempleRunRoadManager')
	self.road_manager:init_manager(self)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	for name, preset_name in pairs(self.constants_data.effect_preset) do
		self.effect_presets[name] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(preset_name)
	end

	yield_return_func(unity_object_pool.WaitAll, unity_object_pool)

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.loaded

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent))

	stage_camera.Camera.enabled = true

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

	get_field_object('stage_light_controller').ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	self:stop_bg_loop_sfx(0)

	self.qte_manager = nil

	self.bike_manager = nil

	self.road_manager = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.road_pool_object) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.road_pool_object)
	end
	self.road_pool_object = nil
	self.road_dict = nil

	-- dispose가 두 번 불리는 경우가 있어서 nil 체크

	self.origin_parent_cache = nil
	self.animator_cache = nil
	self.animating_animators = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.camera_holder) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.camera_holder)
	end
	self.camera_holder = nil
	self.main_camera_transform = nil
	self.main_camera = nil
	self.corner_camera_object = nil

	if self.optimized_npcs ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npcs)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.right_arrow_button) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.right_arrow_button)
	end
	self.right_arrow_button = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.left_arrow_button) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.left_arrow_button)
	end
	self.left_arrow_button = nil

	self.optimized_npcs = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.bike_object) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.bike_object)
	end
	self.bike_object = nil
	self.bike_transform = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.shader_container) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.shader_container)
	end
	self.shader_container = nil

	self.transform_cache = nil

	-- 그냥 파괴해서 아예 안남아있게 함
	if not is_unity_null(self.hp_ui_object) then
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.hp_ui_object)
	end
	self.hp_ui_object = nil

	if self.resholder ~= nil then
		self.resholder:Dispose()
	end
	self.resholder = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.disposed
end

--region Event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if self:is_control_disabled() then
		return false
	end

	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadLeftButtonDown
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickLeftButtonDown then

		self.current_input_state = self.input_state.move_left

		self.is_debug_input = false

		return true

	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadRightButtonDown
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickRightButtonDown then

		self.current_input_state = self.input_state.move_right

		self.is_debug_input = false

		return true

	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadRightButtonUp
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickRightButtonUp
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadLeftButtonUp
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickLeftButtonUp then

		self.current_input_state = self.input_state.none

		self.is_debug_input = false

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_start_event(e)
	self.hp_ui_object:SetActive(false)

	self.left_arrow_handler:ForcePressedButtonUp()
	self.right_arrow_handler:ForcePressedButtonUp()
	self.left_arrow_button:SetActive(false)
	self.right_arrow_button:SetActive(false)

	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(e)
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	self.hp_ui_object:SetActive(true)
	self.left_arrow_button:SetActive(true)
	self.right_arrow_button:SetActive(true)

	return false
end

function local_class:on_animation_event(e)
	local sfx_data = self.event_to_sfx_dict[e.EventName]
	if sfx_data ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx(sfx_data)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

function local_class:game_start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start_routine, self))
end

--- QTE 실패 연출
function local_class:qte_fail_scene()
	local error_dt = self.qte_manager.current_state.error_dt
	local failed_road, fail_anim = self.road_manager:set_and_get_qte_road_top()

	self:play_object_anim(failed_road, fail_anim, error_dt)
	self:play_main_camera_anim(self.game_animations.camera_qte_fail, error_dt)
	self:play_object_anim(self.bike_object, self.bike_manager.constants.animations.qte_fail, error_dt)

	local overturn_delay = 35 / 60

	wait_for_sec(overturn_delay)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_03')
	self:stop_bg_loop_sfx(1)

	-- No Bend 셰이더로 변경하면서 뒤집어진 자동차에 스파인이 살짝 보이는 현상 수정
	for _, npc in pairs(self.optimized_npcs) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		npc.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end
	self:main_camera_shake(0.3, 0.4)

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.game_off

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:try_restart_game()
end

--- 체력 고갈 실패 연출
function local_class:damaged_fail_scene()
	self:hide_ui()
	self:request_disable_control(self)

	self:remove_animating(self.bike_object)
	self:set_anim_time_scale(0)

	local move_left_count = 0
	local speed = 3
	local height = 2.5
	local bike_x0z = vector_util.get_x0z(self.bike_transform.position)
	local is_left = self.game_center_pos.x < bike_x0z.x
	local fall_dir = is_left and 'left' or 'right'
	local npc_fall_offsets = self.constants_data.bike.occupants_fall_offset[fall_dir]
	local spin_move_routines = {}

	local spin_move = function(npc, target_pos)
		move_left_count = move_left_count + 1

		local duration = (target_pos - npc.Transform.position).magnitude / speed

		character_util.set_direction(npc, fall_dir)
		character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'prostrate', mix_duration = duration })
		character_util.spine_rotate(npc, is_left and 720 or -720, duration)

		character_util.jump(npc, height,  duration)
		local move_done = false
		wp_util.move_way_points(npc, { waypoints = target_pos, speed = speed, callback = function(wp_index)
			if wp_index == 0 then
				move_done = true
				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(npc)
				character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(npc)
				character_util.spine_rotate(npc, 0, 0)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
			end
		end})

		local target_spine_scale = 1
		local start_spine_scale = self.constants_data.bike.occupant_scale
		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration
			local cur_scale = start_spine_scale * (1 - progress) + target_spine_scale * progress

			character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, nil, cur_scale)

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, nil, target_spine_scale)

		while not move_done do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	for npc_name, npc in pairs(self.optimized_npcs) do
		local offset = self:convert_table_to_vector3(npc_fall_offsets[npc_name])
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
		npc.Transform:SetParent(nil)
		table.insert(spin_move_routines, util.cs_generator(spin_move, npc, bike_x0z + offset))
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_02')
	self:stop_bg_loop_sfx(1)
	wait_all(spin_move_routines)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.game_off

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:try_restart_game()
end

--- 끝까지 도달했을 시
function local_class:game_success_scene()
	self:request_disable_control(self)

	if self:need_epilogue_checker() then
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.epilogue
		self:epilogue_scene()
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	self:stop_bg_loop_sfx(2)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.game_off
	self:game_exit()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.minigame_name, true))
end

function local_class:game_start_routine()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_pause_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent), 'on_animation_event')

	if self:need_prologue_checker() then
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.prologue
	end

	stage_camera.Camera.enabled = true
	coroutine.yield(unity_object_pool.WaitAll())
	coroutine.yield()
	stage_camera.Camera.enabled = false

	self:request_disable_control(self)

	self:get_transform(self.camera_holder).position = self.game_center_pos

	for npc_name, tabled_local_pos in pairs(self.constants_data.bike.occupants_local_pos) do
		local npc = self.optimized_npcs[npc_name]
		npc.Transform:SetParent(self.bike_mesh_transform)
		npc.Transform.localPosition = self:convert_table_to_vector3(tabled_local_pos)
		npc.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'idle' })
		npc.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_car_leaving_01')
	wait_for_sec(2)

	self.qte_manager:reset()
	self.bike_manager:reset()
	self.road_manager:reset()

	self.current_hp = self.max_hp
	self:update_hp_ui()

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 프롤로그 플레이 필요 여부 확인
	if self:in_prologue() then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.prologue_routine, self))
		self:prologue_scene()
	else
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.starting

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.update_routine, self))

		self:play_bg_loop_sfx()
		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	end

	self:set_ui()

	self:request_enable_control(self)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matching_start_01')

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_game
end

function local_class:try_restart_game()
	local cam_holder_tf = self:get_transform(self.camera_holder)

	cam_holder_tf.position = self.game_center_pos * 2

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--나레이션 박스: 처음부터 다시 진행하시겠습니까?
	--선택지: 예(초록색)
	--미니게임 파트 처음부터 재시작
	--선택지: 아니오(붉은색)
	--스테이지 아웃.
	local result = field_ui_util.show_narration_talk_branch_async({
		key = 'ds_bike_temple_run_1'
	}, {
		{ 'ds_bike_temple_run_2', 'mercy' },
		{ 'ds_bike_temple_run_3', 'brutal' },
	})

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:game_exit()

	if result == 1 then
		self:game_start()
	else
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.minigame_name, false))
	end

	self.main_camera.enabled = true
end

function local_class:game_exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent))

	self:reset_object_anim(self.camera_holder)

	self.qte_manager:exit()
	self.bike_manager:exit()
	self.road_manager:exit()

	self:set_anim_time_scale(1)
	self.animating_animators = {}

	self.disable_control_req_count = 0
	self.disable_control_req_hashset = {}

	self.current_input_state = self.input_state.none

	self.is_debug_input = true

	for _, npc in pairs(self.optimized_npcs) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		npc.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, nil, self.constants_data.bike.occupant_scale)
	end

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.loaded
end

function local_class:update_routine()
	while (self.current_game_state == self.game_state.starting or self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_game)
			and not self.road_manager:is_pattern_done() do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		--region 입력 처리

		if (self.use_touch_emulation or CS.Oak.InputManager.IsPC) and self.is_debug_input then
			if not self:is_control_disabled() then
				if CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A) then
					self.current_input_state = self.input_state.move_left
				elseif CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.D) then
					self.current_input_state = self.input_state.move_right
				else
					self.current_input_state = self.input_state.none
				end
			end
		end

		if self.current_input_state == self.input_state.move_left then
			self.bike_manager:execute_move('left')

		elseif self.current_input_state == self.input_state.move_right then
			self.bike_manager:execute_move('right')
		end


		self.left_arrow_handler:Update()
		self.right_arrow_handler:Update()

		--endregion

		-- QTE 확인
		self.qte_manager:update(dt)

		-- 한 프레임정도 멈추는 경우가 생길 것 같아 바로 break해줌
		if self.qte_manager:compare_state('failed') then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.qte_fail_scene, self))
			return
		end

		-- 바이크 조작
		self.bike_manager:update(dt)

		-- 도로 및 슬로우 업데이트
		-- QTE 및 바이크 좌/우회전이 끝난 시점에
		self.road_manager:update(dt)

		--region 충돌 처리

		local check_type = self.crash_check_type.all
		if self.bike_manager.is_immortal then
			check_type = check_type ~ self.crash_check_type.wall
		end

		local current_crash_priority = self.road_manager:execute_check_crash(self.bike_manager.bike_bounds, check_type)

		self.bike_manager:execute_bike_crash(current_crash_priority)

		--endregion

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.road_manager ~= nil and self.road_manager:is_pattern_done() then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_success_scene, self))
		self:epilogue_routine()
	end
end

function local_class:check_crash(bounds)
	return self.road_manager:execute_check_crash(bounds, self.crash_check_type.none)
end

--region 프롤로그 및 에필로그
function local_class:need_prologue_demonshire()
	local main_quest_id = 286
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(main_quest_id)

	return main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.InnerProgress == 22
			and not main_quest.IsComplete and not self.prologue_played
end

function local_class:need_epilogue_demonshire()
	local main_quest_id = 286
	local main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(main_quest_id)

	return main_quest ~= nil and main_quest.InnerProgress == 22 and not main_quest.IsComplete
end

--- 도입부 연출
function local_class:prologue_scene()
	local leader = self.optimized_npcs.knight
	local sohee = self.optimized_npcs.sohee
	local count_daughter = self.optimized_npcs.count_daughter

	--페이드 인 시 길 중앙을 달리는 중, 아직 장애물 등장하지 않음

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--프리실라: 이 오버 스피드라면 금방 피라미드까지 갈 수 있겠어요…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	self:show_speech_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s23_1', skip = true })

	--소히 : 게다가 이 안정감…
	self:show_speech_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s23_2', skip = true })

	--소히: [shout] 5연속 헤어핀 코스도 문제없다고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	self:main_camera_shake(0.15, 0.3)
	self:show_speech_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s23_3', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	--선택지(초록색): 가솔린도 충분해! 간다!!
	choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{ 'ds_main_s23_4', 'mercy' }
	})

	-- TODO : 선택지 후 신나는 유로비트 깔리면서 미니게임 시작

	if not self.is_show_pc_narration then
		self.is_show_pc_narration = true
		field_ui_util.show_pc_control_narration('tip_keyboard_two')
	end

end

function local_class:prologue_routine()
	while self:in_screenplay() do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		-- 바이크 조작
		self.bike_manager:update(dt)

		-- 도로 및 슬로우 업데이트
		self.road_manager:update(dt)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.road_manager:skip_loaded_patterns()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.update_routine, self))
end

function local_class:in_prologue()
	return self.current_game_state == self.game_state.prologue
end

function local_class:epilogue_scene()
	local leader = self.optimized_npcs.knight
	local sohee = self.optimized_npcs.sohee
	local count_daughter = self.optimized_npcs.count_daughter

	local captain = get_character('vampire_captain')

	self:hide_ui()
	self:request_disable_control(self)

	-- 움직임 끝날 때까지 대기
	while self.bike_manager:is_moving() do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--가운데 라인으로 이동된 후 컨트롤 뺏음
	if self.bike_manager.current_lane == 1 then
		self.bike_manager:execute_move('right', {
			duration = 0.7,
		})

		wait_for_sec(0.7)

	elseif self.bike_manager.current_lane == self.lane_count then
		self.bike_manager:execute_move('left', {
			duration = 0.7,
		})

		wait_for_sec(0.7)
	end

	--장애물 더 이상 등장하지 않음
	--배경은 루프 반복
	--소히: 끝이 보이는 거 같은데?
	self:show_speech_async(sohee, { key = 'ds_main_s23_5', skip = true })

	--프리실라: 잠시만요…! 앞에 서있는 저 사람은…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	self:show_speech_async(count_daughter, { key = 'ds_main_s23_6', skip = true })
	--
	--전방에 친위대장 스파인 서있음
	--ds_captain_guard (down, attack, idle)
	character_util.set_active_state(captain, 'enabled')
	captain.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	character_util.set_emotion(captain, { name = 'attack' })

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(captain, 0, 0)

	captain.Position = self.game_center_pos + self.front_dir * (self.max_vision_range / 3 + 2)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(captain, 1, 0.5)

	local captain_move_done = false

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		while not captain_move_done do
			captain.Position = captain.Position - self.front_dir * self.default_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end))
	--self.road_manager:set_screenplay_objects({ captain.UnityGameObject }, self.max_vision_range + 2, self.default_speed)

	--친위대장 : [shout] 프리실라 님! 당신을 잡으라는…!
	--접근 속도를 고려하여 위 말풍선은 텍스트 한번에 출력.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(captain, {
		key = 'ds_main_s23_7', type_speed = 0, scale = 5, bubble_type = 'shout'
	})

	--근접 시
	while captain.Transform.position.z > self.bike_transform.position.z + 8 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(captain)

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.4, 1)

	--슬로우 타임스케일 qte (아래에서 위)출력
	self.qte_manager:execute_qte('up', (8 - 3) / self.default_speed)

	--qte 입력 시, 슬로우 풀리면서 바이크는 그대로 전진하고 친위대장 충돌
	while self.qte_manager:compare_state('screenplay_wait') do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--qte 성공/실패 상관없이 이후 동일한 연출.
	while captain.Transform.position.z > self.bike_transform.position.z + 3 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(captain)

	local target_pos = self.main_camera_transform.position + vector(0, -0.7, -0.3)

	--충돌 시 fx_hit, fx_lasthit,
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')
	self.effect_presets.fx_hit:Instantiate(self.bike_transform.position + vector(0, 0, 1.2))
	self.effect_presets.fx_lasthit:Instantiate(self.bike_transform.position + vector(0, 0, 1.2))

	--카메라 쉐이크(세기 0.2) (시간0.4초), 하단 말풍선 출력하며 친위대장 날아감
	self:main_camera_shake(0.3, 0.4)

	captain_move_done = true
	local captain_talk_done = false

	--친위대장: [shout] 꺅!?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_linda_scream_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	--speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(captain, {
	--	key = 'ds_main_s23_8', type_speed = 0, scale = 6, bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = captain.Position
	--})
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		self:show_speech_async(captain, {
			key = 'ds_main_s23_8', skip = true, type_speed = 0, scale = 1.2,
			bubble_type = 'shout', world_pos = captain.Position + vector(0, -2, 0)
		})
		captain_talk_done = true
	end))

	--친위대장 (right, damaged, damaged) 자세로 에어스핀하며 화면 밖으로 사라짐
	captain.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.set_anim(captain, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(captain, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(captain)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(captain)

	local move_duration = 1

	local start_pos = captain.Position
	local time_passed = 0

	--친위대장 그자리에서 띄워서 에어스핀 시키고 바이크가 자동 전진하며
	character_util.spine_rotate(captain, -45, move_duration)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(captain, 0, move_duration * 2)

	character_util.set_active_shadow(captain, false)

	--친위대장 날아가는 연출 (월드 12-1 초반 안드로이드 날아가는 연출 참조)
	while time_passed < move_duration do
		local progress = time_passed / move_duration
		local linear_pos = start_pos * (1 - progress) + target_pos * progress
		local y_adder = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * 1.5

		captain.Position = linear_pos + vector(0, y_adder, 0)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(captain, 'disabled')

	--music_player_util.play_sfx({
	--	sfx_name = '01_trip_01', delayed_time = 0, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'
	--})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	count_daughter.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	sohee.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down

	while not captain_talk_done do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--위처럼 캐릭터가 화면 밖으로 나가는 것처럼 보이면 별도 연출 수정 없이 그대로 부탁드립니다.

		self.bike_manager:update(dt)

		self.road_manager:update(dt)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	end

--- Constants에는 Lua Util을 못써서 테이블로 저장되어있는 정보를 Vector3로 변환하는 과정이 필요함
function local_class:convert_table_to_vector3(target)
	return vector(target[1], target[2], target[3])
end

function local_class:convert_table_to_rotation(target)
	return unity_class.quaternion.Euler(target[1], target[2], target[3])
end

--- 최적화를 위해 캐싱되어있는 트랜스폼에 접근하도록
function local_class:get_transform(object)
	if self.transform_cache[object] == nil then
		self.transform_cache[object] = object.transform
	end

	return self.transform_cache[object]
end

--- Transform의 현재 부모를 저장
function local_class:cache_origin_parent(transform)
	self.origin_parent_cache[transform] = transform.parent
end

--- Transform의 원래 부모에 자식으로 붙여줌
function local_class:return_to_origin_parent(transform)
	transform:SetParent(self.origin_parent_cache[transform])
end

--- 풀링된 road 오브젝트를 가져옴
function local_class:get_pooled_road(type)
	if self.road_dict == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local road = nil

	for i = 1, #self.road_dict[type] do
		if self.road_dict[type][i].activeSelf == false then
			road = self.road_dict[type][i]
			road:SetActive(true)
			break
		end
	end

	return road
end

--- 풀링된 road 오브젝트 반환
function local_class:dispose_pooled_road(target)
	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	local transform = self:get_transform(target)
	self:return_to_origin_parent(transform)
	transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

	target:SetActive(false)
end

--- Time Scale 조정
function local_class:set_anim_time_scale(target_scale)
	self.move_time_scale = target_scale

	-- 현재 돌고있는 애니메이션들 speed 조절
	for animator, _ in pairs(self.animating_animators) do
		animator.speed = self.move_time_scale
	end
end

function local_class:get_animator(target)
	if self.animator_cache[target] == nil then
		local animator = target:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

		self.animator_cache[target] = animator
		return animator
	end

	return self.animator_cache[target]
end

--- 애니메이션 실행
---@param dt number 오차 시간만큼은 애니메이션을 업데이트해서 최대한 어긋나지 않도록 세팅
function local_class:play_object_anim(target, name, dt)
	local anim = self:get_animator(target)

	anim.enabled = true

	-- 현재 이동속도 타임스케일을 반영함
	anim.speed = self.move_time_scale
	-- 현재 재생 중인 애니메이터 목록 갱신
	self.animating_animators[anim] = true

	anim:Play(name)

	if dt ~= nil and dt > 0 then
		self:force_update_object_anim(target, dt)
	end
end

function local_class:force_update_object_anim(target, dt)
	local anim = self:get_animator(target)

	anim:Update(dt)
end

--- move_time_scale에 영향을 받지 않는 애니메이션 실행
function local_class:play_object_anim_ignore_time_scale(target, name, dt)
	local anim = self:get_animator(target)

	anim:Play(name)

	if dt ~= nil and dt > 0 then
		self:force_update_object_anim(target, dt)
	end
end

--- 애니메이션 초기화
function local_class:reset_object_anim(target)
	local anim = self:get_animator(target)

	anim.enabled = true
	anim:Rebind()
	anim:Update(0)
	anim.enabled = false
end

--- 현재 재생 중인 애니메이터 목록에서 삭제
function local_class:remove_animating(target)
	local anim = self:get_animator(target)

	-- 사라지는 도로의 경우에는 해당 상태를 유지해야하기에 여기서 애니메이션을 Rebind 하지는 않음

	anim.enabled = false
	self.animating_animators[anim] = nil
end

			and a_min.z <= b_max.z and a_max.z >= b_min.z

function local_class:play_main_camera_anim(name, dt)
	self:play_object_anim(self.camera_holder, name, dt)

function local_class:force_update_main_camera_anim(dt)
	self:force_update_object_anim(self.camera_holder, dt)

function local_class:enable_corner_camera()
	self.main_camera.enabled = false
	self.corner_camera_object:SetActive(true)

function local_class:disable_corner_camera()

		occupant.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	end

--- 얘는 루틴에 포함시키면 너무 지저분해져서 몇 번 발동 안하는 거 그냥 코루틴으로 뺌
function local_class:main_camera_shake_routine(magnitude, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local rand_angle = random_util.get_random_value() * math.pi * 2
		local shake_offset = vector(math.cos(rand_angle), math.sin(rand_angle), 0) / 2 * magnitude

		self.main_camera_transform.localPosition = self.main_camera_transform.rotation * shake_offset

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.main_camera_transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
end

function local_class:main_camera_shake(magnitude, duration)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.main_camera_shake_routine, self, magnitude, duration))
end

	local star_piece_name = self.star_piece_name .. id

	return star_piece_util.has_star_piece(star_piece_name)
end

	if self.sfx_blizzard_loop ~= nil or self.sfx_car_loop ~= nil then

	})
	self.sfx_car_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({

	})

	if self.sfx_blizzard_loop ~= nil then

		self.sfx_blizzard_loop = nil
	end

	if self.sfx_car_loop ~= nil then
		self.sfx_car_loop:FadeOut(mix)
		self.sfx_car_loop = nil
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

local local_class = newclass('BikeTempleRunBikeManager')

local moving_state = newclass('BikeTempleRunBikeMovingState')
local damaged_base_state = newclass('BikeTempleRunBikeDamagedBaseState')

local damaged_state = {
	red_purse = newclass('BikeTempleRunBikeDamagedRedPurseState'),
	alpha_purse = newclass('BikeTempleRunBikeDamagedAlphaPurseState'),
}

local turn_base_state = newclass('BikeTempleRunBikeTurnBaseState')
local turn_state = {
	wait = newclass('BikeTempleRunBikeTurnWaitState', turn_base_state),
	action = newclass('BikeTempleRunBikeTurnActionState', turn_base_state),
}

function local_class:init()
	self.controller = nil

	self.move_state_pool = {
		moving = moving_state(self)
	}
	self.current_move_state = nil

	self.damaged_state_pool = {
		red_purse = damaged_state.red_purse(self),
		alpha_purse = damaged_state.alpha_purse(self),
	}
	self.current_damaged_state = nil

	self.constants = nil

	self.current_lane = 2

	-- shake 등의 요소를 제외한 위치값. 충돌 등의 체크에 필요함
	self.bike_position = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.bike_center = unity_class.vector3.zero

	self.bike_bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector3.one)

	self.shake_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity

	self.is_immortal = false
	self.immortal_time_passed = 0

	self.turn_state_pool = {
		wait = turn_state.wait(self),
		action = turn_state.action(self),
	}
	self.current_turn_state = nil

	self.corner_cam_slow_key = 'corner_cam_slow'
	self.corner_cam_base_slow_key = 'corner_cam_base_slow'

	self.lane_check_bounds = {}

	self.bike_renderer = nil
	self.origin_color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 })

	self.occupants = {}
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil

	self.lane_check_bounds = nil
end

function local_class:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	local bike_lane_offsets = {}

	local controller_constants = self.controller.constants_data
	local bike_constants = controller_constants.bike

	for i = 1, self.controller.lane_count do
		table.insert(bike_lane_offsets, bike_constants.front_dist * self.controller.front_dir
				+ controller_constants.game.lane_horizontal_centers[i] * self.controller.right_dir)
	end

	self.constants = {
		lane_offsets = bike_lane_offsets,
		start_lane = bike_constants.start_lane,
		offset = self.controller:convert_table_to_vector3(bike_constants.offset),
		hitbox = {
			size = self.controller:convert_table_to_vector3(bike_constants.hitbox.size),
			center = self.controller:convert_table_to_vector3(bike_constants.hitbox.center),
		},
		damaged = bike_constants.damaged,
		move_duration = bike_constants.move_duration,
		shake = bike_constants.shake,
		immortal_duration = bike_constants.immortal_duration,
		animations = bike_constants.animations,

		purse = {
			count = bike_constants.purse.count,
			alpha_color = unity_color(bike_constants.purse.alpha_color),
			occupant_alpha = bike_constants.purse.occupant_alpha,

			red_color = unity_color(bike_constants.purse.red_color),
			red_duration = bike_constants.purse.red_duration,
		}
	}

	self.bike_object = self.controller.bike_object
	self.bike_transform = self.controller:get_transform(self.bike_object)

	self.world_bike_center = self.controller.game_center_pos + self.constants.offset

	self.shake_rotation = self.controller.main_camera_transform.rotation

	self.bike_bounds.size = self.constants.hitbox.size
	self.bike_bounds.center = self.constants.hitbox.center

	-- 도로 공간 체크용 바운드
	for i = 1, #bike_lane_offsets do
		local center = self.controller.game_center_pos + bike_lane_offsets[i]
				+ self.constants.offset + self.constants.hitbox.center
		local size = self.constants.hitbox.size

		table.insert(self.lane_check_bounds, CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(center, size))
	end

	self.bike_renderer = self.controller.bike_renderer

	self.origin_color = self.bike_renderer.material:GetColor('_Color')

	for _, occupant in pairs(self.controller.optimized_npcs) do
		table.insert(self.occupants, occupant)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:change_move_state(nil)
	self:change_damaged_state(nil)
	self:change_turn_state(nil)
end

function local_class:reset()
	self:change_move_state(nil)
	self:change_damaged_state(nil)
	self:change_turn_state(nil)

	self.current_lane = self.constants.start_lane
	self:set_bike_position(self.lane_check_bounds[self.current_lane].center)

	self:play_bike_anim('idle')

	self.is_immortal = false
end

function local_class:update(dt)
	if self.current_move_state ~= nil then
		self.current_move_state:update(dt)
	end

	if self.current_damaged_state ~= nil then
		self.current_damaged_state:update(dt)
	end

	if self.current_turn_state ~= nil then
		self.current_turn_state:update(dt)
	end
end

--region 좌우 움직임
function local_class:change_move_state(state_name, args)
	if self.current_move_state ~= nil then
		self.current_move_state:exit()
	end

	if state_name == nil then
		self.current_move_state = nil
		return
	end

	self.current_move_state = self.move_state_pool[state_name]

	if args ~= nil then
		for arg, _ in pairs(args) do
			self.current_move_state[arg] = args[arg]
		end
	end

	self.current_move_state:enter()
end

function local_class:execute_move(move_type, override_args)
	-- 이미 움직임 요청이 들어간 경우는 제외
	if self:is_moving() then
		return
	end

	local move_target_lane = self.current_lane + (move_type == 'left' and -1 or 1)

	-- 이동이 불가능한 경우
	if move_target_lane < 1 or move_target_lane > self.controller.lane_count then
		return
	end

	-- 움직일 수 없는 곳인 경우
	if self.controller:check_crash(self.lane_check_bounds[move_target_lane]) >= self.controller.crash_priority.wall then
		return
	end

	local args = {
		type = move_type,
		duration = self.constants.move_duration,
		start_pos = self.bike_transform.position,
		target_pos = self.lane_check_bounds[move_target_lane].center,
		target_lane = move_target_lane
	}

	if override_args ~= nil then
		for arg, _ in pairs(override_args) do
			args[arg] = override_args[arg]
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_car_arriving_03')
	self:change_move_state('moving', args)
end

function local_class:is_moving()
	if self.current_move_state == nil then
		return false
	end

	return moving_state:made(self.current_move_state)
end

function local_class:can_move_left()
	return self.current_lane > 1
end

function local_class:can_move_right()
	return self.current_lane < self.controller.lane_count
end
--endregion 좌우 움직임

--region 셰이크
function local_class:change_damaged_state(state_name, args)
	if self.current_damaged_state ~= nil then
		self.current_damaged_state:exit()
	end

	if state_name == nil then
		self.current_damaged_state = nil
		return
	end

	self.current_damaged_state = self.damaged_state_pool[state_name]

	if args ~= nil then
		for arg, _ in pairs(args) do
			self.current_damaged_state[arg] = args[arg]
		end
	end

	self.current_damaged_state:enter()
end
--endregion 셰이크

--region 좌/우회전

function local_class:change_turn_state(state_name, args)
	if self.current_turn_state ~= nil then
		self.current_turn_state:exit()
	end

	if state_name == nil then
		self.current_turn_state = nil
		return
	end

	self.current_turn_state = self.turn_state_pool[state_name]

	if args ~= nil then
		for arg, _ in pairs(args) do

function local_class:execute_bike_crash(current_crash_priority)
	-- 벽이면
	if current_crash_priority == self.controller.crash_priority.wall then
		if not self.is_immortal then
			-- 슬로우 / Immortal 처리

			-- 내부에서 Immortal 걸어주는 중
			self:change_damaged_state('red_purse', {
				purse_color = self.constants.purse.red_color,
				origin_color = self.origin_color,
				purse_count = 1,
				purse_duration = self.constants.purse.red_duration,

				alpha_purse_color = self.constants.purse.alpha_color,
				alpha_purse_count = self.constants.purse.alpha_count,
				alpha_purse_duration = self.constants.immortal_duration - self.constants.purse.red_duration,
				occupants_purse_alpha = self.constants.purse.occupant_alpha
			})

			self.controller.road_manager:execute_slow_down()

			self.controller:main_camera_shake(0.15, 0.25)

			self.controller:take_damage(1)
		end

		if self:is_moving() and (self.current_move_state ~= nil and self.current_move_state.type == nil) then
			return
		end

		local move_target_lane = nil
		local min_sqr_magnitude = nil

		-- 가까운 다른 위치 서칭
		for i = 1, #self.lane_check_bounds do
			local need_check = true
			local cur_sqr_magnitude = (self.lane_check_bounds[i].center - self.bike_position).sqrMagnitude

			if min_sqr_magnitude ~= nil then
				-- 더 거리가 작은 위치를 찾은 경우에만 바운드 체크 시작
				need_check = cur_sqr_magnitude < min_sqr_magnitude
			end

			if need_check and self.controller:check_crash(self.lane_check_bounds[i])
					< self.controller.crash_priority.wall then
				min_sqr_magnitude = cur_sqr_magnitude
				move_target_lane = i
			end
		end

		-- 못찾은 경우는 그냥 다음 프레임으로 계산 넘겨버림
		if move_target_lane ~= nil then
			-- 같은 스테이트 덮어써버림
			self:change_move_state('moving', {
				duration = self.constants.move_duration,
				start_pos = self.bike_position,
				target_pos = self.lane_check_bounds[move_target_lane].center,
				target_lane = move_target_lane
			})
		end
	end
end

	-- 중복 체크 되는 부분이라, 빼도 무방함
	if not self.controller:has_purple_coin(purple_coin_id) then
		local purple_coin = get_field_object(self.controller.purple_coin_name .. purple_coin_id)

		if purple_coin ~= nil then

			purple_coin.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.bike_bounds.center, self.bike_bounds.max.y)
			purple_coin.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.7
			purple_coin.Transform:Find('shadow').gameObject:SetActive(false)
			-- FIXME : 카메라 각도 따라서 달라져야 함
			purple_coin.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-80, 0, 0)
			purple_coin.Transform:SetParent(self.bike_transform)

	screen_util.qte_swipe(self.type)
end

function qte_state.screenplay_wait:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	time_util.unmod(self.manager.slow_key)

	self.current_input = nil
end

function qte_state.screenplay_wait:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.manager.event_to_qte_type_screenplay[e.TouchEventType] == self.type then
		self.is_input_success = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function qte_state.screenplay_wait:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.is_input_success or self.time_passed >= self.wait_duration then
		self.manager:change_state(nil)
	end
end

--endregion Screenplay Wait State

local local_class = newclass('BikeTempleRunRoadManager')

local road_base_state = newclass('BikeTempleRunRoadBaseState')
local road_state = {
	approach = newclass('BikeTempleRunRoadApproachState', road_base_state),
	animate = newclass('BikeTempleRunRoadAnimateState', road_base_state),
	disappear = newclass('BikeTempleRunRoadDisappearState', road_base_state),
}

local slow_base_state = newclass('BikeTempleRunRoadSlowBaseState')
local slow_state = {
	down = newclass('BikeTempleRunRoadSlowDownState', slow_base_state),
	lowest = newclass('BikeTempleRunRoadSlowLowestState', slow_base_state),
	up = newclass('BikeTempleRunRoadSlowingUpState', slow_base_state),
}

function local_class:init()
	self.controller = nil

	self.anim_time_scale = 1

	-- 미리 로드할 도로의 갯수
	-- 패턴이 끝나기 전까지 항상 로드된 크기는 이만큼을 유지할 것임
	self.road_preload_count = 3

	-- 현재 로드되어있는 도로들 정보. 패턴의 갯수가 많지 않기에 오버플로우는 고려하지 않음
	-- { type, object, state }
	self.road_queue = {}

	-- 현재 제일 앞쪽에 있는 도로의 road_queue 인덱스
	self.start_road_index = 1

	-- 새 도로 정보를 넣을 road_queue 인덱스
	self.next_road_index = self.start_road_index

	-- 마지막으로 QTE가 발동한 도로의 인덱스. default -1
	self.last_qte_activated_index = -1

	-- 튜토리얼 진행 시 인덱스 밀린 것 해결하는 용도
	self.prologue_end_index = 0

	self.road_pattern = {}

	self.road_state_pools = {
		approach = {},
		animate = {},
		disappear = {},
	}

	self.slow_state_pool = {
		down = slow_state.down(self),
		lowest = slow_state.lowest(self),
		up = slow_state.up(self),
	}
	self.current_slow_state = nil

	self.road_constants = {
		common = {},
		road = {},
	}

	self.gimmick_constants = {}

	self.gimmick_state = {
		disabled = 0,
		enabled = 1,
	}

	-- GameObject(기믹) -> { type, extents, state, unique_id }
	self.gimmick_dict = {}

	-- 풀링된 도로 오브젝트에 붙어있는 콜라이더 오브젝트들 전부 캐싱
	self.gimmicks_on_road = {}

	-- GameObject(도로) -> ObjectName -> Object
	self.unique_gimmicks_on_road = {}

	self.objects_on_road = {}

	self.unique_gimmick_types = {}

	self.next_unique_id = {}
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
end

function local_class:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	-- 상수 계산
	for gimmick_type, info in pairs(self.controller.constants_data.gimmick) do
		self.gimmick_constants[gimmick_type] = {
			crash_type = info.crash_type,
			is_unique = info.is_unique,
		}

		if info.is_unique then
			table.insert(self.unique_gimmick_types, gimmick_type)
		end
	end

	local road_constants = self.controller.constants_data.road

	self.road_constants.common = road_constants.common

	for road_type, info in pairs(road_constants.type) do
		-- 해당 타입의 풀링된 도로 오브젝트 아무거나 가져와봄
		local road_object = self.controller:get_pooled_road(road_type)
		local animator = self.controller:get_animator(road_object)
		local anim_length = 0
		local anim_controller = animator.runtimeAnimatorController
		local ac_clips = anim_controller.animationClips
		local qte_end_delay = 0

		-- 모든 클립들을 돌아봄
		for i = 0, ac_clips.Length - 1 do
			if ac_clips[i].name == info.anim_name then
				anim_length = anim_length + ac_clips[i].length
				if info.qte ~= nil then
					qte_end_delay = ac_clips[i].length
				end
			elseif info.qte ~= nil and ac_clips[i].name == info.qte.success_anim_name then
				anim_length = anim_length + ac_clips[i].length
			end
		end

		self.controller:dispose_pooled_road(road_object)

		self.road_constants.road[road_type] = {
			anim_name = info.anim_name,
			anim_length = anim_length,

			-- 시작 오프셋
			start_offset = self.controller:convert_table_to_vector3(info.start_offset),
			next_road_offset = self.controller:convert_table_to_vector3(info.next_road_offset),
			next_road_rotation = self.controller:convert_table_to_rotation(info.next_road_rotation),

			camera_anim_name = info.camera_anim_name,

			unique_counts = {
				-- star_piece = 1 이런 식으로 저장될 것임
			}
		}

		if info.qte ~= nil then
			self.road_constants.road[road_type].qte = {
				type = info.qte.type,
				end_delay = qte_end_delay,
				turn_done_delay = info.qte.turn_done_delay,
				turn_duration = info.qte.turn_done_delay - qte_end_delay,
				success_anim_name = info.qte.success_anim_name,
				fail_anim_name = info.qte.fail_anim_name,
			}
		end

		local road_pool = self.controller.road_dict[road_type]

		local need_count = true

		for i = 1, #road_pool do
			local pooled_road = road_pool[i]
			local pooled_road_tf = self.controller:get_transform(pooled_road)
			local colliders_parent = pooled_road_tf:Find('Colliders')

			self.gimmicks_on_road[pooled_road] = {}

			for j = 0, colliders_parent.childCount - 1 do
				local collider_object = colliders_parent:GetChild(j).gameObject
				local collider = collider_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider))

				local name = collider_object.name
				local type = ''

				for gimmick_type, _ in pairs(self.gimmick_constants) do
					-- 더 많이 맞는 타입명을 따라감. (ex : wall_fire과 wall의 경우 wall_fire을 따라감)
					if string.find(name, gimmick_type) and string.len(gimmick_type) > string.len(type)  then
						type = gimmick_type
					end
				end

				-- 프리팹 변경 대응
				if type ~= nil then
					table.insert(self.gimmicks_on_road[pooled_road], collider_object)

					self.gimmick_dict[collider_object] = {
						type = type,
						crash_type = self.gimmick_constants[type].crash_type,
						extents = collider.size / 2.0,
						state = self.gimmick_state.disabled,
						unique_id = nil,
					}

					collider_object:SetActive(false)

					if self.gimmick_constants[type].is_unique then
						if self.unique_gimmicks_on_road[pooled_road] == nil then
							self.unique_gimmicks_on_road[pooled_road] = {}
						end

						self.unique_gimmicks_on_road[pooled_road][name] = collider_object
					end

					-- 첫 번째 오브젝트만 체크함
					if i == 1 then
						local counts = self.road_constants.road[road_type].unique_counts

						if counts[type] == nil then
							counts[type] = 0
						end

						counts[type] = counts[type] + 1
					end
				end
			end

			--TODO : 각 오브젝트 앞쪽 선 기준으로 정렬
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	for i = self.start_road_index, self.next_road_index - 1 do
		local road = self.road_queue[i]

		--Can't call Animator.Update on inactive object 문제가 있어 일단 활성화하고 Dispose해줌.
		-- FIXME : 같은 로그가 뜨는 곳이 또 있는데 확인 필요
		road.object:SetActive(true)
		self:unload_target_road(road.object)
		self.controller:reset_object_anim(road.object)
		self.controller:dispose_pooled_road(road.object)

		self.road_queue[i] = nil
		self.start_road_index = self.start_road_index + 1
	end

	-- DEBUG CODE : 해제 정상적으로 됐는지 확인하는 용도
	--for index, data in pairs(self.road_queue) do
	--	CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Road Queue is Not Disposed in Index :' .. index)
	--end
end

function local_class:reset()
	self.start_road_index = 1
	self.next_road_index = self.start_road_index
	self.last_qte_activated_index = -1
	self.prologue_end_index = 0

	self.road_pattern = self.controller.constants_data.pattern

	for i = 1, #self.unique_gimmick_types do
		self.next_unique_id[self.unique_gimmick_types[i]] = 1
	end

	for i = 1, self.road_preload_count do
		self:load_next_road()
	end
end

function local_class:update(dt)
	if self.current_slow_state ~= nil then
		self.current_slow_state:update(dt)
	end

	local anim_dt = dt * self.controller.move_time_scale
	local next_qte_type = nil
	local turn_time_left = 0
	local turn_duration = 0
	local qte_activated_index = self.last_qte_activated_index
	local walker = self.start_road_index
	local walk_start_index = walker

	while walker < self.next_road_index do
		local road = self.road_queue[walker]

		local turn_delay, qte_type = road.state:get_turn_delay_and_qte_type()

		if next_qte_type == nil then
			-- QTE 실행이 결정되지 않았을 때에도 딜레이 값 합산
			turn_time_left = turn_time_left + turn_delay

			if qte_type ~= nil then
				next_qte_type = qte_type
				turn_duration = self.road_constants.road[road.type].qte.turn_duration
				qte_activated_index = walker
			end
		end

		road.state:update(anim_dt)

		if self:compare_road_state(walker, nil) then
			local road_object = road.object
			-- 길 오브젝트 비활성화
			self:unload_target_road(road_object)
			self.controller:dispose_pooled_road(road_object)

			self.road_queue[self.start_road_index] = nil
			self.start_road_index = self.start_road_index + 1

			-- 로드된 갯수가 부족한 경우
			if self.next_road_index - self.start_road_index < self.road_preload_count then
				self:load_next_road()
			end
		end

		walker = walker + 1

		-- 만약 너무 많이 지나갔다 싶으면 이미 뭔가 잘못된 것이므로 loop문 탈출
		if walker - walk_start_index > 10 then
			return
		end
	end

	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('QTE Calc [ Next Type : ' .. (next_qte_type or 'nil') .. ' / Turn Time Left : ' .. turn_time_left .. ' ]')

	-- 커브 이동 중인 경우에는 QTE 발동하지 않도록 함
	if next_qte_type ~= nil and self.controller.qte_manager:is_qte_available(turn_time_left)
			and not self.controller.bike_manager:is_turning() then
		self.last_qte_activated_index = qte_activated_index
		self.controller.bike_manager:execute_turn(next_qte_type, turn_time_left, turn_duration)
		self.controller.qte_manager:execute_qte(next_qte_type, turn_time_left, turn_duration)
	end
end

function local_class:change_road_state(road_index, state_name, args)
	local road = self.road_queue[road_index]
	if road == nil then
		return
	end

	if road.state ~= nil then
		if args == nil then
			args = {}
		end

		-- 스테이트끼리 데이터 옮겨줌
		args.object = road.state.object
		args.transform = road.state.transform
		args.queue_index = road.state.queue_index
		args.type_constants = road.state.type_constants

		road.state:exit()
	end

	if state_name == nil then
		road.state = nil
		return
	end

	local pooled_state = nil

	-- FIXME : Stack 방식으로 변경
	for i = 1, #self.road_state_pools[state_name] do
		if self.road_state_pools[state_name][i].using == false then
			pooled_state = self.road_state_pools[state_name][i]
			break
		end
	end

	-- 없으면 새로 생성함. 스테이트의 최대 사용 개수가 3개를 넘어가지 않을 것이기에 Doubling은 하지 않음
	if pooled_state == nil then
		pooled_state = road_state[state_name](self)
		table.insert(self.road_state_pools[state_name], pooled_state)
	end

	road.state = pooled_state

	if args ~= nil then
		for arg, _ in pairs(args) do
			road.state[arg] = args[arg]
		end
	end

	road.state:enter()
end

function local_class:compare_road_state(road_index, state_name)
	local road = self.road_queue[road_index]

	if state_name == nil then
		return road.state == nil
	end

	return road_state[state_name]:made(road.state)
end

function local_class:set_and_get_qte_road_top()
	local top_road_object = nil
	local fail_anim = nil

	for i = self.start_road_index, self.next_road_index - 1 do
		local road = self.road_queue[i]
		local road_type = self.road_queue[i].type
		if top_road_object == nil then
			if (self:compare_road_state(i, 'animate') or self:compare_road_state(i, 'approach'))
					and self.road_constants.road[road_type].qte ~= nil then
				top_road_object = road.object
				fail_anim = self.road_constants.road[road.type].qte.fail_anim_name
			else
				local cur_road_tf = self.controller:get_transform(self.road_queue[i].object)
				local next_road_tf = self.controller:get_transform(self.road_queue[i + 1].object)

				self.controller:return_to_origin_parent(next_road_tf)
				cur_road_tf:SetParent(next_road_tf)
			end
		end

		-- 모든 스테이트 비워줌
		self:change_road_state(i, nil)
	end

	return top_road_object, fail_anim
end

--- 맨 뒤에 붙은 도로는 떼어버리고, 게임 패턴을 시작함
function local_class:skip_loaded_patterns()
	local road = self.road_queue[self.next_road_index - 1]
	local road_object = road.object

	-- 길 오브젝트 비활성화
	self:unload_target_road(road_object)
	self.controller:dispose_pooled_road(road_object)
	self:change_road_state(self.next_road_index - 1, nil)

	self.road_queue[self.next_road_index - 1] = nil
	self.next_road_index = self.next_road_index - 1
	-- 루프 종료용 인덱스도 당겨줌
	self.prologue_end_index = self.prologue_end_index - 1

	self:load_next_road()
end

function local_class:execute_slow_down()
	self:change_slow_state('down', {
		start_time_scale = self.controller.move_time_scale,
		target_time_scale = self.road_constants.common.slow.lowest_time_scale,
		duration = self.road_constants.common.slow.speed_down_duration,
		lowest_duration = self.road_constants.common.slow.speed_lowest_duration,
		up_duration = self.road_constants.common.slow.speed_up_duration,
	})
end

function local_class:change_slow_state(state_name, args)
	if self.current_slow_state ~= nil then
		self.current_slow_state:exit()
	end

	if state_name == nil then
		self.current_slow_state = nil
		return
	end

	self.current_slow_state = self.slow_state_pool[state_name]

	if args ~= nil then
		for arg, _ in pairs(args) do
			self.current_slow_state[arg] = args[arg]
		end
	end

	self.current_slow_state:enter()
end

--- 다음 도로 세팅
function local_class:load_next_road(overriding_type)
	local pattern_index = self.next_road_index - self.prologue_end_index
	local next_pattern = self.road_pattern[pattern_index]

	if next_pattern == nil or self.controller:in_prologue() then
		next_pattern = {
			type = overriding_type or self.road_constants.common.default_type
		}
	end

	local new_road_type = next_pattern.type
	local new_road_object = self.controller:get_pooled_road(new_road_type)
	local new_road_tf = self.controller:get_transform(new_road_object)
	local type_constants = self.road_constants.road[new_road_type]

	-- 큐에 데이터 추가
	self.road_queue[self.next_road_index] = {
		type = new_road_type,
		object = new_road_object,
		state = nil,
	}

	-- 제일 처음 패턴인 경우에는 따로 빼줌
	if (not self.controller:in_prologue() and self.next_road_index == 1)
			or (self.controller:in_prologue() and self.prologue_end_index == 0) then
		new_road_tf.localPosition = type_constants.start_offset

		self:change_road_state(self.next_road_index, 'animate', {
			queue_index = self.next_road_index,
			object = new_road_object,
			transform = new_road_tf,
			type_constants = type_constants
		})
	else
		local prev_road = self.road_queue[self.next_road_index - 1]
		local prev_road_tf = self.controller:get_transform(prev_road.object)
		local prev_road_type = prev_road.type
		local prev_type_constants = self.road_constants.road[prev_road_type]

		-- 애니메이션 초기화
		self.controller:reset_object_anim(new_road_object)

		-- 자식으로 붙여줌
		new_road_tf:SetParent(prev_road_tf)
		new_road_tf.localPosition = prev_type_constants.next_road_offset
				+ prev_type_constants.next_road_rotation * type_constants.start_offset
		new_road_tf.localRotation = prev_type_constants.next_road_rotation

		self:change_road_state(self.next_road_index, 'approach', {
			queue_index = self.next_road_index,
			object = new_road_object,
			transform = new_road_tf,
			type_constants = type_constants
		})
	end

	local gimmick_objects = self.gimmicks_on_road[new_road_object]

	-- 일단 모든 오브젝트들은 활성화해줌
	for i = 1, #gimmick_objects do
		local gimmick = self.gimmick_dict[gimmick_objects[i]]
		gimmick.state = self.gimmick_state.enabled
	end

	for i = 1, #self.unique_gimmick_types do
		local gimmick_type = self.unique_gimmick_types[i]
		local count = type_constants.unique_counts[gimmick_type]
		local pattern_indexes = next_pattern[gimmick_type .. '_indexes']

		-- 현재 패턴에 정보가 있는 경우만 세팅해줌
		if count ~= nil and pattern_indexes ~= nil then
			for object_index = 1, count do
				local object = self.unique_gimmicks_on_road[new_road_object][gimmick_type .. '_' .. object_index]
				local gimmick = self.gimmick_dict[object]

				-- 아직 먹지 않은 경우만 세팅해줌
				if pattern_indexes[object_index] then
					if not self.controller['has_' .. gimmick_type](
							self.controller, self.next_unique_id[gimmick_type]) then

						object:SetActive(true)
						gimmick.unique_id = self.next_unique_id[gimmick_type]

						self.next_unique_id[gimmick_type] = self.next_unique_id[gimmick_type] + 1
					else
						-- 이미 먹은 경우는 비활성화. 먹은 경우에는 Unique ID도 같이 업데이트 시켜 줌
						object:SetActive(false)
						gimmick.state = self.gimmick_state.disabled

						self.next_unique_id[gimmick_type] = self.next_unique_id[gimmick_type] + 1
					end
				else
					-- 패턴 내에 없는 경우도 비활성화
					object:SetActive(false)
					gimmick.state = self.gimmick_state.disabled
				end
			end
		elseif count ~= nil then
			for object_index = 1, count do
				local object = self.unique_gimmicks_on_road[new_road_object][gimmick_type .. '_' .. object_index]
				local gimmick = self.gimmick_dict[object]

				-- 패턴 내에 없는 경우도 비활성화
				object:SetActive(false)
				gimmick.state = self.gimmick_state.disabled
			end
		end
	end

	self.next_road_index = self.next_road_index + 1

	if self.controller:in_prologue() then
		self.prologue_end_index = self.prologue_end_index + 1
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:unload_target_road(road_object)
	local gimmick_objects = self.gimmicks_on_road[road_object]
	for i = 1, #gimmick_objects do
		local gimmick = self.gimmick_dict[gimmick_objects[i]]
		gimmick.state = self.gimmick_state.disabled

		-- Unique Id 갖고있는 애들만 비활성화
		if gimmick.unique_id ~= nil then
			gimmick_objects[i]:SetActive(false)
			gimmick.unique_id = nil
		end
	end
end

--- 모든 패턴 종료되었는지 확인
function local_class:is_pattern_done()
	return self.start_road_index > #self.road_pattern + self.prologue_end_index
end

--- 바이크 바운드를 받아와서 현재 오브젝트와 충돌하는 상태 확인
function local_class:execute_check_crash(target_bounds, check_type)
	-- 현재 충돌 상태 및 우선순위
	local current_crash_priority = self.controller.crash_priority.none

	local wall_interplay = (check_type & self.controller.crash_check_type.wall) ~= self.controller.crash_check_type.none
	local item_interplay = (check_type & self.controller.crash_check_type.item) ~= self.controller.crash_check_type.none

	-- 사실상 파티션 나눠놓은거라, 그냥 두 개 그룹정도만 체크함.
	-- FIXME : 바이크 앞 선보다 먼 오브젝트들은 무시하도록 수정
	for i = self.start_road_index, self.start_road_index + 1 do
		if i >= self.next_road_index then
			break
		end

		local road = self.road_queue[i]
		local gimmicks = self.gimmicks_on_road[road.object]
		local road_tf = self.controller:get_transform(road.object)

		for j = 1, #gimmicks do
			local gimmick_object = gimmicks[j]

			local gimmick_tf = self.controller:get_transform(gimmick_object)
			local gimmick = self.gimmick_dict[gimmick_object]

			-- 그냥 회전 고려하지 않고 계산함
			local gimmick_bounds_min = gimmick_tf.position - gimmick.extents
			local gimmick_bounds_max = gimmick_tf.position + gimmick.extents

			-- 파괴되지 않았고, 충돌한 상태이면
			if gimmick.state == self.gimmick_state.enabled
					and self.controller:check_3d_collide(target_bounds.min, target_bounds.max,
					gimmick_bounds_min, gimmick_bounds_max) then
				local gimmick_crash_priority = self.controller.crash_priority[gimmick.crash_type]

				if current_crash_priority < gimmick_crash_priority then
					current_crash_priority = gimmick_crash_priority
				end

				if wall_interplay and gimmick.crash_type == 'wall' then
					-- wall_fire은 이펙트 나오지 않아야 함
					if gimmick.type == 'wall' then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')

						-- 이펙트 출력. 벽쪽에 파묻히지 않도록 Z 값을 벽 바운드 기준으로 잡음
						local moved_center_pos = target_bounds.center
								- (target_bounds.max.z - gimmick_bounds_min.z) * self.controller.front_dir
						local diff_x0z = vector_util.get_x0z(gimmick_tf.position - moved_center_pos)
						local z_offset = gimmick_bounds_min.z - target_bounds.center.z

						local effect_pos = target_bounds.center + vector_util.get_x0z(
								diff_x0z / diff_x0z.z * z_offset)

						self.controller.effect_presets.fx_wall_hit:Instantiate(effect_pos,
								unity_class.quaternion.identity, road_tf)
					elseif gimmick.type == 'wall_fire' then
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_fire_01')
					end
				end

				if item_interplay then
					-- 커스텀 함수가 있는 경우
					if self.controller.bike_manager['on_crash_' .. gimmick.type] ~= nil then
						gimmick.state = self.gimmick_state.disabled
						gimmick_object:SetActive(false)
						self.controller.bike_manager['on_crash_' .. gimmick.type](
								self.controller.bike_manager, gimmick.unique_id
						)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return current_crash_priority
end

end

--region Down State
function slow_state.down:init(manager)
	self.super:init(manager)

	self.duration = 1
	self.start_time_scale = 1
	self.target_time_scale = 0.5
	self.lowest_duration = 1
	self.up_duration = 1
end

function slow_state.down:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function slow_state.down:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	-- 입력 비활성화
	self.manager.controller:request_disable_control(self.manager)
end

function slow_state.down:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function slow_state.down:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.time_passed < self.duration then
		local progress = self.time_passed / self.duration
		local cur_time_scale = self.start_time_scale * (1 - progress)
				+ self.target_time_scale * progress
		self.manager.controller:set_anim_time_scale(cur_time_scale)
	else
		self.manager.controller:set_anim_time_scale(self.target_time_scale)
		self.manager:change_slow_state('lowest', {
			duration = self.lowest_duration,
			up_duration = self.up_duration,
			cur_time_scale = self.target_time_scale
		})
	end
end

--- 강제 업데이트 실행용 인터페이스. 이런 경우엔 애니메이션도 같이 업데이트 시켜줘야돼서 따로 뺌
function road_base_state:force_update(dt)
end

--- 인터페이스 역할. 남은 QTE 딜레이와 QTE 타입을 반환함

function road_state.approach:get_turn_delay_and_qte_type()
	local turn_delay = self.type_constants.anim_length
	local next_qte_type = nil

	-- 지금 발동 중인 QTE 도로인 경우는 패스
	if self.type_constants.qte ~= nil and self.manager.last_qte_activated_index ~= self.queue_index then
		next_qte_type = self.type_constants.qte.type
		turn_delay = self.type_constants.qte.end_delay
	end

	return turn_delay, next_qte_type
end

function road_state.approach:get_remain_time()
	return self.type_constants.anim_length
end

--region Animate State
function road_state.animate:init(manager)
	self.super:init(manager)

	self.prev_road_tf = nil
	self.anim_error_dt = 0
	self.force_update_dt = 0
	self.success_anim_played = false
end

function road_state.animate:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function road_state.animate:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	if self.prev_road_tf ~= nil then
		self.manager.controller:return_to_origin_parent(self.transform)
		self.prev_road_tf:SetParent(self.transform)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.anim_error_dt

	self.success_anim_played = false

	-- 오차 갱신
	self.manager.controller:play_object_anim(self.object, self.type_constants.anim_name)
	if self.type_constants.camera_anim_name ~= nil then
		self.manager.controller:play_main_camera_anim(self.type_constants.camera_anim_name)
	end

	self:force_update(self.force_update_dt)
end

function road_state.animate:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	self.manager.controller:remove_animating(self.object)

	if self.type_constants.camera_anim_name ~= nil then
		self.manager.controller:remove_main_camera_animating()
	end

	self.prev_road_tf = nil
	self.force_update_dt = 0
end

function road_state.animate:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	-- FIXME : disappear_duration이 현재 애니메이션 length보다 크면 동작하지 않음...
	if self.type_constants.qte ~= nil and self.time_passed >= self.type_constants.qte.end_delay
			and not self.success_anim_played then
		self.success_anim_played = true
		self.manager.controller:play_object_anim(self.object, self.type_constants.qte.success_anim_name,
				self.time_passed - self.type_constants.qte.end_delay)

	elseif self.time_passed >= self.type_constants.anim_length then
		local error_dt = self.time_passed - self.type_constants.anim_length

		self.manager:change_road_state(self.queue_index + 1, 'animate', {
			prev_road_tf = self.transform,
			force_update_dt = error_dt,
		})

		self.manager:change_road_state(self.queue_index, 'disappear', {
			force_update_dt = error_dt,
			duration = self.manager.road_constants.common.disappear_duration
		})
	end
end

function road_state.animate:force_update(dt)
	-- 현재 애니메이션도 같이 업데이트 시켜줘야 함
	self.manager.controller:force_update_object_anim(self.object, dt)

	if self.type_constants.camera_anim_name ~= nil then
		self.manager.controller:force_update_main_camera_anim(dt)
	end

	self:update(dt)
end

function road_state.animate:get_turn_delay_and_qte_type()
	local turn_delay = self.type_constants.anim_length - self.time_passed
	local next_qte_type = nil

	-- 지금 발동 중인 QTE 도로인 경우는 패스
	if self.type_constants.qte ~= nil and self.manager.last_qte_activated_index ~= self.queue_index then
		next_qte_type = self.type_constants.qte.type
		turn_delay = self.type_constants.qte.end_delay - self.time_passed
	end

	return turn_delay, next_qte_type
end

function road_state.animate:get_remain_time()
	return math.max(self.type_constants.anim_length - self.time_passed, 0)
end
--endregion Animate State

--region Disappear State
function road_state.disappear:init(manager)
	self.super:init(manager)

	self.duration = 1
	self.force_update_dt = 0
end

function road_state.disappear:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function road_state.disappear:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	-- 오차 갱신
	self:force_update(self.force_update_dt)
end

function road_state.disappear:exit()
	self.super:exit()
	self.force_update_dt = 0
end

function road_state.disappear:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self.manager:change_road_state(self.queue_index, nil)
	end
end

function road_state.disappear:force_update(dt)
	self:update(dt)
end

function road_state.disappear:get_turn_delay_and_qte_type()
	return self.super:get_turn_delay_and_qte_type()
end

function road_state.disappear:get_remain_time()
	return 0
end

--endregion Disappear State

--endregion Road State

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	start_coroutine(function()
		---- 퀘스트 마커 비활성화
		--CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:Show(false)
		self.players_check_point_count = {
			noel = 0,
			opponent_1 = 0,
			opponent_2 = 0,
		}

		--노엘 위치로 1초에 걸쳐 카메라 포커스 전환된다. async 아님.
		--ignorecameragrids 적용
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.camera_size, 1)
		camera_util.move_async(self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_noel().Position, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true, end_target = self.get_character.sub_bomb_bug_noel() })

		manager_container:execute_manager_func('start_routine', self)

					false,
					pos)

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

-- use_update_frame 반환값이 true일 경우 작동(즉시 작동)
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	local game_state = self.current_game_state

	-- 게임 상태 체크 최적화
	if game_state ~= self.game_state.playing and game_state ~= self.game_state.ending then
		return
	end

	if not self.time_stop then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	end

	manager_container:update_all(dt)

	--게임이 엔딩일 경우 game_end 호출
	if game_state == self.game_state.ending then
		if self:is_clear() then
			--성공
			--아래 함수 호출 시 game_end호출
			--사용 시 주석 제거
			mini_game_util.game_end(self.minigame_name, true)
		else
			--패배
			--아래 함수 호출 시 game_end호출
			--사용 시 주석 제거
			mini_game_util.game_end(self.minigame_name)
		end
	end
end

-- 게임 엔딩 연출
function local_class:game_end(is_success, data)
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.done
	self.current_game_play_state = self.game_play_state.done

	if is_success then
		--성공 엔딩
		start_coroutine(function()
			--1초에 동안 카메라 검은색으로 페이드 아웃
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.minigame_name, true))

			self:reset_mini_game_ui()

			manager_container:execute_manager_func('reset_setting', self)
			manager_container:execute_manager_func('clean', self)
		end)
	else
		start_coroutine(function()
			sp_util.enter_scene()

			local leader = get_party_leader()

			--패배 엔딩
			--다른 플레이어들이 플레이어보다 먼저 도착하였을 시, 하단의 이벤트 진행
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

			--플레이어 컨트롤 강제로 빼앗음.
			--노엘+이브 (left, tired, idle) 스파인 shake (0.03, 0.5)
			scene_util.shake(leader, 0.03, 0.5)

			--「액티비티 실패」문구 출력 (끝날때까지 대기)
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_activity_failed'))

			--액티비티 실패 문구 제거 대기
			wait_for_sec(3)

			--1초에 동안 카메라 검은색으로 페이드 아웃
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear)

			self:reset_mini_game_ui()

			self:set_active_all_flag()

			--패배 엔딩
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.minigame_name, false))

			manager_container:execute_manager_func('reset_setting', self)
			manager_container:execute_manager_func('clean', self)
		end)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:is_clear()
	return self.current_game_state == self.game_state.ending and self.current_game_play_state == self.game_play_state.clear
end

--region event

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
		return
	end
	local check_point_zone_name = 'sub_bomb_bug_racing_game_play_zone_'
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local game_play_state = self.game_play_state

	for idx = game_play_state.first, game_play_state.sixth do
		if self.current_game_play_state == idx and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, check_point_zone_name .. idx) then
			self.current_game_play_state = idx + 1

			start_coroutine(self["check_scene_" .. idx], self)

			return
		end
	end

	-- 펜스 존 및 클리어 존 처리
	if self.current_game_play_state > game_play_state.sixth then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'sub_bomb_bug_racing_game_clear_fence_zone') then
			sp_util.start_scene(self.fence_zone_scene, self)

			return
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, 'sub_bomb_bug_racing_game_play_zone_7') then
			self.current_game_play_state = game_play_state.clear

			start_coroutine(self.clear_scene, self)

			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	--플레이 범위 탈출 시 이벤트
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.playing and
			type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, get_party_leader(), 'sub_bomb_bug_racing_game_play_zone') then
		sp_util.start_scene(self.off_course, self)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:off_course()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local center_pos = self.get_marker_pos.center(1)

	local dist = -2

	self.time_stop = true

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(leader)

	--존 밖으로 나가려고 할 경우
	--플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗는다.
	--플레이어+탑승중인 폭탄벌레 (현재방향, idle, idle) : 코스 이탈이야, 이브.
	scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_mini_game_2')

	--해당 대사 async 아님
	local return_move_pos = leader.Position + (((leader.Position - center_pos).normalized) * dist)

	--플레이어 + 폭탄벌레 0.5초동안 반대 방향으로 2칸 이동. async
	wp_util.move_async(leader, return_move_pos, nil, 0.5, { y_mode = 'flying' })

	self:minigame_switching()
	--중심방향 기준으로, 이탈하는 위치에 따라 중심방향 쪽으로 회귀하게끔 요청드립니다.

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	self.time_stop = false
end

function local_class:fence_zone_scene()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	local move_pos = self.get_marker_pos.s1_center(1) + vector(0, 2.5, 5)

	self.time_stop = true

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(leader)

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--존 밖으로 나가려고 할 경우
				--플레이어 컨트롤 빼앗는다.
				--플레이어+탑승중인 폭탄벌레 (현재방향, idle, idle) : 이브, 반대 방향으로 들어와야 해.
				scene_util.show_portrait_speech_async(leader, 'ss_noel_bomb_bug_racing_s2_mini_game_3')
			end,
			function()
				--플레이어 + 폭탄벌레 0.5초동안 반대 방향으로 2칸 이동. async
				wp_util.move_async(leader, vector_util.get_xy0(leader.Position, move_pos.z), nil, 0.5, { y_mode = 'flying' })
			end
	)

	self:minigame_switching()
	--중심방향 기준으로, 이탈하는 위치에 따라 중심방향 쪽으로 회귀하게끔 요청드립니다.

	--플레이어 컨트롤 풀림.
	self.time_stop = false
end

function local_class:minigame_switching()
	local switch_leader = get_party_leader()

	-- FlyingVehicleController로 변경
	switch_leader.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.FlyingVehicleController()

	-- 좌표 공중으로 띄움
	character_util.set_position(switch_leader, switch_leader.Position, true)

	-- SetControl 호출 (이 시점에 CharacterControllerManualTouchState로 변경해줌)
	switch_leader.FieldObjectController:SetControl(true)

	local current_state = switch_leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState

	-- 스테이트 변경 대기
	while not lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 변경되자마자 DisabledControls 걸음 (isFly 넣기전 대기)
	current_state:RequestDisableControl(switch_leader, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)

	-- 안전하게 3프레임 대기
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- AnalogueAirbourneStartEvent 호출로 isFly 트루로 변경
	message_system:SendSync(switch_leader, CS.Oak.AnalogueAirbourneStartEvent.Instance)

	-- disableControl Remove
	current_state:RemoveDisableControl(switch_leader)
end

function local_class:set_active_all_flag(is_active)
	local flags = {
		self.get_fo.flag(1),
		self.get_fo.flag(2),
		self.get_fo.flag(3),
		self.get_fo.flag(4),
		self.get_fo.flag(5),
		self.get_fo.flag(6),
	}

	local type = active_state_type.disabled

	if is_active then
		type = active_state_type.enabled
	end

	for idx = 1, #flags do
		field_object_util.set_active_state(flags[idx], type)
	end
end

function local_class:hide_mini_game_ui()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(leader, field_ui_type.action_button)
end

function local_class:reset_mini_game_ui()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, field_ui_type.action_button)
end

function local_class:is_myth_character()
	local main_quest_id = 7002201
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(main_quest_id)

	if quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.IsComplete or quest_progress.InnerProgress >= 12 then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end
--endregion custom

		end,
	}

	--endregion FieldObject

	--region Fx

	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		get = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get')
		end,

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_twosword_oppose_spark')

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_mw_booster_fire')

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_noel_racing_screen')

			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_noel_bombbug_booster_contrail')

function item_manager:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
