----Container에서 개별 실행 필요
function item_manager:init_manager(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	--table 형태
	self.common_constants_data = controller.common_constants_data

	self.default_height = self.common_constants_data.default_height

	--아이템 범위
	self.collision_distance = self.common_constants_data.booster_range
	self.booster_size = self.common_constants_data.booster_size
	self.booster_time_limit = self.common_constants_data.booster_time_limit

	--개수
	self.floating_item_count = self.common_constants_data.booster_marker_count

	self.item_name = 'sub_bomb_bug_booster_'

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.item_fo_list = {}

	--region Sprite

	self.sprite = {
		sprite_info = {
			booster_item = 21752,
		},
		sprite_table = {},
		sprite_table_origin_parent = {},
		create = function(this, name, pos, item_id, scale, showoncharacter, target, drop_type, skip_text)
			scale = lua_helper.get_or_default(scale, 1)
			showoncharacter = lua_helper.get_or_default(showoncharacter, false)

			local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = pos, item_id = item_id, show_on_character = showoncharacter,
					  loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter, spr_scale = scale, target = target, drop_type = drop_type, skip_text = skip_text })

			this.sprite_table[name] = item
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = item.SpriteTransform.parent

			return item
		end,
		fly = function(this, name, target)
			this.sprite_table[name].ConsumeTarget = target
			this.sprite_table[name]:Fly()
			this.sprite_table[name] = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
		end,
		size_set = function(this, name, to, duration, from)
			local from = lua_helper.get_or_default(from, 1)
			local time_passed = 0
			local target = this.sprite_table[name]

			-- time_passed값이 duration보다 작을 경우 반복
			while time_passed < duration do
				local progress = interpolations_constants.linear(time_passed, from, to - from, duration)
				target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress

				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			target.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to
			target.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * to

			-- to가 0이 아닐땐 사라지지 않도록
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(to) then
				this:dispose(name)
			end
		end,
		dispose = function(this, name)
			if this.sprite_table[name] then
				if not (this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] == this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform.parent) then
					this.sprite_table[name].SpriteTransform:SetParent(this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name])
				end
				this.sprite_table[name]:Dispose()
				this.sprite_table[name] = nil
				this.sprite_table_origin_parent[name] = nil
			end
		end,
		dispose_all = function(this)
			if this.sprite_table then
				for name, value in pairs(this.sprite_table) do
					if name then
						this:dispose(name)
					end
				end
			end
			this.sprite_table = nil
			this.sprite_table_origin_parent = nil
		end
	}
	--endregion Sprite

	self.fx_list = {}
end

--Container에서 개별 실행 필요
function item_manager:start_routine()
	for idx = 1, self.floating_item_count do
		local target_name = self.item_name .. idx
		local pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.get_marker_pos.booster(idx), self.default_height)

		table.insert(self.item_fo_list, { name = target_name, pos = pos, is_active = true })

		local item = self.sprite:create(target_name, pos,
				self.sprite.sprite_info.booster_item, self.booster_size, false, nil,
				nil, true)

		self.fx_list[target_name] = self.fx.twinkle():Instantiate(pos)

		item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor(self.fx):load_async()

		self:default_speed()
	end)
end

function item_manager:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.controller or self.controller.time_stop then
		return
	end

	-- 시간 업데이트 (중복 조건 제거)
	self.booster_start_time_passed = self.booster_start_time_passed + dt
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 부스터 타이머 체크
	if self.is_booster_update and self.booster_start_time_passed >= self.booster_time_limit then
		self:default_speed()
		self.is_booster_update = false
	end

	-- 아이템 업데이트 (로컬 변수로 캐싱)
	local sprite_table = self.sprite.sprite_table
	local time_sin = unity_class.mathf.Sin(self.time_passed * 2) * 0.2

	for idx = 1, #self.item_fo_list do
		local item_data = self.item_fo_list[idx]

		if item_data.is_active then
			local target_pos = item_data.pos
			local target_name = item_data.name
			-- 충돌 체크
			if self:is_crash_item(target_pos) then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_magic_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_flying_bug_01')

				-- 충돌 효과
				self.fx.get():Instantiate(target_pos)

				-- 부스터 활성화
				self.is_booster_update = true
				self.booster_start_time_passed = 0
				self:booster_speed()

				if self.fx_list[target_name] then
					self.fx_list[target_name]:Dispose()
					self.fx_list[target_name] = nil
				end

				-- 아이템 제거
				item_data.is_active = false
				self.sprite:dispose(item_data.name)
			else
				-- 부유 애니메이션 (활성 아이템만)
				sprite_table[item_data.name].SpriteTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 2.75 + time_sin, 0)
			end
		end
	end
end

function item_manager:reset_setting()
	self:dispose()
	self:clean()
end

function item_manager:clean()
	self.sprite:dispose_all()

	self:fx_dispose_all()
end

function item_manager:is_crash_item(pos)
	local noel = get_party_leader()

	--충돌 체크 (최적화: 제곱근 연산 제거)
	local distance_sq = (vector_util.get_x0z(pos) - vector_util.get_x0z(noel.Position)).sqrMagnitude
	return distance_sq <= (self.collision_distance * self.collision_distance)
end

function item_manager:fx_dispose_all()
	if not self.fx_list then
		return
	end

	for _, target in pairs(self.fx_list) do
		if target then
			target:Dispose()
		end
	end

	self.fx_list = nil
end


--region custom

function item_manager:remove_buffs()
	local noel = get_party_leader()

	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(noel, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, noel, 'speed_cap_racing_default_persistent')
end

--기본 스피드
function item_manager:default_speed()
	local noel = get_party_leader()

	if self.fx_list['contrail'] then
		self.fx_list['contrail']:Dispose()
		self.fx_list['contrail'] = nil
	end

	self.is_default_buff = true

	character_util.remove_emotion(noel)

	self:remove_buffs()

	buff_manager:AddBuff(noel, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None,
			noel, 'speed_cap_racing_default_persistent', 0, false, false)
end

--부스터
function item_manager:booster_speed()
	local noel = get_party_leader()

	if not self.fx_list['contrail'] then
		scene_util.set_emotion(noel, self.controller, 'attack')
		
		self.fx_list['contrail'] = self.fx.booster_contrail():Instantiate(noel.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, noel.Transform)
	end

	self.is_default_buff = false

	self:remove_buffs()
end

--endregion custom

--endregion item_manager

return {
	create = function()
		return item_manager();
	end
}

local container = newclass('BBControllerContainer')

function container:init()
	self.managers = {}
end

function container:register(controller_type, controller)
	if not self.managers[controller_type] then
		self.managers[controller_type] = controller
	end
end

function container:get(controller_type)
	return self.managers[controller_type]
end

function container:update_all(dt)
	for _, manager in pairs(self.managers) do
		if manager.update_frame then
			manager:update_frame(dt)
		end
	end
end

function container:execute_manager_func(function_name, param)
	for _, manager in pairs(self.managers) do
		local execute_func = manager[function_name]
		if execute_func then
			execute_func(manager, param)
		end
	end
end

function container:single_execute_manager_func(manager, function_name, param)
	if not manager then
		return
	end
	
	local execute_func = manager[function_name]
	if execute_func then
		execute_func(manager, param)
	end
end

function container:dispose()
	if not self.managers then
		return
	end
	
	for _, manager in pairs(self.managers) do
		if manager and manager.dispose then
			manager:dispose()
		end
	end

	self.managers = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return container()
	end
}
